Your Role

As a Senior Process Development Engineer – 2D growth, you will lead high-temperature thermal processing, tool qualification and graphene-synthesis baseline development for FabONE.

You will drive the release and optimization of 2D-material growth processes, improve thermal-film properties, and establish stable, repeatable graphene-growth recipes. Working on site in our Aachen cleanroom, you will collaborate with Process Integration and Metrology teams to integrate thermal processes into downstream GFET and optical modules.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead high-temperature process development, layer property mapping and recipe optimization for graphene and other 2D materials

  • Drive tool installation, commissioning, process qualification and system optimization in FabONE

  • Develop, qualify and stabilize repeatable graphene-growth recipes that meet defect-density and film properties specifications

  • Support the integration of graphene growth and transfer processes on target 300 mm substrate wafers

  • Establish SPC baseline charts and routine characterization protocols for daily process monitoring

  • Use Design of Experiments (DOE), SPC and root-cause analysis to improve process performance and resolve process and/or equipment issues

  • Collaborate with Process Integration and Metrology teams on film characterization using techniques such as Raman spectroscopy, optical microscopy, sheet-resistance measurement, AFM and SEM

  • Support inline defect reduction and the continuous improvement of process yield and stability

  • Create SOPs, safety protocols and technical documentation to reduce single-point-of-failure risks

  • Cross-train team members to establish reliable operational coverage for furnace processes

What You Bring

  • Deep expertise in high-temperature furnace operations and thermal processing

  • Hands-on experience with semiconductor process development, process control and baseline stabilization in a cleanroom fab environment

  • Experience with CVD synthesis of graphene or other 2D materials is a strong advantage

  • Experience with Thermal Furnace processes is an advantage

  • A proven track record of commissioning and qualifying process tools and releasing processes into operation

  • Experience using SPC and DOE methodologies, including tools such as JMP or Minitab

  • Familiarity with thin-film characterization techniques, including sheet-resistance measurement, Raman spectroscopy, optical microscopy, AFM or SEM

  • Strong problem-solving and root-cause analysis skills for process and equipment troubleshooting

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across multidisciplinary engineering teams

  • Comfortable working in an ISO 5/6 cleanroom while wearing full cleanroom PPE

  • Comfortable handling wafer cassettes, precursor canisters and high-temperature furnace hardware

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to establish graphene-growth processes for FabONE from qualification through stable operation

  • A hands-on, cleanroom-based role working with high-temperature processing and 2D-material technologies

  • A potential career path towards the Senior IC or Technical Principal track, leading the thermal and 2D-material deposition technology roadmap, or towards engineering management leadership

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

jobs.excerpt: Who we are:At Wagepoint, we're good people.  It's easy to feel that way when you're surrounded by folks doing the best work of their careers, building great payroll software for small businesses across Canada.
jobs.description:
Who we are:

At Wagepoint, we're good people. It's easy to feel that way when you're surrounded by folks doing the best work of their careers, building great payroll software for small businesses across Canada.

Our team brings together diverse backgrounds, perspectives, experiences, and ideas to make payroll the easiest part of running a business.

We're remote-first, growing, and looking for passionate people who don't settle for the first solution or the way it's been done before. We care deeply about our customers and each other, and understand that when it comes to payroll, getting it right matters.

Our values guide how we work and what we expect from one another:

  • Cultivate Impact by focusing on what matters most and delivering meaningful outcomes for our customers.

  • Unify as One Team by collaborating openly, communicating clearly, and rallying around shared goals.

  • Stay Curious and Kind by challenging assumptions, learning quickly, and leading with empathy.

If you want to build the future of payroll in a place where your ideas are welcomed and your contributions matter, look no further!

The role at high level:

We're looking for an experienced Director, Partner Salesto lead Wagepoint's partner channel and drive results across both new partner acquisition and existing partner expansion.

You'll lead the Account Executives responsible for bringing new accounting and bookkeeping firms on board, as well as the Account Managers focused on growing and strengthening our existing partner relationships. You'll be accountable for the team's results, with your primary focus on coaching, developing, and enabling your people to consistently hit and exceed their targets.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll spend most of your time working alongside your team: coaching deals, developing selling skills, inspecting pipeline, improving forecast accuracy, and getting into the field with your reps and partners. You'll also build the plays, processes, and coverage models that help the team execute consistently and scale.

You'll report directly to our VP, Sales and be part of a team focused on growing Wagepoint's partner channel across Canada. This is a Canada-based role with regular in-territory travel alongside the team.

What you'll be expected to own:

  • Own Wagepoint's partner channel results across new partner acquisition and existing channel expansion, driving performance against monthly, quarterly, and yearly targets.

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Account Executives and Account Managers, helping each person build the skills, confidence, and consistency to exceed their targets.

  • Spend meaningful time in deal reviews, call coaching, regular 1:1s, ride-alongs, and joint partner meetings. Coach reps to win their own deals rather than stepping in to close deals for them.

  • Drive pipeline generation across the team, through inbound and outbound activity, ensuring every rep has the pipeline coverage needed to achieve their targets.

  • Establish clear expectations and accountability standards for activity, pipeline generation, CRM hygiene, conversion, and forecast accuracy. Inspect performance regularly and address gaps quickly.

  • Own the team's monthly and quarterly forecasting process, including commit and upside calls, identifying risks, and developing plans to close performance gaps.

  • Lead in the field with your team and in front of partners, including joint meetings, business reviews with top partners, and participation in key accounting industry conferences and association events.

  • Translate Wagepoint's annual partner strategy into clear quarterly plays, offers, incentives, and targets.

  • Partner with Revenue Operations to design territories, assign books of business, establish coverage models, and create clear rules of engagement between Account Executives and Account Managers.

  • Hire, onboard, and develop a high-performing team, including building hiring plans, supporting interview processes, and establishing 30/60/90-day ramp plans.

  • Work closely with Sales Enablement to identify skill gaps, strengthen onboarding, and launch new sales plays that are consistently adopted across the team.

  • Partner with Marketing to influence partner campaigns, events, messaging, and lead flow, ensuring the team has a healthy pipeline of qualified opportunities.

  • Bring partner feedback and market insights to internal stakeholders, helping identify opportunities to improve our offering and remove barriers to partner growth.

  • Maintain clean handoffs from new partner acquisition through onboarding and ongoing account management.

What you bring to the table:

  • 7+ years of experience in B2B sales, with at least 3 years directly managing quota-carrying sales professionals.

  • A track record of achieving team sales targets through coaching, leadership, and performance management, rather than relying on personal sales production.

  • Experience leading both new business acquisition teams (hunters) and account management or expansion teams (farmers).

  • Demonstrated experience hiring, onboarding, developing, and managing the performance of sales professionals, including navigating difficult performance conversations.

  • Strong front-line coaching skills, including deal strategy, call coaching, and helping reps develop their sales capabilities.

  • A disciplined approach to pipeline management, forecasting, activity inspection, and performance measurement.

  • The ability to set clear expectations, hold people accountable, and act quickly when performance falls short.

  • Confidence working in the field alongside sales teams and building relationships with partners.

  • Experience developing simple, repeatable sales plays and getting teams to execute them consistently.

  • A data-driven mindset, with the ability to understand funnel metrics, conversion rates, activity levels, and pipeline coverage.

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, particularly working with Revenue Operations, Sales Enablement, Marketing, and Professional Services.

  • A leadership style that balances high standards and accountability with coaching, empathy, and a genuine commitment to developing people.

Bonus points if:

  • You have experience selling into the accounting and bookkeeping industry or an established network in this space.

  • You have experience in payroll, HCM, or a related industry.

  • You have experience leading partner or channel sales teams.

What we bring to the table:

  • Impact: Dig in and directly contribute to Wagepoint’s growth and success.

  • Culture: Work alongside a team that genuinely enjoys solving problems together, celebrates wins, supports one another through challenges, and still finds time for the occasional terrible joke.

  • Growth: We believe learning is part of the job. We're committed to helping you Get Better Every Day (a representation of our Stay Curious and Kind value!) by offering professional development, new experiences, and career growth as we continue to evolve.

  • Innovation: Curiosity and experimentation encouraged! Bring ideas, challenge assumptions, responsibly utilize AI, and help shape better ways of working.

  • Remote: Work from wherever you do your best work. Wagepoint has always been remote-first, giving you flexibility, autonomy, and hopefully a little extra time with the people (and pets) you love.

Compensation:

An excellent total compensation package with a base salary in the range of CAD $145,000–$162,000 (and OTE range of CAD $240,000–$270,000) along with comprehensive benefits.

Ready to join the team? Apply now and help us continue making payroll the easiest part of running a business.

Next steps:

If this sounds like the right fit, we'd love to hear from you! No need for a formal cover letter, just send us your resume and if you'd like, a few lines about what excites you about the opportunity.

If we agree it's a great match, someone from our team will reach out to schedule a call.

Psssst!

In 2026, we were recognized as one of Canada's Best Workplaces for Mental Wellness and Inclusion. That commitment extends to our hiring process, where we strive to create an experience that is welcoming, respectful, and inclusive from day one.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, identities, and perspectives, and we're committed to building a workplace where everyone can thrive.

As a remote company, all interviews are conducted virtually. If you require accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know. We're happy to support you!

True Zero Technologies, a veteran-owned small business, was founded on the principle that the purposeful enablement of people and technology in an organization directly ties to the quality of its outcomes. True Zero recognizes that those outcomes begin and end with our people, and that is what we have built a community of like-minded, driven, and passionate individuals and innovators who are aligned in a common goal of delivering top-tier services to our customers. In addition, True Zero earned coveted spots on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing companies in America in 2022, 2023, and 2025, a testament to our sustained growth driven by our people-first approach and unwavering dedication to excellence.

Position Overview

True Zero Technologies is seeking an experienced Senior System Architect to lead the design, development, and implementation of enterprise IT, cloud, and cybersecurity architectures within complex federal environments. This senior-level position is responsible for developing secure, scalable, and resilient technology solutions that align with organizational objectives, federal security requirements, and enterprise architecture standards. The role will provide technical leadership across system modernization, cloud infrastructure, Zero Trust architecture, DevSecOps, and the integration of enterprise cybersecurity technologies.

The ideal candidate will possess extensive experience in enterprise systems architecture, cloud computing, and cybersecurity engineering, with deep technical expertise in AWS environments, security platform integration, and large-scale system design. The candidate must demonstrate strong architectural leadership, strategic planning capabilities, and the ability to collaborate with technical teams and federal stakeholders to deliver secure, high-performing enterprise solutions.

Job Responsibilities

    Job Responsibilities

  • Enterprise Systems Architecture & Technical Leadership: Lead the design, development, and implementation of enterprise IT, operational, technical, and information architectures, ensuring solutions align with organizational strategies, customer requirements, leadership priorities, and established enterprise architecture standards.
  • Cloud Architecture & Infrastructure Modernization: Design, validate, and implement scalable, secure, and resilient cloud-based and hybrid infrastructure solutions, including AWS and AWS GovCloud environments. Provide architectural guidance for cloud migration, infrastructure modernization, containerized platforms, and performance optimization across business-critical systems.
  • Cybersecurity Architecture & Zero Trust Integration: Develop and validate enterprise security architectures aligned with Zero Trust principles, NIST SP 800-207, and applicable federal cybersecurity requirements. Support the integration of SIEM, SOAR, CDM, TDSP, EDR, identity management, and AWS cloud-native security capabilities across complex enterprise environments.
  • DevSecOps & Secure Application Architecture: Design and maintain secure CI/CD pipelines, DevSecOps infrastructure, and application architectures, incorporating security controls throughout the software development lifecycle. Support containerized workloads, Kubernetes environments, and secure application deployment strategies to improve operational efficiency and system security.
  • Architecture Documentation, Standards & Governance: Lead the development and maintenance of Engineering Design Documents (EDDs), architecture blueprints, technical specifications, security control mappings, and enterprise architecture standards. Participate in architecture governance boards and technical working groups to validate design decisions, evaluate proposed technologies, and ensure architectural compliance.
  • System Integration, Engineering & Performance Optimization: Evaluate existing systems, infrastructure, and security technologies to identify architectural gaps, performance limitations, and opportunities for improvement. Design and oversee the implementation of integrated systems that support interoperability, scalability, operational efficiency, and enterprise security objectives.
  • Technical Project Management & Stakeholder Collaboration: Provide architectural oversight for multiple concurrent IT and cybersecurity initiatives, coordinating with business owners, system engineers, developers, infrastructure teams, security personnel, and federal stakeholders. Develop technical proposals, communicate architectural recommendations, manage design priorities, and ensure successful implementation of enterprise technology solutions within established timelines.

Job Requirements

    Job Requirements

  • Cybersecurity & Enterprise Architecture Experience: Minimum of 12 years of progressive experience supporting cybersecurity and information technology environments, including enterprise systems architecture, technical engineering, security solution design, and integration of complex business-critical systems. Demonstrated ability to lead large-scale architectural initiatives, manage multiple concurrent priorities, and deliver solutions within strict deadlines.
  • Cloud Architecture Experience & AWS Certification: Minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience designing, implementing, or supporting cloud-based solutions, including AWS infrastructure and services. Must possess an active AWS Certified Solutions Architect certification (Associate or Professional), with additional AWS certifications considered advantageous. Experience with AWS GovCloud, Amazon EKS, Amazon ECS, and containerized application environments is required.
  • Enterprise Security Technologies & Zero Trust Architecture: Strong technical understanding of enterprise cybersecurity architectures and security technologies, including SIEM, SOAR, EDR, CDM, penetration testing capabilities, DevSecOps, Identity and Access Management (IAM), and cloud-native security services. Demonstrated experience designing secure architectures aligned with Zero Trust principles, NIST SP 800-207, and applicable federal cybersecurity frameworks.
  • Systems Engineering, Software Development & Architecture Governance: Proven experience across the software development, enhancement, and maintenance lifecycle, including secure application architecture, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure design, system integration, and technical documentation. Ability to develop Engineering Design Documents, architecture blueprints, security control mappings, and scalable technical solutions while applying modern engineering practices and enterprise architecture standards.
  • Security Clearance, Technical Leadership & Communication: Must possess and maintain a Non-Sensitive / High Risk Public Trust security clearance (Tier 4/6c). Demonstrated ability to perform complex technical tasks, evaluate emerging technologies, lead technical design discussions, and communicate architectural strategies effectively to engineering teams, organizational leadership, and federal stakeholders. Excellent written and verbal communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills are required.

jobs.description:
Who Are Massive Rocket?

Massive Rocket is a rapidly scaling Braze and Snowflake agency on a mission to transform how digital marketing, product, and engineering teams connect. In just five years, we’ve grown at speed and are now gearing up for our next big milestone: hitting $100M in revenue. We build human experiences at scale, powered by cutting‑edge web, mobile, cloud, data, and AI technologies. If you’re excited by innovation, love solving complex challenges, and want to help shape the future of digital experiences, you’ll feel right at home here.

Every role at Massive Rocket is entrepreneurial. The people who thrive here don’t just focus on their own remit — they understand the goals of the teams around them and actively contribute to the success of their colleagues, customers, and partners. We’re building a culture of ownership, collaboration, and growth, and we’re looking for people who want to make a real impact.

Who Are We Looking to Add to Our Team?

As a Senior CRM Data Analyst at Massive Rocket, you’ll be the single, hands-on owner of analytics for your client accounts. You’ll take a request from the client’s first message all the way to a readout without supervision, and your insights, outcomes reporting and strategic perspective will be something both our CRM team and our clients can trust.

You’ll be part of our data team and work inside a CRM pod, where the pod’s Lead Consultant sets day-to-day priorities. You’ll partner closely with the Lead and Senior Consultants on the account, Account Management and Project Management, as well as the client’s marketing, loyalty and data teams. Your focus is analysis, insight and reporting rather than Braze builds, campaign execution or data engineering.

You’ll thrive here if you care about every number being right, can turn analysis into recommendations people can act on, and know when a request fits the agreed hours and when it needs scoping as a project.

What Will You Do?

  • Own the analytics workstream on your accounts, running request intake and prioritisation within the agreed hours and flagging early when a request is project-sized
  • Act as the client’s go-to contact for data questions, testing whether each question is framed fairly before you run the analysis
  • Write production-quality SQL in the client’s warehouse (Snowflake, Databricks or similar) and develop the transformation logic behind your analysis
  • Trace data lineage, fix gaps in existing reports, SQL and data events, and reconcile metrics across systems, including the client’s analytics tool (Amplitude, GA4)
  • Run cohort, behavioural and decomposition analysis on transaction and loyalty data, covering first vs repeat purchase, ATV, revenue, frequency, retention, LTV and offers
  • Build or use propensity and segmentation models, and connect insights on segments, offers, channels and seasonality to revenue, efficiency and cost savings
  • Design and report on tests independently, from sample size and holdout design to incremental uplift and results by segment, using AI to make your analysis and testing faster and more effective
  • Build and maintain dashboards in the client’s BI tool (Power BI, Tableau, Looker or similar) and own the KPI definitions behind them
  • Validate and document every figure before it reaches the client, and present findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders in clear, strategic stories
  • Review other analysts’ SQL, coach consultants on using data, manage 1–2 junior analysts as the team grows, and build reusable assets that work across accounts

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Production-quality SQL in Snowflake or another cloud warehouse (Databricks, Redshift or similar)
  • Experience building dashboards and reporting in a BI tool such as Power BI or Tableau, plus advanced Excel
  • Experience with a product or digital analytics tool (Amplitude, GA4, Mixpanel)
  • Hands-on cohort and behavioural analysis on customer, transaction or loyalty data
  • A strong grasp of data quality, validation and governance
  • Experimentation and statistics in Python or R, including test design, sample size, significance and incremental uplift
  • Experience building or using a propensity or segmentation model, such as recency and frequency tiers or 90/180/365-day activity tiers
  • CRM, loyalty or customer analytics experience, with the commercial sense to challenge a flawed question
  • Clear client-facing English, with the ability to explain findings to non-technical audiences in writing and in person

Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience with Braze, SFMC or Adobe Campaign, and an understanding of how segments and insights are used in them
  • Experience with a CDP such as Hightouch, Segment or similar
  • QSR, restaurant or retail experience
  • Uplift modelling experience
  • Agency or consultancy experience (in-house candidates who work closely with stakeholders are very welcome too)

Why You’ll Love Working Here

Rocket‑Fuelled Growth – Big challenges, fast learning, and the chance to level up quicker than anywhere else

A Culture That Actually Gives a Damn – Supportive, positive, and built around people who want to see you win

A Global Crew – Collaborate with brilliant teammates across Europe, the US, and beyond

Remote‑First for Life – Work from wherever you feel your best

Real Career Momentum – Clear progression, real ownership, and space to grow into your next chapter

jobs.excerpt: Black Duck Software, Inc.  helps organizations build secure, high-quality software, minimizing risks while maximizing speed and productivity.
jobs.description:
Black Duck Software, Inc. helps organizations build secure, high-quality software, minimizing risks while maximizing speed and productivity. Black Duck, a recognized pioneer in application security, provides SAST, SCA, and DAST solutions that enable teams to quickly find and fix vulnerabilities and defects in proprietary code, open source components, and application behavior. With a combination of industry-leading tools, services, and expertise, only Black Duck helps organizations maximize security and quality in DevSecOps and throughout the software development life cycle.

Lead Product Security

Job Title: Lead Product Security

Reports to (Direct Title): Director of Security Operations

Department: Cybersecurity

Position Summary

The Lead Product Security is the senior technical authority for how security is designed into Black Duck products. Operating with broad autonomy under general guidance, the role will lead secure architecture and design reviews, contribute to the threat modeling methodology, and set the standards and design gates that define what secure-by-default means for our engineering teams. A core part of the role is scaling security capability rather than absorbing security work: the role will help mature and evolve the Security Champions program, mentor engineers and less experienced security staff, and build the enablement content that lets product teams reason about security themselves. The Lead Product Security will also drive deep secure code review in high-risk areas, support external security assessments, partner with PSIRT on product vulnerability response, and measure product security maturity to guide a prioritized improvement roadmap.

Essential Functions/Responsibilities

  • Lead security architecture and design reviews for Black Duck SCA, Coverity, and adjacent product lines, delivering actionable feedback before implementation begins.
  • Contribute to the threat modeling methodology and help scale its adoption: coach engineers to run their own models and review outputs, rather than serving as the sole modeler.
  • Define security requirements, design gates, and product security baselines that give engineering a testable definition of secure-by-default.
  • Build and measure the secure development lifecycle across SCA, SAST, secret scanning (GitGuardian), dependency hygiene, and build pipeline integrity.
  • Perform deep secure code review on high-risk areas including authentication, authorization, cryptography, secrets handling, and input validation.
  • Secure the product supply chain and release process, including SBOM generation and the integrity of build and distribution artifacts.
  • Help mature and evolve the Security Champions program: recruit champions across product teams, grow the training and enablement curriculum, run office hours, and report on participation and outcomes.
  • Mentor engineers and less experienced security staff on secure design, secure code review, and threat modeling, growing capability across the organization rather than absorbing the work.
  • Assist with the scoping and coordination of penetration tests and third-party security assessments; triage findings and drive remediation to closure with engineering owners.
  • Partner with PSIRT on triage and fix coordination for internally discovered and externally reported product vulnerabilities, feeding root causes back into design and SDLC controls.
  • Measure product security maturity using BSIMM or SAMM style assessment and drive a prioritized improvement roadmap.
  • Support EU Cyber Resilience Act secure-by-design and vulnerability handling obligations with the technical evidence and process changes engineering needs.
  • Provide technical subject matter expertise on customer security questionnaires, audit requests, and security escalations, drafting accurate answers, gathering evidence from engineering, and building a reusable knowledge base of vetted responses.
  • Support incident response for issues that touch product code, build systems, or product infrastructure, contributing product-specific context and remediation guidance.
  • Lead discrete workstreams within larger product security initiatives, track milestones in Jira, and provide technical input into application security tooling evaluations and POCs.
  • Other tasks and activities as assigned.

Required Education/Experience & Skills

  • Awareness of AI and LLM security risks such as prompt injection, sensitive data exposure, and the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8+ years of experience in product security, application security, or software security engineering, with hands-on depth in secure design review, threat modeling, and secure code review.
  • Demonstrated experience building or running a security champions program, developer enablement initiative, or equivalent effort that scaled security capability across engineering teams.
  • Working knowledge of application security tooling (SCA, SAST, DAST, secret scanning), the vulnerability classes each detects, and where each produces false positives.
  • Practical secure coding and review experience in at least one language used in commercial software products, with the ability to read unfamiliar code and reason about security impact.
  • Experience defining security requirements, standards, or design gates that engineering teams actually adopted.
  • Familiarity with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) from a product security perspective, including container and infrastructure-as-code security.
  • Experience coordinating penetration tests or third-party security assessments and driving findings through to remediation.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and lead technical workstreams without formal direct-report authority.
  • Practical use of AI and LLM tools to accelerate day-to-day security work (secure code review, investigation, documentation), with sound judgment about when AI-generated output requires human validation before it is shared, shipped, or acted on.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical security topics to engineers, security peers, and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience contributing to a Product Security Incident Response Team (PSIRT) or equivalent product vulnerability response process, including CVSS scoring and coordinated disclosure, is a plus.
  • Familiarity with product security maturity models (BSIMM, SAMM) or secure-by-design regulatory requirements such as the EU Cyber Resilience Act is a plus.
  • Industry certifications such as CSSLP, CISSP, GWAPT, OSWE, or cloud security equivalents are a plus.
  • Experience supporting customer security questionnaires, RFPs, or third-party risk assessments is a plus.

Physical Requirements

General office environment and responsibilities requiring:

  • Extensive use of the computer which involves viewing a monitor and keyboarding for most of the workday
  • Placing and receiving phone calls
  • Occasionally moving and lifting objects up to 20 pounds

May require some travel as needed

$117,000—$150,000 CAD

jobs.title: Senior SoC Architect (f/m/d)
jobs.excerpt: About usWe see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility.
jobs.description:
About us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

The Role

We are seeking a skilled Senior SoC Architect at Black Semiconductor to drive the architecture of our entire Electronics-Photonics IC (EPIC) SoC, translating the Marketing Requirement Document (MRD) into a complete, internally consistent, and implementable Product Requirement Document (PRD) covering digital, analog, I/O, and memory subsystems.

You will own the digital and high-speed I/O subsystem architecture directly, with particular depth in high-speed SerDes and the protocol digital logic for UCIe, PCIe, and Ethernet. Working closely with the Analog/RF System Architect, Photonics System Architect, Package Electrical/SI Architect, memory subsystem owner, product management, and engineering teams, you will integrate their subsystem architectures into one coherent overall product architecture.

To join our team, you should be excited to

  • Own the overall EPIC SoC technical leadership from initial concept through production and drive cross-functional technical alignment across photonics, analog, digital, technology, and product teams.

  • Build and document the overall product architecture, translating the MRD into a complete PRD and ensuring architectural decisions, technical requirements, dependencies, and trade-offs are consistently aligned across teams.

  • Own the digital subsystem architecture, including core logic, on-chip interconnect fabric, and subsystem partitioning.

  • Own the high-speed I/O subsystem architecture, with particular depth in high-speed SerDes and the protocol digital logic for UCIe, PCIe, and Ethernet, including how protocol layers map onto the physical SerDes implementation.

  • Partner with the Analog/RF System Architect, Photonics System Architect, Package Electrical/SI Architect, and memory subsystem owner to integrate their architectures and ensure the full-chip architecture is internally consistent and feasible within the target electrical, physical, and packaging constraints.

  • Drive full-chip performance, power, and area (PPA) trade-off analysis, partner with external vendors/3rd-party IP providers on full-chip validation and characterization teams on product characterization, and make the calls needed to keep the PRD internally consistent.

  • Present the integrated architecture and PRD to product management and engineering leadership and own it through to sign-off.

Your Qualifications

Essential

  • 7–10 years of experience in SoC or product architecture roles, with proven SoC/product architecture ownership and demonstrated experience taking a product from MRD-level requirements through a complete, implementable PRD-level architecture covering multiple subsystems and at least one full product architecture cycle.

  • Deep, hands-on high-speed I/O subsystem expertise, particularly high-speed SerDes and the protocol digital logic for UCIe, PCIe, and Ethernet, including how protocol requirements shape physical-layer architecture.

  • Strong digital subsystem and interconnect fabric architecture experience, including defining on-chip interconnect and digital subsystem partitioning for a complex SoC.

  • Strong cross-domain integration skills, with the ability to take analog, photonic, packaging, and memory architecture input from peer subsystem owners and integrate it into one internally consistent PRD without needing to personally own those domains.

  • Experience translating marketing/product-level requirements into precise, engineering-actionable architecture specifications and reasoning about full-chip performance, power, and area (PPA) trade-offs.

  • Experience with 3rd-party IP vendors, including evaluating and selecting external IPs and design integration partners.

  • Experience with architecture specification and requirements management tooling for authoring and maintaining the PRD and tracing it back to the MRD; UCIe, PCIe, and Ethernet protocol/standards documentation and compliance tooling; architecture and performance modeling tools, including custom or commercial full-chip performance/power models; Python / C++ for modeling, scripting, and analysis; and collaboration and documentation platforms for coordinating input from analog, photonics, packaging, memory, and other subsystem architects into a single PRD.

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience serving as an SoC Chief Engineer, with end-to-end accountability for a product's full-chip architecture, schedule, and quality outcomes.

  • Familiarity with silicon photonics or electro-optic I/O, and how it changes traditional I/O subsystem architecture assumptions.

  • Familiarity with advanced packaging, including 2.5D/3D and chiplet integration, and its impact on full-chip architecture choices.

  • Experience working directly with product management and/or customers to shape MRD-level requirements.

  • Experience with CXL or other die-to-die/coherent interconnect standards adjacent to UCIe/PCIe.

Our work culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry

Remote (With 3 in-person meetings in Columbus, OH per year)

Firefly is an insurance agency with more than 200 branches around the country. Our Operations Department works with our agents and insurance company partners to ensure licensing compliance, maintain agent access to agency and carrier systems, and to pay agent commissions on time and accurately.

The Opportunity

We are looking for someone to join our Operations team as an Operations Specialist to help our team maintain agent carrier appointments, ensure carrier website access, monitor compliance of agent licenses, assist with agent onboarding, act as an admin of our Agency Management System (we use EZLynx), and help our team prepare and process agent commissions.

This job is great for an “insurance nerd”: someone who loves both the insurance industry and technology. Our team loves finding creative ways to use software and automations to get work done.

Please note: If you get this job, you’ll do your daily work from home. However, Firefly holds three required in-person meetings each year in Columbus, Ohio. We know from experience that proximity to Columbus matters. That’s why we’re looking for candidates who live in one of these states:

  • Ohio
  • Illinois
  • Indiana
  • Georgia
  • Kentucky
  • Michigan
  • North Carolina
  • Pennsylvania
  • Tennessee
  • West Virginia

You will need to have your own high-speed internet connection and a distraction-free place where you can do your work. Firefly will provide the tools you need to work effectively from home, including a computer, software phone, email, task management, electronic documents, and website access. This position requires you to have a high comfort level working in a paperless environment.

What You’ll Do

  • Carrier Appointments and Access
    • Manage the carrier appointments of our agent and producer force.
    • Help agents maintain access to carrier websites and tools.
  • Compliance
    • Maintain records of the Insurance Licenses of our agents.
    • Monitor the status of agent E&O coverage to ensure regulatory compliance.
  • Agency Management System Admin
    • Firefly uses EZLynx as our Agency Management System (AMS).
    • Act as an AMS admin to create new branches and user accounts, oversee downloads, and manage user settings.
    • Run reports to assist with projects and carrier changes.
    • Help us keep our book of business organized.
  • Commissions and Charges
    • Help our team make sure agents are paid accurately and on time.
    • Help gather monthly commission statements from our carrier partners.
    • Help match operating costs incurred by our agent force with the correct branch. These costs include things like charges for MVR or CLUE reports, software subscriptions, etc.
  • Agency acquisitions and book transfers
    • Facilitate onboarding of acquired agencies into Firefly, and other book transfer requests.
    • Identify operational challenges and process gaps and outline recommendations for resolution.
    • Support post-acquisition employee onboarding

Who is a Good Fit For This Position?

We are looking for someone who has experience with insurance agency operations. You’re a good fit if you are curious about how systems connect, are eager to learn, and take pride in delivering consistent and reliable outcomes.

Must Have

  • Relevant work experience in the insurance industry, which could include:
    • Experience working in an insurance agency, either as a producer, CSR, or office manager.
    • Experience working for an insurance company, either in a licensing, commissions, or sales support
    • Experience working for company that provides services to insurance agents or insurance companies.
  • You must love using technology to make work simpler, faster, and more consistent. Our Operations team uses a lot of automations and technology “short cuts” to getting work done.

It Helps To Have

  • Excel proficiency – Our team deals with a lot of data and reports. Familiarity with Excel would allow you to achieve outcomes quicker. (Bonus points if you have experience with Excel’s Power Query tool to access data from cloud databases.)
  • Familiarity with EZLynx or other Agency Management System, either as a user or admin.
  • Familiarity with the basics of insurance agent licensing practices.
  • Experience working with process automation tools. Our team uses Microsoft’s Power Automate every day in our workflows to get more work done with faster and more consistent outcomes.

About Firefly

We are a mid-sized insurance agency network with more than 200 branches nationwide. We help independent agents grow their businesses by giving them access to top-rated carriers, advanced technology, and support systems that make their work easier and more rewarding.

We’re a process-driven organization that uses technology and automation-assisted workflows to deliver consistent, high-quality results for both our team and our agents.

Our culture defines the way we act with each other and our customers. Our culture is built on four values: Transparency, Doing What’s Right, Teamwork, Empathy and Stretching for amazing. We live these values daily as we work with each other and with our agents. Firefly’s team is professional, fast-growing, and technology-driven — but also fun and people-focused.

jobs.description:
Role Title: English Language Expert (Australia & New Zealand)

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Australia or New Zealand, Remote

micro1 is engaging English Language Experts (Australia & New Zealand) to contribute to a dynamic linguistic project for a valued customer. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input.

Scope of Work

  1. Listen to multi-speaker conversational audio recordings, identifying and tagging key speaker and audio metadata such as dialect, accent, audio quality, background noise, age, and speaking style.
  2. Annotate and correct first-pass ASR (Automatic Speech Recognition) transcripts, ensuring precise application of Australian and New Zealand English spelling, usage, and conventions.
  3. Utilize your knowledge of Australian and New Zealand accents, including General, Broad, and Cultivated Australian English, Aboriginal English, Māori English, Pasifika-influenced English, and regional and community varieties such as those shaped by Italian, Greek, Vietnamese, and Lebanese heritage communities, to accurately identify and categorize dialectal features. Distinguish between Australian and New Zealand speakers, including features such as the New Zealand short-front vowel shift.
  4. Apply your knowledge of Australian and New Zealand English vocabulary, idioms, slang, code-switching (such as the use of Māori words and phrases in everyday New Zealand English), and spelling to enhance the linguistic accuracy of project data.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Fluent proficiency in Australian and/or New Zealand English, with demonstrated familiarity across multiple dialects and regional accents.
  2. Background in language teaching, linguistics, transcription, editing, translation, journalism, or a related discipline.
  3. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a meticulous approach to language variation and usage.
  4. Ability to distinguish subtle differences in Australian and New Zealand English pronunciation and vocabulary, including differences between the two varieties.
  5. Experience working with audio data, metadata tagging, or transcription practices is beneficial.
  6. Adaptable, detail-oriented, and able to manage complex annotation guidelines independently.
  7. Interest in linguistic technology, AI training, or language data projects is a plus.

We are seeking a clinically-adept and highly experienced Director of Partner Operations to lead the strategic management and operational success of our key hospital and health system partnerships.

The Role

    This pivotal role requires a strong fusion of clinical knowledge, expert project management, and strategic account leadership to drive the successful implementation, adoption, and ongoing clinical value realization of our programs within complex hospital environments. You will be the dedicated operational and strategic leader, ensuring seamless integration and achieving defined clinical and operational outcomes.

What You’ll Do

    1. Strategic Partnership & Clinical Engagement

    2. Account Ownership: Serve as the dedicated operational lead for assigned hospital system partners, owning overall relationship health, partner satisfaction, and driving the achievement of established clinical outcomes.
    3. Deep Clinical Integration: Engage directly with hospital department leads, CMOs, CNOs, and operational leaders to understand clinical pathways and ensure seamless integration of our programs into existing hospital workflows.
    4. Value Realization: Proactively identify growth opportunities by continuously demonstrating the clinical and economic ROI of the partnership to executive stakeholders.
    5. Relationship Cultivation: Build and maintain high-trust, long-term relationships with mid-to-senior level hospital executives.

    6. Program/Project Implementation Leadership

    7. End-to-End Management: Lead and execute the full project lifecycle for new partner implementations, including detailed planning, resource allocation, and risk management.
    8. Implementation Oversight: Drive the clinical and operational onboarding process, ensuring rapid time-to-value and smooth integration with hospital IT/EMR systems.
    9. Cross-Functional Coordination: Act as the primary operational hub, expertly coordinating internal teams (Product, Clinical Ops, Technology) to meet partner commitments and milestones.

    10. Operational Performance & Governance

    11. Performance Tracking: Oversee performance governance, and present regular, data-driven operational and clinical health reports to executive stakeholders, both internal and external.
    12. Issue Resolution: Act as the highest-level operational escalation point, managing and resolving complex clinical workflow issues swiftly to minimize disruption.
    13. Analytics & Strategy: Translate performance reports and KPIs into actionable strategic plans and operational adjustments necessary to meet or exceed targets.

What You’ll Bring

  • Clinical Background: Active or prior experience as a Registered Nurse (RN), Paramedic, or Social Worker is strongly preferred.
  • Hospital Experience: Deep, demonstrable understanding of hospital clinical workflows, service line operations, and the financial/operational challenges of acute care delivery.
  • Attention to Detail: Exceptional organizational skills and a high attention to detail in navigating complex clinical environments and implementation plans.
  • Experience: 5+ years of progressive experience in strategic account management, partner operations, or complex project management specifically within the hospital/health system space.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Management, Clinical Sciences (e.g., Nursing, Allied Health), or a related field.
  • Project Leadership: Proven expertise in leading and managing large-scale, complex implementation projects.
    Executive Communication: Exceptional executive-level communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with proven ability to influence hospital administrators and clinical leadership.
  • Travel: Ability to travel up to 25-50% to manage critical partner relationships and implementations.
  • Preferred: Located in the greater New Orleans metropolitan area

Why choose myLaurel?

    We offer a competitive compensation package and a mission-driven culture focused on growth, collaboration, and patient care.
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance
  • Work-Life Balance: Generous Discretionary Time Off (DTO) and paid holidays
  • Financial Wellness: 401(k) retirement plan
  • Impact: The opportunity to be on the ground floor of a transformative healthcare model that keeps patients out of the hospital and in their homes

About myLaurel

myLaurel was founded on the belief that a meaningful portion of hospital care can, and should, be delivered in the comfort of home. As a tech-enabled medical group, we provide on-demand acute and transitional care to frail, elderly, or medically complex patients at home - helping them avoid the traditional pathway of ambulance, emergency department, hospital admission, and post-acute facility care.

Health systems, payers, and provider groups partner with myLaurel to reduce avoidable utilization, lower readmission rates, accelerate throughput, and improve the patient experience - all while maintaining the highest standards of clinical quality and safety. We stand behind our outcomes by putting our fees at risk, demonstrating both accountability and confidence in the results we deliver.

Care is delivered through a physician-led model that combines virtual oversight with in-home clinicians, advanced technology, diagnostics, and therapies. For high-risk populations, myLaurel achieves 33% lower ED utilization, a 49% absolute reduction in readmissions, and an average of 15 bed-days saved daily - alongside a Net Promoter Score of 97.

JOB PURPOSE:

The Retention Marketing Strategist (Email & SMS, Ecommerce) aka Client Strategist exists to develop and implement data-driven marketing strategies tailored to client needs, ensuring a positive client experience and maximizing campaign performance. In our Pod structure, you are the strategic brain and operational lead of a self-contained client delivery unit. This role focuses on client-facing interactions, strategic planning, and ongoing optimization to drive business growth. You will own client outcomes, lead the pod's delivery, and be the primary strategic voice for the client.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES & ACCOUNTABILITIES:

  • Account Performance: Own the performance of your accounts against revenue forecasts and retention KPIs. Regularly audit active flows, track campaign revenue contributions, and monitor leading retention metrics like repurchase rates.

  • Strategy Development & Prioritisation: Maintain a living gameplan for each account. Collaborate with clients to understand their business needs and objectives. Decide high-leverage priorities and articulate the retention logic behind every initiative.

  • Pod Coordination & Operational Leadership: Direct your pod (Activations Specialist, Designer, Copywriter) effectively. Provide clear briefs, manage production timelines, and lead weekly standups to catch blockers early.

  • Client Communication & Relationship Management: Lead strategic check-ins, communicate proactively about performance, and translate complex retention data into clear business outcomes. Develop and maintain strong client relationships to drive an overall positive client experience.

  • Quality Ownership: Take ultimate accountability for all copy, creative, and flow builds before they reach the client. Ensure consistent brand voice, segment logic, and strategic alignment across the account.

  • Growth & Thought Leadership: Upsell and cross-sell additional services to clients to enhance their marketing efforts. Share industry insights and information with marketing to position the company as a thought leader.

SUCCESS MEASURES:

    • Pod members receive clear briefs and work flows smoothly through production on time.

    • Account Health Reports are updated accurately and standups are led with preparation.

    • Client communication is proactive, not reactive.

  • Medium-Term (3–6 months):

    • Accounts are consistently hitting or exceeding retention benchmarks (NPS, Net Revenue Retention).

    • You are proactively identifying strategic opportunities, not just managing existing execution tasks.

    • Clients view you as a trusted strategic partner, and pod members trust your direction.

    • Managerial intervention is significantly minimized.

KEY QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Relevant Experience: 5+ years of experience in email marketing, SMS marketing, push notification, client strategy, account management, or a similar strategic role, preferably within a digital marketing, e-commerce, or creative agency. Klaviyo and Shopify proficiency is a plus.

  • Strategic & Analytical Thinking: Proven ability to analyze performance data, identify growth opportunities, and translate complex metrics into actionable strategies that drive Net Revenue Retention (NRR) and client success.

  • Client Relationship Mastery: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a demonstrated track record of building deep trust, managing expectations proactively, and acting as a true strategic partner rather than just an order-taker.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Experience guiding and collaborating with internal execution teams (or "pods"). Ability to write clear briefs, streamline workflows, and ensure projects are delivered on time and to standard.

  • Project & Account Management: Strong organizational skills with the ability to juggle multiple client accounts simultaneously, maintain accurate Account Health Reports, and lead effective stand-ups.

    Industry Expertise: A solid understanding of digital marketing principles, e-commerce trends, and customer lifecycle strategies to provide high-level, relevant advice to clients.

jobs.description:
About Mindset Care, Inc.

Mindset was founded to create a better experience for those with a mental illness and their caregivers in applying for Social Security Disability benefits.

Our team of Social Security Disability lawyers and representatives has helped thousands of individuals through the arduous process of obtaining Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI) and/or Supplemental Security income (SSI) through the Social Security Administration.

Mindset is seeking an empathetic, detail-oriented SSD Eligibility Specialist to serve as a trusted first point of contact for prospective clients. This role conducts structured phone assessments, gathers sensitive medical and employment information, explains the Social Security Disability (SSD) intake and application process—including SSI and SSDI—and maintains complete, accurate records. The ideal candidate combines direct SSD or disability-benefits experience with strong client service, sound judgment, organization, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced remote environment.

Due to this being a remote role, you’ll need a reliable internet connection with speeds of at least 100 Mbps download and 30 Mbps upload, a comfortable place to work, and a backup plan for occasional internet outages. We will provide your MacBook as well as a headset, keyboard, and monitor as needed. You will be responsible for maintaining a setup that supports a productive workday. During scheduled working hours, employees must be able to perform the position’s essential duties and meet its attendance, availability, productivity, confidentiality, and performance expectations, subject to approved leave, reasonable accommodations, and applicable law.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Conduct structured telephone intake and eligibility assessments to understand each client’s medical, employment, and service needs.
  • Collect, verify, and document sensitive client information accurately, completely, and confidentially.
  • Explain Mindset’s services and next steps in clear, compassionate language.
  • Support clients who may be distressed, overwhelmed, or unfamiliar with the SSI/SSDI process.
  • Manage inbound and outbound calls, follow-up tasks, and multiple priorities while meeting quality and productivity expectations.
  • Maintain accurate client records in case management, CRM, or related systems.
  • Coordinate with case management and other internal teams to ensure a smooth client handoff.
  • Follow privacy, security, and documentation requirements.
  • Participate in coaching, training, quality review, and team meetings.
  • Apply critical thinking to analyze intake information, assess the reported severity of a claimant’s conditions and their impact on daily functioning and ability to work, and identify appropriate follow-up questions.
  • All other duties as assigned by the leadership team.

Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated experience in intake, phone-based customer service, client support, healthcare, public benefits, case support, or a comparable role.
  • Direct experience supporting Social Security Disability (SSD) claims—including SSI and SSDI intake, eligibility screening, medical and work history collection, and application preparation.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and a consistent record of accurate documentation.
  • Empathy, professionalism, and sound judgment when discussing sensitive medical and financial circumstances.
  • Ability to organize follow-up work, multitask, and prioritize in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, including the ability to connect medical information to reported functional limitations, identify gaps or inconsistencies, ask appropriate follow-up questions, and explain complex processes in plain language.
  • Comfort working independently and reliably in a remote environment.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace and the ability to learn new systems.
  • Reliable internet connection for remote work.
  • High school diploma or equivalent, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with case management, client advocacy, benefits navigation, or eligibility screening.
  • Experience managing a high volume of inbound and outbound client calls.
  • Experience using CRM, case-management, EHR, virtual phone, or online scheduling systems.
  • Spanish-language proficiency is helpful but not required.
  • A college degree is not required; relevant experience and demonstrated capability are valued.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Clients feel heard, respected, and confident about their next steps.
  • Intake records are complete, accurate, and submitted on time.
  • Complex SSD, SSI, and SSDI processes are explained clearly and consistently.
  • Follow-up tasks are managed reliably without sacrificing quality.
  • Quality and productivity expectations are met in a fast-paced remote environment.
  • The Eligibility Specialist collaborates effectively and responds positively to coaching.

Schedule:

  • 8 hours per day, 5 days a week, with overtime availability as needed.

Benefits:

  • Remote-first policy.
  • Meaningful responsibility from the start.
  • Opportunities for growth within the company.
  • A creative, transparent team committed to accomplishing Mindset’s mission.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

Overview

You'll own the creative engine behind one of iwoca's highest-growth channels. Your mission is to turn performance insights into a steady stream of ads that actually cut through in a category where most look the same, building the creative infrastructure that fuels scalable, measurable growth across Meta, TikTok, and beyond.

About iwoca

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don't wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that's as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science, and five-star customer service ensure business owners can act with the speed, confidence, and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We've already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The Team

The Direct Acquisition team at iwoca acquires customers profitably across paid and organic channels. Paid Social is one of our highest-growth channels - we've validated the opportunity, proven incrementality through conversion lift studies, and scaled from test budgets to six-figure monthly spend across Meta and TikTok.

Creative is the core growth lever for the channel. We've learnt that the ad is the targeting, that creator-led content significantly outperforms traditional UGC in funnel conversion, and that the gap between a good concept and a great one is the difference between breaking even and scaling aggressively. But we've also learnt that building a creative engine - sourcing creators, briefing agencies, managing production, and connecting it all to testing insights - is a full-time challenge that deserves dedicated, passionate ownership.

You'll work closely with a tight group of collaborators:

  • Paid Social Channel Lead: Sets strategy and manages performance.

  • Paid Social Executive; Launching/optimising campaigns and reporting performance/insights

  • Head of Brand: Shapes creative direction and ensures brand consistency.

  • In-house Designers: Produce statics and AI-assisted imagery.

  • External Partner Network: Includes UGC agencies, creator management platforms, and freelance video editors.

The Role

We need someone genuinely obsessed with what makes people stop scrolling, who understands social platforms intuitively because they live on them, and can translate that into a disciplined creative operation that delivers results.

Creative Vision and Strategy

  • Develop the creative roadmap for paid social, working with the channel owners to translate performance data, testing insights, and cultural trends into a pipeline of concepts across video, static, UGC, partnership ads, and emerging formats.

  • Work with the channel owners and brand team to shape creative direction for multiple products including our core flexi-loan and a new credit card ensuring each has a distinct identity that stands out in-feed.

  • Push beyond the generic stock imagery and safe messaging that dominates financial services. Find the concepts, formats, and creators that people actually notice.

  • Research & understand customers, translating insights into creative concepts.

  • Balance high-performing hooks with positioning iwoca as a mature, trustworthy lender.

Creative Production and Resource Management

  • Own the full production pipeline: concept through briefing, production, feedback, delivery, and asset management.

  • Build and manage a network of in-house designers, external UGC agencies, and a self-built roster of creators for partnership ads, who can speak authentically about business finance.

  • Manage contracts, usage rights, and production timelines across multiple concurrent projects, balancing quality with velocity.

  • Tie creator content to seasonal business moments such as stock purchasing ahead of peak trading seasons or year-end cash flow to maximise relevance.

Testing, Insights and Iteration

  • Work with the channel owners to build a creative testing framework connecting platform metrics such as hook rate, hold rate, CTR, and landing page conversion to commercial outcomes.

  • Turn monthly creative reviews into actionable briefs: what to iterate, what to retire, what to double down on.

Requirements

Essential

  • Proven track record producing paid social creative that drives measurable business outcomes, not just engagement.

  • Deep fluency with Meta and TikTok, understanding how algorithms reward creative, how formats perform differently, what makes content feel native.

  • Experience managing creative production across multiple formats and partners simultaneously.

  • Strong project & stakeholder management with a proven ability to source, brief, and manage creators or influencers, including negotiating usage rights and partnership arrangements.

  • Strong creative judgement paired with commercial discipline; ie. you can tell the difference between a concept that will perform and one that just looks good in a deck.

  • Social native. You live on these platforms. Understanding of performance marketing / paid social creative landscape and industry trends.

Nice to have

  • B2B or financial services paid social experience (or strong B2C analytical chops that transfer).

  • Hands-on video production or editing skills.

  • Experience with creator management platforms (e.g. Grin, CreatorIQ).

  • Familiarity with creative testing methodologies and connecting creative variables to conversion.

  • An existing network of creators, UGC producers, or freelance creative talent.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

Project Description:

We are looking for experienced Payroll Data Migration Specialists to join an international HR & Payroll transformation project.

The role focuses on coordinating and overseeing payroll data migration activities across multiple countries, ensuring data accuracy, consistency, and compliance with global migration standards.

The engagement is scheduled to begin in January/February 2027 on a full-time basis. The initial duration is a minimum of 6 months, with the possibility of extension.

Required Qualifications:

  • Hands-on experience with Workday – mandatory.

  • Business-fluent English, both written and spoken.

  • Proven experience in complex, preferably international, data migration projects.

  • Strong understanding of HR and payroll data structures, processes, and dependencies.

  • Practical experience with data mapping, data cleansing, data validation, and reconciliation.

  • Good understanding of ETL processes and data migration methodologies.

  • Experience in stakeholder coordination and project management.

  • Ability to work effectively with international teams and country-level stakeholders.

  • Understanding of data protection and security principles related to sensitive personnel and payroll data.

  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a global project environment.

Nice to Have:

  • Previous experience in global Workday implementations or payroll transformation programmes.

  • Experience coordinating multi-country payroll migrations.

  • Familiarity with payroll compliance requirements across different countries.

  • Experience with migration readiness assessments, cutover planning, and post-migration validation

Scope of Services:

  • Coordinate payroll data migration activities across multiple countries, ensuring alignment with the global migration methodology.

  • Ensure migration documentation, deliverables, and supporting evidence are complete, consistent, and traceable.

  • Consolidate migration progress, track key milestones, and provide status updates across participating countries.

  • Assess migration readiness, identify potential risks, and provide recommendations to the Global Project Manager and Programme Manager.

  • Define and oversee data cleansing strategies to ensure data quality and migration readiness.

  • Monitor Extraction, Transformation & Loading (ETL) processes from legacy HR/payroll systems into the target environment.

  • Establish reconciliation frameworks to validate the accuracy and completeness of migrated data.

  • Perform or coordinate payroll data reconciliations, including headcount, salary totals, tax configurations, and other critical payroll elements.

  • Collaborate with international stakeholders, local country teams, and technical teams to resolve migration-related issues.

  • Ensure compliance with data protection, confidentiality, and security requirements when handling sensitive employee information.

  • Monitor site performance and implement action plans for sites not meeting expectations, in conjunction with the CRA. 
  • Assist CRAs with preparation for site visits (i.e. running reports, QC of files (checking for missing documents), resolving action items from previous visits).

  • Assist with the coordination of study visits and shipment of drug, ancillary supplies and laboratory kits/samples. 
  • Manage sites to ensure subjects are complying with protocol requirements, study visits, and timelines. 
  • Liaise with the project team and others to distribute and track clinical trial supplies, e.g. Case Report Forms, study medication, lab kits, ensuring that sites have sufficient supplies to continue recruitment. 
  • Proactively work with sites and project teams to ensure maintenance activities (including Amendments, revised documents, etc.) are completed for assigned sites as applicable in region. 
  • Demonstrate an understanding of the purpose of CTMS, how to use it, and how to navigate within the different sections. To enter weekly details in CTMS or as per study requirement. 
  • Assist in submissions and notifications to Ethics Committees and Regulatory Authorities as applicable in region. 
  • Facilitate translation and back translation of all necessary documents as appropriate for local country requirements and as needed regionally. 
  • Attend, as needed, meetings (investigator, sponsor, kick-off, face-to-face) and to present at the meetings.

  • At least one year of experience in a related field, (e.g. medical, clinical, pharmaceutical, laboratory research, data analysis, data management or technical writing).

  • Basic understanding of biology and biological processes 
  • Ability to monitor study sites according to protocol monitoring guidelines, SOPs, ICH Guidelines and GCP. 
  • Good organizational and time management skills 
  • Good communication skills, oral and written
  • Exhibits general computer literacy
