jobs.excerpt: Ready to be a Titan? Every call matters to a trades business.
jobs.description:
Ready to be a Titan?

Every call matters to a trades business. It can be a new customer, an urgent service request, or the next job booked. At ServiceTitan, we’re bringing calls, conversations, and customer context together in one Communications Center and Contact Center experience. The voice platform underneath it needs to make every call reliable, route it to the right place, and preserve what happened along the way.


We’re looking for a Staff Product Manager to own the vision, strategy, roadmap, and delivery for the voice platform behind our telephony products. You’ll shape how calls are carried, routed, measured, and connected across Basic Phones, Phones Pro, and Contact Center Pro, from carrier decisions and call quality to enterprise number ownership and the platform’s shared call model.


This is a high-autonomy individual contributor role for a hands-on telephony product builder. You’ll set direction across three communications engineering teams, make clear investment decisions, and drive delivery through influence. You’ll partner with Communications Intelligence and experience PMs to make the platform work as one product for customers.


What you’ll do:

  • Own the voice and telephony strategy and multi-quarter roadmap. Prioritize customer impact, reliability risk, enterprise needs, and contractual commitments; make explicit decisions about what to deliver and what to defer.
  • Guide carrier and hosted voice vendor strategy with Engineering and Telecom. Evaluate build, buy, and partner options against call quality, cost, resilience, and operational risk, including redundancy, failover, and removal of single points of failure.
  • Define the platform’s shared call model: calls, legs, participants, transfers, and voice agent sessions. Partner with Communications Intelligence to establish consistent definitions and attribution rules that reporting, APIs, and AI capabilities can rely on.
  • Shape enterprise numbering and routing, including organization-owned numbers, routing by ZIP code, and attribution to the right location across multi-location businesses and franchise networks.
  • Set measurable availability and call quality targets with Engineering. Use call-level performance, customer feedback, and incident findings to identify gaps, prioritize durable improvements, and track outcomes.
  • Make voice compliance an ongoing part of the roadmap. Partner with Legal, Security, and Engineering on caller ID verification, consent to call and record, and emergency calling, with clear rollout and rollback plans.
  • Translate platform strategy into customer workflows and testable requirements. Build working prototypes, validate ideas with agents, supervisors, administrators, and operators, and drive launch, adoption, and iteration.
  • Plan migrations and staged rollouts that protect existing customer workflows while enabling a unified Communications Center and Contact Center experience.
  • Align Engineering, Design, Support, Telecom, and go-to-market partners around shared priorities, dependencies, and success measures. Communicate decisions clearly to customers and executives, and mentor PM peers on telephony depth and product judgment.

What you’ll bring:

  • 7+ years in product management, with direct experience owning a voice or Contact Center product area from strategy through delivery across multiple teams, with measurable improvements in availability, call quality, cost, revenue, or customer outcomes. We assess demonstrated skills and impact, and we value experience over specific years.
  • Working knowledge of SIP signaling, media streams, codecs, carriers, and phone numbers. You can distinguish signaling failures from audio failures, form testable hypotheses, and make or challenge technical trade-offs with Engineering.
  • Fluency in Contact Center workflows, including queues, routing, agent status, transfers, and recording, and how call definitions affect reporting and attribution.
  • Familiarity with telephony requirements such as STIR/SHAKEN caller ID verification, consent to call and record, and E911 emergency calling.
  • Strong roadmap judgment: you can weigh reliability, enterprise growth, customer experience, and dated commitments, explain dependencies, and make clear choices under constraints.
  • Experience writing product strategy or architecture documents that guided multi-quarter work across teams and aligned engineering leaders and executives.
  • Hands-on prototyping skills using Figma Make, Claude Design, or comparable tools to test ideas and make requirements concrete.
  • A record of driving outcomes without formal authority, with clear customer and executive communication, ownership through delivery, and high standards for product quality.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

Additional experience that would help:

  • Delivering live transcription, agent assistance, or production voice agents, including media, latency, consent, and human handoff considerations.
  • Designing enterprise telephony onboarding and migrations for multi-location businesses or franchise networks.
  • Working with multi-carrier or multi-region voice systems, session border controllers, and media servers.
  • Managing telephony compliance as a continuing program with risk-based rollout stages and rollback plans.

Be Human With Us:
Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. We need amazing people like you to help us challenge the conventional and think differently about the problems that we’re solving. We’re in this together. Come be human, with us.


Use of AI Technology:

We use technology, including automated and AI-assisted tools, to support certain aspects of our recruitment process. These tools are designed to improve efficiency and enhance the candidate experience. AI tools are not used to make hiring decisions; all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams.


What We Offer:

When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career:

  • Flextime, recognition, and support for autonomous work: Flexible time off with ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career. We offer a comprehensive onboarding program, leadership training for Titans at all levels, and other programs and events. Great work is rewarded through Bonusly, peer-nominated awards, and more.
  • Holistic health and wellness benefits: Company-paid medical, dental, and vision (with 100% employer paid options and 90% coverage for dependents), FSA and HSA, 401k match, and telehealth options including memberships to One Medical.
  • Support for Titans at all stages of life: Parental leave and support, up to $20k in fertility services (i.e. IUI and IVF), surrogacy, and adoption reimbursement, on demand maternity support through Maven Maternity, free breast milk shipping through Maven Milk, pet insurance, legal advisory services, financial planning tools, and more.

At ServiceTitan, we celebrate individuality and uniqueness. We believe that the convergence of fresh perspectives and experiences from all walks of life is what makes our product and culture so great. About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

This is a talent pool for future US-based opportunities. We are not actively hiring for this position at this time.

About the Role

The Lead, Retention combines strategic account ownership, hands-on CRM expertise, and team leadership to help direct-to-consumer brands grow customer lifetime value. In this role, you would own retention strategy and client relationships across a portfolio of e-commerce accounts, translating business goals and customer insights into email, SMS, subscription, and loyalty programs that drive measurable revenue and repeat purchase.

Working with the Director of Retention and partnering closely with Performance Marketing, Creative, and Strategy teams, you would lead the roadmap from customer acquisition through first purchase, repeat purchase, subscription retention, and win-back.

This role is designed for an experienced strategist and operator who can lead senior client conversations, connect lifecycle performance to commercial outcomes, and guide specialists through complex execution without losing touch with the work.

What You’ll Do

  • Own retention strategy, client relationships, and performance roadmaps for a portfolio of DTC accounts, serving as a senior strategic partner rather than simply managing campaign delivery.

  • Translate client objectives into clear KPI frameworks, retention revenue forecasts, and prioritized plans. Explain performance, identify gaps, and recommend actions to improve results.

  • Build lifecycle strategies spanning lead capture, welcome and first-purchase journeys, post-purchase engagement, repeat purchase, subscription activation and retention, loyalty, and win-back.

  • Develop email and SMS campaign calendars, segmentation plans, automation roadmaps, and testing priorities grounded in customer behavior and business goals.

  • Lead client conversations, presenting results and recommendations clearly, managing expectations, and bringing a confident point of view to complex strategic decisions.

  • Coordinate specialists and designers across accounts, delegate effectively, and review briefs, creative, segmentation, and campaign builds to maintain a high standard of delivery.

  • Stay close to execution: build or troubleshoot automation logic, lead-capture forms, and app integrations when needed, and ensure campaigns and flows are thoroughly quality-assured before launch.

  • Turn cohort analysis, repeat purchase behavior, subscription performance, and lifetime value insights into practical opportunities for client growth.

  • Mentor team members on retention strategy, analysis, execution, and quality control, helping them develop stronger judgment and greater ownership.

  • Partner with Performance Marketing, Creative, and Strategy teams so acquisition investment, messaging, and lifecycle programming reinforce one another.

  • Identify opportunities to deepen client programs through personalization, loyalty, subscription journeys, and stronger cross-channel coordination.

You Should Apply If This Sounds Like You

  • You have a strong track record of developing and scaling retention programs for DTC or e-commerce brands, with meaningful ownership of client relationships and performance outcomes.

  • You combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You can build a compelling roadmap, guide a team through delivery, and get into the platform when a complex problem needs solving.

LOCATION: REMOTE

HOURS: M-F, 8-5 (PACIFIC TIME ZONE)

The RCM Specialist I is an individual contributor role on the RCM team, responsible for front-end and mid-cycle revenue cycle tasks with a primary focus on insurance verification, claim submission, and customer service. This role ensures accurate eligibility and benefit gather across dental or medical payers, clean pre-authorization and claim generation, timely insurance processing, and a positive experience for patients and supported offices. The ideal candidate has a working knowledge of dental and medical billing processes, is detail-oriented, and is committed to delivering excellent service to both internal stakeholders and patients.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Perform all assigned RCM activities in accordance with best practices and internal SOPs.
  • Verify insurance coverage and benefits for scheduled patients using payer portals or phone calls.
  • Accurately enter and update insurance information in the practice management system.
  • Confirm eligibility, plan limitations, and coordination of benefits to ensure claims are submitted cleanly in the appropriate billing order.
  • Submit pre-determination and pre-authorizations requested by the patient or supporting practices with all necessary clinical attachments, follow-up on processing status, and notify practice of status return in a timely manner ensuring treatment is not delayed.
  • Prepare and submit claims (electronic, paper, or via portal) in accordance with payer-specific requirements and timelines.
  • Review rejected claims, identify causes, and resubmit corrected claims as needed.
  • Respond promptly and professionally to patient and office inquiries related to billing, insurance coverage, and balances.
  • Assist in creating and sending patient statements and following up on outstanding balances as directed.
  • Document all insurance verification results, pre-authorization and claim submissions, and patient interactions thoroughly and clearly.
  • Escalate issues related to claim delays, system errors, or patient concerns to the appropriate RCM team members or supervisors.
  • Maintain compliance with HIPAA, payer guidelines, and internal policies.
  • Participate in team meetings and training sessions to stay current on processes, tools, and payer updates.
  • Support other RCM functions as needed to ensure a smooth and efficient revenue cycle process.
  • Support RCM management in understanding and self-identifying contributing factors to site-specific RCM KPIs, highlighting areas of concern and areas for improvement. KPIs include but may not be limited to:
  • Collection Rate: Monitor and report on the net collection rate, analyzing performance against targets. Collaborate with the team to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Days in AR: Track and evaluate average days in AR to ensure appropriate advanced collection, payment application, efficient and accurate claim filing, and timely back-end billing and claim resolution. Investigate and address any delays or bottlenecks that may be causing extended days in AR.
  • % AR Over 90 Days: Review and analyze the percentage of AR over 90 days (insurance v. patient) to identify trends or issues requiring attention. Work with the team to reduce the percentage of aged receivables by implementing strategies to resolve outstanding claims and payments.
  • Maintain respect and professionalism in all interactions with internal stakeholders, patients, payers, third parties, and others

ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATIONS

  • Prior experience in Dental Office workflows, Revenue Cycle functions to include Scheduling, Registration, Insurance verification, fee schedules, claim submission, charging/coding requirements, insurance AR follow up and payment posting process
  • Must be knowledgeable of reimbursement/compliance process and procedures with all payors
  • Experience with practice management software systems, insurance portals, clearing houses, insurance guidelines, banking reconciliation software, proficient in intermediate PC skills (MS Office—strong excel skills). Strong computer literacy, Excellent Math and problem-solving skills. Data entry and 10-key by touch.
  • Strong interpersonal and organizational skills. Ability to work within a team setting and as an individual contributor. Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Responsible for quality work, meeting deadlines, and adherence to Compliance and Revenue cycle standard operating procedures
  • Organized work habits, accuracy, and proven attention to detail with strong analytical skills
  • Responsible for quality work, meeting deadlines, and adherence to Compliance and Revenue cycle standard operating procedures

The role requires strong PDP expertise, specifically in MarkLogic and Semaphore, enterprise infrastructure knowledge, data-platform troubleshooting skills, disciplined case management, clear customer communication, and the ability to troubleshoot effectively when direct system access or the electronic transfer of logs, data samples, and diagnostic information may be limited. Participation in scheduled holiday, weekend, and after-hours support coverage is required.

  • Diagnose issues involving enterprise data and metadata, including ingestion, transformation, modeling, indexing, search, query behavior, data quality, and movement across MarkLogic and connected systems, while maintaining appropriate handling of sensitive government data.

  • Coordinate urgent incidents and troubleshooting calls with customers, Progress Support, Engineering, Product Management, Professional Services, and account teams.

  • Work effectively with restricted U.S. Government environments where direct access or electronic transfer of logs, screenshots, or data samples may be limited.
  • Monitor shared support channels, maintain continuity across handoffs, and participate in scheduled on-call, holiday, weekend, and after-hours coverage.
  • Identify recurring product, data, and operational issues and improve knowledge articles, troubleshooting guidance, intake checklists, and support processes.
  • Serve as a senior technical and procedural resource, mentor teammates, and help ensure consistent case quality and customer care.

Your background:

  • 8+ years of enterprise software technical support, production operations, systems engineering, database administration, data-platform operations, or equivalent experience.
  • Demonstrated ownership of complex, customer-facing incidents and the ability to manage multiple cases without losing detail or momentum.
  • Deep understanding of database and distributed-system concepts such as clustering, replication, transactions, indexing, caching, backup and recovery, and high availability.
  • Experience troubleshooting enterprise data platforms, including data modeling, ingestion, transformation, metadata, indexing, search, data quality, and system-to-system data flows.
  • Ability to analyze the relationship between data characteristics, query patterns, application behavior, and platform performance.

  • Experience supporting Java, JavaScript, XQuery, SQL, JSON, XML, REST APIs, and client/server applications; MarkLogic and Semaphore experience is strongly preferred.
  • Experience with AWS and/or Azure deployments, including virtual machines, storage, networking, automation templates, and operational troubleshooting.
  • Ability to translate incomplete symptoms into a structured diagnostic plan and communicate clearly with both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication, sound judgment during high-severity incidents, and a strong customer-service orientation.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, data science, or a related field preferred, or equivalent practical experience.

Our Engineering Career Framework is viewable by anyone outside the company and describes what’s expected for our engineers at each of our career levels. Check out our blog post on this topic and more here.

Patient Services Specialist – Patient Support Programs

About PSPSync:

PSPSync is a dynamic and innovative provider of Patient Support Program (PSP) solutions, dedicated to enhancing access, adherence, and outcomes for patients prescribed specialty medications. We collaborate with pharmaceutical manufacturers, healthcare professionals, and pharmacies to streamline the patient journey and ensure seamless care.

Role Summary

The Patient Services Specialist is the primary point of contact for both physicians and patients enrolled in PSPSync patient support programs. Reporting to the Program Manager, this remote role (Canada) navigates patients through complex treatment pathways, manages reimbursement processes, coordinates healthcare services, and provides ongoing support to ensure timely access to therapy. The Patient Services Specialist is critical in delivering compassionate, high-touch service that enhances the patient and customer experience while driving program KPIs.

Responsibilities

  • Patient & Physician Case Management
    • Serve as the dedicated point of contact for assigned patients and physicians, managing case files from enrollment through ongoing treatment.
    • Provide compassionate support to patients facing complex challenges in their treatment journey.
    • Educate patients on their therapy, program services, and financial assistance options.
  • Reimbursement & Access Support
    • Conduct private and public reimbursement investigations to support timely access to therapy.
    • Manage prior authorization submissions to secure reimbursement approvals.
  • Care Coordination & Adherence
    • Liaise with physicians’ offices, pharmacies, payers, and other healthcare stakeholders to coordinate services.
    • Proactively follow up with patients to confirm medication delivery, monitor adherence, and address barriers to treatment.
  • Documentation & Compliance
    • Document all case activities in PSPSync’s CRM system with accuracy and timeliness.
  • Performance & Continuous Improvement
    • Meet and exceed program KPIs, including service level targets, patient onboarding timelines, and adherence metrics.

Key Competencies

  • Patient-Centric Care – delivers compassionate, high-touch support tailored to individual patient needs.

jobs.description:
Powering the agentic revolution in travel. Sabre is an AI-native technology leader, backed by one of the world’s largest travel data clouds. Built on an open, modular, cloud-native architecture, Sabre serves as the backbone for both established leaders and bold, new disruptors, guiding them to the next age of travel retailing through intelligent, connected, and personalized experiences. With AI at its core and operating at unparalleled scale, Sabre transforms insights into innovation, empowering airlines, hoteliers, agencies and other partners to retail, distribute and fulfill travel worldwide.

Sabre Payments is transforming the way the travel industry manages and processes payments. Combining innovative payment technology with deep expertise in travel, we provide travel companies with an integrated payments ecosystem designed to simplify payment operations, improve efficiency and maximise the value of every transaction.

Our platform enables travel businesses to pay and get paid globally through a network of more than 70 issuers and a broad range of acquiring, payment and financial technology partners. Our solutions include virtual cards, issuing, acquiring, fraud and chargeback management, foreign exchange and cross-border payment capabilities.

By combining our global payment network, technology and travel industry expertise, we help travel businesses optimise their end-to-end payment strategy, reduce complexity and unlock new commercial opportunities.

Join us as we continue to build and expand our global payments business.


Role and Responsibilities


As Senior Sales Manager, EMEA – Sabre Payments, you will be responsible for driving commercial growth across the EMEA region, with a particular focus on acquiring new SME travel agency customers.

You will identify, develop and convert new business opportunities, positioning Sabre Payments as a strategic payments partner for travel agencies looking to improve their payment processes, access competitive payment solutions and grow their businesses.

This is a commercially driven, hands-on sales role requiring strong prospecting, relationship-building, negotiation and closing capabilities. You will own the sales process from initial engagement through contract signature and successful customer onboarding, working closely with internal teams to ensure a seamless customer experience.


What will you achieve?


  • Drive new business acquisition: Identify, target and acquire new SME travel agency customers across EMEA, delivering against agreed sales, revenue and payment volume targets.
  • Build and manage a strong sales pipeline: Proactively identify prospective customers, develop new leads and maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified opportunities, ensuring consistent progression through the sales cycle.
  • Own the full sales lifecycle: Manage opportunities from prospecting and initial engagement through solution positioning, commercial negotiations, contracting, implementation and customer activation.
  • Develop customer relationships: Establish strong relationships with business owners, founders, finance directors and other senior decision-makers within travel agencies, understanding their business models, payment challenges and growth ambitions.
  • Position the full Sabre Payments proposition: Promote relevant payment solutions, including virtual cards, issuing, acquiring, fraud and chargeback management, FX and cross-border payments, identifying opportunities to deliver value across the customer's payment ecosystem.
  • Deliver commercial results: Achieve agreed targets for new customer acquisition, payment volumes and revenue, contributing directly to the growth and profitability of Sabre Payments across EMEA.
  • Collaborate across Sabre: Work closely with regional sales teams, Global Distribution System account managers, Product, Partnerships, Implementations, Customer Success and Finance to maximise commercial opportunities and ensure successful customer onboarding.
  • Maintain accurate sales reporting: Ensure all pipeline opportunities, customer interactions, forecasts and commercial activities are accurately recorded in Salesforce or the designated CRM platform, providing management with clear visibility of performance and pipeline development.
  • Monitor the competitive landscape: Maintain a strong understanding of the payments and travel technology markets, identifying competitor activity, emerging trends and opportunities to strengthen Sabre Payments' competitive positioning.
  • Represent Sabre Payments externally: Attend relevant industry events, conferences and customer meetings, building brand awareness and developing relationships across the travel and payments ecosystem.

What's in it for you?


  • The opportunity to play a key role in the expansion of Sabre Payments, contributing directly to the growth of an ambitious global business.
  • The opportunity to work with an innovative portfolio of payment products and solutions within one of the world's leading travel technology companies.
  • Exposure to the global travel and payments ecosystem, building relationships with travel agency owners, senior executives, banks, financial institutions, fintechs and international payment networks.
  • A commercially focused environment offering the opportunity to take ownership, develop new markets and make a tangible impact on business performance.
  • The opportunity to work collaboratively with international teams across Sabre, gaining exposure to different markets, customers and payment technologies.

Qualifications and Education Requirements


Must-Have Skills and Experience

  • Proven sales track record: Demonstrable experience in B2B sales, business development and new customer acquisition, ideally within payments, financial services, fintech or the travel industry.
  • New business development: Strong prospecting and lead-generation capabilities, with a proven ability to identify opportunities, build pipelines and convert prospects into paying customers.
  • Payments knowledge: Good understanding of the payments ecosystem, ideally including card payments, virtual cards, issuing, acquiring, payment processing or related financial services.
  • Commercial acumen: Strong understanding of commercial models, revenue generation, pricing structures and negotiation, with the ability to identify and close commercially attractive opportunities.
  • Sales and negotiation skills: Excellent presentation, communication, negotiation and closing capabilities, with confidence engaging directly with business owners and senior decision-makers.
  • Relationship management: Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build credibility, establish trust and develop long-term commercial relationships.
  • Ownership and accountability: A self-motivated, results-oriented individual who can independently manage a sales territory, prioritise activities and consistently deliver against ambitious targets.
  • Communication skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
  • CRM and reporting: Experience using Salesforce or other CRM platforms, together with strong analytical and reporting capabilities.
  • Travel flexibility: Willingness to travel across EMEA and internationally when required for customer meetings, business development activities and industry events.

Nice-to-Have Skills and Experience

  • Experience selling payment solutions to SME travel agencies, independent travel agents, tour operators, online travel agencies or travel management companies.
  • Good understanding of the travel industry, including its distribution models, commercial dynamics and payment flows.
  • Existing relationships within the EMEA travel agency or payments ecosystem.
  • Experience selling multiple payment products or integrated payment solutions rather than a single standalone product.
  • Knowledge of virtual cards, card issuing, acquiring, FX, cross-border payments and payment optimisation.
  • Additional European languages, particularly Spanish, French, Italian or German.

Important

The duties and responsibilities described above are not intended to be an exhaustive list. Additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time, and the scope of the role may evolve in line with business requirements.



We will give careful consideration to your application and review your details against the position criteria. You will receive separate notification as your application progresses. Please note that only candidates who meet the minimum criteria for the role will proceed in the selection process.

jobs.excerpt: About WellHive WellHive is a healthcare technology company with one mission: getting Veterans to care faster.
jobs.description:
About WellHive

WellHive is a healthcare technology company with one mission: getting Veterans to care faster. Our platform connects community health systems and providers with the Department of Veterans Affairs, so VA schedulers can find open appointments and book Veterans directly into community care. Every provider service we bring live is capacity a Veteran can use.

Role Summary

Network Growth Executives (NGEs) build the provider network behind every Veteran’s appointment. You will own a multi-state Enterprise territory and bring large health systems into the VA community care network: organizations with 250 or more providers, and those that connect through a direct EHR integration such as Epic or Oracle Health.

You are the account quarterback. You lead each health system from the first conversation through go-live, work closely with VA facility leaders in your states, and hand off a live, bookable network to our Network Success team. You are measured on active, usable services that VA schedulers can find and book, not signed contracts.

What You’ll Do

Own a multi-state Enterprise territory

  • Own 3–4 anchor states plus neighboring states, with a book of about 80 Enterprise health systems.
  • Work 20–25 priority accounts at a time, ranked by VA referral volume, high-demand providers and stage; rotate in the next account as each one goes live.
  • Build a territory plan around documented VA demand: named VA sites, specialties, geography and access gaps.
  • Travel regularly to meet health system executives, attend regional conferences and visit VA facilities.

Lead every account from first conversation to go-live

  • Research each system before outreach: VA referral patterns, provider rosters, community care network credentialing, EHR and decision-makers.
  • Build and maintain relationships with C-suite and operational leaders, including CEOs, COOs, CIOs, access and patient access leaders, and service line chiefs.
  • Run tailored demos on each health system’s own VA referral data, and confirm the EHR and scheduling path early.
  • Resolve security, IT, workflow and staffing questions, and lead the agreement and security review through signature.
  • Quarterback onboarding with the assigned Project Manager and Network Success Manager: run a weekly account standup, confirm provider counts and the go-live date, and keep one voice to the customer.
  • Run the go-live, hand the relationship to the Network Success Manager in a live meeting, and stay on as executive sponsor for the first 30 days.

Partner with the VA

  • Engage VA Medical Center community care leaders in your anchor states, line up VA champions and request facility outreach where an account stalls.
  • Deliver a monthly update to VA facilities in your states, and confirm the first booking at every go-live with our VA adoption team.

Run the business in Salesforce

  • Keep Salesforce accurate and current: contacts, stages, provider counts and a dated next step on every account.
  • Report weekly in the pipeline review against your annual target, and escalate blockers within one business day with a clear bottom line and ask.

What Success Looks Like

  • New Enterprise accounts: 16 or more health systems live in your first full year, growing from there.
  • Usable capacity: services live at full provider counts, visible in VA search and booking.
  • Speed: steady movement from signed agreement to go-live, with no account stalled more than 60 days without a plan.
  • A strong territory: trusted relationships with health system executives and VA facility leaders across your states.

Who You’ll Work With

You lead a cross-functional account team: Project Managers and Provider Network Specialists who build and activate services, Network Success Managers who own the provider relationship after go-live, technical support for EHR integration, business development for executive introductions, our VA adoption team, and partner leads.

What You Bring

  • 7+ years of enterprise sales experience, with a record of closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals with health systems or in a similarly regulated industry.
  • Executive presence and credibility with health system C-suite leaders, and the persistence to open new doors.
  • Experience leading long sales cycles that include security review, IT integration and legal agreements.
  • Working knowledge of EHR platforms such as Epic and Oracle Health, and the ability to explain technical requirements in business terms.
  • Strong organization across many accounts at once, with disciplined pipeline management in Salesforce.
  • Comfort with regular travel across a multi-state territory.
  • A genuine commitment to improving access to care for Veterans.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

Preferred

  • Experience with the VA, VA Community Care or federal health programs. • Familiarity with community care network administrators and provider credentialing.
  • Existing relationships with health systems, hospital associations or VA leaders in your territory.
  • Military service or a Veteran connection.

Why WellHive

  • Mission: every health system you bring live opens new appointments for Veterans in your states.
  • Ownership: a defined territory, a clear target and the account team to deliver it.
  • Compensation: competitive base salary plus uncapped commission, paid at agreement signing and at go-live, with an additional incentive tied to active providers at launch.
  • Growth: a rapidly scaling team with room to grow your territory and your career.

    • Keep documentation current: definitions, methodologies, field guides, and onboarding resources for new team members.

  • Experience with Autodesk Construction Cloud, eBuilder, or Procore
  • Experience coordinating multi-day working sessions or workshops across teams

Characteristics of an ideal candidate 

  • Responsive; we take pride in reacting quickly and positively to clients and teammates, internal and external
  • Innovative; a desire to drive innovation through new and unique solutions while embracing creative ideas
  • Entrepreneurial; the drive to take initiative, deliver results, and create value for our clients

Why Avicado

Owners of the biggest capital programs in the world run them across systems that don’t talk to each other. The information exists; getting a connected view of it is the problem. That’s the work at Avicado.

The product has strong traction and has been proven in real-world environments, and now we’re looking for a PM to chart the future of the product.

This is not a traditional roadmap role. You will take in incomplete, conflicting inputs from users, customers, stakeholders, and the product itself, and decide what we should build – and what we shouldn’t – as demand accelerates.

You will work closely with operators, product engineers, forward deployed engineers, and mission colleagues to find high-leverage problems and drive them through a shipped capability. You’ll often need to set aside loud or conflicting inputs and make calls others disagree with.

This role reports to the CTO and operates at the intersection of mission, product, and engineering. Success is measured by whether we build the right things and those things create real mission impact at scale.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Own the product direction end-to-end. Turn ambiguous problems into concrete bets and drive them through to shipped capability.
  • Turn signal into direction. Take messy, often conflicting input from users, stakeholders, and the product itself, decide what actually matters for growth and mission impact, and translate it into clear product direction – including pushing back when the loudest ask isn’t the right one.
  • Build alignment across Mission and Engineering. Bring people along when Mission and Engineering see a problem differently – disagree when you need to, then get everyone committed on the path forward.
  • Partner with engineering. Embed with the team, meet them where they work best, and shape solutions that are both impactful and technically sound.
  • Work directly with users. Build deep intuition for real-world workflows and needs.
  • Drive adoption and durability. Move users from first use to daily reliance and keep quality high as volume grows.

WHAT YOU SHOULD HAVE

  • Strong product judgment. You consistently identify the right problems and make sound prioritization decisions.
  • Ability to separate signal from noise. You form independent, defensible opinions from incomplete and conflicting inputs, and can act on them under uncertainty.
  • Experience operating under real constraints. You’ve shipped products where security, infrastructure, or deployment realities shaped decisions.
  • High ownership and a bias toward action. You take responsibility for outcomes and push work through to completion.
  • Technical fluency. You can engage with engineers and understand system constraints and tradeoffs.
  • Clear, direct communication. You can articulate decisions, tradeoffs, and reasoning in a way others can act on.
  • Active TS/SCI clearance (or ability to obtain one)
  • Willingness to travel onsite

Nice to have

  • Experience working with operational, mission-driven, or investigative users
  • Experience with LLM-based systems
  • Experience with product analytics (e.g., SQL)
  • Experience rapidly prototyping ideas (Figma, AI coding tools, etc.)
  • Experience with digital investigations or targeting
  • Exposure to constrained or high-security environments

What we offer

We’re proud to offer competitive benefits that support our employees. Some key highlights of our benefits package include:
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • 100% remote first culture. You can work from anywhere in the US and all full time employees have WeWork access
  • Unlimited PTO including competitive vacation and holiday schedules
  • Lifestyle stipends - Monthly mental health, wellness & fitness stipend, in-home office setup stipend and family planning assistance

jobs.description:
Role Overview

The HR Manager collaboratively manages day-to-day HR compliance and employee relations processes through teamwork, shared discovery, and Talent Operations leadership review, supporting compliance, consistency, and employee-focused Talent Operations practices across the organization. This individual-contributor role has no direct reports and leads through functional ownership and cross-functional partnership. The HR Manager interprets and communicates policies, monitors employment law and regulatory requirements, manages workplace concerns, and develops recommendations to mitigate risk. The position independently manages analysis, documentation, recommendations, and follow-through on matters involving employee relations, performance management, attendance, employment records, onboarding, and organizational change. The VP, Talent Operations reviews recommendations and approves final outcomes; the HR Manager coordinates implementation of approved outcomes and remains accountable for accurate, timely, and consistent process execution.

A Day in the Life

  • Manage day-to-day administration of HR policies and programs and provide practical guidance to leaders and employees on policy interpretation, employee relations, attendance, conduct, performance, and workplace expectations
  • Own employee relations intake and case management; conduct or coordinate timely, objective workplace investigations; document interviews and findings; and recommend follow-up actions for final review and approval by the VP, Talent Operations
  • Coach leaders through performance improvement, corrective action, and employment decisions while balancing employee experience, business needs, and compliance risk; develop recommendations and coordinate implementation following VP approval of final outcomes
  • Manage monitoring of federal, state, and local employment requirements; recommend updates to HR policies, procedures, notices, practices, and employee communications; and coordinate implementation following VP approval
  • Maintain accurate, complete, and confidential employee records, case files, employment documentation, and required compliance reports
  • Manage periodic audits of HR records and practices, identify gaps or trends, recommend corrective actions and process improvements, and track implementation of approved outcomes
  • Coordinate compliance requirements across recruiting, employment authorization, onboarding, compensation and benefits, payroll coordination, leave and attendance, safety, training, and employee separations, partnering with the responsible functional owners
  • Develop and deliver employee and manager communications and training related to HR policies, respectful workplace expectations, documentation standards, employment practices, and regulatory responsibilities, consistent with approved policies and outcomes
  • Partner with Talent Operations leadership, business leaders, legal counsel, vendors, and other internal or external resources on compliance and employee relations matters; escalate complex or high-risk concerns promptly to VP Talent Operations
  • Use HR systems and workforce data to manage case tracking, monitor compliance activities, identify recurring issues, and recommend actions
  • Lead or contribute to cross-functional HR compliance projects and organizational change initiatives
  • Connect with HR support staff and service providers through established partnerships to ensure timely, accurate, and consistent completion of HR processes

Role Progression

  • Within 1 month, you’ll: Learn Talent Operations policies, systems, workflows, documentation standards, and key partners; understand current compliance priorities, employee relations procedures, and VP final-review requirements; and begin handling routine inquiries.
  • Within 3 months, you’ll: Independently manage day-to-day compliance and employee relations processes; conduct or coordinate investigations and support performance matters; identify recurring risks or process gaps; and submit practical recommendations to your manager.
  • Within 6 months, you’ll: Own assigned compliance and employee relations programs and case-management processes; lead audits, investigations, training, or cross-functional initiatives; use workforce and case data to identify trends and recommend risk mitigation; and demonstrate timely, consistent execution and implementation of approved outcomes.

About You

  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources, business administration, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience
  • 4-7 years of progressive human resources experience, including meaningful responsibility for HR compliance and employee relations
  • Working knowledge of employment law, HR regulatory requirements, policy administration, workplace investigations, performance management, leave and attendance practices, and employment documentation
  • Demonstrated ability to handle confidential and sensitive matters with sound judgment, objectivity, and discretion
  • Strong written and verbal communication, analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, collaborate across functions, and provide clear, practical guidance to leaders and employees
  • Proficiency with human resource management systems and standard business applications
  • Successful candidates will be required to complete and pass a CLEAR™ identity verification as part of the pre-employment screening process

This role is responsible for the design, administration, reliability, performance, and security of Azure-based SQL Server environments, while also owning key Data Engineering and data platform responsibilities that enable trusted, automated, and well-governed data pipelines. The position requires traditional DBA ownership and deep expertise in SQL Server administration, performance optimization and database design combine with modern cloud engineering practice - automation, CI/CD, testing, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to ensure highly available, scalable, and compliant data systems. The role supports both production and non-production environments and plays a critical part in on-call operations, proactive monitoring, incident prevention, and continuous improvement across databases and the broader data platform.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

Database Administration (Azure SQL & SQL Server)

  • Administer and support ~30 SQL Server IaaS virtual machines hosted on Azure, including production and non-production workloads.
  • Manage and maintain 2 high-availability SQL Server clusters, ensuring uptime, failover readiness, and business continuity.
  • Administer ~20 Azure SQL PaaS logical servers hosting multiple elastic pools, including Business Critical, General Purpose, and 7 Azure SQL Managed Instances supporting enterprise workloads.
  • Manage and optimize Azure SQL elastic pools containing multiple Azure SQL databases per pool.
  • Perform routine DBA activities including:
    • Performance tuning and query optimization
    • Index and statistics maintenance
    • Capacity planning and cost optimization
    • Backup, restore, and disaster recovery testing
    • Security configuration, access management, and compliance

High Availability, Disaster Recovery & Replication

  • Design, maintain, and validate high availability and disaster recovery (HA/DR) strategies across IaaS and PaaS SQL environments.
  • Support production and non-production replication from a monolithic source database using Attunity Replicate (Qlik).
  • Ensure data consistency, replication health, and timely recovery across replicated systems.
  • Collaborate with application, reporting, and analytics teams to meet data availability SLAs.

Monitoring, Alerting & On-Call Operations

  • Design, implement, and maintain comprehensive monitoring and alerting solutions across SQL platforms.
  • Maintain alerting via:
    • SQL Server Agent jobs
    • Ability to pinpoint KPIs with SQL PI tools like Foglight.
    • Azure Monitor and Azure Alerts (per resource)
  • Develop and maintain PowerShell-based monitoring scripts running on virtual machines to:
    • Detect Azure resource thresholds and capacity risks
    • Identify performance and availability conditions
    • Trigger alerts for proactive issue prevention
  • Integrate alerting with PagerDuty for critical on-call notifications and email-based warnings for non-critical events.
  • Participate in on-call rotations and lead incident response, root cause analysis, and post-incident remediation.

About Nerdio

At Nerdio, our mission is to simplify the lives of IT professionals and maximize their Microsoft Cloud and end user computing investments.

Deploying, managing, and cost-optimizing Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), Windows 365, and Intune is technically complex without a purpose-built management layer on top. Nerdio is that layer. We automate what Microsoft’s native tooling leaves manual, so enterprises and Managed Service Providers (MSPs) can run cloud desktops at scale with lower cost, less operational effort, and less migration risk.

Founded in 2016, Nerdio is used by more than 15,000 organizations in over 50 countries and was named Microsoft’s 2024 Americas Partner of the Year. Our vision is to be the control plane that makes Microsoft cloud workspaces simpler, more efficient, and cost-effective at scale. How much of that opportunity we capture depends on go-to-market execution.

We are a fast-moving, nimble company looking for people who are collaborative, empathetic, driven, and who love to move at the speed of light.

Nerdio is looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager, Field Enablement to be the connective tissue between Product, Marketing, and our direct and partner sales organizations. You will make sure sellers and partners understand our products, our positioning, and our customer value, and can use that story to drive better outcomes for sellers, partners, and customers.

You will partner closely with Nerdio’s Sales Enablement & Readiness team, which leads onboarding, training, certifications, sales methodology, and field execution for sellers and partners. As part of Product Marketing, you will create the messaging, positioning, competitive insights, and content that power these programs. Together, the teams will equip sellers and partners to confidently position, demonstrate, and sell Nerdio solutions.

What you'll do

  • Translate product into field-ready messaging. Turn strategy, releases, and positioning into clear value messaging, talk tracks, and proof points for direct sellers, MSPs, and Microsoft co-sell teams.

Collaborate with Sales Enablement & Readiness to establish launch timelines, readiness requirements, and content delivery milestones, enabling Sales Enablement to partner on the training, rollout, reinforcement for field readiness.
  • Build product-led sales content. Create pitch decks, solution briefs, battle cards, customer stories, and ROI tools tailored to direct and partner motions.
  • Equip partners and co-sell. Work with Partnerships and Partner Marketing to create partner-ready content that makes MSP, channel, and Microsoft co-sell motions repeatable.

  • Partner with Sales Enablement. Align on priorities and supply the product content for their onboarding, training, and playbooks.

Qualifications

Overview

About the Company:

Come join our ‘Ohana!

Honu Services located in Kailua, Hawaii was founded on a simple principle: With the right support you can build anything. Our mission is to empower clients and optimize client potential through cost effective and exceptional operational support. We provide small businesses within the government contracting industry with specialized operational support services found at major corporations. Our talented and dedicated team has years of experience in taking small businesses to the next level. We are certified in ISO 9001, 20000-1, and 27001 standards to ensure the quality and consistency of our services are best in class.

Visit Honu Services for more information.

Job Description:

The Director of Compliance is responsible for designing, implementing, and overseeing the Ethics Awareness and Compliance Program (“Program”) for Honu Services and the sister subsidiaries it supports (collectively, the “enterprise”). Embedded within the Office of Regulatory Affairs, this foundational role ensures the enterprise operates in full alignment with applicable laws, regulations, government contracting standards, and internal policies, while supporting business growth, risk management, and audit readiness. The ideal candidate will establish and maintain a comprehensive compliance framework for the Federal procurement market which fosters enterprise growth and a strong culture of compliance. The position reports to and is overseen by the General Counsel & Head of Compliance, however the Director of Compliance will periodically report to Honu Services’ C-Suite (currently the CEO, COO, and CFO), as well as the Board of Directors of Na Oiwi Kane, Honu Services’ parent company, on the effectiveness of the Program, issues arising under the Program, and resources needed to maintain the Program.

Responsibilities include:

  • Develop the enterprise’s compliance strategy in alignment with corporate objectives and government contracting requirements;
  • Oversee the Program, to include the development, implementation, and auditing of policies and procedures which ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations (e.g., FAR, DFARS, agency supplements, ITAR/EAR), and internal standards;
  • Ensure that a written Code of Ethics and Business Conduct (the “Code”) is maintained, regularly updated and distributed/made available to all employees;
  • Ensure training related to the Program and Code is received by all enterprise employees on a regular basis and new hires as part of their on-boarding process;
  • Monitor internal and external changes impacting the Program and Code (including, but not limited to, important legislative and regulatory developments) and communicate the impact to executive leadership;
  • Conduct periodic risk assessments and review the Program no less than annually to ensure the Program is adapted to current requirements, changes in business lines and focus, and to account for lessons-learned;
  • In conjunction with enterprise leadership and key personnel, promote a culture of compliance, ethics, and accountability through the organization;
  • Identify resources and data access necessary to carry out the functions and responsibilities of an effective Program;
  • Ensure timely preparation, review and submission of regulatory filings and documentation;
  • Oversee internal reporting systems for the reporting of suspected instances of improper conduct including through a system that permits employees to report anonymously and confidentially (i.e. a Hotline system);
  • Ensure all internal reports are handled and resolved in the appropriate manner and documented;
  • Investigate alleged violations of the Code or Program and, if appropriate, develop mitigating corrective action;
  • Oversee and implement policies and procedures to ensure that appropriate notification and disclosure are provided to the Government, where required by law; and
  • Other duties as assigned.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in compliance, legal, or regulatory roles in the government contracting sector;
  • Active designation as a Certified Compliance & Ethics Professional (CCEP) through the Society of Corporate Compliance and Ethics;
  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree in law, public policy, business, or a related field preferred;
  • Deep knowledge of federal procurement regulations; experience with SBA regulations strongly preferred;
  • Experience related to internal and external audits, including those initiated by the government;
  • Proven ability to advise executive leadership and manage enterprise-level risk;
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively; and
  • Exceptional written and oral communication skills.

Physical Requirements:

Work may involve sitting or standing for extended periods of time. Position may require typing and reading from a computer screen. Must have enough mobility, including but not limited to bending, reaching, and kneeling to complete daily duties in a timely and efficient manner. May include lifting weigh up to thirty (30) pounds, as necessary.

Location/Work Schedule:

This is a remote work-from-home position, but the successful candidate may work from our office in Kailua as desired. jobs.description:
Overview

National Debt Relief (NDR) is seeking a Data Engineer to join our Data Engineering team and help build, operate, and improve the data platform that supports analytics and decision-making across the business. Reporting to the Senior Data Engineering Manager, this role will work across our Snowflake-based platform, including ingestion, orchestration, transformation, and analytics-ready data models.

We are an AI-first engineering team, and AI coding agents are a core part of how we develop and maintain our platform. Success in this role requires strong technical judgment, a clear understanding of the systems and data you support, and ownership of production outcomes. The ideal candidate brings strong SQL and data modeling fundamentals, strong depth in at least one area of the modern data stack, and the ability to work effectively across the broader platform. This role is well suited for an engineer who is curious, proactive, and focused on delivering reliable, maintainable data solutions.

Responsibilities

Essential Duties/Responsibilites

  • Own data engineering projects end to end across ingestion, orchestration, transformation, and the analytics layer, including loosely scoped ones, from defining scope through verified delivery.
  • Develop and maintain Python-based ingestion pipelines when custom pipelines are required, integrating data from APIs and third-party systems.
  • Design and build data pipelines and workflows using dbt, Python, Dagster, and Snowflake, making sound modeling and design decisions within the established architecture.
  • Use AI coding agents as a core part of daily work, directing them effectively and taking full responsibility for reviewing and verifying everything you ship.
  • Ensure data quality and trust through testing, data contracts, and automated alerting.
  • Monitor and support production pipelines, including morning load failures (Eastern Time working hours), on-call rotation, and incident triage.
  • Manage Snowflake infrastructure and access controls for sensitive data through infrastructure-as-code, following security, governance, and privacy standards.
  • Optimize Snowflake performance and manage compute costs through efficient query design, warehouse tuning, and resource utilization monitoring.
  • Identify opportunities to improve the platform and turn them into well-defined work; evaluate requirements critically and escalate decisions beyond your scope with recommended solutions.
  • Collaborate with engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders through code review, documentation, and active participation in team discussions.

Qualifications

Education/Experience

  • 4+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or data warehouse development.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience using Python to retrieve and integrate data from APIs.
  • Experience with CI/CD workflows, version control, and automated testing for data pipelines.
  • Experience in financial services or related industries preferred
  • Experience with Terraform or similar infrastructure-as-code tooling preferred.
  • Experience with semantic layers, metric definitions, or BI tools preferred.

Required Skills/Abilities

  • Strong SQL and data modeling skills, including the ability to define appropriate grain and keys, design incremental strategies, organize models into maintainable layers, and make sound tradeoffs between simplicity, performance, and usability.
  • Working proficiency across dbt, Dagster, and Snowflake, with familiarity with Python and infrastructure-as-code. Strong depth in at least one area of the stack and the judgment to know when to pull in additional expertise.
  • Demonstrated proficiency using AI coding agents, including providing clear context and constraints, breaking work into effective tasks, and critically reviewing generated code and outputs.
  • Ability to diagnose data and pipeline issues across multiple layers of the platform, identify root causes, and distinguish one-off failures from systemic problems that require a more durable solution.
  • Ownership mindset: acting on problems in your area without waiting for assignment and treating work as done when the data is right, not when the pull request merges.
  • Develop a strong understanding of the pipelines and data domains you support, including key dependencies, business logic, failure modes, and downstream consumers.
  • Clear, timely, and proactive written communication, including raising blockers early.
  • Business acumen and skill at translating business needs into technical solutions.
  • Effective prioritization across multiple projects while keeping progress visible.

National Debt Relief Role Qualifications:

  • Computer competency and ability to work with a computer.
  • Prioritize multiple tasks and projects simultaneously.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Punctuality expected, ready to report to work on a consistent basis.
  • Attain and maintain high performance expectations on a monthly basis.
  • Work in a fast-paced, high-volume setting.
  • Use and navigate multiple computer systems with exceptional multi-tasking skills.
  • Remain calm and professional during difficult discussions.
  • Take constructive feedback.
  • Available for full-time position.

Compensation Information

Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for each position across the US. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. This good faith pay range is provided in compliance with NYC law and the laws of other jurisdictions that may require a salary range in job postings. The salary for this position is $125,000 to $144,000 annually.

About National Debt Relief

National Debt Relief was founded in 2009 with the goal of helping an expanding number of consumers deal with overwhelming debt. We are one of the most-trusted and best-rated consumer debt relief providers in the United States. As a leading debt settlement organization, we have helped over 450,000 people settle over $10 billion of debt, while empowering them to lead a healthier financial lifestyle and feel free to live their best life. At National Debt Relief, we treat our clients like real people. Our purpose is to elevate, empower, and transform their lives.

Rated A+ by the Better Business Bureau, our goal is to help individuals and families get out of debt with the least possible cost through conducting financial consultations, educating the consumer and recommending the appropriate solution. We become our clients' number one advocate to help them reestablish financial stability as quickly as possible.

Want to learn more about who we are? Connect with us on social!

Benefits

National Debt Relief is a team-oriented environment full of rewards and growth opportunities for our employees. We are dedicated to our employee's success and growth within the company, through our employee mentorship and leadership programs.

Our extensive benefits package includes:

jobs.description:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


Department Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we create technologies our customers refer to as their lifeline. Our technology platforms in communications, software, video and services help our customers work safely and more efficiently. Our technology platforms in mission-critical communications, command center software and video security & analytics, bolstered by managed & support services, make cities safer and help communities and businesses thrive. At Motorola Solutions, we are ushering in a new era in public safety and security.


Job Description

As the Director, Vertical Channel Account Managers (VCAMs) for Europe, you will lead, inspire, and scale a high-performing team of sales professionals dedicated to driving enterprise end-user engagement, customer acquisition, and long-term account growth. In this leadership role, you will report directly to the Senior Sales Director and steer our pan-European end-user sales strategy across key industry sectors such as energy, retail, transport, and utilities.


We believe that our strength lies in an inclusive culture where high performers thrive on accountability, innovation, and shared purpose. You will champion executive-level customer relationships, mentor your team to master complex end-user buying cycles, and collaborate across global teams to help to provide integrated solutions that solve our customers' most vital operational challenges. We recognize that talent takes many paths; candidate qualifications may be demonstrated through formal credentials, equivalent practical experience, or demonstrable professional achievements.


Key Responsibilities:


Strategic Sales Leadership & Team Development


  • Recruit, coach, and scale a specialized team of VCAMs focused on direct end-user engagement across targeted European industry verticals

  • Foster an inclusive culture of accountability, using structured business reviews and dedicated mentorship to elevate team execution during high-stakes sales pursuits

  • Align closely with the Senior Sales Director to set regional benchmarks, quota allocations, and long-range organizational growth plans

End-User Account Strategy & Market Penetration


  • Define pan-European go-to-market strategies tailored to the unique regulatory, operational, and digital transformation needs of vertical enterprise clients

  • Guide the team in building comprehensive account plans that expand footprint, identify modernization opportunities, and accelerate enterprise sales cycles

  • Lead executive-level engagements with enterprise C-suite decision-makers to help to deliver robust, long-term customer partnerships

Operational Execution & Cross-Functional Alignment


  • Analyze pipeline metrics, forecasting accuracy, and customer engagement data to optimize resource deployment and remove roadblocks across the sales lifecycle

  • Collaborate with solution architects and marketing teams to ensure enterprise campaign execution directly reflects real-world vertical customer demands

  • Oversee deal execution and cross-functional collaboration to help to ensure our comprehensive technology portfolio addresses complex client requirements seamlessly


Basic Requirements

  • Experience: 8+ years of experience in B2B tech/SaaS channel sales, partner management, or alliance leadership, with at least 3+ years of proven experience directly managing and scaling a partner-facing sales team.
  • Regional & Vertical Expertise: Proven track record of managing revenues and teams across the European market. Deep understanding of European channel dynamics and experience building go-to-market strategies tailored to specific industry verticals.
  • Sales Methodology: You will have completed training in a methodology such as Command of the Message, Challenger, Miller Heiman.
  • Language Skills: Professional fluency in English is mandatory. Working proficiency in at least one other major European language (e.g., German, French, or Spanish) is highly preferred.
  • Channel Metrics Proficiency: Deep understanding of channel economics, GTM models, channel behaviour and the ability to foster global relationships.
  • Tools: Hands-on experience with enterprise CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce) and PRM platforms (e.g., Impartner, Allbound, or similar).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Management, International Relations, or equivalent practical experience (MBA is a plus).
  • Traveling requirement: Up to 50%.


Travel Requirements

Over 50%


Relocation Provided

None

Experienced

ICUC has been the global leader in Social Media solutions for over 20 years. To date, the ICUC team consists of over 350 people, in over 35 countries, covering 50 languages around the clock. In an environment where the only constant is change, we create common ground between brands and audiences across communities and social media. Fueled by a unique culture built in and around meritocracy, we bring the passion, the know-how and the balance necessary to maintain the charted course we set for ourselves: to be the best, we employ the best. Are you ready to be part of the ICUC team?

If you enjoy social media, have a passion for writing, and know how to connect with people online, we’d love to hear from you.

We’re always looking for talented individuals to join our team.

We're looking for team members who are available to work a mix of the following shifts:


  • Overnights:12AM–8AM North American Central Time

AND

  • Days: 8AM–4PM North American Central Time

OR

Please note that the overnight shift is required for this role, as well as either the day or evening shift. This role requires flexibility to work a variety of shifts, including evenings and weekends.

  • Writing thoughtful, engaging content to spark conversations and drive engagement.
  • Ensuring online communities are safe, respectful, and aligned with client guidelines.

  • Becoming a true extension of our clients’ brands - understanding their strategy, tone, and audience.

  • Strong written communication skills (spelling, grammar, clarity) in English with strong cultural awareness
  • Experience managing social platforms, specifically moderating and engaging
  • Ability to write for brands and adapt tone for different audiences

  • Ability to engage with a variety of content topics (e.g., tech, retail, food, hospitality, tourism, health, pharma)
  • Strong organizational skills, reliability, and excellent customer service instincts
  • Access to reliable, high-speed internet suitable for remote work

Why Work With Us:

  • 100% remote from day one - and always will be.
  • Be part of a creative, supportive, and fast-moving team.
  • Work with exciting global brands.

jobs.excerpt: The Associate Director, Education Development is a business development role in the IME/CME (Independent Medical Education/Continuing Medical Education) sector, focused on generating new grant opportunities and supporter relationships.
jobs.description:
The Associate Director, Education Development is a business development role in the IME/CME (Independent Medical Education/Continuing Medical Education) sector, focused on generating new grant opportunities and supporter relationships. This individual reports to the Director, Education Development, M3 IME (Netherlands). This is a firewalled position: the individual sells M3 IME services only, maintaining the business separation required for accredited education in the US and in many other markets globally. The Associate Director, Education Development will work autonomously to identify and cultivate new business relationships, and grow existing ones, within target supporter companies agreed with the Director, Education Development. Ultimately, this role will support M3 IME’s financial goals by building a robust network of decision makers, delivering qualified opportunities, developing presentations and concept proposals, and supporting opportunities through to close for both organic and new business.

Primary duties and responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Opportunity Identification, Business Development and Selling

To deliver outbound business development and selling activities on behalf of M3 IME.

To work with the Director, Education Development and other M3 IME team members to grow business for current and new offerings, by building relationships with prospective supporters and setting up introductory meetings.

  • Cultivate a network of key global decision makers and influencers in IME/CME, aligned to the M3 IME strategy
  • Generate outbound leads and opportunities, both RFP-based and unsolicited (non-RFP)
  • Build knowledge of M3 IME expertise, capabilities and case studies
  • Prepare and deliver credentials presentations that clearly communicate the M3 IME value proposition
  • Assist with grant proposal development, including writing and uploading to grant portals as required, with support from the scientific team

To maintain awareness of the competitive landscape, opportunities for expansion, customers, markets, and new industry developments and standards, including by attending relevant therapeutic or business conferences as needed and approved by the Director, Education Development.

  • Use centrally provided tools to carry out environmental scanning and stay abreast of key trends and industry movement

Leadership and Internal Management

To provide consultation and strategic input as required/requested from Senior Leadership and the M3 IME Team.

To motivate colleagues through leading by example, demonstrating teamwork, collaboration, clear and concise communication, and commitment to excellence in all aspects of business development.

New Business Operational Governance

  • To execute the new business process and identify opportunities to improve it.
  • Coordinate the sales process with the M3 IME team
  • Maintain an accurate opportunities pipeline, sales call documentation and key management information
  • Provide timely updates on business metrics and performance, and report on progress with target supporters

To track and report quarterly personal KPIs including new business wins (signed contracts/letter of agreement) generated by the Associate Director of Education Development against quarterly targets.

  • Validate KPI report with Director, Education Development and Finance Lead to qualify for quarterly commission
  • Minimum 5 years’ experience in a healthcare environment, including a similar role in an IME/CME, medical communications or comparable organization
  • Previous experience in a sales or business development role, or proven ability in a related role
  • Experience building and cultivating a new business prospect database
  • An established network within the IME space is preferred; a network built in medical communications or through selling to medical affairs would also be relevant
  • Deep understanding of the pharmaceutical industry, particularly the healthcare education landscape
  • Diligent approach to customer relationship management
  • Strong relationship-building skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Able to work independently and as part of the M3 IME team
  • Target-driven, tenacious and personable
  • Proficient in the Microsoft Office suite
  • Comfortable using AI tools to support research, writing and productivity, in line with company policies on confidentiality and data protection
  • Experience in independent medical communications and/or accredited education, in the US and/or globally, is desirable

About M3 EU:

M3 EU is at the forefront of healthcare innovation, offering digital solutions across healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, and more. Since our inception in 2000, we’ve seen remarkable growth, fuelled by our mission to utilize the internet for a healthier world and more efficient healthcare systems.

Our success is anchored in our trusted digital platforms that engage physician communities globally, facilitating impactful medical education, precise job placement, and insightful market research. M3 EU prides itself on a dynamic and innovative work environment where every team member contributes to global health advancements.

Joining M3 EU means being part of a dedicated team striving to make a significant difference in healthcare. We provide a unique opportunity for you to be at the cutting edge of healthcare innovation, shaping the future in a meaningful career. Embrace the chance to drive change with M3 EU.

About the business division:

M3 IME B.V. is a global provider of independent medical education (IME) dedicated to improving healthcare outcomes through high-quality, evidence-based learning for healthcare professionals (HCPs).

As part of the M3 Education group, we leverage a network of over 7 million verified HCPs worldwide to deliver tailored education that meets local and global learning needs. Our programs are designed using rigorous instructional design principles, developed in collaboration with leading experts, and measured through robust outcomes frameworks.
