jobs.description:
Why Enterprise Productivity & Performance?

In today's environment, CEOs, boards, and investors are under increasing pressure to deliver sustainable growth while improving productivity, expanding margins, and funding future innovation. Enterprise leaders are navigating a complex landscape shaped by economic uncertainty, disruptive technologies, evolving customer expectations, and the rapid acceleration of AI. The organizations that outperform are those that can simultaneously optimize performance, reinvest in strategic priorities, and create long-term enterprise value.


Enterprise Productivity & Performance (EPP), part of Accenture's CEO Advisory practice, helps organizations address the questions that matter most to executive leadership teams: What will truly move the needle on enterprise value? How can organizations unlock productivity at scale? How can cost structures be transformed to fund growth, innovation, and reinvention?

Working at the intersection of strategy, operations, technology, data, and AI, we help clients identify and realize enterprise-wide performance opportunities that improve investor metrics, strengthen competitiveness, and enable sustained value creation. Our work goes beyond traditional cost reduction programs, focusing on holistic productivity transformation that aligns enterprise resources with strategic priorities and positions organizations for long-term success.


As part of CEO Advisory, Enterprise Productivity & Performance plays a critical role in helping Accenture become the first call for CEOs, executive teams, boards, and owners. We bring together deep industry expertise, data-driven insights, AI-enabled solutions, and the full breadth of Accenture's capabilities to shape and deliver large-scale reinvention and transformation programs.


Your Role in Enterprise Productivity & Performance

Work at the intersection of business, technology, data, and AI to design and deliver innovative approaches to cost optimization, productivity improvement, operating model transformation, and enterprise reinvention.


Partner with clients to identify the structural drivers of performance, evaluate opportunities across functions and business units, and develop actionable roadmaps that deliver measurable business impact.


Advise clients on AI-enabled productivity strategies and transformation programs that accelerate efficiency, improve decision-making, and create sustainable competitive advantage.


Go deep to understand clients' operating environments, business challenges, cost structures, growth priorities, and strategic objectives in the context of industry, economic, technology, and market trends.


Provide world-class business strategy and performance improvement solutions while coaching and developing junior team members.


Support all phases of client engagements, including opportunity shaping, planning, budgeting, execution, deliverables, stakeholder management, and risk assessment.


Coordinate work across Accenture's industry, functional, technology, and data teams to deliver integrated client solutions.


Ability to travel as needed, up to 100%.

Here's What You Need

Minimum of 3 years of professional experience in consulting, strategy, transformation, value creation, or operational improvement roles, with experience across one or more of the following areas:

  • Cost Transformation
  • Business Strategy
  • Operational Efficiency
  • Operating Model Transformation
  • Value Creation

  • Business Transformation

Bachelor's Degree

A minimum of 3 years of experience identifying and delivering measurable productivity improvements, cost efficiencies, operating model enhancements, margin expansion, or enterprise value creation outcomes.

A minimum of 3 years of experience in analytical, problem-solving, and hypothesis-driven thinking skills, with experience translating complex business challenges into actionable executive recommendations.

A minimum of 3 years of experience bringing an informed industry perspective and strategic point of view across one or more sectors, including:

  • Financial Services
  • Insurance
  • Retail
  • Consumer Goods
  • Technology
  • Life Sciences and Pharmaceuticals
  • Health and Public Service

Experience engaging with senior executives and influencing strategic decision-making across business and functional leadership teams.

Bonus Points If:

You have experience leading large-scale enterprise productivity, cost transformation, performance improvement, or enterprise reinvention programs.

You bring expertise in AI-enabled productivity, intelligent operations, digital transformation, or technology-driven performance improvement initiatives.

You have experience across multiple industries, including Financial Services, Retail, Consumer Goods, Technology, and Life Sciences.

You enjoy developing others and leading interdisciplinary teams, framing, designing, and delivering solutions to complex business challenges.

You have experience supporting business development activities, executive-level relationship building, and the origination of transformation opportunities.

You have an MBA or equivalent graduate degree.

jobs.excerpt: Category: IT Services Location: Offshore Telangana India The Command Center Application Monitoring Analyst is responsible for the day-to-day operational monitoring of the Command Center App (CCA), ensuring that the application, dashboards, data pipelines, and underlying data products remain available, accurate, timely, and reliable.
jobs.description:
Category: IT Services

Location: Offshore Telangana India


The Command Center Application Monitoring Analyst is responsible for the day-to-day operational monitoring of the Command Center App (CCA), ensuring that the application, dashboards, data pipelines, and underlying data products remain available, accurate, timely, and reliable.
The role acts as the first line of operational monitoring, proactively identifying issues, performing initial investigation and validation, coordinating with relevant technical teams, and tracking incidents through to resolution.
Key Responsibilities
Command Center Application Monitoring
Perform daily monitoring of the Command Center App and its key business functionalities.
Validate that dashboards, KPIs, filters, navigation, and application features are functioning as expected.
Monitor application availability, performance, and data refresh status.
Identify anomalies, failures, missing data, or unexpected application behavior.
Perform scheduled monitoring checks throughout the business day.
Data Quality Monitoring
Monitor established data quality rules and dashboards.
Investigate data quality alerts, discrepancies, missing records, and unusual trends.
Perform initial validation against available source data or governed data products.
Escalate confirmed data quality issues to the appropriate Data Engineering, Data Product, or Analytics teams.
Track recurring data quality issues and support root-cause analysis.
Incident Management and Escalation
Act as the first point of contact for CCA operational issues.
Perform initial triage to determine whether an issue relates to the application, data, pipeline, access, or infrastructure.
Log production defects and incidents with clear issue descriptions, supporting evidence, and business impact.
Escalate incidents according to the defined severity and escalation process.
Follow up with responsible teams until resolution.
Validate fixes before incidents are closed.
Release and Deployment Monitoring
Support operational validation following CCA releases and production deployments.
Perform post-deployment smoke checks on critical application functionality.
Validate that key reports, dashboards, data pipelines, access controls, and application features remain operational.
Report deployment-related issues immediately and support rollback or escalation decisions where required.
User Access and Security Checks
Support monitoring of user access to CCA.
Assist with validation of SSO, role-based access, RLS/PLS, and user onboarding issues.
Escalate access and authentication issues to the appropriate support teams.
Ensure access-related activities follow established governance processes.
Operational Reporting
Maintain a daily monitoring checklist and issue tracker.
Provide regular operational status updates covering application availability, pipeline status, data freshness, data quality exceptions, open production incidents, outstanding defects, and release-related issues.
Highlight risks, recurring failures, ageing issues, and dependencies requiring management attention.

Requirements

Required Skills and Experience
  • 3-5 years of experience in Data Analytics, Application Support, Production Support, Data Operations, BI Operations, or a similar role.
  • Good understanding of how applications function, including key features, workflows, dependencies, and user interactions.
  • Working knowledge of SQL for basic data validation and troubleshooting.
  • Understanding of data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, data refreshes, and data quality concepts.
  • Familiarity with tools such as Azure DevOps, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, and the Microsoft data and analytics ecosystem.
  • Basic knowledge of APIs and tools such as Swagger or Postman.
  • Experience logging, tracking, and managing production incidents and defects.
  • Ability to perform structured issue triage and distinguish between application, data, pipeline, access, and infrastructure problems.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to identify unusual data or application behavior.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills.
Key Competencies
  • Proactive monitoring: Identifies potential issues before they are reported by users.
  • Analytical thinking: Investigates discrepancies and narrows down likely causes.
  • Attention to detail: Detects subtle data, application, or operational anomalies.
  • Ownership: Tracks issues through to resolution rather than simply escalating them.
  • Communication: Provides clear, concise updates to technical teams, business stakeholders, and management.
  • Prioritization: Distinguishes critical production incidents from lower-priority defects.
  • Process discipline: Consistently follows monitoring, escalation, incident, and deployment procedures.
Typical Daily Activities
  • Verify overnight pipeline and data-refresh status with GTDP.
  • Check the relevant monitoring portal for failed, delayed, or incomplete pipelines.
  • Perform CCA application health checks.
  • Validate key dashboards, KPIs, and critical business views.
  • Review data quality monitoring results.
  • Investigate exceptions and perform initial data validation.
  • Log and escalate confirmed production issues.
  • Follow up on outstanding incidents and defects.
  • Perform additional checks following deployments or releases.
  • Maintain the daily monitoring checklist and provide an operational status update.
Success Measures / KPIs
  • At least 98% completion of scheduled monitoring checks.
  • Critical monitoring checks completed within the agreed morning operational window.
  • Production issues proactively identified before significant user impact, where technically possible.
  • Timely escalation of critical incidents according to the agreed SLA.
  • Accurate documentation and classification of production issues.
  • Reduction in recurring production incidents through identification of patterns and root causes.
  • Post-deployment validation completed for 100% of production CCA releases.
  • Clear and up-to-date tracking of all open CCA operational issues.

jobs.description:
The Principal Specialist, Trade Compliance is an individual contributor responsible for driving compliant, efficient, and business enabling export/import operations. Serving as a subject matter expert and trusted advisor, this role supports operational export control matters, strengthens export controls and screening processes, and partners across functions to manage risk, prevent avoidable shipment holds and delays, and support operational continuity. Core areas include U.S. export controls (EAR and ITAR), HS and Schedule B classification, valuation and country of origin, license determination and license management, restricted party and end use/user screening, export/import compliance block resolution, export filings (AES/EEI), reconciling broker entries, and recordkeeping. Experience with Oracle GTM and SAP GTS is preferred. The role may also provide targeted support for U.S. import operations, including shipment review, documentation, issue resolution, and escalation of compliance concerns. 

About GlobalFoundries:

GlobalFoundries is a leading full-service semiconductor foundry providing a unique combination of design, development, and fabrication services to some of the world’s most inspired technology companies. With a global manufacturing footprint spanning three continents, GlobalFoundries makes possible the technologies and systems that transform industries and give customers the power to shape their markets. For more information, visit www.gf.com.

Summary of Role: The Principal Specialist, Trade Compliance is an individual contributor responsible for driving compliant, efficient, and business enabling export/import operations .

Essential Responsibilities: Serving as a subject matter expert and trusted advisor, this role supports operational export control matters, strengthens export controls and screening processes, and partners across functions to manage risk, prevent avoidable shipment holds and delays, and support operational continuity. Core areas include U.S. export controls (EAR and ITAR), HS and Schedule B classification, valuation and country of origin, license determination and license management, restricted party and end use/user screening, export/import compliance block resolution, export filings (AES/EEI), reconciling broker entries, and recordkeeping. Experience with Oracle GTM and SAP GTS is preferred. The role may also provide targeted support for U.S. import operations, including shipment review, documentation, issue resolution, and escalation of compliance concerns.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own day to day export compliance execution and provide timely, practical guidance to business teams, logistics, sales and customer service, freight forwarders, customers, suppliers, and service providers.
  • Review and release export transactions, including resolution of trade system (GTM/GTS) compliance blocks (embargo, restricted party, and license determination holds), and drive urgent and high priority shipments to compliant, on time resolution.
  • Determine and validate export classifications (ECCN/EAR99) for products, wafers, samples, technology, software, and equipment in partnership with engineering and product teams.
  • Prepare, submit, and manage export license applications, license exception usage, and license conditions, including tracking quantities, values, and expirations.
  • Oversee restricted party, end use, and end user screening; investigate potential matches and red flags; and support due diligence and risk intelligence reviews of customers, suppliers, and other counterparties.
  • Conduct routine, risk based audits of export transactions, AES/EEI filings, and supporting documentation.
  • Develop, maintain, and continuously improve export compliance procedures, records, controls, and operating practices across applicable sites, consistent with the company’s Export Management and Compliance Program.
  • Advise on export control and sanctions requirements for hand carries, samples, documents, technology transfers, and deemed exports, including support for HR and onboarding processes.
  • Assess internal controls, identify root causes and compliance gaps, and drive sustainable corrective and preventive actions.
  • Translate complex export control requirements into clear, actionable guidance, decision frameworks, and operating requirements for internal stakeholders.
  • Support day to day import compliance execution, including routine reconciliation of customs broker entries against commercial documents to verify tariff classification, customs valuation, country of origin, duty treatment, special tariff applicability, supporting documentation, and filing post summary corrections.
  • Review ACE reports and import data to identify errors, trends, and duty impact issues, and coordinate with customs brokers to resolve them.
  • Support tariff matters and assist with CTPAT program activities as needed.
  • Lead cross functional trade compliance projects and contribute to broader Global Trade Compliance initiatives, systems enhancements, and process transformation.
  • Design and deliver training and practical guidance for business partners on export and import compliance requirements.

Other Responsibilities:

  • Operate with a high degree of independence but able to work well within the team across export/import controls, classification, licensing, screening, sanctions, trade system compliance, and day to day import compliance activities including entry review and reconciliation.
  • Apply sound judgment to interpret requirements, evaluate facts, assess risk, and recommend practical, defensible solutions.
  • Lead resolution of complex operational issues and implement durable improvements to processes, systems, and controls.
  • Manage competing priorities, exercise urgency when required, and maintain quality in a fast paced environment.
  • Develop recommendations that may materially affect operations, costs, customers, and cross functional processes, and communicate tradeoffs clearly to decision makers.

Required Qualifications:

Education – Bachelor degree

  • Experience - Five years of progressively responsible experience in export compliance, trade compliance, or international trade operations.
  • Advanced working knowledge of the Export Administration Regulations (EAR), U.S. sanctions programs (OFAC), export licensing, internal controls, and recordkeeping requirements.
  • Working knowledge of U.S. import regulations and customs operations, including tariff classification, customs valuation, country of origin, and CBP recordkeeping requirements.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead projects, coordinate cross functional work, influence without direct authority, and guide business partners or less experienced colleagues.
  • Strong analytical, investigative, problem solving, and written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities, work independently, and drive complex issues to timely resolution.
  • Professional fluency in written and spoken English.
  • Proficiency with trade compliance (e.g., SAP GTS), screening, and data analysis tools. Ability to learn and apply new systems quickly.

jobs.excerpt: K2 is building the largest and highest-power satellites ever flown, unlocking performance levels previously out of reach across every orbit.
jobs.description:
K2 is building the largest and highest-power satellites ever flown, unlocking performance levels previously out of reach across every orbit. Backed by over $1 billion in total funding from leading investors including Altimeter Capital, ICONIQ, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Redpoint Ventures, and T. Rowe Price — and with over $1 billion in signed contracts across commercial and US government customers, we're mass-producing the highest-power satellite platforms ever built for missions from LEO to deep space.

The rise of heavy-lift launch vehicles is shifting the industry from an era of mass constraint to one of mass abundance, and we believe this new era demands a fundamentally different class of spacecraft. Engineered to survive the harshest radiation environments and to fully capitalize on today's and tomorrow's massive rockets, K2 satellites deliver unmatched capability at constellation scale and across multiple orbits.

With multiple launches in 2027 and plans to scale to 100 satellites a year, we're Building Bigger — helping develop the solar system and build toward a Kardashev Type II (K2) civilization. If you are a motivated individual who thrives in a fast-paced environment and you're excited about contributing to the success of a high-growth Series D-funded company, we'd love for you to apply.

The Role

We are looking for a Principal ASIC Synthesis and Timing Engineer to lead the implementation of complex SoCs for next-generation satellite and space systems. You will own the constraints development and validation—from RTL handoff to synthesis —and collaborate closely with architecture, RTL design, DFT, and physical design team. This role also involves managing external physical design partners, driving convergence of schedule and ensuring first-pass silicon success in advanced FinFET technologies. You’ll be a key contributor in achieving timing closure, optimizing PPA, and supporting design integration with external partners. You will be part of a collaborative design team developing state-of-the-art mixed-signal SoCs to be hosted on some of the largest, most powerful, rapidly designed and rapidly manufactured satellites ever deployed in space. In your first 6 months, you will develop and implement new SoC sub-systems for satellite communications and beyond. In your first two years, you will have contributed to developing cutting-edge SoCs that will fly in space.

Responsibilities

  • Own the complete RTL-to-Synthesis flow: Do synthesis at block and top level, Work with physical design team to integrate the floorplanning information for physical synthesis.
  • Develop and maintain design methodologies, scripts, and automation to optimize performance, power, and area (PPA).
  • Collaborate with front-end and verification teams to ensure clean handoffs, timing closure, and efficient design iteration.
  • Drive timing closure across multiple voltage and process corners, including sign-off with foundry-qualified tools.
  • Own Lint, CDC and UPF checks and drive collaboration to close out issues.
  • Develop an end to end formal verification methodology without any gap to deliver on full confidence functionality between the RTL and the post layout netlist.
  • Manage and technically guide external physical design partners and service vendors, ensuring alignment on milestones, deliverables, and quality standards.
  • Work with EDA vendors to debug and optimize tool flows, and evaluate new methodologies.
  • Support chip bring-up and debug through close collaboration with post-silicon and test teams.
  • Support your product through production and spaceflight.

Qualifications

  • B.S. or M.S. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field
  • 10+ years of experience in ASIC design for high-performance SoCs.
  • Proven end-to-end expertise in RTL-to-GDSII flows using industry tools (Synopsys, Cadence, or Siemens).
  • Strong hands-on experience with timing closure, IR drop analysis, low power implementation and ECO implementation.
  • Deep understanding of physical design constraints for multi-clock, multi-voltage, and hierarchical SoCs.
  • Experience with advanced FinFET process nodes.
  • Prior experience in design convergence with offshore/outsourced PD teams or vendors.
  • Able to resolve formal verification issues.
  • Able to analyze and fix VCLP issues regarding UPF.
  • Experience with Logic equivalence check debug, Functional ECO development and implementation with minimal database disruption, Low power checker to validate UPF;
  • Familiarity with DFT integration, STA sign-off with functional ECO implementation.
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Act as technical leader and subject-matter expert helping to teach, grow, and mentor others in the team.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to radiation-hardened or space-qualified ASICs.
  • Familiarity with physical design service vendor management or offshore collaboration.
  • Experience driving tapeouts through TSMC.
  • Experience with Gate-All-Around technologies.
  • Experience working in cross-functional, geographically distributed teams.

Compensation and Benefits:

  • Base salary range for this role is $190,000 – $280,000 + equity in the company
  • Salary will be based on several factors including, but not limited to: knowledge and skills, education, and experience level
  • Comprehensive benefits package including paid time off, medical/dental/vision/ coverage, life insurance, paid parental leave, and many other perks

If you don’t meet 100% of the preferred skills and experience, we encourage you to still apply! Building a spacecraft unlike any other requires a team unlike any other and non-traditional career twists and turns are encouraged!

If you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know.

Who We Are

Pindrop is a cybersecurity company delivering continuous identity verification across voice, video, and digital interactions. Powered by the Pindrop Intelligence Network, our unified trust platform helps enterprises answer three critical questions:

Is this identity synthetic? Detect AI-generated and manipulated voice and video.
Is this identity risky? Identify fraud, suspicious behavior, and other risk signals.
Is this identity known? Authenticate identities using voice, device, behavioral, and other signals.

Pindrop brings this intelligence together across purpose-built trust engines to help organizations make informed decisions in real time — protecting customers, workforce interactions, and emerging AI-driven interactions.

Pindrop protects billions of high-risk interactions for enterprises, including leading financial institutions, insurers, and healthcare organizations. Its technology is informed by more than 8 billion real-world interactions annually and protected by 300+ patents.

Recognized by TIME as one of the 10 Most Influential Software Companies of 2026 and by Inc. for Best in Business for Innovation, Pindrop is backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz, IVP, and CapitalG.

What you’ll do

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Capture team, you will design, build, and operate the distributed services that form Pindrop's real-time ingestion layer. You will engineer systems that acquire, normalize, and deliver real-time and recorded audio, video, and telephony metadata across provider platforms (Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Webex, Google Meet, Amazon Connect, Genesys) into Pindrop’s downstream analytics, fraud detection, and authentication engines.This is a product-engineering role focused on real-time media ingestion, low-latency streaming pipelines, provider integrations, and production reliability. It is not an ML model-development or model-scoring role.

More specifically, you will:

  • Design, build, test, deploy, and operate distributed Go microservices and media pipelines optimized for low-latency processing, high availability, and fault tolerance.
  • Build and evolve integrations across communication technologies and protocols, including SIPREC, RTP, WebRTC, WebSockets, and enterprise contact center platforms.
  • Lead projects from architecture and technical design through implementation, testing, deployment, documentation, and production support.
  • Diagnose complex distributed systems issues using logs, metrics, traces, and system tests; improve service reliability, capacity, and security.
  • Provide technical guidance through design reviews, code reviews, architecture decisions, and mentoring junior engineers.
  • Partner closely with Product, System Test, Infrastructure, SRE, and adjacent analytics teams to deliver seamless data ingestion.
  • Participate in a shared on-call rotation after completing team training and production-readiness onboarding.

Who you are

  • Resilient & Adaptable: You are optimistic in the face of ambiguity and change, turning complex engineering challenges into scalable solutions.
  • Accountable Owner: You take end-to-end responsibility for outcomes, under-promising and over-delivering on commitments.
  • Analytical Problem Solver: You possess strong analytical skills and enjoy driving technical design, project leadership, and mentorship.
  • Clear Communicator: You communicate complex technical concepts clearly to cross-functional partners and make decisions understandable across teams.

Your skill-set

Must Have

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience building and operating distributed backend services in production.
  • Strong proficiency in Go (Golang) or a comparable compiled language, with strong Linux/Unix, networking, concurrency, and performance tuning fundamentals.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud-native architectures (AWS/GCP), containerization/orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), and DevOps practices (Terraform/CDK, CI/CD pipelines).
  • Proven track record of diagnosing and resolving complex issues in distributed systems, including participation in on-call production support.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with real-time communication protocols and streaming frameworks (SIPREC, VoIP, SIP, RTP, WebRTC, WebSockets, FFmpeg, GStreamer).
  • Experience integrating with telephony, contact-center, CPaaS, or meeting platforms (Amazon Connect, Genesys, Zoom, Teams, Webex).
  • Experience with event-driven messaging systems (Apache Kafka/MSK), distributed caching, or service-to-service API design (REST/gRPC).
  • Familiarity with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) and security best practices in compliance-sensitive cloud environments.

What You’ll Gain

Build Pindrop's "front door"—the real-time ingestion layer for communication data from global providers like Zoom, Teams, Webex, and Verizon. Your work directly feeds the deepfake detection and voice security engines that protect billions of interactions for the world's top financial institutions and enterprises. You will solve high-impact distributed systems puzzles at enterprise scale alongside world-class engineering, security, and AI minds.

  • Work with experienced engineering leaders and teammates who value technical excellence, curiosity, thoughtful debate, and continuous improvement.
  • Work on technology operating at enterprise scale that determines whether the person—or AI—on the other side of an interaction can be trusted.
  • With Audaciously Innovate as our core value, you’ll incorporate AI into your development workflow, experiment with emerging tools, and help define modern AI-enabled engineering practices.
  • Collaborate across Engineering, Product, and SRE to challenge assumptions, influence technical direction, and turn complex requirements into scalable systems.
  • Expand your influence through architecture, technical decision-making, mentorship, and cross-functional leadership.

What we offer

As part of Pindrop, you’ll directly influence our products and contribute to shaping the future of voice security. We invest in great people and support them with great benefits:

  • Competitive compensation, including equity for all employees
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Remote-first culture

This position is contracted through Alcor BPO.

Not sure if this is you?

We want a diverse, global team, with a broad range of experience and perspectives. If this job sounds great, but you’re not sure if you qualify, apply anyway! We carefully consider every application and will either move forward with you, find another team that might be a better fit, keep in touch for future opportunities, or thank you for your time.

AI - A Transformative Force

At Pindrop, we view artificial intelligence as a transformative force that, when harnessed responsibly, can unlock unprecedented value for our customers, partners and society and enable and empower us to continue to deliver cutting-edge technology to combat fraud and unblur the lines between what it means to be human versus machine.

Applications with the strongest match to job requirements are prioritized for human review; not all applications may be individually reviewed.

🚀 The Vision: Building the Operating System for Product Creation

Since 2013, THE/STUDIO has been building the definitive operating system for product creation. We are combining modern SaaS technology with custom manufacturing to make producing physical goods as seamless, fast, and scalable as launching software.

We operate two core platforms: Customize Now(our best-in-class, on-demand manufacturing platform) and Source Anything (our new SaaS product that enables customers to seamlessly work with global factories beyond our own network).

We are a profitable, previously Silicon Valley-backed, fully remote company, and we are not just looking to improve manufacturing, we are looking for a visionary operator to help us truly revolutionize the global supply chain.

💻 The Role

We’re looking for a hard-working Junior Sourcing Representative to build and work our factory network across Europe, including European factories of US companies. Candidates from Italy, Spain and Portugal are our priority, given how big manufacturing is there. You’ll match customer requests to the right factory, get them quoted, and follow up until every quote is in.

This is a junior, hands-on role, not a sourcing manager or supply chain strategy role. You’ll do what the rest of our sourcing team does every day: find factories, call them, follow up and get results.

Why This Role Is Exciting:

  • Direct Access to Leadership: You will have the opportunity to work directly with our CEO and executive team, giving you high visibility, direct mentorship, and a seat at the table.

  • Product & Strategic Influence: We operate with flat hierarchies. Your daily insights from the ground level will directly shape our product roadmap, workflows, and company strategy.

  • Rapid Scale & Career Trajectory: We are growing rapidly. Joining us right now means high autonomy, minimal red tape, and massive room for personal and professional acceleration.

🎯 What You’ll Do

  • Find and vet factories: Identify manufacturers across Europe that fit each request, across apparel, leather goods, footwear, accessories, textiles and packaging. Check what they make, their MOQs and their lead times.

  • Assign RFQs: Send requests for quotes to the right factories through our internal platform.

  • Follow up until it’s done: Phone, email and WhatsApp until every factory has quoted on time. Factories rarely answer the first message, so chasing is a big part of this job.

  • Onboard factories: Guide new factories through signing up on our platform, and upload quotes for them when needed.

  • Meet SLA targets: Make sure quotes come back within our service deadlines.

  • Keep records: Keep factory status, quotes and escalations up to date in our tracking tools.

  • Grow your network: Build a reliable list of European factories that keeps growing every month.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with our global sourcing, sales and operations teams to keep every request moving.

💡 The Profile We’re Looking For (Our Core Pillars)

Our Founder/CEO defines our top performers by three distinct traits. If this describes how you operate, you will thrive here:

  1. Raw Intelligence & Problem-Solving: High processing power, business acumen, and logical reasoning. You can think on your feet, connect complex ideas, and break down ambiguous problems quickly.

  2. "Give a Shit" Energy (Extreme Ownership): You take 100% accountability for your domain and outcomes. You don't make excuses or blame external factors. You look inward, find solutions, and push across the finish line.

  3. Rapid Adaptation & Radical Candor: You embrace blunt, constructive feedback and pivot instantly without ego. You excel in a fast-moving environment where you need to act with urgency without waiting for hand-holding.

Requirements:

  • Location: Based in Europe. Italy, Spain or Portugal preferred

  • Languages: Fluent in Italian, Spanish or Portuguese, plus working-level English (B2 or above)

  • Experience: 1–3 years in manufacturing: for example factory production, sourcing, purchasing, merchandising, export sales or supply chain coordination

  • Factory contact: Direct contact with factories or suppliers in your current or past roles

  • Hard-working: Persistent and comfortable making many calls and follow-ups every day

  • Organised: Able to handle many requests and deadlines at once

  • Communication: Clear, professional communication in English (B2 or above) with factories and our global team.

  • Independent Contractor Mindset: Highly disciplined, self-motivated, and comfortable operating as a full-time, dedicated independent contractor in a 100% remote setting.

  • Remote Infrastructure: Reliable setup including a fast computer, noise-canceling headset, and a rock-solid, stable internet connection.

Nice to Have:

  • Knowledge of a manufacturing district, e.g. Italian leather goods and textiles, Portuguese textiles and footwear, Spanish footwear and packaging

  • A second language from Italian, Spanish or Portuguese

  • Experience with RFQ systems, B2B marketplaces or a CRM

This is not the right role if you’re a senior sourcing or procurement manager, or looking for a role managing a team.

💰 Compensation & Terms

  • Base: Depending on experience. This is a junior role, monthly comp starts at 1000 EUR.

  • Engagement Type: Full-time, exclusive independent contractor role.

🔎 Our Hiring Process

  1. Submit Application: IMPORTANT! Please submit your resume/CV in English

  2. Initial Screening

  3. Hiring Manager Interview: Your factory experience, how you follow up, and how you handle deadlines.

  4. Case Study: A practical sourcing task: find and approach factories for a real-style request.

jobs.description:
#RunwiththePack


At Arctic Wolf, we’re on a mission to end cyber risk.


We are a global leader in security operations, helping organizations stay resilient against evolving cyber threats through industry-leading security operations, threat intelligence, and a people-first approach to cybersecurity.


More than 3,000 Pack members across the world work together every day to protect our customers and empower security teams with new levels of speed, accuracy, and intelligence at scale. What sets us apart is our relentless focus on our customers, innovation at scale, and a collaborative culture where talented people can do meaningful work that truly makes a difference.


We’re constantly looking for talented people to join the Pack and help us take our performance to the next level.

About the Position:

The Staff Threat Intelligence Researcher is an expert individual contributor aligned closely with the Adversary Operations team. This role leads rapid, intelligence-driven investigations into emerging threats, active campaigns, and high-impact adversary activity, using internal managed detection and response (MDR), incident response (IR), endpoint, network, cloud, identity, malware, infrastructure, and open-source data. The researcher connects signals across customer environments, develops defensible campaign and actor assessments, and translates findings into timely hunting guidance, durable detections, incident response actions, customer protections, and authoritative reporting. Success is demonstrated through fast, technically rigorous investigations; discovery of previously unknown or under-scoped activity; and clear operational impact across security operations, incident response, product, and customer-facing teams.

Responsibilities

Recognized as a technical authority, the Staff Threat Intelligence Researcher independently leads complex adversary investigations and helps shape how the organization identifies, validates, tracks, and responds to emerging threats across a large, multi-customer telemetry environment.

  • Lead rapid-response research into emerging threats, newly disclosed vulnerabilities, active exploitation, malware campaigns, ransomware operations, and nation-state or cybercriminal activity that may affect customers.
  • Proactively hunt across internal MDR and IR telemetry to identify active campaigns, previously unknown infrastructure, malware, intrusion patterns, and common adversary behaviors across customer environments.
  • Correlate endpoint, network, cloud, identity, email, vulnerability, malware, infrastructure, case, and open-source data to develop and test campaign hypotheses.
  • Scope potentially widespread activity by determining affected customers, observed behaviors, intrusion timelines, infrastructure overlap, and confidence in campaign or actor clustering.
  • Produce time-sensitive intelligence assessments, threat advisories, hunting packages, campaign reports, and executive or customer briefings during high-impact security events.
  • Develop and operationalize YARA, Sigma, behavioral analytics, search logic, indicators, and detection hypotheses in partnership with detection engineering, threat hunting, and security operations teams.
  • Partner closely with Adversary Response and Incident Response teams during active investigations, providing adversary context, collection requirements, analytical judgments, and follow-on hunting recommendations.
  • Establish and apply rigorous standards for campaign clustering, actor tracking, attribution, analytical confidence, evidence handling, and intelligence validation.
  • Build repeatable research methods, tooling, and automation that reduce the time from initial signal to validated finding and customer protection.
  • Publish high-quality internal and external research and represent the organization in customer briefings, intelligence-sharing communities, and industry forums.

Expert Positioning Goal

Serve as a recognized authority in adversary research and response by developing repeatable campaign-investigation tradecraft, mentoring other researchers, and producing original research that improves customer protection and industry understanding of active threats.

Example Key Results

  • Identified and scoped an active campaign through cross-customer MDR telemetry, enabling rapid customer notification, targeted hunting, and new behavioral detections.
  • Reduced time from emerging-threat signal to validated intelligence package by creating reusable queries, enrichment workflows, and investigation playbooks.
  • Established a defensible campaign-clustering and analytical-confidence approach used consistently in adversary reporting and response decisions.

Complexity & Problem Solving

Solves highly complex and ambiguous problems involving incomplete telemetry, noisy or deceptive indicators, uncertain attribution, multi-stage intrusions, and activity distributed across customer environments. Forms and tests competing hypotheses, distinguishes shared tooling from coordinated campaigns, assesses confidence and impact, and makes time-sensitive recommendations while identifying evidence gaps and alternative explanations.

About You

  • Extensive experience in cyber threat intelligence, adversary research, threat hunting, malware analysis, incident response, or a related discipline, with demonstrated technical leadership as a senior individual contributor.
  • Deep knowledge of nation-state, cybercriminal, ransomware, initial-access, malware, and vulnerability-exploitation ecosystems.
  • Demonstrated experience hunting across large-scale endpoint, network, cloud, identity, email, and security-operations telemetry using SIEM, EDR, data-lake, or similar analysis platforms.
  • Strong ability to use SQL, Python, Kusto Query Language, SPL, or comparable languages to analyze large datasets, automate enrichment, and build reusable research workflows.
  • Experience analyzing host and network telemetry such as process execution, command lines, authentication events, DNS, proxy, firewall, Zeek, Sysmon, auditd, and cloud audit logs.
  • Experience translating intelligence into YARA, Sigma, behavioral detections, hunting strategies, incident response actions, defensive controls, or product improvements.
  • Working knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK, the Diamond Model, intrusion analysis, structured analytic techniques, campaign clustering, attribution, and analytical confidence.
  • Familiarity with malware-analysis and reverse-engineering tools such as Ghidra, IDA Pro, x64dbg, debuggers, sandboxes, and static or dynamic analysis utilities.
  • Proven ability to author publication-quality threat research and communicate technical findings, uncertainty, customer impact, and recommended actions to technical, executive, and customer audiences.
  • Sound judgment when handling sensitive intelligence, customer data, uncertain attribution, and high-impact or fast-moving security incidents.

On-Camera Policy
To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.

Benefits


All wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including:


  • Equity for all employees
  • Flexible time off and paid volunteer days
  • 401(k) contribution and matching
  • Training and career development programs
  • Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical, mental health, dental, disability, life and AD&D, and value-added services
  • Robust Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with mental health services

At Arctic Wolf, protecting our people, customers, and data is fundamental to how we operate. All employees are expected to uphold our commitment to security, privacy, and compliance by following internal information security policies, standards, and controls designed to safeguard the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of business, customer, employee, and other confidential information and to support compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

We are seeking a talented and detail-oriented Real Estate Photo Editor to enhance property photographs for real estate listings.   • Proven experience in real estate photo editing or architectural photography.

Accomplishing this requires strong partnerships with patients, partners and stakeholders across the entire value chain. Together, we define how our business can create solutions that serve the needs of those affected by rare diseases while facilitating sustainable growth.

At Sobi, each person brings their unique talents to work as a team and make a difference. We are dedicated to developing and delivering innovative therapies to improve the lives of rare disease patients and our edge comes from our team of people.

Our employees come from a variety of backgrounds within research, healthcare, industry and the academic sphere.

About Trickle Up

Trickle Up works with women living in extreme poverty to build sustainable livelihoods. We partner with local organizations and governments to expand access to Economic Inclusion, including through the Graduation Approach.

About the Role

Trickle Up seeks an experienced development professional to build and strengthen its Economic Inclusion work in Côte d’Ivoire. This role offers the opportunity to provide ongoing technical and implementation support, develop lasting government and partner relationships, and help shape a growing country program.

The Country Program Lead will work closely with the Vice President, Africa, and the Economic Inclusion team to support partners, resolve implementation challenges, and turn learning into better results. We are looking for someone who takes initiative, follows through on commitments, and is interested in contributing to the continued development of Trickle Up’s work in Côte d’Ivoire. This is intended as a longer-term engagement, initially offered through a one-year consultancy agreement. Any extension will depend on funding, program needs, satisfactory completion of agreed deliverables, and the appropriate engagement arrangement.

Key Responsibilities

Program planning and implementation

  • Coordinate agreed implementation priorities for the Man pilot and other funded initiatives, supporting partners to address challenges and follow through on actions.
  • Maintain a practical monthly work plan and track progress, budgets, donor commitments, risks, and dependencies. Recommend corrective actions and follow up on agreed decisions.

Government and partner relationships

  • Build and maintain productive relationships with relevant ministries, implementation partners, development partners, financial institutions, cooperatives, and other stakeholders.
  • Clarify roles and technical assistance priorities, prepare inputs for stakeholder and financing discussions, and follow up on commitments that support program adoption and expansion.

Program quality and partner capacity

  • Provide technical support on operating procedures, targeting, coaching, training, supervision, assessments, livelihoods, and market linkages.
  • Work closely with the Economic Inclusion team to adapt tools, curricula, and delivery approaches and strengthen partner capacity. Promote women’s agency, inclusion, safeguarding, and accessible participant feedback.

Evidence and learning

  • Work with the Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning (MEL) Manager and technical specialists on data collection and quality, locally appropriate tools, key indicators, and issues requiring technical guidance.
  • Use evidence, participant feedback, delivery capacity, costs, and risks to improve implementation and inform expansion and financing plans. Document lessons for Trickle Up’s wider Economic Inclusion practice and approved external use.

Program development

  • Develop agreed concept notes, proposals, partnership opportunities, and future program designs with Trickle Up’s Africa, Economic Inclusion, and business development teams.
  • Identify practical opportunities to strengthen and grow the country portfolio, taking account of partner capacity and confirmed or potential funding.

Country establishment

  • Coordinate requested information and documentation with designated legal, tax, registration, and other advisers, and follow up on establishment activities.
  • Track progress, dependencies, and risks.

Monthly priorities and results

At the beginning of each month, the Consultant and the Vice President, Africa will agree on specific deliverables, expected results, timelines, estimated consulting days, and criteria for assessing completion or satisfactory progress. The recurring areas below will guide this work as the country program develops.

  • Workplan and priorities: An updated plan with agreed activities, expected outputs, timelines, and dependencies.
  • Implementation and partner support: Evidence of progress, support provided, implementation challenges, and corrective actions.
  • Program quality and technical support: Completion or advancement of agreed technical outputs, tools, training, and livelihood or market activities.
  • MEL and learning: Progress on data collection and quality, indicators, lessons, and issues requiring technical guidance.
  • Partnerships and stakeholder engagement: A brief record of engagement, decisions, and agreed follow-up actions.
  • Program development: Progress on concepts, proposals, partnerships, and future program design.
  • Progress and action report: A concise monthly summary of work and outputs, days worked, outstanding actions, risks or dependencies, and priorities for the following month.

Working Relationships and Authority

  • The Consultant will coordinate with Trickle Up’s Africa and Economic Inclusion teams, relevant Côte d’Ivoire personnel, implementation partners, and approved advisers.
  • The Consultant may provide technical guidance, coordination, mentoring, and recommendations within the agreed scope. The engagement does not include authority to hire, terminate, discipline, set compensation for, or formally evaluate Trickle Up employees.
  • The Consultant may participate in technical discussions with government agencies, donors, partners, and other stakeholders as authorized. The Consultant may not sign agreements, make financial, legal, programmatic, employment, or institutional commitments, issue formal correspondence in Trickle Up’s name, or publicly state an organizational position without prior written authorization.
  • The Consultant is responsible for organizing how and when the services are performed, meeting agreed deadlines, safeguarding standards, confidentiality and data-protection requirements, and applicable laws.

Required Qualifications

  • At least seven years of relevant experience in Economic Inclusion, social protection, livelihoods, or a closely related field, including at least five years advising or leading complex programs, multidisciplinary teams, partnerships, or technical-assistance engagements.
  • Fluent French and strong professional English, including written reporting and collaboration with international teams.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting Ivorian government programs or institutions through technical assistance, such as operating procedures, capacity strengthening, frontline training, costing, budgeting, or implementation support.
  • Experience working with government and development partners on program adoption, scale, public financing, cash transfers, or related social-protection initiatives.
  • Applied understanding of Economic Inclusion and the Graduation Approach, including program delivery, partner management, budgeting, donor commitments, and capacity strengthening.
  • Ability to assess data quality, interpret findings, synthesize stakeholder input, and translate evidence into clear recommendations.
  • Demonstrated experience working as an independent consultant or adviser and managing deliverable-based assignments requiring independent professional judgment.
  • A relevant degree or equivalent professional experience and a demonstrated commitment to women’s agency, inclusion, safeguarding, and ethical practice.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with market systems, digital coaching tools, or field coordination of impact evaluations, including randomized trials.
  • Established professional knowledge of Côte d’Ivoire’s social protection, livelihoods, public finance, and development-partner environment.

Application Requirements

Applicants should submit the following by November 30, 2026:

  • A résumé or curriculum vitae.
  • A brief cover letter describing relevant experience and proposed approach to the consultancy.
  • A financial proposal stating the proposed professional fee, currency, and any applicable taxes.
  • Availability during the anticipated consultancy period.
  • Contact information for at least two professional references.

Independent Consultancy and Safeguards

The selected consultant will be engaged under a written consultancy agreement and Terms of Reference. The engagement is not intended to create an employer-employee relationship. The consultant will be responsible for applicable registration, tax, social protection, insurance, and other obligations associated with independent professional activity, subject to applicable law and the final agreement.

Trickle Up is committed to safeguarding, inclusion, confidentiality, responsible data handling, and preventing sexual exploitation, abuse, and harassment. The selected consultant will be required to comply with applicable contractual safeguards and Trickle Up policies relevant to the assignment.

How to Apply

Please submit the required application materials by clicking the "Apply" button by November 30, 2026. We will review applications based on qualifications, proposed approach, availability, and financial proposal. Only shortlisted applicants may be contacted.

jobs.excerpt: Founded in 2004, NetBrain is the leader in no-code network automation.
jobs.description:
Founded in 2004, NetBrain is the leader in no-code network automation. Its ground-breaking Next-Gen platform provides IT operations teams with the ability to scale their hybrid multi-cloud connected networks by automating the processes associated with Diagnostic Troubleshooting, Outage Prevention and Protected Change Management. Today, over 2,500 of the world’s largest enterprises and managed services providers leverage NetBrain’s platform.

What We Need

We are hiring a Sr. Pricing and Market Strategist to lead Pricing & Packaging for the Solutions Marketing function. Pricing scope covers NetBrain's established model and emerging models across the direct-sale motion alongside MSP and segment-specific commercial models. ICP definition and competitive commercial intelligence are supporting inputs that sharpen pricing decisions, not separate workstreams. You will report to the VP of Solutions Marketing, lead pricing and monetization initiatives end-to-end and serve as the pricing point of contact for assigned products and motions.

NetBrain is at an inflection point, and we are sharpening the commercial engine to match deep technology and loyal customers. This role delivers one primary outcome: pricing and packaging rigorously anchored to customer value that accelerates adoption and grows ARR. Two inputs feed it: an explicit, value-aligned ICP that shows where NetBrain creates the most value, and a defensible read on how the alternatives in the market are priced. The work will be ratified by leadership and visible in renewal and new-business numbers.

What You'll Do

Pricing & Packaging Strategy (core responsibility): Lead pricing and monetization initiatives end-to-end — research (customer discovery, conjoint, willingness-to-pay, economic value estimation), price experiments, and data-backed recommendations. Ensure pricing is rigorously aligned to and drives measurable customer value. Build the business cases (ACV, attach, win rate, renewal economics, ARR uplift), shepherd them through Finance, CRO and CEO approval, and instrument pricing performance as a standing quarterly rhythm with Sales Ops, Deal Desk and Finance. Use ICP segment value and competitive pricing intelligence as standing inputs to every pricing and packaging recommendation.

SaaS, MSP, Segment-Specific and Use Case Pricing (core responsibility): Lead the commercial design of NetBrain's emerging SaaS offerings, value metrics, subscription, usage-based and hybrid structures, edition strategy, and the migration path from existing models. Define MSP and segment-specific pricing models alongside the core direct-sale model, MSP constructs (per-tenant, per-managed-device, white-label, pooled-license), enterprise and mid-market discount and ramp structures, federal and service-provider variants, and the rules for when to sell direct vs. through a partner or MSP.

Input: ICP Value Alignment. Work from the NetBrain ICP to inform pricing and packaging. Quantify the value NetBrain creates per segment and turn it into the value cases that anchor pricing decisions and Sales conversations. Calibrate pricing, packaging and offer constructs to where each segment derives the most value, and translate the ICP into commercial guardrails (price floors, packaging defaults, discount norms) per segment, with explicit 'do not pursue' guidance.

Input: Competitive Commercial Intelligence. Maintain a sales-ready read on how competitors price, package, discount and structure their offers (list pricing, value metrics, bundle architecture, term and ramp structures, channel margins, MSP economics, SaaS commercial moves) and feed it directly into pricing and packaging decisions and deal-desk guidance.

What You Bring

  • 8-10 years in Pricing, Monetization, Product Marketing or Strategy/Operations in SaaS or enterprise software, with at least one tour leading pricing and packaging end-to-end.
  • In-depth understanding of SaaS pricing models (subscription, usage-based, hybrid) and value-based pricing principles, applied to real commercial decisions.
  • Hands-on with pricing research and experimentation — customer discovery, economic value estimation, conjoint, willingness-to-pay — and translation into commercial moves.
  • Experience building TAM/SAM/SOM and market-sizing models, and translating market intelligence into GTM investment and commercial decisions.
  • Advanced analytical and AI skills — AI/Excel/Sheets revenue forecasts, scenario analyses, and business cases for pricing moves.
  • Worked on alternative commercial models (such as MSP, ISV, Partner) alongside a direct-sale motion.
  • Clear writer and communicator — credible with the CRO, deal desk, finance, sales and product. Comfortable with ambiguity, low ego, high ownership; drives alignment without positional authority.
  • Background in network management, automation, observability or adjacent infrastructure markets.
  • Experience navigating pricing model transitions (perpetual to subscription, capacity to consumption, on-prem to SaaS).
  • Launched or scaled an MSP / managed-service GTM motion alongside a direct-sale motion.
  • Bachelor's in Business, Economics, Marketing, Strategy or related. MBA a plus
  • Manual Dexterity: Repetitive motion of wrists, hands and fingers for using a computer.
  • Stationary Tasks: Sitting for extended periods, remaining in a stationary position.

What We Offer

Our comprehensive compensation package is vital in how we recognize our people for the impact they make on us reaching our goals as a company.

For this role, the estimated base salary range is $148,000 - $175,000 + Bonus. The actual salary may vary based on a range of factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process.

The range listed above is a guideline and may be modified. People Experience offers a comprehensive benefits package in addition to cash compensation that includes but is not limited to 401k and medical/dental coverage. Speak with your Recruiter for more details on our Total Rewards philosophy.

Join Energy Recovery and Help Build a Sustainable Future
At Energy Recovery, we build products that help limit global temperature rise, reduce carbon emissions, provide safe drinking water for millions of people, and bring efficiency and sustainability to a range of industries. This includes everything from generous health plans and time off, paid family leave, subsidized lunches and company events, and opportunities for charitable giving and volunteering in the community.

What You Can Look Forward To:

ERII is seeking a qualified candidate for a full-time job opening for the position of R&D Engineer, based in India and reporting to the Director, Product Design. The role will be a founding member of ERI’s India R&D team and will be remote until our India office is established. The person will work closely with a senior India-based engineer.

The R&D department is a dynamic, global group of engineers with a wide range of backgrounds, several of them holding PhD and Masters degrees. We are looking for a talented and energetic candidate who can thrive in a team environment, support R&D efforts in new technology/new product development as well as provide R&D support to enhance and expand current product lines for fluid machinery in desalination, wastewater, or other industrial processes.

The position requires a sound knowledge base in mechanics of solids, CAD modeling and computational methods for analyzing stresses and deformation of solid components and assemblies. Hands-on experience in CAD packages and FE analysis tools is required. The candidate will spend the bulk of their time providing mechanical design support to various New Technology and New Product development projects as well as supporting validation testing, working closely with engineering teams in the US and India.

What You Will Do:

  • Support R&D projects (New Technology and New Products) involving fluid machines such as pressure exchangers, centrifugal and reciprocating pumps, turbines, turbochargers etc.
  • Design fluid machinery components and assemblies and create detailed engineering drawings with appropriate GD&T and tolerance stack-ups while optimizing for manufacturability & quality.
  • Leverage commercial FEA solvers such as ANSYS to evaluate the design life and robustness of mechanical components/systems over the full range of operational conditions.
  • Support the design of experiments and test setups to validate designs and work closely with testing teams to confirm and validate model predictions.
  • Use commercial (e.g. MATLAB) and open-source (e.g. Python) software to process test and analysis data and draw physics-based insights.
  • Participate in the development cycle of a fluid machine including engineering analyses, detailed design, DFMEA, design reviews, prototype builds, experimental validation, RCAs & release to manufacturing.
  • Collaborate with multi-national, cross-functional teams across time zones.
  • Follow ERI’s structured, phase-gated development process, contributing to design reviews and documentation at each phase.
  • Contribute to the development of validated design tools and design practices.
  • Other duties and projects as assigned.

What You Bring to the Table:

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering (or related discipline) with 2+ years of relevant industry experience, or a Master's degree with 1+ years of relevant industry experience, required.
  • Hands-on mechanical design experience, including design of components and assemblies for performance, reliability and manufacturability, required.
  • Experience designing with brittle or non-metallic materials a plus.
  • Proficiency in CAD packages such as SolidWorks/Onshape/Creo/NX/CATIA, including 3-D modeling, assemblies and detailed manufacturing drawings, is required.
  • Working knowledge of GD&T (ASME Y14.5) and tolerance analysis is required.
  • Proficiency in FE analysis using commercial solvers such as ANSYS Workbench or equivalent required.
  • Proficiency in using AI tools to accelerate engineering work (e.g. research, scripting/automation, data analysis, documentation), with sound engineering judgment to verify AI-generated results, is a plus.
  • Experience with design, analysis or testing of fluid machines such as pumps, turbines, compressors or valves a plus.
  • Experience with DFMEA, inspection & quality control plans, and engineering standards such as ASME/API/ISO desirable.
  • Must possess a demonstrated ability to work in a team environment, manage multiple tasks, and be goal oriented.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Must be willing to work from ERI's India office once it is established; the role will be remote until then.
  • Regular overlap with US Pacific time, typically 2-4 hours in the IST evening, in-office workday adjusted accordingly.
  • Position may require up to 5% travel, including international travel.

About the Role

We are seeking experienced Computational Mathematicians, Statisticians, and Optimization Experts with prior professional AI-training or model-evaluation experience to contribute to a project focused on improving advanced AI systems.

You will apply your mathematical expertise and programming skills to develop challenging technical tasks, evaluate AI-generated code and reasoning, identify errors, and establish objective standards for accurate solutions. This opportunity is intended for professionals with substantive AI-training experience involving mathematical, statistical, or optimization content.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Create realistic computational mathematics and statistics tasks that challenge advanced AI models.
  2. Develop clear task instructions, reproducible environments, reference solutions, and evaluation criteria.
  3. Evaluate AI-generated proofs, calculations, code, models, optimizations, and technical deliverables.

  1. Prior paid experience training, evaluating, benchmarking, or improving AI systems on mathematical or technical tasks.
  2. Strong practical proficiency in Python.
  3. Deep expertise in at least one relevant mathematical specialization.
  4. Hands-on experience using computational methods for numerical analysis, optimization, statistics, theorem proving, modeling, or scientific computing.

Relevant Specializations

  • Applied Mathematics
  • Scientific Computing
  • Operations Research
  • Optimization
  • Formal Mathematics
  • Theorem Proving
  • Probability and Statistics
  • Numerical Methods

Public Proof of Technical Expertise

Strong applicants should be able to demonstrate their expertise through evidence such as:

  • Peer-reviewed publications or preprints.

  • Competition, theorem-proving, or optimization results.

Compensation is output-based, with payment for tasks that meet project specifications and quality requirements. Task availability and completion time may vary.

jobs.excerpt: About the jobThe SOC Analyst is responsible for the continuous monitoring, triage, and investigation of security events across the organization's environment, as part of a global follow-the-sun Security Operations Center.
jobs.description:
About the job

The SOC Analyst is responsible for the continuous monitoring, triage, and investigation of security events across the organization's environment, as part of a global follow-the-sun Security Operations Center. This position reports to the SOC Lead. The role goes beyond acknowledging alerts: the focus is on understanding what each alert means, investigating suspicious activity end to end, responding to real threats, and handing over cleanly between regions so that nothing is lost across shifts. The ideal candidate has solid SOC experience, a strong investigative mindset, and thrives in a fast-paced, fully remote setting where accuracy, discipline, and security are essential. Hands-on engineering experience with core security platforms is a big plus.

Responsibilities

  • Monitor, triage, and analyze security alerts and events from the organization's security stack, including SIEM, Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Security Service Edge (SSE), and Web Application Firewall (WAF) platforms.

  • Investigate security incidents end to end, from initial triage through analysis, containment, eradication, and post-incident documentation, coordinating with relevant teams throughout.

  • Determine the scope, severity, and impact of security events, separating true positives from false positives and escalating confirmed incidents according to defined procedures.

  • Execute response actions within the security platforms, such as isolating endpoints, blocking indicators, disabling compromised accounts, and enforcing access restrictions.

  • Ensure structured, high-quality shift handovers across regions in the follow-the-sun model, so that open investigations, ongoing incidents, and pending actions continue seamlessly around the clock.

  • Proactively threat hunt across endpoint, network, and log data to uncover suspicious activity that existing detections may have missed, mapping findings to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.

  • Provide feedback on detection quality and contribute to the tuning of SIEM correlation rules, EDR custom detections, and WAF rules to reduce noise and improve coverage.

  • Enrich investigations with threat intelligence, including indicators of compromise, attacker techniques, and emerging campaigns relevant to the organization.

  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and incident response playbooks.

  • Collaborate with IT, infrastructure, application, and security engineering teams to resolve incidents and support day-to-day operations.

  • Support vulnerability management and drive continuous improvement of the organization's overall security posture.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience as a SOC Analyst, triaging alerts and investigating security incidents in a production environment.

  • Solid working knowledge of core security technologies such as EDR, SSE, SIEM, and WAF, and of how to use them to investigate and respond to threats.

  • Hands-on experience implementing, configuring, and tuning these platforms, or writing and tuning detection content, is a big plus.

  • Experience with incident response and threat hunting, ideally with familiarity with the MITRE ATT&CK framework.

  • Excellent understanding of network security, endpoint security, cloud security, and Zero Trust principles.

  • Relevant certifications such as Security+, CySA+, GCIA, GCIH, BTL1, or vendor-specific credentials are a plus.

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with a high attention to detail.

  • Ability to handle sensitive information responsibly and securely.

  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English, and the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams and across time zones.

About You

You are a hands-on security analyst who wants to understand what is really happening behind an alert, rather than only closing tickets. You dig into the data, follow the evidence, and know when and how to escalate. If you have also stood up or tuned the tools you work with, or written your own detections, even better. You are structured, reliable, and comfortable working independently in a remote, follow-the-sun team, and you take pride in leaving a clear handover for the next shift. You are curious about new threats and technologies, and you enjoy working closely with both technical teams and end users to raise the security bar across the environment.

jobs.description:
⚡️ About Merkle Science

Merkle Science provides blockchain transaction monitoring and intelligence solutions for web3 companies, digital asset service providers, financial institutions, law enforcement and government agencies to detect, investigate and prevent illicit use of cryptocurrencies. Our vision is to make cryptocurrencies safe and provide infrastructure for the safe and compliant growth of cryptocurrencies.
Merkle Science is headquartered in New York with offices in Singapore, Bangalore and London. The team has combined experience across Bank of America, Paypal, Luno, Thomson Reuters and Amazon. The company has raised over US$27 MM from SIG, Beco, Republic, DCG, Kenetic, GGV and several others.

The Role

You will design, build and run the systems behind our data products, covering ingestion, processing, analytical storage and serving. You own your work from the design document through to production. The people who design a pipeline also run it and answer for its numbers.

Our stack is very wide, and we go deep in every part of it. We don't stop at "it works." We keep measuring, profiling and tuning to make systems faster, cheaper and more reliable. We want engineers who are razor sharp, pay close attention to detail, and care as much about why a query takes 800 ms as whether it returns the right answer.

You don't need blockchain experience. If you're a strong data engineer who wants to learn it, we'd like to hear from you.

What You'll Do

  • Design and build scalable, high-throughput data pipelines and platform systems for blockchain data across 30+ chains.

  • Build backend data services and loaders in Go and Python.

  • Design and evolve data models and analytical workloads in ClickHouse, and tune them for sub-second queries.

  • Build incremental, idempotent pipelines on Databricks over billions of rows and tens of terabytes.

  • Keep improving the scale, reliability, freshness, performance and cost efficiency of the platform.

  • Investigate hard performance and reliability problems and see them through to resolution.

  • Work closely with the product, analytics and investigations teams that use the data, and turn their needs into platform designs.

  • Help set technical direction through architecture discussions, design reviews and code reviews.

  • Mentor engineers and help set strong engineering and operational practices.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years building and operating production data systems, including ETL and ELT pipelines. At least two of those years should be spent owning systems that other engineers depend on.

  • Expert Python and strong SQL. You write typed, tested code, are comfortable with asyncio and concurrency, and have built incremental data models over billions of rows.

  • Go for backend services. You have built and run high-throughput services or data loaders in Go in production.

  • ClickHouse in production. You know MergeTree schema and sort-key design, materialised views, bulk loads and query tuning.

  • Databricks in production. You have worked with PySpark, Delta Lake and Unity Catalog, designed incremental and idempotent tables, and kept an eye on compute cost.

  • Large-scale data. You have hands-on experience with pipelines over billions of rows and tens of terabytes. You understand how partitioning, clustering and file sizing affect cost and latency.

  • Kafka, Airflow and Kubernetes in production. You understand delivery semantics and idempotent writes, have handled backfills and failures, and have run data workloads with Docker and Helm. Google Cloud is preferred; AWS is fine.

  • An operations and communication mindset. You instrument what you build, write runbooks and post-incident reviews, and can write a design document that a reviewer in another time zone can approve.

Nice to Have

  • Blockchain data: EVM, UTXO or non-EVM chain data models, and pulling data from nodes over JSON-RPC or gRPC.

  • Graph or distributed key-value stores: entity resolution or clustering on large graphs.

  • Infrastructure as code, GitOps and observability: Terraform, Helm, ArgoCD, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus and Grafana, and load-test design.

  • Experience building platforms that serve multiple data sources, datasets or product teams.

  • AI-assisted development, and experience in fintech, compliance or AML.

How We Work

  • You'll join a small, senior team where everyone owns their work end to end.

  • We make decisions based on measured evidence, not opinion.

  • We keep design notes and runbooks next to the code.

  • We test at production scale and run blameless post-incident reviews.

  • We use AI coding tools every day, and we use judgement when reviewing what they produce.

❤️ Well Being, Compensation and Benefits

We care about your well-being. Along with excellent health insurance, we offer flexible time off, learning & development initiatives and hours that are designed to provide work/life balance. We regularly host team-building sessions and encourage discussions around mental health.
We reward talent and believe in acknowledging people for their contributions. We offer industry-leading compensation, along with generous equity. As a rapidly growing business, there are endless opportunities to grow your career with Merkle Science.
