Working primarily in ADP Vantage HCM, this role resolves employee, manager, and HR service tickets; maintains and tests system configuration; and produces the standard and ad hoc reporting that HR, Finance, and business leaders rely on to make workforce decisions.

This is a hands-on role with two distinct measures of success: tickets resolved accurately and within service-level targets, and reporting that is timely, reconciled, and trusted by the people who consume it.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Ticket and Case Management — approximately 50%

  • Serve as first- and second-tier support for the HRIS ticket queue, triaging requests from employees, managers, HR partners, Payroll, and Benefits.
  • Diagnose and resolve issues in HRIS systems across core HR, position and organizational data, time and attendance, benefits enrollment, and employee/manager self-service access.
  • Own tickets end to end: acknowledge, investigate, resolve or escalate, document root cause, and confirm resolution with the requester.
  • Meet or exceed defined service-level agreements for response and resolution time; proactively surface aging or at-risk tickets.
  • Escalate platform defects and unresolved issues to ADP support, tracking cases through closure and communicating status internally.
  • Execute mass data changes and transactional corrections, applying appropriate validation and audit steps before and after each load.
  • Identify recurring ticket themes and convert them into permanent fixes — configuration changes, process adjustments, job aids, or targeted training — to reduce inbound volume.
  • Maintain the HRIS knowledge base, standard operating procedures, and end-user documentation.
  • Process security role and system access requests in line with established approval and segregation-of-duties requirements.

Reporting and Analytics — approximately 30%

  • Design, build, and maintain standard and ad hoc reports using ADP Vantage HCM reporting tools and ADP DataCloud.
  • Deliver the recurring reporting calendar: headcount and roster, turnover and retention, staffing and requisition activity, compensation, time and attendance exceptions, benefits enrollment, and EEO-1/AAP and other regulatory reporting.
  • Build and maintain HR dashboards and scorecards for HR leadership and business unit management, including documented metric definitions and refresh procedures.
  • Reconcile HRIS data against Payroll, Finance, and benefit carrier sources; research and resolve variances before reports are distributed.
  • Translate ambiguous business questions into clear data requirements and then into repeatable reports; validate with requesters that the output answers the question actually asked.
  • Analyze workforce trends and provide written commentary explaining what the data shows, not just what it says.
  • Support audit, compliance, and legal data requests, including documentation of report logic and data lineage.
  • Automate manual and spreadsheet-based reporting where practical, and retire redundant reports.

Data Integrity, Configuration, and Projects — approximately 20%

  • Run cyclical data audits and error-correction routines; own the remediation plan for identified exceptions.
  • Configure and test system tables, codes, workflows, and business processes; document all changes under established change-control procedures.
  • Test ADP releases, patches, and new functionality ahead of production deployment; document results and communicate user-facing impacts.
  • Monitor interfaces and data feeds between ADP Vantage HCM and downstream systems, coordinating resolution of failures.
  • Participate in HRIS projects including module rollouts, acquisition data conversions, open enrollment, and annual compensation and performance cycles.

Required

  • Three or more years of HRIS or HR operations experience with hands-on responsibility for an enterprise HCM platform.
  • Demonstrated experience resolving HR system support tickets in a queue-based environment with defined service levels.
  • Proven ability to build reports independently — selecting fields, defining logic and filters, validating output, and presenting results.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookup and reference functions, and large-dataset manipulation.
  • Working knowledge of core HR, payroll, and benefits data structures and how upstream data errors affect downstream systems.
  • Demonstrated discretion in handling confidential employee and compensation data.
  • Clear written and verbal communication with both technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Information Systems, Business Analytics, or a related field; an equivalent combination of education and directly relevant experience will be considered.
  • Direct experience with ADP Vantage HCM or ADP WorkforceNow, including its reporting tools and ADP DataCloud.

jobs.description:
AssociateResearch Scientist

College Board –Learning & Assessment

Location: This is a fully remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office).

Role Type: This is a full-time position

About the Team

The College Access and Readiness Research Team specializes in designing and conducting research and analyses focused on improving student access to, persistence in, and completion of higher education. We pay particular attention to outcomes of the over one million students who participate in the Advanced Placement Program before graduating high school. The data- and evidence-driven insights we provide drive actions that support all students' college and career success and drive strategic organizational decisions.

About the Opportunity

The Associate Research Scientist works with members of the College Access and Readiness Research Team, the larger Research team, product owners, and field staff to answer critical research and data analysis questions to advance the mission of the College Board and sustain and grow the Advanced Placement Program. As the Associate Research Scientist, you will contribute to the team's broader research agenda as needed, with a primary focus on research that helps invite more students into AP.


A core focus of this role is building and maintaining a high-quality evidence base on high school course taking: collecting, cleaning, and organizing student transcript data from K-12 districts and partners, building dashboards that make this data usable for stakeholders, and synthesizing findings into published reports that advance our understanding of high-quality advanced course taking and its relationship to longer-term student outcomes. This role also conducts customized research for individual districts, tailoring analyses and deliverables to their specific questions. You will work iteratively and collaboratively with stakeholders to produce high quality learnings, dashboards, visualizations, and deliverables, and will effectively communicate findings to a wide variety of audiences.


In this role, you will:

Design Research and Communicate Findings (35%)

  • Collaborate with program partners, product owners, and field staff to identify research needs and propose studies that support student success through evidence-based claims, particularly around advanced high school course taking and longer-term outcomes
  • Design and conduct customized research for individual districts, tailoring questions, analyses, and deliverables to their specific needs
  • Present findings directly to district leaders and internal partners, responding to questions and identifying follow-up research
  • Synthesize findings into reports, memos, and visuals with clear talking points for both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Disseminate findings in a variety of formats (e.g., presentations, College Board Research Reports, peer-reviewed journals)

Collect, Clean, and Manage Transcript Data (25%)

  • Acquire, clean, and organize student transcript data from K-12 districts and other partners, building repeatable processes to handle new and varied data sources
  • Design and maintain data pipelines that merge transcript data with other institutional and outcomes datasets
  • Establish data quality checks and documentation practices so datasets are reliable and usable across projects

Build Dashboards & Analytic Tools (20%)

  • Design and build dashboards that surface trends in advanced high school course taking and related outcomes for technical and non-technical audiences
  • Maintain and iterate on dashboards based on stakeholder feedback and evolving data availability

Conduct Statistical Analyses (20%)

  • Lead analyses of educational datasets using advanced statistical methods to answer pressing questions about course taking and outcomes
  • Rapidly respond to data analysis questions to advance the mission of the College Board
  • Collaborate with other research scientists on the College Access and Readiness Research team to review and support improvement of the team's work

About You

You have:

  • A Ph.D. or Ed.D. in Education, Psychology, Educational Measurement, Economics, Sociology, Public Policy, or a related quantitative field
  • Excellent data coding, manipulation, and analysis skills, with a strong foundation in research methodology and advanced statistical techniques
  • Experience collecting, cleaning, and organizing large, messy, real-world datasets (e.g., student transcript or administrative K-12 data) from multiple external sources
  • Experience building dashboards or data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau) for varied audiences
  • Experience with large, national datasets related to the education industry and the ability to work accurately and quickly with new datasets
  • Adept problem-solving skills, including using data to inform decisions and actions
  • Adaptability and a willingness to shift approach as work, data sources, and organizational priorities evolve
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with experience presenting to both technical and non-technical audiences, including authoring reports for publication
  • Strong organization and prioritization skills and the proven ability to move forward multiple projects in concert, both independently and as a member of the team
  • A strong interest in collaborating in a team environment and working agilely with researchers and non-researchers to support organizational priorities
  • Ability to travel up to 6-8 times a year

All roles at College Board require:

  • A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work
  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions and comfort with learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively.
  • Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal
  • A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input.
  • A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking.
  • A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success
  • Authorization to work in the United States

About Our Process

  • Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.
  • While the hiring process may vary, it generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise such as live coding, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks.

What We Offer

At College Board, we offer more than a paycheck- we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.

A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation

  • The hiring range for this role is $80,000–$135,000.
  • Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at the College Board.
  • We aim to make our best offer upfront, rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data.
  • We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live.

You’ll have open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and what it’s like to work at College Board throughout your hiring process. Check out our careers page for more.

About the team

The Rich Media AI group aims to create a real estate buying and renting experience where every mover can get a deep sense of a home online and reimagine it as their own. We are inventing technologies that allow people to feel like they’re already there - all from their phone or desktop. Using cutting-edge computer vision and AI science, we work across disciplines to build products like virtual staging, 360 tours, floor plans, aerial overviews, marketing videos, and new experiences not even imagined yet! With our products already on over 1 million homes a year, we are creating the next chapter of home shopping experiences.

About the role

As Principal Product Manager of GenAI Media Experiences, you will lead the creation of generative AI experiences that let shoppers immerse themselves in a home and its potential, often without requiring additional camera hardware or time spent capturing the home. This includes virtual staging, virtual renovation, AI walkthrough videos, inferred floor plans, and more. You will be the product partner for our science and engineering team in Germany, shaping what new research can become, then taking ideas from prototype to build, launch, and scale across Zillow's consumer and B2B surfaces.

This is an innovation role at its core that also holds a high bar for market impact. You’ll spend time flexing across early exploration with scientists, MLEs, and designers; building and refining new AI-based media experiences; and working across multiple teams to bring them to market. These initiatives sit at the forefront of real estate and computer vision technology, directly empowering home shoppers while also equipping partners (including agents, landlords, and photographers) with next-generation solutions to elevate and expand their businesses.

As Principal Product Manager, you'll bring your curiosity, experience, product judgment, and drive to a team that values invention, imagination, speed, and impact.

You Will Get To:

  • Partner with scientists, MLEs, and designers to turn new research into experiences shoppers want and shape the most promising ideas into offerings
  • Own the roadmap for multiple generative AI media products
  • Craft novel 3D and AI-driven experiences with UX designers, for shoppers across mobile and desktop
  • Partner with business units, platform teams, and other PMs to define business cases and execution roadmaps to launch across B2B and B2C surfaces
  • Set success metrics, iterate fast, and know when to scale, pivot, or stop
This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $195,600.00 - $312,400.00 annually. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

  • 10+ years of product experience, including taking new products from concept to wide adoption from the ground up
  • Proven record of turning innovation into market impact and measurable ROI
  • Experience working directly with applied scientists and MLEs on model quality, evaluation, and the trade-offs between fidelity, speed, and cost
  • Strong product judgment on complex, novel UX and the commercial potential of new science
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and risk: you iterate quickly, learn fast, and adapt
  • A high-trust leader who unites distributed teams and diverse disciplines around a shared vision, including rigorously shepherding ideas from early design through to documented requirements and full-stack execution
  • Analytical, using data to test hypotheses, drive decisions, and evaluate results

Optional but preferred/plus

  • Experience with media, 3D, or computer vision
  • Experience with generative AI technologies, such as LMMs and VLMs
  • Fluency using modern AI-assisted tools to elevate your own PM craft

This role is US-based (Eastern time preferred but not required) and involves quarterly travel to Europe.

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.

jobs.excerpt: 🧭 Buscamos un/a Director/a Académico/aEn Polaris x Ucademy no buscamos a alguien que dé clase.
jobs.description:
🧭 Buscamos un/a Director/a Académico/a

En Polaris x Ucademy no buscamos a alguien que dé clase. Buscamos a quien decida cómo se enseña.

El Director/a Académico/a lidera el claustro de profesores de su vertical, define la pedagogía y responde de una sola cosa: que nuestros alumnos consigan su plaza.

📚 La vertical que liderarás

  • Correos

  • ADIF

  • Renfe

  • Justicia (Auxilio Judicial, Tramitación y Gestión Procesal)

  • Bibliotecas, Archivos y Museos

  • Trabajo Social

Son oposiciones muy distintas entre sí, con convocatorias que se mueven constantemente. Por eso buscamos un perfil con criterio propio y capacidad de organizar.

🌟 Quiénes somos

En Polaris x Ucademy preparamos oposiciones de una forma más digital, práctica y personalizada. Ya hemos acompañado a miles de opositores y tenemos un objetivo claro: que 10.000 personas consigan su plaza preparándose con nosotros.

Somos muy digitales, pero lo humano no se negocia. La tecnología nos ayuda a enseñar mejor, y son nuestros preparadores quienes aportan conocimiento, criterio, cercanía y acompañamiento.

🎯 Qué harás

Liderar el claustro

  • Serás el/la responsable de los profesores de tu vertical: les darás líneas claras, resolverás sus dudas y decidirás quién forma parte del equipo.

  • Participarás en la selección de nuevos preparadores y en su incorporación.

Decidir la pedagogía

  • Tú decides cómo se enseña en tu vertical, dentro del Método Polaris.

  • Nada se publica sin tu visto bueno: eres quien valida la calidad pedagógica y audiovisual del contenido.

Cuidar al alumno y la convocatoria

  • Seguirás el avance académico de los alumnos frente a sus fechas de examen.

  • Estarás encima de las convocatorias y adaptarás la preparación cuando cambien.

Construir producto

  • Trabajarás la propuesta de valor de cada formación junto al equipo.

  • Impulsarás simulacros periódicos y la mejora continua de las clases en directo.

🔎 A quién buscamos

Imprescindible

  • Experiencia sólida en formación de oposiciones. Es el requisito que más pesa: necesitamos a alguien que haya acompañado a muchos opositores hasta su plaza y sepa qué funciona y qué no.

  • Capacidad de liderar a otros docentes en remoto: dar feedback, marcar estándares y sostener un equipo.

  • Criterio pedagógico: saber por qué una clase funciona y cómo convertir eso en método.

  • Autonomía y ownership. Vas a tomar decisiones, no a esperar instrucciones.

  • Soltura con herramientas digitales e IA. Trabajamos con ellas a diario.

Lo que marcaría la diferencia

  • Haber ocupado un rol como este en una academia de oposiciones online: dirección académica, coordinación del claustro o responsable de contenidos.

  • Residir en Madrid. El puesto es 100 % remoto, pero nuestro equipo está aquí y nos gusta vernos de vez en cuando.

  • Tener plaza propia en alguna de las oposiciones de la vertical. Conocer el proceso desde dentro cambia la forma de dirigir.

🤝 Cómo funciona la colaboración

Es una colaboración freelance: trabajarás con Polaris x Ucademy mediante prestación de servicios, de forma continuada y compatible con tu actividad profesional actual.

¿Eres funcionario/a en activo? Perfecto. No te pedimos que dejes tu puesto ni que pidas una excedencia: este rol está pensado para compaginarse.

🌍 100 % remoto (preferiblemente desde Madrid)
🕐 Dedicación y horarios a convenir
🎯 Objetivo claro: las plazas que consiguen tus alumnos
💰 Compensación competitiva, acorde a la responsabilidad del rol

🎬 Cómo es el proceso de selección

1. Revisión de perfil. En la candidatura responderás a unas preguntas breves y nos enviarás un vídeo de presentación de 1 minuto. Grábalo con el móvil: cuéntanos quién eres, tu experiencia en formación de oposiciones y a qué equipos has liderado.

2. Entrevista con el equipo de Educación. Hablaremos de tu experiencia, de cómo entiendes la preparación de oposiciones y de cómo lideras a un equipo docente.

3. Caso práctico. Te plantearemos una situación real de nuestra vertical y nos contarás cómo la abordarías. Queremos ver tu criterio, no una respuesta de manual.

4. Entrevista final para concretar el proyecto, tu alcance y las condiciones.

Si ya has dirigido la preparación de opositores y quieres hacerlo a mayor escala, queremos conocerte.

👉 Lidera el claustro de Polaris x Ucademy.

This role focuses on creating high-performing "Frankenstein" ads - strategically combining data-backed elements from existing winning creatives to develop fresh, original concepts.


You'll go beyond traditional video editing, independently developing visual narratives and making strategic creative decisions based on performance insights and available assets.


We're constantly exploring new formats, creative angles, and approaches to bring more variety to our advertising, while doubling down on what's already working.

Des projets qui comptent

Vous dirigerez le volet sécurité physique de projets où votre expertise servira à protéger les personnes, les biens et les infrastructures, notamment dans les secteurs suivants :

  • les installations gouvernementales fédérales, provinciales et municipales, la défense, les ambassades et les postes frontaliers;

  • la justice et la sécurité publique : palais de justice, établissements de détention et installations policières;

  • les infrastructures de transport, d’énergie (électricité et gaz naturel), d’eau et autres services essentiels, y compris les installations maritimes comme les ports et les écluses;

  • les centres de données, centres de contrôle, installations de radiotélédiffusion et environnements technologiques critiques;

  • les établissements de santé et d’enseignement ainsi que les installations de recherche et développement;

  • les installations industrielles, minières, aéronautiques et commerciales.

  • Intégrer, lorsque requis, les contrôles de véhicules et de piétons, les solutions biométriques et les technologies émergentes en fonction du besoin réel et du contexte d’utilisation.

  • Effectuer des relevés de sites existants, valider les contraintes et établir des concepts adaptés aux opérations, aux infrastructures et aux étapes de réalisation.

Espaces opérationnels et infrastructures associées

Job Description


The Investment Accounting & Systems Analyst is responsible for the accounting, compliance reporting, and operational support functions related to the organization's investment portfolio and Special Purpose Trusts (SPTs). This position performs investment accounting activities, prepares financial and regulatory reporting, oversees trust accounting functions, supports audits and tax filings, and collaborates with internal and external stakeholders to ensure accurate financial records and compliance reporting. The role serves as a key contributor to the investment and trust administration function while providing operational support across the broader Investment Team. This position is not responsible for investment selection or management decisions, investment performance measurement or reporting, or custodial functions performed by external providers.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Prepare and analyze monthly investment account reconciliations, journal entries, and account roll-forwards to ensure accurate recording of investment activity.
  • Download, review, and process investment statements and transaction activity for assigned asset classes and investment types. Prepare month-end accounting entries related to investment transactions and portfolio activity.
  • Review and calculate investment management fees in accordance with contractual agreements and coordinate timely payment processing.
  • Prepare detailed schedules and supporting documentation for monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Assist in the preparation, review, and distribution of investment-related reports and analyses for management, committees, and organizational leadership.
  • Process portfolio rebalances, transfers, and related transactions through custodian bank and other investment platforms and portals as required.
  • Review of regulatory returns for Special Purpose Trusts for which the organization serves as trustee.
  • Coordinate charitable distributions from trust accounts and ensure compliance with trust agreements and applicable regulations. Maintain accounting records for Special Purpose Trusts, including but not limited to: Recording market value adjustments, processing distributions and fees, preparing journal entries for monthly activity, reconciling trust accounts, monitoring investment activity
  • Prepare account reconciliations and supporting schedules for pooled income funds, gift annuity funds, transportation funds, restricted endowments and other special trust arrangements.
  • Maintain communication and coordination with internal and external service stakeholders
  • Utilize specialized trust accounting software to calculate asset values, income allocations, and trust distributions.
  • Assist in the preparation and review of assigned annual financial statement audit schedules and supporting documentation.
  • Respond to auditor inquiries and provide requested information related to assigned investment and trust accounting responsibilities.
  • Prepare regulatory filings and other external reporting requirements as assigned.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, organizational policies, trust agreements, and regulatory requirements.
  • Serve as a backup resource for key investment accounting and operational functions across the Investment Team.
  • Assist in documenting and maintaining policies, procedures, workflows, and internal controls related to assigned responsibilities.
  • Participate in process improvement initiatives designed to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and reporting capabilities.
  • Provide shared oversight and review of support staff work to ensure accuracy, completeness, and adherence to established procedures.
  • Collaborate effectively with Accounting, Treasury, external investment managers, custodians, auditors, and other stakeholders to support organizational objectives.
  • Performs other duties and responsibilities as assigned to support the efficient operation of the department and organization.

Required Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 3 years of progressive accounting experience, including preparing journal entries, account reconciliations, financial reports and preparing audit support documentation
  • General ledger accounting, reconciliations and month-end close processes
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field

Preferred Qualifications:

  • CPA certification, progress toward certification, or an equivalent professional credential relevant to the position is preferred.
  • Investment accounting, trust accounting, finance, or related experience preferred.

Compensation is determined based on years of relevant experience and departmental equity.

About INFINNI

INFINNI is the infrastructure behind the creator economy. We’re the leading CRM in our category, with thousands of creators and creator businesses running their operations on our platform. Now we’re building the next layer: AI-powered tools, big data and infrastructure built for creators.We’re a global team of 100+ engineers, designers, marketers and operators, with people from Meta, TikTok, Microsoft, N26, TIER and WeWork.

The role

This is a frontend lead who sits in Design, not Engineering. You’ll own how design becomes code at INFINNI.Today design reaches engineering the way it does almost everywhere: files, docs and threads that drift from each other and from what ships. AI made each of them faster to produce. It didn’t close the gaps between them.We’re changing that. Internally we call it Design Next: a new way for Design, Product and Engineering to go from idea to production, built around AI from the start. Code is the source of truth. Design tools are input, not the destination.Parts of it already run. Most of it is still to be built. You’ll be one of the few people building it, with a real say in how it works.

What you’ll own

  1. The frontend standards. Define what production-ready means for the work Design produces, and make it enforceable, not aspirational.

  • An engineer builds a feature from Design’s work without asking a single question.
  • Design-system violations get caught before review, not after release.
  • Designers ship with confidence, because the guardrails are right.

Who you are

  • You’re AI native. AI isn’t a tool you picked up last year. It’s how you work, think and build.

  • Prepare, handle and inspect a wide range of semiconductor samples according to defined analysis requirements

  • Use complementary characterization techniques, including EDX and FIB, where required

  • Work closely with Failure Analysis, Process Integration and engineering teams to understand inspection requirements and communicate results effectively across functions

  • Maintain accurate records of incoming sample lots, expected outcomes, reporting deadlines and priorities

  • Perform daily, weekly and monthly tool-health checks, calibration and routine performance monitoring

  • Troubleshoot tool and measurement issues and coordinate with equipment vendors to maintain tool availability

  • Maintain an accurate inventory of consumables and spare parts required for reliable SEM operation

  • Standardize measurement procedures and reporting methods to ensure consistent and repeatable results

  • Document operating procedures and best practices and, over time, support the training of additional SEM operators

  • Support the operation of additional defect-inspection tools and contribute to defect analysis and yield-improvement activities as the team grows

What You Bring

  • Technical training or a bachelor’s or master’s degree in physics, chemistry, engineering, materials science or a related field

  • Previous hands-on experience operating SEM systems

  • Experience with FIB and EDX is highly desirable

  • An understanding of sample preparation, imaging, measurement and basic failure-analysis methods

  • Previous experience working in a semiconductor cleanroom is an advantage

  • Willingness and ability to spend extended periods working in a cleanroom while wearing the required PPE

  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to work carefully and consistently with sensitive samples and equipment

About the role:

We are seeking a talented and experienced Senior Data Analyst / Analytics Engineer with deep expertise in Tableau, Google BigQuery, Snowflake, and modern data modeling (dbt, Omni, or Looker Studio) to join our team. In this role, you will lead critical business intelligence modernization initiatives, reverse-engineering complex reporting logic from legacy dashboards and rebuilding high-performance analytical data models to power executive decision-making.

Job Description:

As a Senior Data Analyst / Analytics Engineer, you will work closely with technical leads, product managers, and business stakeholders to modernize legacy BI environments.

You will be responsible for deconstructing legacy dashboard architectures, extracting embedded business rules and Level of Detail (LOD) calculations, and re-architecting those metrics into scalable SQL models and cloud semantic layers.

You will perform as a core data translator, bridging the gap between cloud data warehouses, semantic layers, and client-facing business teams.

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in a quantitative field such as computer science, systems engineering, mathematics, statistics, or a related technical discipline.

  • At least 4 years of hands-on experience using Tableau to design, maintain, and audit complex dashboards and calculated fields.

  • Demonstrated experience with cloud data warehouses, specifically Google BigQuery and/or Snowflake.

  • Proven experience delivering BI migration, dashboard refactoring, or semantic data modeling projects.

Required skills/Competencies

  • Advanced Tableau Engineering: Deep understanding of complex Tableau calculations, parameters, table calculations, and Level of Detail (LOD) expressions (FIXED, INCLUDE, EXCLUDE), with the ability to unpack workbook logic.

  • Cloud Data Warehousing & Advanced SQL: Strong expertise in writing performant, modular SQL (CTEs, window functions) and structuring data within Google BigQuery and/or Snowflake.

  • Modern Transformations & Modeling: Hands-on experience with dbt for building curated data models and managing transformation workflows.

  • Semantic Layer & Modern BI Tools: Hands-on experience building semantic data models or curated topics in Omni Analytics or Looker Studio (formerly Google Data Studio) / Looker.

  • Data Validation & Quality Assurance: Rigorous approach to data reconciliation, checking data parity between legacy source reporting and modernized target models.

  • Communication & Stakeholder Management: Excellent verbal and written English communication skills (Full Professional / Advanced) to lead technical discussions, clarify metric definitions, and present solutions directly to stakeholders.

  • Ways of Working: Self-motivated, proactive problem-solver comfortable working independently in an Agile sprint-based environment.

Responsibilities

  • Reverse-Engineer Reporting Logic: Audit and deconstruct legacy Tableau workbooks, deciphering nested formulas, calculated fields, and LOD expressions into clear business documentation.

  • Warehouse Data Modeling: Translate extracted business logic into scalable, maintainable SQL and transformation models using dbt across BigQuery and Snowflake.

  • Semantic Layer Implementation: Build and configure curated data models, metrics, and self-service topics in Omni Analytics (or Looker Studio).

  • Data Parity & Governance: Implement thorough data validation checks to ensure metrics produced in the modern semantic layer match legacy benchmarks with 100% precision.

  • Stakeholder Alignment: Collaborate with technical teams, data engineers, and business leaders to define canonical KPI definitions and document data dictionaries.

  • Best Practices & Documentation: Establish reusable modeling standards, documentation, and maintainable BI pipelines for long-term platform health.

If you are a senior data practitioner with deep experience across Tableau, BigQuery, Snowflake, and modern semantic modeling, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.

Job title: Key Account Liaison, Respiratory, Southeast
Location: Remote (Geography: Southeast - AL, GA, FL, LA, SC, MD, VA)



About the Job


As a Sanofi Respiratory Key Account Liaison, you serve as a field-based partner (non-sales) and trusted advisor to complex health system accounts, driving long-term engagement, operational excellence, and improved outcomes for patients living with respiratory diseases. Within the respiratory therapeutic area, you partner with health systems to identify population health priorities, activate respiratory care pathways that close gaps in care, and you act as the connective tissue between internal teams and external stakeholders, enabling seamless execution across the customer lifecycle.

Join the team transforming care for people with immune challenges, rare diseases, cancers, and Specialty Care neurological conditions. In Specialty Care, you’ll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs.

About Sanofi


We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

Main Responsibilities


Executive Stakeholder Mapping and Relationship Management


  • Act as the central liaison for respiratory population health communications and coordination related to the account
  • Build relationships with system stakeholders across clinical, operational, quality, population health, and executive levels within Key Accounts (Top Health Systems)
  • Engage population health, quality, and care management leaders to understand system-level priorities, performance measures (e.g., HEDIS, quality and value-based care metrics), and respiratory patient population needs
  • Address customer needs, resolve issues, and ensure satisfaction throughout the engagement lifecycle
  • Provide strategic insights and feedback from accounts to inform headquarters teams of opportunities for deep engagement and partnership in respiratory
  • Translate customer insights into actionable feedback, contributing to respiratory commercial strategy, product innovation, and market positioning

Respiratory Population Health and Care Pathway Development


  • Partner with health system clinical and operational leaders to assess respiratory patient populations (e.g., asthma, COPD, and other respiratory conditions), identify care gaps, and prioritize opportunities to improve outcomes across the continuum of care
  • Collaborate with systems to develop, refine, and implement respiratory care pathways, including diagnosis, referral, treatment optimization, and follow-up, in alignment with clinical guidelines and system priorities
  • Support integration of respiratory care pathways into clinical workflows and enabling infrastructure (e.g., EHR tools, referral processes, care team roles) in collaboration with system informatics and quality teams
  • Help systems leverage data and analytics to stratify respiratory patient populations, track pathway adoption, and measure impact on quality, utilization, and outcomes
  • Connect health system teams with the appropriate internal experts (e.g., Medical Affairs, Customer Solutions Marketing, Health Economics and Outcomes Research) to support respiratory pathway-related projects, within compliance guidelines
  • Share learnings and best practices on respiratory pathway design and population health strategies across accounts to inform scalable solutions

Enable Cross-Team Collaboration for Respiratory Account Engagement


  • Enable alignment and strategic execution across field teams to ensure cohesive and impactful customer interactions in respiratory
  • Coordinate with internal teams (Customer Solutions Marketing, Medical Affairs, Sales, etc.) to support project execution, including population health and care pathway initiatives, and pull-through at Health Systems at appropriate steps of the engagement process
  • Identify and remove barriers to collaboration to drive efficiency and accountability across teams

Own Account Profiling and Quarterly Business Review (QBR) Execution


  • Own the development of comprehensive respiratory account profiles capturing strategic priorities, population health and quality initiatives, care pathway status, stakeholder mapping, and growth opportunities
  • Analyze respiratory performance metrics, utilization trends, pathway adoption and outcomes data, and customer feedback to generate insightful, data-driven QBRs that inform strategic planning, content development, and engagement recommendations
  • Lead Quarterly Business Reviews with key internal stakeholders, tracking follow-ups and ensuring progress and continuous improvement in respiratory account engagement
  • Maintain a dynamic view of account health and engagement, leveraging CRM tools and dashboards to monitor respiratory progress and inform future initiatives

Essential Skills


  • Respiratory Disease State Expertise: Understanding of respiratory disease burden, treatment landscape, and patient journeys (e.g., asthma, COPD) and the factors that drive outcomes
  • Market Insight & Gap Analysis: Understanding customer pain points and identifying opportunities to bridge strategic gaps in respiratory care and in system operations
  • Population Health & Care Pathway Expertise: Understanding of population health management, value-based care, and quality measurement. Ability to partner with health systems to identify respiratory care gaps and develop, implement, and evaluate care pathways
  • Orchestration & Pull-Through Expertise: Navigating health system contacts and identifying alignment of customer with business goals, connecting internal and external experts to drive execution of collaborative respiratory projects
  • Executive Presence: Confidence and credibility when engaging with C/D-suite stakeholders, earning trust and respect
  • Stakeholder Mapping & Engagement: Building relationships across clinical, operational, quality, population health, and executive levels to drive alignment
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Connecting internal stakeholders to drive impact at respiratory accounts
  • Account Profiling & Strategy: Creating detailed account plans that reflect respiratory strategic priorities and growth potential
  • Data & Outcomes Analysis: Synthesizing population-level, utilization, and pathway performance data into actionable insights
  • Quarterly Business Review (QBR) Execution: Synthesizing performance data and customer feedback into actionable insights
  • Healthcare System Expertise: Understanding of the dynamic healthcare environment; navigating shifting priorities, regulations, payer dynamics, and customer expectations
  • Customer-Centric Mindset: Understanding customer needs to build lasting partnerships

About You


Basic Qualifications


  • Bachelor's degree
  • A minimum of five years of work experience in one or more of the following: field sales, product marketing, or medical or clinical experience in the same or related therapeutic area within the pharmaceutical or biotech industry
  • Specialty disease state experience

Preferred Qualifications


  • Master's degree (e.g., MBA, MPH, MHA, or related field)
  • Respiratory or biologic marketplace experience
  • Experience working with health systems on respiratory disease management, population health, quality improvement, or care pathway initiatives
  • Familiarity with value-based care models, quality metrics, and health system data and analytics
  • Launch experience
  • Marketing experience
  • Demonstrated leadership skills
  • Ability to assemble and lead cross-functional teams toward a shared vision of success
  • Ability to execute against strategic and tactical plans under tight timelines
  • Ability to present ideas effectively to individuals or groups, targeting presentation to the needs of the audience
  • Strong organizational skills
  • Strong project management experience, including superior analytical and planning skills
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously

Special Working Conditions


  • Valid driver's license
  • Ability to travel 50-60 percent
  • Ability to travel to meetings/trainings/programs as necessary
  • Must work within label, and regulatory and legal compliance guidelines

Why Choose Us?


  • Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.
  • Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.
  • Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.
  • Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high-quality healthcare, prevention and wellness programs and at least 14 weeks’ gender-neutral parental leave.

Street addresses weren’t designed for 2026. They aren’t accurate enough to specify building entrances, and they don’t exist for parks, rural areas and many parts of the world. This makes it hard to find places and causes problems and inefficiencies on a global scale.

That’s why we created what3words. We divided the world into 3m squares and gave each square a unique combination of three words. It’s the easiest way to find and share precise locations.

Over the last year, what3words has been used in 193 countries, and our monthly active users continue to grow at an impressive pace. Our tech is used by emergency services, delivery companies, eCommerce businesses, ride-hailing apps and NGOs, and is integrated into the navigation systems of millions of cars around the world.

Who we’re looking for

Based in Vietnam out of our centrally located Ho Chi Minh City office, we’re looking for an experienced Front End Engineer who knows code, and enjoys creating engaging experiences that people love to use.

At what3words, we're proud of our tech stack. We have built a massively scalable, microservices-based architecture, based around Kubernetes on AWS. You'll be exposed to technologies such as ReactJS, Docker, Redis, Kubernetes, AWS Lambdas, Prometheus, Grafana, Python, Athena, BigQuery, Java, Scala, C++, and Swift.

This is a great opportunity to join a collaborative, ambitious and Agile team, at one of the most exciting times in this company's life.

Requirements:
This role will focus primarily on the development of our map site, account management system, and other websites to support and showcase what3words’ offerings. You will also work closely with our product and UX teams, receiving and inputting on designs and feasibility checks, and bringing fresh ideas to make what3words a better solution. You will have good experience of building sleek user interfaces on top of RESTful web APIs, using React, JavaScript, CSS. You will be able to work independently, self-motivate, collaborate well with others and keep calm under pressure.

What we expect:

  • Strong experience with ES6, TypeScript, React, HTML, CSS.

  • Excellent communication skills in verbal and written English.

  • A passion for software engineering and continuous learning.

  • Solid track record of building responsive sites for desktop, tablet and mobile.

Bonus points for:

  • Knowledge of Next.js, Google Maps or Leaflet, GIS systems, AWS, Kubernetes, or similar systems.

  • Experience of Agile working environments.

The role is based in our centrally located HCMC office. While you can work from the office five days a week if preferred, our Engineering team can choose to work up to two days a week from home. We also offer a six-week remote-work allowance; for up to six weeks a year, you can work from anywhere in the world (as long as you’ve got great WiFi and are happy to work with your main office timezone).

Equality, diversity and inclusion at what3words

Our mission is to help everyone talk about everywhere, and we believe diverse perspectives make for a better company and better products too. We strongly encourage applications from underrepresented groups and are committed to diversity, equity and inclusion in our hiring processes and company culture.

jobs.description:
Senior Associate, Conserving the Pantanal and Gran Chaco Wildlands

The Environment Portfolio at The Pew Charitable Trusts

For more than 30 years, Pew has been a major force in engaging the public and policy makers about the causes, consequences, and solutions to some of the world’s most pressing environmental challenges. Our environment work spans all seven continents with more than 250 professionals working at the local, national, and international levels to reduce the scope and severity of global environmental problems, such as the erosion of large natural ecosystems that contain a great part of the world’s remaining biodiversity, and the destruction of the marine environment. Pew’s global environmental program focuses on science-based, nonpartisan, and sustainable solutions to help protect the planet and people. We work in partnership with governments, Indigenous rights holders, intergovernmental organizations, non-governmental organizations, local stakeholders, scientists, and other researchers to advance public policy so that nature and communities can thrive.

Since 1990, Pew has worked in North America, South America and Australia to protect large and critically important terrestrial ecosystems, including rivers and other freshwater resources, coastal temperate rainforests, interior mountain ranges, the northern boreal forests, Australia’s Outback, and Chilean Patagonia. We work to ensure these natural systems remain bountiful, functioning, and resilient, providing essential ecological services such as clean air and clean water, sustenance and food security for local communities and more broadly for the welfare of current and future generations. Our work relies on the sciences of conservation, sociology, biology, and economics to advocate for practical and durable solutions to the loss of biodiversity.

In the sea, reforms to how our oceans are managed are essential to address overfishing, pollution, and loss of habitat. Pew began its oceans program in the United States, focusing on ending overfishing and protecting fragile marine habitat. Starting in 2005, Pew’s ocean conservation program expanded around the world and played a significant role in reforming marine fisheries management in the European Union and on the high seas and creating large scale marine reserves around the world. Our work is grounded in the best available science and pursues domestic and international conservation measures that are long-term and provide permanent, durable protections for marine ecosystems. We also work to address systemic threats to the ocean, including from plastics, over-and-illegal fishing, seabed mining, and climate change.

Conserving the Pantanal and Gran Chaco Wildlands

South America’s Pantanal and Gran Chaco regions are among the most ecologically significant tropical wetlands and dry forests on Earth. This area spans parts of Brazil, Bolivia, Paraguay, and Argentina and contains thousands of plant and animal species and provides vital aquatic habitat, nutrient renewal, migration routes, and flood control for millions of animals and people living downstream. The region’s extensive ecosystems are currently threatened by deforestation, drought and intensification of wildfires related to climate change, and thus urgently need conservation action.


The project works with the policy framework in each country to solidify and expand protection of the extraordinary biodiversity of the Pantanal-Gran Chaco region. Pew partners with local and international conservation organizations, government agencies, and Indigenous governments and organizations to improve management of and expand protected areas, support Indigenous organizations and communities in the management of their territories, promote sustainable management for ranching lands, and to advance long-term conservation financing mechanisms for durable protections.

Position Overview

Reporting to the Project Director, Conserving the Pantanal and Gran Chaco Wildlands, the Senior Associate, Conserving the Pantanal and Gran Chaco Wildlands will manage contracts with partner non-governmental organizations (NGOs) and consultants, act as a liaison with other Pew units, facilitate planning and evaluation, and generally monitor workflow across the team.

The Senior Associate will support the Project Director in ensuring adequate project management with a primary focus on managing contracts and coordinating workflow. This will also include backstopping other team members to cover key gaps as they arise. A secondary focus will include facilitating communications and managing relationships with strategic partners and key stakeholders.

The Senior Associate will be located either in Santa Cruz, Bolivia; or elsewhere within the South America region following evaluation by Pew.

Responsibilities:

  • Foster a work environment that inspires excellence, values impact, encourages transparency, builds mutual trust and respect, embraces and values diversity, and is collaborative, caring and compassionate. Under the Project Director’s leadership, provide project management and coordination to the Pantanal and Gran Chaco team.
  • Support the Project Director in establishing and cultivating strategic alliances and managing joint initiatives with international organizations, foundations, other non-governmental organizations (NGOs), government agencies, and other institutions in the region.
  • Promote best practices and innovations in project management across team activities.
  • Manage contracts with consultants and partner organizations using Pew’s platforms and internal procedures to guarantee quality and timeliness.
  • Monitor the status of the initiative’s objectives, deliverables, and activities, and provide timely feedback to the Project Director and team.
  • Coordinate annual planning exercises and other strategic planning for the project.
  • Contribute to the planning and organizing of periodic staff workshops and participation in external events and represent the project as needed.
  • Collaborate on the production and dissemination of communications products.
  • Support the Project Director in coordinating key activities with staff and partner organizations.
  • Participate in activities that support program and Pew-wide objectives.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required.
  • Generally, 4 years of applicable experience.
  • Fluency in English and in either Spanish or Portuguese.
  • Significant experience in project management, including planning and evaluation, budgeting, and contracting, and similar areas.
  • Significant experience working with non-profit organizations.
  • Knowledge and field experience within the Latin American region with preference for Bolivia, Brazil, and Argentina.

  • Capacity to lead group discussions with individuals working in different roles and countries; skilled in training and guiding team members with a high degree of cultural sensitivity.

  • Effective professional writing skills in both English and Spanish/Portuguese. Effectively communicates ideas, thoughts and concepts clearly and concisely and in a compelling way, both written and orally.

jobs.description:
Steuere unsere Accounting Operations und entwickle unsere Finance-Prozesse für die nächste Wachstumsphase weiter.

Black Semiconductor wächst und entwickelt seine Finance-Organisation für die nächste Wachstumsphase weiter. Dafür brauchen wir stabile Accounting-Prozesse, effiziente Abläufe und ein Team, das unser operatives Tagesgeschäft zuverlässig steuert – in unserem HQ in Aachen und über unsere internationalen Gesellschaften hinweg.

In dieser Rolle übernimmst Du die operative Verantwortung für Accounts Payable und Accounts Receivable und sorgst dafür, dass Rechnungs- und Zahlungsprozesse reibungslos funktionieren. Gerade zu Beginn arbeitest Du selbst aktiv im Tagesgeschäft mit und stellst sicher, dass die operativen Abläufe zuverlässig funktionieren. Gleichzeitig baust Du unseren Debitorenbereich auf – einschließlich der zugehörigen Prozesse und der Einführung von SAP S/4HANA Cloud.

Du verbindest operative Umsetzung mit Prozessgestaltung und arbeitest eng mit unserer Senior Managerin Finance & Accounting zusammen. Dabei hast Du den Freiraum, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, Verbesserungen voranzutreiben und unsere Accounting Operations aktiv mitzugestalten. Dazu gehört auch, digitale Tools weiterzuentwickeln und KI gezielt einzusetzen, um unsere Finance-Prozesse effizienter zu gestalten und manuelle Tätigkeiten zu reduzieren.

Warum diese Rolle?

Mehr als Accounting: Du verbindest operative Finance-Expertise mit Prozessgestaltung und übernimmst Verantwortung dafür, wie unsere Accounting Operations heute funktionieren und morgen aufgestellt sind.

Gestaltungsspielraum im Scale-up: Du triffst auf ein wachsendes Unternehmen, in dem Du neue Prozesse aufbauen, bestehende Abläufe hinterfragen, eigene Ideen einbringen und Verbesserungen direkt umsetzt.

Automatisierung mit echtem Impact: Du hast die Möglichkeit, den Einsatz digitaler Tools und KI in unseren Finance-Prozessen voranzutreiben und neue Anwendungsmöglichkeiten zu erschließen, um manuelle Tätigkeiten Schritt für Schritt zu reduzieren.

Nähe zu Finance Leadership: Du arbeitest eng mit unserer Senior Managerin Finance & Accounting zusammen und kannst die Weiterentwicklung unserer Finance-Organisation aktiv mitprägen.

Dein nächster Karriereschritt: Du führst ein kleines AP Team und kannst dich perspektivisch zum Team Lead AP/AR Operations mit wachsender internationaler Verantwortung weiterentwickeln.

Über uns

Wir verstehen die Halbleiterindustrie als ein Universum voller Möglichkeiten. Wir erkennen Chancen und sehen das transformative Potenzial, das unsere Graphen-Lösungen für die Neugestaltung der Branche mit sich bringen.

Wir laden Dich ein, diesen Wandel gemeinsam mit uns voranzutreiben, indem wir kluge Köpfe mit einer gemeinsamen Vision zusammenbringen. Diese Vision ist es, zu zeigen, dass grundlegende Veränderungen möglich sind. Mit Deinem Wissen und Deinen Fähigkeiten kannst Du beweisen, dass Dinge anders – und besser – gemacht werden können.

Gemeinsam haben wir die Kraft, das Paradigma zu verändern, wie die Welt vernetzt ist.

Unsere Technology

Die steigenden Anforderungen der Halbleiterindustrie an leistungsfähigere Chips mit höherer Bandbreite und geringerem Energieverbrauch werden durch unsere Technologie adressiert. Wir ermöglichen die Verbindung von Chips mit Hochdurchsatz-Computernetzwerken bei minimaler Latenz.

Der entscheidende Faktor ist die Nutzung der einzigartigen physikalischen Eigenschaften von Graphen, um elektronische Datenverarbeitung mit photonischer Kommunikation zu vereinen. Dadurch können unzählige Chips miteinander interagieren, als wären sie ein einziges System. Unsere Graphen-Photonik-Innovation hebt Rechenleistung und Effizienz auf ein neues Niveau.

Kurz gesagt: Wir vernetzen Chips zu leistungsstarken, energieeffizienten Systemen und überwinden mit unserer Graphen-Technologie die bisherigen Grenzen der Konnektivität in der Halbleiterindustrie.

Deine Aufgaben

AP/AR Operations: Du steuerst und bearbeitest die Accounts-Payable- und Accounts-Receivable-Prozesse für unser HQ in Aachen und unsere Gesellschaften in Deutschland und den Niederlanden. Gerade zu Beginn arbeitest Du selbst aktiv im Tagesgeschäft AP mit und stellst eine zuverlässige Rechnungsverarbeitung, Kontenabstimmungen und die Klärung offener Posten sicher.

Aufbau des Debitorenbereichs & Prozessoptimierung: Du baust unsere Debitorenprozesse und -strukturen weiter auf, begleitest die Einführung von SAP S/4HANA Cloud für AP / AR und entwickelst bestehende Abläufe mit Blick auf Standardisierung und Skalierbarkeit weiter.

Teamkoordination: Du koordinierst unser kleines AP-Team, priorisierst Aufgaben und sorgst gemeinsam mit dem Team für reibungslose Abläufe im Tagesgeschäft.

Automatisierung & Digitalisierung: Du identifizierst Effizienzpotenziale, entwickelst den Einsatz digitaler Tools weiter und nutzt KI zur Unterstützung und Optimierung unserer Finance-Prozesse, um manuelle Tätigkeiten zu reduzieren und effizientere Abläufe zu ermöglichen.

Zusammenarbeit & Weiterentwicklung: Du unterstützt unsere Senior Managerin Finance & Accounting bei operativen und übergreifenden Finance-Themen und gestaltest die Weiterentwicklung unserer Accounting Operations aktiv mit.

Das bringst Du mit

  • Fundiertes Verständnis von Rechnungs-, Zahlungs- und P2P-Prozessen

  • Erfahrungen mit ERP-Systemen; Kenntnisse in SAP S/4HANA Cloud sind ein Plus

  • Erste Führungserfahrung oder Erfahrung in der fachlichen Anleitung und Koordination von Mitarbeitenden

  • Digitale Kompetenz und Interesse daran, KI und digitale Tools im Arbeitsalltag einzusetzen und zur Verbesserung von Finance-Prozessen zu nutzen

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Was wir Dir bieten

Du gestaltest den weiteren Aufbau unseres Debitorenbereichs und die Weiterentwicklung unserer digitalen Finance-Prozesse einschließlich des Einsatzes von KI aktiv mit. Mit dem Wachstum von Black Semiconductor kann sich Deine Rolle perspektivisch zu einer Teamlead-Position AP /AR mit wachsender internationaler Verantwortung weiterentwickeln.

Beteiligung: Du erhältst virtuelle Aktienoptionen und partizipierst damit am langfristigen Erfolg unseres Unternehmens.

Flexibilität: Wir arbeiten hybrid mit einer Anwesenheit von ca. ein bis zwei Tagen pro Woche in Aachen.

Gesundheit & Zukunft: Deine Gesundheit und Zukunft sind uns wichtig. Wir bieten Dir ein umfassendes Leistungspaket mit Versicherungs-, Vorsorge- und weiteren Benefits.

Zukunftsbranche: Arbeite an einer Technologie, die die nächste Generation der Halbleiter-Konnektivität mitgestalten soll.

Unsere Kultur

Menschen vor Prozessen. Bei Black Semiconductor ist Flexibilität der Schlüssel - wir sorgen dafür, dass sich die Arbeit dem Leben anpasst und nicht umgekehrt. Wir setzen uns für die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben ein, damit Karrieren sinnvoll und bereichernd sind. Unsere Prozesse sind menschenzentriert, damit Du Dich auf das Wesentliche konzentrieren kannst.

Lass uns gemeinsam wachsen. Dein Potenzial ist unsere Priorität. Wir bieten Dir die nötige Autonomie, um etwas zu bewirken, und fördern Dein Wachstum durch eine Kultur des kontinuierlichen Lernens. Wir investieren in Deine berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung.

Wir leben Offenheit. Zusammenarbeit und Inklusion sind die Eckpfeiler unserer Kultur. Wir praktizieren Offenheit und fördern Vertrauen und Respekt. Individualität ist unsere kollektive Stärke, die uns zu Innovationen antreibt und uns voranbringt.

Wir verbinden Chips – und Menschen. Wir ermutigen qualifizierte Personen mit beliebigem Hintergrund, sich zu bewerben. Wir fördern ein integratives und unterstützendes Arbeitsumfeld, das Zusammenarbeit, Innovation und Wachstum schätzt. Schließ Dich unserem Team an und werde Teil eines Unternehmens, das in der Branche etwas bewirken will.

jobs.excerpt: About SundaySunday is on a mission to empower everyone to care for their little plot of land.
jobs.description:
About Sunday

Sunday is on a mission to empower everyone to care for their little plot of land. The simple act of getting outside, getting your hands dirty, and caring for your home is more than it seems. It's a reconnection to something written in our DNA, and it's at the core of us working together toward a better planet.

We're bringing safer, science-backed products and personalized, data-driven guidance to the American yard. Our in-house R&D team builds the products. The largest soil database ever created, along with Sunny, our AI yard companion, tailors a plan to every home.

In 2024 we helped our one millionth customer. Today Sunday offers 75+ products across lawn, garden, pest control, and pet, sold online and in about 7,000 stores nationwide, including Home Depot, Walmart, Target, and Costco. On any spring weekend, roughly 750 people are out in their yard using Sunday at any given moment. Sunday is becoming a household name, and we're making a dent.

Position Overview

As the Logistics Lead, you will be responsible for getting Sunday orders to customers. You will own our 3PL relationship with Radial for DTC and Retail fulfillment, manage orders from creation to delivery, and keep shipping fast, accurate, and cost-effective through our spring peak. You will be the main point of contact for Customer Service and Quality on anything that affects delivery.

This is a senior individual contributor role with real ownership. You will work autonomously, set the standards for how orders flow, and bring the data and judgment the Sr. Director of Supply Chain Operations needs for contract negotiations and strategic decisions. You will partner closely with the Operations Production Director, who owns Costco production and fulfillment through Innomark. Success means orders that arrive on time and in full, a well-run peak season, and a steadily lower cost per order.

Key Responsibilities

3PL Management

  • Own the day-to-day Radial relationship, including daily operations, escalations, and weekly and quarterly business reviews
  • Hold Radial accountable to SLAs and productivity terms, including units per hour, and drive corrective actions when performance slips
  • Plan and staff peak with Radial across Retail Pipe (December–January), Reauth (January to mid-April), and new-subscriber orders (peaking mid-April)
  • Manage 3PL production work at Radial, including kitting, pre-kitting, display builds, and rework

Order Management & Shipping

  • Own DTC and B2B orders from creation to delivery, finding and resolving stuck, short-shipped, or misrouted orders
  • Lead daily B2B order routing, including our Claude-based routing process, and maintain its rules and SOPs
  • Partner with the Retail team on wholesale order inquiries and retailer routing and compliance requirements
  • Evaluate carriers and ship methods for cost and reliability, and recommend changes

Cross-Team Collaboration

  • Partner with Customer Service to run the customer-facing steps of out-of-stock protocols, based on decisions from Planning
  • Partner with Quality and vendors to track and reduce defects affecting delivery, including product, packaging, and soil tests
  • Define functional requirements for order and shipping systems with Tech, and maintain data integrity across our ERP, Radial, and order systems

Cost, Reporting & Process

  • Own logistics budget line items day to day, and find cost savings and avoidance in warehousing and outbound shipping
  • Report on logistics KPIs, including on-time and in-full, order accuracy, cost per order, and damage and claims, and provide performance, volume, and cost data for annual Radial contract negotiations
  • Review 3PL and carrier invoices with the Purchasing & Inventory Analyst and Finance
  • Build and maintain SOPs for order handling, kitting, and shipping

Qualifications

Experience

  • 4+ years of experience in logistics, fulfillment, or customer operations, including hands-on 3PL management
  • Experience running DTC e-commerce fulfillment at volume
  • Retail and wholesale fulfillment experience (EDI, routing guides, chargebacks) is a strong plus

Skills

  • Proficient with ERP, WMS, and order management systems; strong in Excel or Google Sheets
  • Build and read KPI reports, and use data to hold partners accountable and make decisions
  • Calm, decisive problem-solving during peak, with good judgment on when and how to escalate with a proposed solution
  • Interest in using AI tools to automate routine order work

Core Competencies

  • Communication & Collaboration
  • Expertise
  • Problem Solving and Evaluating Alternatives
  • Feedback & Resilience
  • Scope & Autonomy
  • Prioritization

jobs.description:
AutoCAD Drafter

Position Overview

We are looking for an experienced AutoCAD Drafter to convert PDF plans and hand‑drawn sketches into clean, professional CAD drawings. The drafter must ensure accuracy by verifying scales before delivery, as even minor errors can render plans unusable. This role requires precision, technical expertise, and a strong commitment to quality drafting outputs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Convert PDF plans and sketches into accurate AutoCAD drawings.
  • Verify and apply correct scales to all drawings before submission.
  • Produce clean, precise, and project‑ready drafting outputs.
  • Collaborate with architects, engineers, and project managers to clarify requirements.
  • Revise and update drawings based on feedback or site conditions.
  • Maintain organized drawing files and documentation for project records.
  • Deliver outputs within agreed timelines while adhering to quality standards.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Drafting Technology, or related field.
  • Minimum 2–3 years of professional experience in AutoCAD drafting.
  • Demonstrated ability to convert PDF/sketches into scaled CAD drawings.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced proficiency in AutoCAD (mandatory).
  • Strong knowledge of architectural standards, construction methods, and detailing.
  • Ability to verify and apply correct scales with precision.
  • Familiarity with Revit or other CAD/BIM tools is an advantage.

Core Competencies

  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy in drafting.
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills.
  • Effective communication and collaboration with design teams.
  • Ability to meet deadlines and adapt to project changes.

jobs.excerpt: Talent Acquisition Sourcer Location: Remote (Canada-wide) Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent Category: Corporate & Support Team / Talent Acquisition About VetCareVetCare is a proud Canadian community of veterinary practices committed to offering exceptional patient care and client experiences.
jobs.description:
Talent Acquisition Sourcer

Location: Remote (Canada-wide)

Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Category: Corporate & Support Team / Talent Acquisition

About VetCare

VetCare is a proud Canadian community of veterinary practices committed to offering exceptional patient care and client experiences. We combine the personal touch, local culture, and clinical autonomy of independent practices with the robust support, resources, and connection of a nationwide network.

At VetCare, our values guide everything we do:

  • Come together as one: We support each other as one team.

  • Always focus on the patient: We prioritize clinical excellence, patient care, and client connection.

  • Raise the bar: We pursue continuous improvement, personal development, and positive change.

  • Engage with empathy: We seek understanding and lead with compassion in every interaction.

Position Purpose

The Talent Acquisition Sourcer / Junior Recruiter is the core outbound pipeline engine for VetCare’s national talent team. This role is built specifically for a true hunter—someone energized by proactive search, direct headhunting, and tracking down passive clinical professionals across Canada, with an acute focus on rural, northern, and hard-to-fill markets.

We already have great recruiters managing relationship stewardship and process management; what we need now is an outbound specialist who thrives on uncovering hidden talent and feeding qualified Doctors of Veterinary Medicine (DVMs) and Registered Veterinary Technologists/Technicians (RVTs) to our senior recruiters. You will partner closely with our internal recruiting team as your primary stakeholders, handling screening and interview handoffs while providing the administrative velocity that keeps pipelines moving. Direct exposure to multi-site practice managers and regional leadership will serve as a natural operational growth path as your role evolves.

What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities)

Passive Sourcing & Pipeline Hunting (50%)

  • Execute aggressive outbound headhunting strategies across specialized platforms, including LinkedIn Recruiter, provincial veterinary licensing registries, university faculties, associations (CVMA), and clinical networks.

  • Target, map, and nurture talent communities in persistent, hard-to-fill markets (e.g., Northern Ontario, rural Alberta, interior British Columbia, and rural Atlantic Canada).

  • Craft highly customized, compelling cold-outreach messaging that cuts through the noise, articulating VetCare’s clinical autonomy, practice culture, and sustainable workload model.

  • Conduct initial phone screens to evaluate clinical interests, licensing eligibility, relocation appetite, and mutual culture fit before handing warm leads off to our senior recruiters.

Recruitment Coordination & Team Support (30%)

  • Partner side-by-side with our senior recruiters to manage candidate logistics, schedule seamless recruiter interview handoffs, and ensure candidate momentum across multiple Canadian time zones.

  • Maintain rigorous ATS hygiene—tracking lead statuses, pipeline movement, and sourcing channel metrics to keep team dashboards accurate and actionable.

  • Support pre-employment administration, including professional clinical reference checks, regulatory credential verifications with provincial colleges, and offer package documentation.

  • Maintain job board postings across regional and academic platforms, ensuring alignment with provincial standards and pay transparency legislation.

Market Intelligence & Candidate Engagement (20%)

  • Serve as an engaging, authentic first contact for clinicians, navigating sensitive discussions around burnout, relocation barriers, and scheduling needs with high empathy.

  • Keep a pulse on competitor offerings, compensation trends, and provincial licensing shifts, sharing real-time market insights with the talent acquisition team.

  • Support early-career student outreach, campus career events, and RVT externship pipelines alongside the senior recruiters.

What You Bring (Qualifications & Competencies)

  • Hunter Mindset (Essential): You are a relentless outbound sourcer who enjoys the thrill of the chase. You prefer prospecting, direct outreach, and cold pipeline creation over administrative "farming" or waiting for applications to arrive.

  • Experience: 1–3 years of hands-on recruitment sourcing or coordination experience within an agency or in-house talent team. Prior experience in healthcare, locum staffing, or niche/scarce-talent industries is a strong asset.

  • Education: Post-secondary diploma or degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field (or equivalent practical work experience).

  • Sourcing & Digital Tools: Strong working command of Boolean logic, LinkedIn Recruiter workflows, and modern ATS/CRM systems. Proficient with Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace.

  • Canadian Regulatory Landscape: Foundational understanding of Canadian employment standards; exposure to provincial veterinary colleges (e.g., CVO, ABVMA, BCVMA) is considered an asset.

  • Bilingualism: Fluency in French is considered an asset.

  • Resilience & EQ: High emotional intelligence to build instant rapport with guarded medical professionals, combined with the persistence needed to thrive in tight candidate pools.

Key Success Measures (KPIs)

  • Outbound Pipeline Delivery: Volume of vetted, qualified DVM and RVT candidates passed along to internal recruiters monthly.

  • Sourcing Velocity: Conversion rates from initial cold outreach to completed preliminary screen.

  • Hard-to-Hire Impact: Consistent candidate discovery and engagement in remote, rural, and high-vacancy clinical regions.

  • Coordination Efficiency: Smooth handoffs to internal recruiters with minimal turnaround delay or candidate drop-off.

  • ATS Integrity: Pristine candidate records, updated stage tracking, and clear communication notes.

What We Offer (Compensation & Benefits)

  • Competitive Compensation: Base salary range of $65,000 – $75,000 CAD per year, commensurate with sourcing depth and industry background.

  • Incentive Potential: Eligible for an annual performance bonus (5%–10%) plus placement-based milestone bonuses per DVM hire retained past 6 months.

  • Work Arrangement: 100% remote work flexibility from anywhere in Canada.

  • Comprehensive Benefits: Group coverage including extended health, dental, vision care, life insurance, and disability.

  • Professional Growth: Clear advancement path into full-cycle recruiting and regional operations, supported by an annual professional development budget for recruitment training, certifications, and HR memberships.

  • Collaborative Culture: A supportive internal team where your sourcing impact directly shapes clinic success and community pet care.

VetCare is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion across all our practices and corporate teams. If you require accommodations at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

We are seeking a Senior ASIC Physical Design Engineer to help implement advanced SoCs that power next-generation satellite and space systems. In this role, you will contribute to the full physical design flow—from synthesis to GDSII—working closely with architecture, RTL, verification, and packaging teams. You’ll be a key contributor in achieving timing closure, optimizing PPA, and supporting design integration with external partners. You will be part of a collaborative design team developing state-of-the-art mixed-signal SoCs to be hosted on some of the largest, most powerful, rapidly designed and rapidly manufactured satellites ever deployed in space. In your first 6 months, you will develop and implement new SoC sub-systems for satellite communications and beyond. In your first two years, you will have contributed to developing cutting-edge SoCs that will fly in space. 

Responsibilities

  • Execute the complete physical design flow for complex SoC blocks and top-level integration, including synthesis, floorplanning, place & route, CTS, STA, and physical verification.
