  • Collaborate with front-end, verification, and DFT teams to ensure clean handoff and predictable convergence.
  • Work with external physical design service providers and internal leads to review deliverables, resolve issues, and ensure schedule alignment.
  • Develop and maintain scripts and automation to improve flow efficiency and consistency.
  • Support physical sign-off activities including DRC/LVS, IR drop, EM, and power analysis.
  • Assist in chip-level integration, ECOs, and tapeout preparation.
  • Contribute to methodology development, tool evaluation, and flow documentation.
  • Support your product through production and spaceflight.

Required Qualifications 

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field.
  • 5–10 years of experience in ASIC physical design for complex SoCs.
  • Hands-on experience with industry-standard tools (Synopsys ICC2/Fusion Compiler, Cadence Innovus, or equivalent).
  • Strong understanding of timing analysis, power optimization, and physical verification flows.
  • Experience with hierarchical or flat SoC design methodologies.
  • Familiarity with FinFET technologies.
  • Working knowledge of DFT, UPF/CPF power intent, and ECO implementation.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work cross-functionally in fast-paced environments.

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Exposure to radiation-hardened or space-qualified ASICs.
  • Experience with chip-package co-design or advanced packaging (2.5D/3D).
  • Familiarity with physical design service vendor management or offshore collaboration.
  • Experience with sign-off through TSMC.
  • Experience with Gate-All-Around technologies.
  • Experience working in cross-functional, geographically distributed teams.

Compensation and Benefits:

  • Salary will be based on several factors including, but not limited to: knowledge and skills, education, and experience level
  • Comprehensive benefits package including paid time off, medical/dental/vision/ coverage, life insurance, paid parental leave, and many other perks

JOB DESCRIPTION – Lead Software Engineer

Location: Remote, United Kingdom, with travel to London for meetings when required.

Division: TM1 Reports

Contract Terms: Permanent,40 hours per week


THE TEAM


The TM1 Reports team is Ticketmaster’s dedicated reporting team producing analytical reports for our clients to unlock the power of data for our clients and deliver insights to allow our them to make the best decisions for our fans.


THE JOB


Ticketmaster Reports team is looking for an experienced, motivated, and self-driven candidate who can contribute towards various aspects of taking our offering to the next level and building out our new reporting offerings for our clients. This involves design, development, and production support of the systems as well as working with product teams and other engineering teams in shaping the future of the application.


Now is an exciting time to join the team and make a real difference as well as showcase your design and architecture skills as we shape the next generation of analytics in ticketing with intelligent profile, AI initiatives, integration with various components of the TM ecosystem, and overall, building a world-class system. If you are the sort of person that enjoys a fast-paced work environment, is able to quickly pick-up cutting-edge technologies and product concepts, and has the desire to experiment with and evaluate new technological paths forward, this is the role for you.


WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING


  • Design and develop new systems and implement enhancements to existing systems, breaking down complex problems into essential components and building efficient solutions.
  • Work with product teams to gather and understand requirements, discuss approaches, design solutions based on the requirements and create design documents for implementation keeping in mind costs, capacity, shelf-life and choosing the right tools and technologies.
  • Design and develop high-traffic, large scale software applications as a full-stack developer - systems ranging from front-end UI, web and API services, data models and data flow processes, infrastructure for deploying and long-term maintenance of the systems.

  • Experience in working with cloud-based platforms (preferably AWS).

  • Experience writing SQL queries, working with SQL (e.g., MySQL) and NoSQL databases (e.g., DynamoDB).

  • Experience working with code and build tools like Gitlab, CI/CD, Jenkins, and Sonar.

  • An overall calm personality - ability to see the big picture and how the current team / task / project fits into it.

Nice to know / good to have

  • UI design experience, building client facing data applications
  • Experience in the entertainment and/or online ticketing industry
  • Familiarity with operating across diverse cultural and regulatory environments (Europe, Asia, South America)

YOU (BEHAVIOURAL SKILLS/COMPETENCIES)

LIFE AT TICKETMASTER

We are proud to be a part of Live Nation Entertainment, the world’s largest live entertainment company.

Reliability - We understand that fans and clients rely on us to power their live event experiences, and we rely on each other to make it happen.

Teamwork - We believe individual achievement pales in comparison to the level of success that can be achieved by a team.

Integrity - We are committed to the highest moral and ethical standards on behalf of the countless partners and stakeholders we represent.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES

jobs.excerpt: About usWe see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility.
jobs.description:
About us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

The Role

As a Senior Automated Test Equipment (ATE) Test Engineer, you will own the bring-up and operation of our high-volume 300 mm wafer test infrastructure for electronic-photonic integrated circuits. On a daily basis, you will set up and qualify ATE test cells, develop and debug test programs for DC, RF, and electro-optical device characterization, and drive probe card design with vendors. You will analyze wafer-level data to make pass/fail calls and share insights with design and process teams, helping us scale from engineering characterization to high-volume production.

To join our team, you should be excited to:

  • Set up, qualify, and calibrate ATE test cells, ensuring readiness for high-volume wafer testing.

  • Develop and debug automated test programs for DC, RF, optical, and electro-optical device characterization, including new measurement methods.

  • Own probe card specifications, design, qualification, and integration, alongside associated interface hardware, in collaboration with vendors.

  • Collaborate across teams to define comprehensive measurement plans and contribute to design-for-test (DFT) implementation.

  • Collect, analyze, and report wafer-level measurement data to determine pass/fail outcomes and support yield monitoring, reliability testing, and failure analysis.

  • Transfer laboratory characterization methods into production, developing automated test protocols and equipment specifications for manufacturing integration.

  • Optimize test throughput while maintaining measurement accuracy and reliability.

  • Work with manufacturing engineering to implement statistical process control (SPC), improve yield, and strengthen test efficiency and data analytics.

  • Support supplier qualification, vendor evaluation, and incoming material characterization.

  • Create test documentation and training materials, ensuring procedures meet industry standards and customer quality requirements.

Your Qualifications

  • Master’s degree or Ph.D. in Engineering, Physics, or a related technical discipline.

  • At least five years of hands-on experience setting up and operating ATE systems, including wafer probers and probe card specification, qualification, and integration.

  • Strong programming skills in Java and Python for test automation, instrument control, and automated data collection.

  • Hands-on experience performing electrical, optical, and electro-optical measurements on EIC and PIC devices; RF or high-speed testing experience is a plus.

  • A sound understanding of PIC and/or EIC device structures and operation, including EIC-to-PIC interface architectures.

  • Practical knowledge of design-for-test (DFT) methodologies and their implementation in integrated circuits.

  • A proven track record of transferring laboratory test methods and device characterization into production environments.

  • Proficiency in data processing, statistical analysis, and visualization using Python, Java, or LabVIEW, with experience applying statistical process control (SPC) and monitoring yield, process performance, and reliability.

  • Knowledge of supplier management, incoming material characterization, and vendor qualification processes.

  • Experience in a fast-paced startup or semiconductor manufacturing environment is preferred.

  • Advanced knowledge of optoelectronic device physics, graphene-based devices, and semiconductor operating principles is an advantage.

  • Familiarity with photonic component qualification methodologies and industry reliability testing standards is a plus.

  • Experience characterizing and testing optoelectronic or semiconductor packaging is an advantage.

Our work culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry

Experienced Freight Dispatcher — U.S. Trucking

Full-Time | Remote — Philippines | U.S. Freight Operations

Experienced U.S. Freight Dispatchers

We are hiring experienced Freight Dispatchers to support U.S. trucking operations, coordinate freight movements, and communicate professionally with U.S. drivers, freight brokers, carriers, shippers, and receivers.

Applicants must have previous professional experience supporting U.S. freight dispatch operations and be capable of managing assigned transportation activities accurately and independently.

Key Responsibilities

  • Search and evaluate freight using U.S. freight load boards.
  • Evaluate available loads based on equipment type, freight rate, mileage, deadhead, appointments, and operating requirements.
  • Negotiate freight rates within authorized limits.
  • Calculate loaded miles, deadhead miles, total trip miles, and rate per mile.
  • Coordinate professionally with U.S. CDL-A drivers, freight brokers, carriers, shippers, and receivers.
  • Schedule pickups and deliveries.
  • Monitor active shipments and communicate accurate load-status updates.
  • Identify and respond appropriately to delays, appointment changes, and transportation issues.
  • Review rate confirmations and dispatch instructions for accuracy.
  • Maintain accurate load, dispatch, and communication records.
  • Maintain bills of lading, proof-of-delivery documents, rate confirmations, and other applicable freight documentation.
  • Document detention, layover, TONU, and other applicable freight exceptions.
  • Support efficient equipment utilization and freight movement.
  • Escalate safety, compliance, broker-verification, documentation, or service concerns when appropriate.

Required Qualifications

  • Previous professional experience in U.S. freight dispatching.
  • Fluent professional spoken and written English.
  • Strong professional telephone communication skills.
  • Strong understanding of U.S. trucking operations and freight terminology.
  • Experience communicating with U.S. CDL-A drivers, freight brokers, carriers, and other transportation personnel.
  • Working knowledge of U.S. freight load boards.
  • Ability to evaluate freight and calculate mileage, deadhead, and rate per mile.
  • Experience negotiating freight rates within authorized limits.
  • Ability to coordinate pickup and delivery appointments.
  • Strong organization, documentation, and follow-up skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple active transportation activities accurately.
  • Reliable computer and stable high-speed internet connection.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Availability during assigned U.S. transportation operating hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working directly with U.S. motor carriers or Owner-Operators.
  • Experience dispatching multiple trucks or coordinating fleet operations.
  • Familiarity with DAT One, Truckstop, or comparable freight load boards.
  • Experience with transportation-management or dispatch systems.
  • Knowledge of Dry Van, Reefer, Flatbed, or Step Deck operations.
  • Understanding of Hours-of-Service and ELD considerations.
  • Familiarity with broker verification.
  • Experience handling detention, layover, TONU, and freight documentation.

Work Arrangement and Schedule

This is a full-time remote position based in the Philippines.

Applicants must maintain a professional remote-work environment with reliable high-speed internet, dependable telephone and communication capability, and suitable computer equipment.

The position supports U.S. trucking operations and requires availability during assigned U.S. transportation operating hours, which may require nighttime working hours in the Philippines.

Specific working days and schedules will be provided as part of the hiring process.

The Right Fit

This position is intended for experienced freight-dispatch professionals who already understand U.S. trucking operations and can confidently work with drivers, brokers, freight load boards, shipment documentation, and active transportation requirements.

The right candidate should be able to evaluate freight, recognize operational problems, communicate professionally, maintain accurate records, and follow assigned loads from initial planning through delivery.

Previous professional U.S. freight-dispatch experience is required. Entry-level applicants will not be considered.

jobs.description:
About Rediminds

At RediMinds, we build AI-enabled systems that help complex industries operate better, faster, and more intelligently. Our work spans healthcare, legal, finance, government, and other high-impact domains where software quality, trust, and speed truly matter.

We are a growing, entrepreneurial team that values ownership, clarity, compassion, and technical excellence. We're looking for builders who want to grow with us, contribute meaningfully, and be part of a team creating real products with real-world impact.

RediMinds — building the future with people who care enough to get the details right.

RediMinds, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Contractor. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all contractors and applicants and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for contract without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws

100% Remote | Full-Time

The opportunity

Every independent review represents a person seeking access to care or essential services. At RediMinds, we combine technology-enabled workflows with the judgment of independent clinicians to help deliver fair, well-supported, and timely determinations.

We are adding Case Review Managers to safeguard quality at two critical points: when a case enters our system and before the final determination is issued. Much of the administrative workflow is automated. Your judgment, attention to detail, and clear writing ensure the information is right, discrepancies are resolved, and each determination is complete and ready for release.

What you will do

  • Review incoming case files for completeness and accuracy, including case summaries, member and service details, clinical records, supporting documents, and key dates; identify missing or inconsistent information.
  • Validate system-generated summaries and case information against the underlying record, escalating discrepancies and ensuring a reliable foundation for clinician review.
  • Quality-check clinicians’ written reviews for completeness, internal consistency, clear rationale, accurate references to supporting evidence, and responsiveness to the question under review.
  • Work directly with clinicians to clarify or correct gaps in documentation while preserving their independent clinical judgment and decision-making authority.
  • Perform final quality assurance on determination letters, ensuring they faithfully reflect the clinician’s findings, are clear and professional, and meet applicable case-specific requirements before issuance.
  • Coordinate with clinical and operations teams to resolve issues, maintain accurate case records, and meet standard and expedited review deadlines.
  • Protect confidential health information, follow independence and conflict-of-interest safeguards, and identify opportunities to strengthen quality and improve workflows.

What you bring - required

  • Hands-on experience in utilization review (UR), healthcare appeals, independent review, clinical review operations, or closely related medical-record and decision-document quality assurance.
  • Ability to read and critically assess clinical documentation, identify omissions or inconsistencies, and raise well-founded questions for the appropriate clinical reviewer.
  • Excellent written communication and editing skills; able to make complex, sensitive determinations clear, accurate, and consistent.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to manage multiple cases against firm deadlines.
  • Comfort working in technology-enabled systems and independently verifying summaries, documents, and other system outputs against source records.
  • Understanding of patient confidentiality and the importance of impartial, well-documented healthcare review processes.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a healthcare-related field or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

Especially valuable - not required

  • Direct experience with an Independent Review Organization (IRO), external grievance reviews, or external healthcare appeals.
  • Experience with Pennsylvania Personal Assistance Services (PAS) cases is especially valuable; related experience in Community HealthChoices, Medicaid managed care, or long-term services and supports (LTSS) is also welcome.
  • Experience auditing clinical review rationales and final determination or appeal letters for quality and regulatory completeness.
  • A clinical credential (such as RN or LPN/LVN) or relevant clinical training.

How we work

This is a fully remote, self-directed role with close collaboration across clinical and operations teams. Evening or weekend work may be required when needed to meet regulatory deadlines. The Case Review Manager is accountable for documentation and process quality; independent clinicians remain responsible for clinical determinations.

Gestalte unsere Treasury-Strukturen und schaffe Transparenz über Liquidität und Cashflows für unsere nächste Wachstumsphase.

Black Semiconductor wächst international und entwickelt seine Finance-Organisation für die nächste Wachstumsphase weiter. In dieser Rolle übernimmst Du Verantwortung für zentrale Treasury-Themen - von Cash Forecasting und Liquiditätsmanagement bis hin zur Weiterentwicklung unserer Prozesse und Systeme. Du arbeitest eng mit unserer Senior Managerin Finance & Accounting und dem Finance-Team zusammen, bringst eigene Ideen ein und schaffst Strukturen, die mit unserem Unternehmen und unseren internationalen Gesellschaften mitwachsen.

Du verbindest fundierte Treasury-Expertise mit einer ausgeprägten Hands-on-Mentalität und hast die Möglichkeit, den Aufbau einer zunehmend global ausgerichteten Treasury-Funktion aktiv mitzugestalten.

Warum diese Rolle?

Treasury aktiv aufbauen: Du übernimmst nicht einfach bestehende Strukturen, sondern gestaltest unsere Treasury-Prozesse und Standards in einer entscheidenden Wachstumsphase aktiv mit.

Gestaltungsspielraum statt starrer Strukturen: Du kannst bestehende Abläufe hinterfragen, pragmatische Lösungen entwickeln und direkt umsetzen. Dabei ist Deine Expertise gefragt, auch wenn es darum geht, neue Wege zu finden.

Internationaler Impact: Du wirkst am Aufbau einer global abgestimmten Treasury-Steuerung mit und schaffst die Grundlage für mehr Transparenz und einheitliche Standards über Länder- und Gesellschaftsgrenzen hinweg.

Automatisierung & Skalierbarkeit: Du entwickelst Prozesse und Reporting weiter, nutzt digitale Lösungen und schaffst effiziente Abläufe, die auch mit zunehmender Komplexität funktionieren.

Nähe zu Finance Leadership: Du arbeitest eng mit unserer Senior Managerin Finance & Accounting zusammen und bringst Deine Expertise in Liquiditätssteuerung, Finanzierungsfragen und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Finance-Strukturen ein.

Dein nächster Karriereschritt: Mit dem Wachstum von Black Semiconductor kann sich Deine Rolle perspektivisch zu einer Treasury-Lead- oder Global-Treasury-Manager-Position mit wachsender internationaler Verantwortung entwickeln.

Über uns

Wir verstehen die Halbleiterindustrie als ein Universum voller Möglichkeiten. Wir erkennen Chancen und sehen das transformative Potenzial, das unsere Graphen-Lösungen für die Neugestaltung der Branche mit sich bringen.

Wir laden Dich ein, diesen Wandel gemeinsam mit uns voranzutreiben, indem wir kluge Köpfe mit einer gemeinsamen Vision zusammenbringen. Diese Vision ist es, zu zeigen, dass grundlegende Veränderungen möglich sind. Mit Deinem Wissen und Deinen Fähigkeiten kannst Du beweisen, dass Dinge anders – und besser – gemacht werden können.

Gemeinsam haben wir die Kraft, das Paradigma zu verändern, wie die Welt vernetzt ist.

Unsere Technology

Die steigenden Anforderungen der Halbleiterindustrie an leistungsfähigere Chips mit höherer Bandbreite und geringerem Energieverbrauch werden durch unsere Technologie adressiert. Wir ermöglichen die Verbindung von Chips mit Hochdurchsatz-Computernetzwerken bei minimaler Latenz.

Der entscheidende Faktor ist die Nutzung der einzigartigen physikalischen Eigenschaften von Graphen, um elektronische Datenverarbeitung mit photonischer Kommunikation zu vereinen. Dadurch können unzählige Chips miteinander interagieren, als wären sie ein einziges System. Unsere Graphen-Photonik-Innovation hebt Rechenleistung und Effizienz auf ein neues Niveau.

Kurz gesagt: Wir vernetzen Chips zu leistungsstarken, energieeffizienten Systemen und überwinden mit unserer Graphen-Technologie die bisherigen Grenzen der Konnektivität in der Halbleiterindustrie.

Deine Aufgaben

Cash Forecasting & Liquiditätsmanagement: Du verantwortest die Weiterentwicklung unserer Cash-Forecasts und schaffst Transparenz über Liquidität, Zahlungsströme und den Finanzierungsbedarf unserer internationalen Gesellschaften.

Treasury-Strukturen & Prozesse: Du entwickelst zuverlässige Treasury-Prozesse, Zuständigkeiten und Standards weiter und unterstützt den Aufbau einer global abgestimmten Treasury-Steuerung über Länder- und Gesellschaftsgrenzen hinweg.

Automatisierung & Reporting: Du identifizierst Potenziale zur Automatisierung von Forecasting, Reporting und wiederkehrenden Treasury-Abläufen und setzt skalierbare, systemgestützte Lösungen um. Gleichzeitig gestaltest du die Weiterentwicklung unserer SAP S/4HANA Cloud aktiv mit und schöpfst deren Potenzial voll aus.

Finanzierung & Analysen: Du unterstützt bei Finanzierungsaktivitäten, beispielsweise im Zusammenhang mit Wandeldarlehen, erstellst Analysen und bereitest fundierte Entscheidungsgrundlagen für interne Stakeholder vor.

Zusammenarbeit & Weiterentwicklung: Du arbeitest eng mit unserer Senior Managerin Finance & Accounting und dem HQ-Finance-Team zusammen, koordinierst Treasury-Themen mit relevanten internen und externen Stakeholdern und treibst Verbesserungen eigenständig voran.

Das bringst Du mit

  • Fundierte Erfahrung im Treasury, insbesondere im Cash Forecasting und Liquiditätsmanagement

  • Hands-on-Mentalität sowie eine strukturierte und pragmatische Arbeitsweise, um Prozesse auch in einem wachsenden Umfeld eigenständig aufzubauen

  • Erfahrung in internationalen Strukturen oder mit mehreren Gesellschaften sowie die Fähigkeit, übergreifende Standards zu entwickeln

  • Interesse an Automatisierung, digitalen Systemen und skalierbaren Prozessverbesserungen

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Was wir Dir bieten

Entwicklung: Du übernimmst Verantwortung für zentrale Treasury-Themen und gestaltest den Aufbau unserer Treasury-Strukturen aktiv mit. Mit dem Wachstum von Black Semiconductor kann sich Dein Verantwortungsbereich perspektivisch bis hin zu einer Treasury-Lead- oder Global-Treasury-Manager-Rolle mit internationaler Verantwortung und dem Aufbau eines kleinen Teams entwickeln.

Beteiligung: Du erhältst virtuelle Aktienoptionen und partizipierst damit am langfristigen Erfolg unseres Unternehmens.

Flexibilität: Wir arbeiten hybrid mit einer Anwesenheit von ca. ein bis zwei Tagen pro Woche in Aachen.

Gesundheit & Zukunft: Deine Gesundheit und Zukunft sind uns wichtig. Wir bieten Dir ein umfassendes Leistungspaket mit Versicherungs-, Vorsorge- und weiteren Benefits.

Zukunftsbranche: Arbeite an einer Technologie, die die nächste Generation der Halbleiter-Konnektivität mitgestalten soll.

Unsere Kultur

Menschen vor Prozessen. Bei Black Semiconductor ist Flexibilität der Schlüssel - wir sorgen dafür, dass sich die Arbeit dem Leben anpasst und nicht umgekehrt. Wir setzen uns für die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben ein, damit Karrieren sinnvoll und bereichernd sind. Unsere Prozesse sind menschenzentriert, damit Du Dich auf das Wesentliche konzentrieren kannst.

Lass uns gemeinsam wachsen. Dein Potenzial ist unsere Priorität. Wir bieten Dir die nötige Autonomie, um etwas zu bewirken, und fördern Dein Wachstum durch eine Kultur des kontinuierlichen Lernens. Wir investieren in Deine berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung.

Wir leben Offenheit. Zusammenarbeit und Inklusion sind die Eckpfeiler unserer Kultur. Wir praktizieren Offenheit und fördern Vertrauen und Respekt. Individualität ist unsere kollektive Stärke, die uns zu Innovationen antreibt und uns voranbringt.

Wir verbinden Chips – und Menschen. Wir ermutigen qualifizierte Personen mit beliebigem Hintergrund, sich zu bewerben. Wir fördern ein integratives und unterstützendes Arbeitsumfeld, das Zusammenarbeit, Innovation und Wachstum schätzt. Schließ Dich unserem Team an und werde Teil eines Unternehmens, das in der Branche etwas bewirken will.

Kannst Du Dich in dieser Rolle und in unserem Unternehmen wiederfinden? Let's connect.

Todo con guía constante del equipo de Sistema.bio.

jobs.description:
Tech Lead - Shared Backend Services

Hybrid in London (UK) or Remote within the UK

We’re looking for a Tech Lead to join the Funnel Platform team.

You’ll lead the team behind the shared services and frameworks that iwoca’s engineers build on. Those engineers are your customers, and the shared backend services feed iwoca’s lending decisions.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The Team

Funnel Platform takes its name from iwoca’s customer funnel – a business’s journey from first application to repeat lending. It owns the shared services and frameworks that the customer journey teams along that funnel build on, in the UK and Germany. The team’s aim is to make those services reliable, and simple for other teams to change.

The team works across three areas:

  • Credit data. Looking after the services that bring in data from the UK credit bureaus and Companies House.

  • Bank data. Looking after the service other teams use to work with business bank transactions.

  • New shared services. Building services that several teams need, including one for split tests.

The team is small – three backend engineers, including you. Infrastructure, such as Kubernetes and cloud hosting, sits with a separate team, so the work here is software.

The Role

As the Tech Lead in Funnel Platform, you’ll stay hands-on in the code while you lead the team. The team has no product manager, so you’ll decide what it builds, with input on priorities from the leaders of iwoca’s customer journey teams. You’ll report to the head of engineering for the customer journey teams.

  • Ownership. You’ll be accountable for the team’s existing services and the new ones it builds, from design to production.

  • Engineering standards. You’ll shape how the team designs and tests the shared services, and review the changes other teams make to them.

  • Impact. You’ll improve the services iwoca’s customer journey teams depend on, so your work speeds up theirs.

  • Influence. You’ll use data to persuade the customer journey teams and their leaders to back shared-service work that helps all of them.

  • Leadership and growth. You’ll line-manage the team’s two engineers, and give them the guidance and context to lead projects of their own.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Technical leadership. You’ve led engineers as a tech lead for around two years, while staying hands-on in the code.

  • Shared services. You’ve built and run backend services or frameworks that other engineering teams use and contribute to. You’ve reviewed their changes and shaped how they use your work.

  • Backend engineering. You know at least one backend language in depth, and you’ve designed and run distributed systems in production.

  • Problem finding. You’ve set a team’s priorities without a product manager, talking to the people who use your work to find the real problem before you design a fix. You can show what a technical trade-off costs or saves the business.

  • AI leverage. You’ve used AI to produce work you couldn’t have delivered without it – such as an internal tool or a migration. You know where it helps keep shared code easy to maintain, and you review what it produces before it goes live.

Bonus:

  • Python and Django. You’ve built production services in Python with Django.

  • Numerical background. You’re comfortable analysing data and drawing conclusions you can defend.

  • Experimentation. You’ve built tools that other teams use to run split tests.

  • Fintech. You’ve worked at a fintech or another financial services business.

The salary

About Abridge

Founded in 2018, Abridge is the first AI-native clinician intelligence platform organized around the patient, built for clinicians, and designed to help health systems coordinate the clinical, financial, and evidence-based decisions for every moment of care. Powered by purpose-built AI for healthcare, Abridge connects patients, providers, payers, and life sciences companies. This year, the platform will support more than 100 million patient-clinician conversations across more than 300 of the largest and most complex health systems in the U.S. With deep workflow integration, the Abridge clinician intelligence platform has been validated to support encounters in 28+ languages across specialties and care settings.

Abridge is setting the industry standard for the responsible deployment of Al across health systems with continual and transparent Al evaluation. Clinical decision support references and cites gold-standard sources of evidence, and features like Linked Evidence map AI-generated documentation to source data, helping clinicians quickly trust and verify the output.

Abridge was awarded Best in KLAS for Ambient AI in 2025 and 2026, in addition to other accolades, including TIME Best Inventions of 2024 and 2025, CNBC Disruptor 2025, and Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies 2025.

We are a growing team of practicing clinicians, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to transform healthcare. We have offices located in San Francisco, New York, and Pittsburgh.

THE ROLE

Core Product is responsible for how doctors and nurses use Abridge every day, and how deeply and broadly they engage with it. That covers the notes clinicians rely on after every visit, how care moves across the inpatient stay and the emergency department, the assistant clinicians ask questions of, nursing workflows, and the voice, mobile, and desktop experiences that clinician’s use.

We are hiring a Product Manager to own one of these areas end to end. You'll spend real time with clinicians, turn what you learn into product conviction, and ship with engineering, design, machine learning, and clinical science. Success means clinicians who come back to Abridge again and again, and health systems that can see the time saved and value created.

This is a hybrid role based in San Francisco or New York. Please only apply or consider this opportunity if you are open to Monday, Wednesday, and Friday in office or relocation.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Own product strategy and execution for your area. Define the vision and roadmap, decide what to build and what not to build, and own the outcomes.

  • Earn clinician love. Do deep discovery with physicians, nurses, and advanced practice providers across ambulatory, inpatient, and ED settings. Test hypotheses quickly and iterate on adoption, retention, and perceived time saved.

  • Ship AI experiences clinicians trust. Partner with ML and clinical science to define quality bars and evals. Design for uncertainty and edge cases, and know where AI shouldn't be used.

  • Make Abridge part of the workflow. Work across EHR integrations (Epic, Cerner, Meditech) and Abridge's own surfaces so the experience fits how clinicians already work.

  • Grow depth and breadth of engagement. Set clear success metrics, such as active use, retention, workflows per clinician, and time saved, and drive them across care settings and roles.

  • Prototype to build conviction. Use AI coding tools to sharpen your own thinking and get the team aligned before engineering commits.

  • Operate with a high bar for quality, speed, and accountability.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including end-to-end ownership of user-facing products you launched, not just optimized.

  • Hands-on AI/ML product experience with specifics. You've shipped AI features and have opinions on what makes them good or bad.

  • A visible building habit. You prototype, build with AI tools daily, and can show us something you made recently.

  • Strong product taste and user empathy. You describe a product by starting with the user and how it feels to use.

  • Experience partnering closely with engineering, design, and ML teams in a fast-moving environment.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to create structure, sequencing, and measurable outcomes where little exists.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management, including with clinical audiences.

BONUS POINTS IF…

  • You have a technical background (former engineer, or a CS/engineering degree).

  • You have worked with clinical SMEs, health system stakeholders, or in clinical, healthcare, or other regulated environments.

  • You have experience with EHRs like Epic, Cerner, or Meditech.

  • You have built productivity tools, workflow automation, ambient intelligence, or agentic products.

  • You have shipped products that deliver measurable operational or financial ROI.

Why Work at Abridge?

At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.

Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business.

Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients.

We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you.

How we take care of Abridgers:

  • Generous Time Off: 14 paid holidays, flexible PTO for salaried employees, and accrued time off for hourly employees

  • Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for all full-time employees and their families.

  • Generous HSA Contribution: If you choose a High Deductible Health Plan, Abridge makes monthly contributions to your HSA.

  • Paid Parental Leave: Generous paid parental leave for all full-time employees.

  • Family Forming Benefits: Resources and financial support to help you build your family.

  • 401(k) Matching: Contribution matching to help invest in your future.

  • Personal Device Allowance: Tax free funds for personal device usage.

  • Pre-tax Benefits: Access to Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Commuter Benefits.

  • Lifestyle Wallet: Monthly contributions for fitness, professional development, coworking, and more.

  • Mental Health Support: Dedicated access to therapy and coaching to help you reach your goals.

  • Sabbatical Leave: Paid Sabbatical Leave after 5 years of employment.

  • Compensation and Equity: Competitive compensation and equity grants for full time employees.

  • ... and much more!

Equal Opportunity Employer

Abridge is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability.

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the interview process. Once you submit your application, we'll follow up with details on how to request an accommodation for interviewing, completing any assessments, or otherwise participating in the selection process.

Staying safe - Protect yourself from recruitment fraud

We are aware of individuals and entities fraudulently representing themselves as Abridge recruiters and/or hiring managers. Abridge will never ask for financial information or payment, or for personal information such as bank account number or social security number during the job application or interview process. Any emails from the Abridge recruiting team will come from an @abridge.com email address. You can learn more about how to protect yourself from these types of fraud by referring to this article. Please exercise caution and cease communications if something feels suspicious about your interactions.

jobs.description:
When you’re the best, we’re the best. We instill an environment where employees feel engaged, satisfied and able to contribute their unique skills and talents while living and working as their authentic selves. We provide extensive opportunities for personal and professional development, building both employee competence and organizational capability to fuel exceptional performance through an inclusive environment both now and in the future.

Summary:


In this role, you will serve as a senior pharmacy advocate and strategic advisor within Vizient’s national pharmacy program, supporting Children’s Hospital Association (CHA) clients. You will collaborate with pharmacy leaders, hospital executives, clinicians, CHA staff, pharmaceutical suppliers, and Vizient business units to identify and implement pediatric pharmacy strategies that improve patient care, operational efficiency, and financial performance. You will lead complex consulting engagements, leveraging pharmacy purchasing data, analytics, evidence-based practices, and contracting resources to deliver value beyond the national pharmacy program. You will build trusted executive relationships and guide clients from opportunity assessment through implementation to measurable results.


Responsibilities:


  • Build and maintain executive-level relationships with CHA member pharmacy leadership, CHA personnel, and hospital executives, including C-suite engagement.
  • Lead member meetings, strategic discussions, and executive-level presentations that translate complex pharmacy insights into clear recommendations, compelling business cases, and decisions.
  • Collaborate with CHA spend executives and Vizient teams to strengthen pharmacy program education, communicate enhancements, and develop relevant content for recurring CHA pharmacy meetings.
  • Analyze member purchasing patterns, pharmaceutical utilization, and supplier opportunities using Vizient tools and member data to identify pediatric-specific financial and clinical value.
  • Collaborate with pharmaceutical suppliers, CHA member pharmacists, and Vizient contracting and analytics teams to develop, expand, and communicate CHA-specific custom or enhanced pharmacy contracts.
  • Identify opportunities for product standardization, formulary optimization, appropriate therapeutic interchange, and improved purchasing economics while maintaining or improving patient care quality.
  • Validate potential savings and operational impact with pharmacy and clinical stakeholders; track progress toward contractual value objectives.
  • Lead practical assessments of pharmacy and medication-management programs across acute-care health systems, infusion centers, ambulatory surgery centers, and affiliated clinics, with attention to pediatric practice needs.
  • Use evidence-based literature, regulatory standards, benchmark comparisons, and leading practices to recommend clinical, operational, and financial improvements.
  • Partner with pharmacy and clinical leaders on formulary management, P&T activities, therapeutic interchange, IV-to-oral conversion, medication-use protocols, and related opportunities as applicable to the member.
  • Develop strategic operating plans, detailed project work plans, standardized tools, calculators, draft protocols, and order sets; provide hands-on support for implementation and evaluation.
  • Lead complex, cross-functional projects; set priorities, scope, timing, and resource needs, and coordinate analytical work to deliver measurable results.
  • Collaborate across Vizient business units to identify, position, launch, and implement new or improved pharmacy consulting services, products, and solutions.
  • Engage clinical pharmacy thought leaders, review emerging evidence, and contribute to professional knowledge through presentations, conferences, publications, and practice-development activities.
  • Manage multiple concurrent member priorities and engagements, maintain strong member satisfaction, and meet or exceed agreed project and contractual value targets.

Qualifications:


  • Pharmacy degree (PharmD) required; master’s degree in business or a related field preferred.
  • 7 or more years of relevant pharmacy experience in an acute-care hospital, including hospital or health-system pharmacy leadership experience, required.
  • Background in pharmacy or healthcare consulting, including operational, financial, and clinical assessments and implementation support.
  • Knowledge of pediatric pharmacy practices and children’s hospital operations.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate with pharmaceutical suppliers to develop and present client purchasing or contracting opportunities.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze clinical, operational, and financial data, develop actionable recommendations, and lead complex initiatives.
  • Strong executive-level communication, presentation, facilitation, collaboration, and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities to meet client needs and project timelines.
  • Prior experience as a Director of Pharmacy or Pharmacy Manager preferred.
  • Completion of an ASHP-accredited pharmacy residency program preferred.
  • Experience with 340B programs and Pharmacy and Therapeutics Committee activities preferred.
  • Ability to travel regularly and expeditiously throughout the year to meet clients’ needs and timetables.

Estimated Hiring Range:

At Vizient, we consider skills, experience, and organizational needs in our compensation approach. Geographic factors may adjust the range estimate and hires typically fall below the top range. Compensation decisions are tailored to individual circumstances. The current salary range for this role is $135,200.00 to $236,600.00.

This position is also incentive eligible.

jobs.description:
Role overview:

  • Location: Toronto, Ontario. Fully remote, with regular in-person client meetings and events.
  • Employment Type: Full-time, permanent
  • Target Start Date: January 2027

About elia/GPHY

elia is the all-in-one workplace operations platform for large organizations. Desk and room booking, visitor management, occupancy sensors, smart lockers, digital signage, asset management: we bring it all together in a single platform. Large organizations trust us in Canada, the United States and around the world. We are a fast-growing team of about 40 people, and we plan to reach about 120 over the next three years. Everyone has a direct impact on the product and on how we build the company, and AI is part of how we work.

The Role

Most large organizations run their workplace on a patchwork of tools. Facilities have one system for rooms, IT has another for devices, HR has a spreadsheet for attendance, and nobody fully trusts the data. elia replaces that patchwork with one platform, built to work with the Microsoft tools companies already use.

This year we consolidated our positioning around large enterprises, and it has brought us a lot of success.

You will be our senior Account Executive for Toronto and Ontario, and you will own that market. Your job is to win new logos: find large organizations and sign their first contract with elia. SDRs will support you with outreach, but opening doors in Toronto depends heavily on you. That means being comfortable picking up the phone, building relationships, and getting out to events and industry gatherings to meet future customers in person.

We sell to large organizations, and cycles are long. We expect you to be able to multi-thread those large accounts in order to accelerate adoption.

What You Will Do

  • Own a target list of large Ontario organizations (500+ employees) and turn it into a pipeline, mostly through your own outbound work and network.
  • Hunt new logos. You win the first contract with each new customer. Once a customer is signed, our account management team takes over the relationship.
  • Run enterprise deals from first meeting to signature: discovery, business case, tailored demo with our Solution Engineer, proposal, negotiation and close.
  • Map and work the buying committee across Facilities, IT, HR, Real Estate and Finance. Find the champion, reach the economic buyer, and understand how the decision really gets made.
  • Lead RFP responses for large opportunities, with support from our Solution Engineer and marketing.
  • Build elia's presence in the Toronto workplace community through client events, industry events and partners.
  • Keep Hubspot clean and forecast honestly. Everything should be logged in Hubspot. If it isn't logged, it never happened.

What You Bring

  • About 5 years of proven success selling technology to businesses, in a market similar to ours: large organizations, multiple stakeholders, long sales cycles.
  • You have sold SaaS. Software combined with hardware (sensors, room displays) is ideal, and a real plus.
  • A strong affinity for technology, and a track record you can point to, ideally from a startup or scale-up where you did this yourself.
  • An entrepreneurial, hunter mindset. Your focus is signing new customers, not managing existing ones.
  • Experience with long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and formal RFPs with large private or public-sector buyers.
  • A network in Ontario facilities, real estate, IT or workplace teams is a strong asset.
  • You are organized. You know where every deal stands without needing to look it up, and you sell the business case, not the feature list.
  • A quiet home workspace where you can make calls all day.
  • English is required. French is an asset, not a requirement.

Comfortable with Technologies

  • You should be comfortable with technologies and already be leveraging AI tools in your day-to-day work.
  • We are looking for someone who is tech-savvy, understands platforms well, and is curious to try out different tools.

What We Offer

  • Uncapped commission, with accelerators above quota and extra pay for self-sourced and multi-year deals.
  • The chance to join early and lead our Ontario growth.
  • A clear, published career ladder with promotion criteria you can see.
  • A product that customers actually use every day, with a team that ships fast and listens to the field.
  • A flexible schedule.
  • Free access to Tonic Gym, or $100 toward sports.
  • Our famous G-PHEST team events.
  • Group insurance

jobs.description:
PermitFlow is redefining how America builds. We’re an applied AI company serving the nation’s builders, tackling one of the largest information challenges in the economy: understanding what can be built, where, and how. Our AI agent workforce helps the fastest-growing construction companies navigate everything from permitting and licensing to inspections and project closeouts – accelerating housing, clean-energy, and infrastructure development across the country.

Despite being a $1.6T industry, construction still suffers from massive delays, wasted capital, and lost opportunity. PermitFlow has already delivered unprecedented speed, accuracy, and visibility to over $20B in development, helping contractors reduce compliance time, de-risk projects, and scale with confidence.

As the U.S. enters a new capex supercycle across data centers, factories, housing, and renewables, joining PermitFlow means building the AI infrastructure at the core of every construction project driving the next wave of reindustrialization.

We’ve raised over $90M, most recently completing our Series B, from top-tier investors including Accel, Kleiner Perkins, Initialized, Y Combinator, Felicis, and Altos Ventures, with backing from leaders at OpenAI, Google, Procore, ServiceTitan, Zillow, PlanGrid, and Uber.

Our HQ is in New York City with a hybrid schedule (3 in-office days per week). We are seeking NYC-based candidates or those open to relocation to NYC.

Role Overview

This is a foundational GTM role that combines industry credibility with integration know-how to help customers modernize how they build. You’ll partner closely with Sales but you’re not a seller - your role is to help customers understand how PermitFlow fits into their existing systems, why it matters to their operations, and what it will take to implement successfully.

You’ll act as the connective tissue between our customers’ operational realities and our platform’s technical capabilities - ensuring every solution we propose is practical, scalable, and ready to deploy.

As PermitFlow scales, this function will become increasingly central to how we sell, scope, and implement enterprise-wide solutions - anchoring around your expertise in workflow design, integrations, and industry operations.

What You’ll Do

  • Partner with Enterprise AEs to support complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, with strong focus on technical validation.

  • Design custom workflow configurations that leverage PermitFlow’s platform capabilities and align with customer business goals

  • Scope and document technical integrations (ServiceTitan, Salesforce) to ensure seamless adoption

  • Translate between operational language and technical requirements - ensuring customers, Sales, and Product all stay aligned

  • Deliver tailored demos and proof-of-concepts that showcase how PermitFlow integrates into existing workflows

  • Collaborate with Product, Implementation, and Customer Success to ensure successful handoff and deployment

  • Create repeatable solution assets — integration guides, workflow templates, demo scripts — to scale the team as we grow

Who You Are

  • Domain Expert: Deep understanding of construction, permitting, or pre-construction workflows; can speak credibly with contractors, builders, and developers.

  • Workflow Designer & Solution Creative: Skilled at mapping customer processes, identifying bottlenecks, and designing elegant, scalable solutions.

  • Integration-Savvy: Comfortable scoping technical integrations and data flows across tools like ServiceTitan, or Salesforce.

  • Sales Partner: Experienced supporting enterprise sales teams through discovery, demos, and solution validation.

  • Technical Translator: Able to bridge customer pain points and product capabilities—simplifying complex tech for executive audiences.

  • Cross-Functional Operator: Works fluidly across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Implementation to align on deliverables and ensure success.

  • Builder Mentality: Thrives in ambiguity and enjoys creating structure, content, and processes from scratch.

  • Mission-Driven: Energized by fixing the fragmented pre-construction process and transforming how America builds.

How Success Will Be Measured

  • Win rate and quality of supported enterprise deals

  • Accuracy and scalability of scoped solutions

  • Strength of internal and customer relationships

  • Contribution to sales productivity and playbook development

  • Successful alignment between what’s sold and what’s delivered

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high-growth company

  • 100% company-paid base medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees + healthcare FSA

  • 401(k) savings plan

  • Unlimited PTO and paid family leave

  • Home office & equipment stipend

  • Daily in-office lunch and dinner provided

  • Commuter benefits (pre-tax transit and parking)

PermitFlow provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, or family status, as protected by applicable law.

We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities. All employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.

Compensation Range: $175K - $225K

About Cogstate

At Cogstate, we help improve the quality and reliability of clinical trial data by providing specialized clinical assessment, training, and quality oversight solutions to pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies around the world.

Our team partners with sponsors and research sites to support the consistent administration, scoring, and review of clinical outcome assessments across global clinical trials. Through services including central scoring, central review, image-based review, rater training and certification, calibration, and quality review and remediation, we help reduce variability, strengthen data quality, and ensure greater confidence in clinical trial endpoints.

Our work spans multiple therapeutic areas, including dermatology, where we engage experienced clinicians to bring indication-specific and scale-specific expertise to clinical trial programs. Our experts help ensure assessments are performed and evaluated consistently, from training and certifying site raters to centrally reviewing scores and images and identifying opportunities for remediation.

Our global team brings together clinical, scientific, operational, data, and technology expertise to solve complex challenges in clinical trials. At Cogstate, our goal is simple: to help sponsors generate high-quality, reliable data that supports confident decision-making throughout clinical development.

About the Clinician Network

By joining the Cogstate Clinician Network, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute your clinical expertise to research studies around the world.

Depending on your background, scales experience, and therapeutic area expertise, we may have an opportunity for you immediately - or it may take some time before a study opens that is the right fit.

Cogstate is continuing to grow and expand our clinical research initiatives, so new projects and opportunities are always on the horizon.

About the Role

Cogstate is seeking experienced Dermatologists to support clinical research studies through a range of centralized assessment and quality oversight services. In this fully remote, contract-based role, clinicians may perform Central Scoring, Central Review, Image-Based Review, Site Rater Training & Certification, Calibration Activities, and Quality Review & Remediation across a variety of dermatology clinical trials.

Cogstate provides comprehensive, fully compensated training on study protocols, scoring methodologies, review processes, and operational requirements before clinicians begin study work. Ongoing calibration exercises and quality oversight activities help ensure consistency, reliability, and regulatory compliance across all study assessments.

Depending on study needs and individual expertise, consultants may contribute to one or more service areas, including:

  • Central Scoring: Independent scoring and interpretation of dermatology-specific clinician-reported and observer-reported outcome measures.
  • Central Review: Secondary review of completed assessments to ensure accuracy, consistency, and protocol adherence.
  • Image-Based Review: Evaluation of clinical photographs and imaging data to assess disease severity, treatment response, and endpoint compliance.
  • Site Rater Training & Certification: Training, certifying, and supporting site-based raters on proper scale administration and scoring procedures.
  • Calibration Activities: Participating in ongoing calibration exercises to maintain inter-rater reliability and scoring consistency across global studies.
  • Quality Review & Remediation: Identifying assessment quality issues, providing corrective feedback, and supporting remediation efforts to improve data quality and protocol compliance.

These are fully-remote, contract positions. Work is provided on an as-needed basis and scheduled according to clinician availability.

Qualifications & Expertise

  • MD or DO with specialization in Dermatology.
  • Board-certified or board-eligible Dermatologist preferred.
  • Active and unrestricted medical license in a relevant jurisdiction.
  • Minimum 3-5 years of post-training clinical practice experience in dermatology.
  • Experience evaluating and managing patients with dermatologic conditions in clinical, academic, or research settings.
  • Demonstrated experience with dermatology clinical outcome assessments, disease severity scales, and clinician-reported outcome measures.
  • Experience with one or more dermatology indications such as atopic dermatitis, psoriasis, vitiligo, hidradenitis suppurativa, alopecia areata, prurigo nodularis, eczema, chronic pruritus, or other inflammatory and rare dermatologic disorders.
  • Familiarity with dermatology rating scales and assessments such as EASI, IGA, SCORAD, PASI, DLQI, VASI, PP-NRS, HiSCR, CDLQI, and other study-specific outcome measures.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to consistently apply scoring criteria and identify assessment quality issues.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide training, feedback, and remediation guidance to site personnel.
  • Proficiency with telehealth platforms, Microsoft Office applications, and web-based clinical trial systems.

Our Culture
We bring our whole selves to work every day. We’re courageous and we deliver together. We’re passionate individuals who enjoy working together. We’re brave enough and care enough to have the right conversations to get the best outcome and are famous for our can-do attitude. We see challenges as opportunities and move with pace to achieve our goals.

If you’re ready to help us in our journey to optimize the measurement of brain health around the world, please apply now!

Pocket FM is the world's largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we're redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe.

With one of the largest creator ecosystems in entertainment, Pocket FM is home to millions of listeners and an ever-growing catalog of original serialized content. We're building the future of storytelling by bringing together exceptional writers, creators, and creative leaders to develop stories audiences can't stop listening to.

About the Role

    Pocket FM is seeking a Content Lead to drive the creative strategy, writing, and localization of serialized audio fiction for Indonesian audiences. This role will lead the adaptation of English-language stories into compelling Bahasa Indonesia content, ensuring strong storytelling, cultural relevance, and audience engagement.

    You'll manage a team of writers and editors, oversee story development across multiple series, and use AI tools, audience data, and creative feedback to continuously improve content quality and performance.

    We're looking for a hands-on creative leader with strong fiction writing and editorial experience, a deep understanding of episodic storytelling, and the ability to build scalable content workflows.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the creative strategy, writing, and editorial direction for Pocket FM's Bahasa Indonesia serialized fiction across genres including romance, romantasy, fantasy, thriller, and drama.

  • Oversee English-to-Bahasa Indonesia localization and creative adaptation, ensuring natural dialogue, cultural relevance, and preservation of the original story's emotional impact.

  • Develop and improve episodic storytelling, including strong hooks, pacing, character arcs, cliffhangers, and emotional payoffs that drive audience retention.

  • Lead, mentor, and manage writers, editors, and localization specialists, providing actionable creative feedback and maintaining high editorial standards.

  • Review and refine scripts, identifying storytelling weaknesses and improving dialogue, plot structure, character development, and overall narrative quality.

  • Implement AI-assisted writing, localization, and editing workflows to improve content quality, speed, and efficiency.

  • Analyze audience engagement, retention metrics, and listener feedback to make data-driven creative decisions and improve story performance.

  • Build scalable editorial processes, writing guidelines, story bibles, and quality-control systems to ensure consistency across series.

  • Manage writing schedules, production deadlines, and script delivery across multiple active shows.

  • Collaborate with Production, Product, Marketing, and other cross-functional teams to support content launches and ongoing performance optimization.

  • Identify emerging storytelling trends, popular genres, and audience preferences to inform content selection and development in Indonesia.

Qualifications

  • Proven experience in fiction writing, screenwriting, television writing, serialized fiction, audio storytelling, or other narrative-driven entertainment.

  • Strong understanding of episodic storytelling, including narrative structure, pacing, cliffhangers, character development, and emotional engagement.

  • Experience writing, editing, or developing fictional content, ideally in romance, romantasy, fantasy, thriller, drama, or similar genres.

  • Experience creatively adapting or localizing English-language fictional content into Bahasa Indonesia, beyond direct translation.

  • Excellent Bahasa Indonesia writing and editing skills, with strong English proficiency and an understanding of Indonesian cultural nuances and audience preferences.

  • Experience managing and developing creative teams, including writers, editors, or freelancers, with responsibility for creative quality and performance.

  • Hands-on experience using AI tools or large language models for writing, localization, editing, or content development.

  • Demonstrated ability to use audience data, retention metrics, or qualitative feedback to make creative changes and improve content performance.

  • Strong editorial judgment, with the ability to identify storytelling weaknesses and provide clear, actionable feedback.

  • Experience managing multiple content projects, editorial workflows, and production deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

  • Familiarity with Indonesian entertainment, digital fiction, television, streaming, or serialized storytelling platforms.

  • Strong communication, collaboration, and organizational skills, with a passion for creating engaging fiction for Indonesian audiences.

jobs.title: Global Clinical Study Manager
jobs.excerpt: BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals.
jobs.description:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

General Description:

  • Accountable for global study delivery within agreed timelines and budget with appropriate inspection readiness quality
  • Leads all aspects of assigned clinical study(ies)
  • Leads global cross-functional study team (including oversight of external partners) and acts as point of escalation for resolution of issues within assigned study(ies)
  • Ensures alignment of study goals with clinical operations and corporate goals and objectives
  • Experience in managing global oncology studies; preferably pivotal studies and inspection management with HA

Essential Functions of the job:

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Leads the global cross-functional study team effectively, ensures effective decision making, and acts as point of escalation for resolution of study related issues
  • Leads external vendors management involved in study delivery
  • Builds trust and relationship with regional subject matter experts and supports the delivery of their local study objectives
  • Collaborates with key stakeholders across the organization and provides regular updates on study progress to senior management as required
  • Represents the study team at internal meetings and leads the cross-functional Clinical Study Team (CST) meetings
  • Participates and presents at various topics of Clinical Study Management
  • Participates in Clinical Operations Process improvement initiative

Planning and Execution

  • Leads planning and management of the assigned clinical study(ies) from feasibility through closeout activities
  • Generates, manages, maintains, and communicates high quality study timelines and tracks progress towards these
  • Ensures that the clinical studies are operationally feasible along with Global Clinical Program Lead, oversees trial feasibility, trial allocation and site selection process across all regions
  • Ensures timely availability of high-quality study documents to allow study submission to regulatory authorities and ECs/IRBs
  • Provides oversight to study start up and site activation plans
  • Ensures study plans (eg project management plan, monitoring plan, Trial Master File plan, data monitoring plan, ...) are created, updated and distributed timely and implemented appropriately
  • Ensures study systems and tools are set up timely, correctly and are functioning properly. Ensures study level information is updated on an ongoing basis in all systems
  • Implements RBQM end-to-end processes on time within the allocated study (e.g., periodic reviews, centralized monitoring analyses, action items)
  • Ensures relevant study specific training is developed and implemented and ensures training records are well documented and filed
  • Ensures Trial Master File for study is created, maintained and QC’d on a regular basis as per the study TMF QC plan
  • Collaborates closely with Global Clinical Supplies to forecast study drug and timely delivery of supplies to sites
  • Supports and as needed drives overall data cleaning timelines in close collaboration with Data Management and other stakeholders (including but not limited to regional clinical operations teams and medicator monitor)
  • Ensures planning and execution of the Clinical Study Report in collaboration with Medical Writing and relevant CST members

Quality and Risk Management

  • Monitors study activities to ensure compliance with the study protocol, SOPs, all study plans, ICH/GCP and all other relevant regulations
  • Regularly reviews and manages quality-related GCO metrics to be within acceptable limits
  • Ensures inspection readiness at any point in time throughout the study life cycle
  • Works with cross-functional study team to identify, interpret, and evaluate issues on the study and ensures corrective and preventative actions are implemented
  • Ensures senior management and other key stakeholders are informed of risks and challenges and ensures risk mitigation plans are put in place and implemented
  • Prepares team for quality assurance audits and inspections
  • Collaborates with CST members and other colleagues to ensure cross-team, site learnings, and best practices are shared
  • Leads improvements and partners with study team members to enhance the efficiency and the quality of the work performed on assigned studies
  • Contributes to development, optimization and review of work instructions and SOPs as required

Budget and Resources

  • Works with the sourcing team to select and manage study vendors, approving invoice payment throughout the study
  • Manages study budgets, including baseline budget evaluation, change control, study closure budget, presents study budget for senior management engagement
  • Adheres to clinical study budgeting processes and provides input to finance on budget accruals and forecasts
  • Identifies and manages study team resource needs and establishes contingency plans for key resources.
  • Monitors Clinical Study Team resource utilization over the study life cycle Ensures clinical studies at a project level are executed within endorsed time, quality, and cost parameters

Education Required:

Bachelor’s Degree in a scientific or healthcare discipline required*, Higher Degree preferred

*exceptions might be made for candidates with relevant clinical operations experience

Supervisory Responsibilities:

Provides performance feedback on team members as required

Computer Skills:

MS Office, Project Planning Applications, Clinical Trial Management Systems

Other Qualifications:

  • Proven Project Management experience in Global Clinical Studies (Oncology experience preferred)
  • Advanced knowledge of clinical operations methodologies, in depth understanding of all aspects of clinical study processes
  • Able to independently lead global clinical studies (pivotal study management experience required)
  • 5+ years of progressive experience in clinical research within a biotech or pharma company
  • A minimum of 3 years working as a lead Senior Project Manager/Clinical Study Manager on GlobalClinical Studies focused in Oncology
  • Prior experience in managing early (Phase 1-2) and/or late-stage pivotal studies (phase 3) in Breast Oncology Studies (preferred)

Travel: Travel might be required as per business need.

Salary Range Italy: 63,900.00 EUR - 79,900.00 EUR

Salary Range France: 74,100.00 EUR - 92,600.00 EUR

Salary Range Spain: 71,400.00 EUR - 89,200.00 EUR

Global Competencies

When we exhibit our values of Patients First, Driving Excellence, Bold Ingenuity, and Collaborative Spirit, through our twelve global competencies below, we help get more affordable medicines to more patients around the world.

  • Fosters Teamwork
  • Provides and Solicits Honest and Actionable Feedback
  • Self-Awareness
  • Acts Inclusively
  • Demonstrates Initiative
  • Entrepreneurial Mindset
  • Continuous Learning
  • Embraces Change
  • Results-Oriented
  • Analytical Thinking/Data Analysis
  • Financial Excellence
  • Communicates with Clarity

All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.
