jobs.description:
At Two Six Technologies, we build, deploy, and implement innovative products that solve the world’s most complex challenges today. Through unrivaled collaboration and unwavering trust, we push the boundaries of what’s possible to empower our team and support our customers in building a safer global future.

Overview of Opportunity

Two Six Technologies is actively seeking a Customer Success Manager (CSM) to join our team. Sitting at the intersection of sales, support, and product, the CSM carries a primary mandate: ensure customers achieve their desired business outcomes, drive feature adoption, and transform satisfied users into long-term product advocates. If you have a strong background in customer relationship management, post-sale retention, and cross-functional advocacy, our growing team wants to talk to you!

This position will be Remote with occasional travel to customer sites across the U.S. This position requires less than 20% CONUS and OCONUS travel.

At Two Six Technologies, we strive to solve problems collaboratively, innovate and respond to feedback, and include, thank, celebrate, and be kind to our team members. As a valued team member, you will be surrounded by and expected to embody these values, working on your own and with your colleagues to find creative solutions and tackle challenging problems with cutting-edge technology.

The work requires an active Secret clearance with the eligibility and willingness to obtain and maintain a TS/SCI.

What You Will Do:

  • Customer Success: Accelerate decision velocity to identify opportunities, isolate narrative vulnerabilities, optimize target acquisition, and orchestrate immediate campaign deployment in support of Company objectives.
  • Onboarding & Adoption: Guide new customers through implementation and initial setup; create customer success plans and drive active feature usage.
  • Relationship Management: Build strong relationships across multiple stakeholder levels in customer organizations; conduct regular check-ins and Executive/Quarterly Business Reviews (EBRs/QBRs).
  • Retention & Risk Management: Monitor customer health metrics (usage data, support tickets, engagement signals), identify churn risks early, and manage contract renewals.
  • Growth & Expansion: Identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities, track expansion revenue, and partner with sales to close expansion opportunities.
  • Voice of the Customer: Relay product feedback and feature requests to Product/Engineering teams while turning satisfied customers into case studies, references, and referrals.

Understand the Information Environment: Isolate narrative vulnerabilities and plan information operations. Leverage Two Six products driven by agentic AI and an enriched data architecture to provide insight to customers on opportunities in the non-kinetic space.

  • Briefings & Strategy: Draft high-level strategic documents and present operational plans to senior military leadership, government agencies, and coalition partners.

Customer Relationships: Represent and promote Two Six Technologies in customer engagements and explore expansion opportunities. This includes building relationships with adjacent customers to:

    • Understand their requirements;
    • Understand how our product and service offerings can meet those requirements;
    • Grow the Two Six presence in the customer arena.

What you will need:

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or Technical Account Management within a software/technology environment.
  • Relationship & Communication Skills: Proven track record of managing post-sale client relationships, conducting Business Reviews (QBRs/EBRs), and building trust across executive and technical stakeholders.
  • Data-Driven Retention: Demonstrated experience tracking customer health metrics, running retention playbooks, and managing renewals.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Demonstrated ability to act as the "Voice of the Customer," collaborating directly with Product, Engineering, and Sales teams.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Communications, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Travel: Ability and willingness to travel up to 10% CONUS and OCONUS
  • Professional Skills:
    • Knowledge of technologies and data used in the information advantage domain, including any of the following: PAI, data collection and analytics, natural language processing, AI, including machine learning, ad tech, mobile technology, and/or telecommunications.
    • Excellence in communicating, including written and verbal.
    • Ability to collaborate across teams, especially within a distributed team.
    • Ability and willingness to learn new things, particularly new technology.
    • Ability to operate independently. A self-starter.
    • Excellent analytic skills.
    • Ability to combine quantitative and qualitative analysis to generate insight.
  • Clearance: Active Secret clearance with the eligibility and willingness to obtain and maintain a TS/SCI

What we’d love you to have:

  • Experience in the information advantage domain, including best tradecraft practices.
  • Experience providing mission support through product licenses, not just services.
  • Experience working with government, defense, or federal technology programs.
  • Direct ownership of renewal quotas or expansion/upsell revenue KPIs.
  • Familiarity with Customer Success software platforms (e.g., Gainsight, ChurnZero) and CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce).

Clearance Requirements:

  • Active Secret clearance with the eligibility and willingness to obtain and maintain a TS/SCI

Two Six Technologies is committed to providing competitive and comprehensive compensation packages that reflect the value we place on our employees and their contributions. We believe in rewarding skills, experience, and performance. Our offerings include but are not limited to, medical, dental, and vision insurance, life and disability insurance, retirement benefits, paid leave, tuition assistance and professional development.

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

IT Systems Administrator, IndiaRemote (India) | Full-Time

Also searched as: System Administrator, IT Support Executive, IT Administrator, IT Coordinator, Service Desk Analyst

When a colleague is locked out, a new hire needs access on day one, or someone cannot work out which CRM button to press, do you want to be the person who sorts all of it, fast?

On a typical day you might clear the morning tech ticket queue and unblock two people before their first meeting, set up a new joiner's accounts and access in Rippling and Google Workspace after lunch, and answer a CRM workflow question and update the tech guide so it stops coming in before end of day.

About Contour

We started in 2020 with a handful of students and a belief that great education should not be out of reach. Today we operate across three brands with 8,000+ students and 425+ team members: roughly 100 in India and 325 onshore in Australia. The India team runs publishing, student experience, CRM and technology, operations, and people and culture.

A remote team of hundreds only moves as fast as its access, its tools, and its ability to use them. This is the seat that keeps all three working.

About This Role

You are the tech-savvy generalist who keeps Contour's team unblocked. You own the tech ticket queue, you run the system administration behind accounts and access, and you are the person people go to when a tool or a CRM workflow is not doing what they need.

The job has four parts that all sit with you. You run the tickets: every tech and access request comes through Suptask, and you triage, resolve first line, and escalate the rest with clear context. You do the system administration: Google Workspace, Rippling, and seats and access across Monday and HubSpot. You own onboarding and offboarding: setting new joiners up in the right systems on day one through Rippling, removing access cleanly when someone leaves, and building basic automations in Rippling so that setup is reliable rather than manual. And you run the audits: regular access and license checks so the right people have the right access, nothing is over-provisioned, and no leaver is left with a login.

On top of the pure IT work, you handle the non-IT but tech-based tickets: the CRM questions. Which button, which workflow, why did this behave that way. You resolve them, and just as importantly you train the team and keep the tech guide and knowledge base current, so the same questions stop coming in. This is where being genuinely tech-savvy matters: you learn a system fast, explain it plainly, and turn a repeat question into a bit of documentation.

You report to the VP of Global Enablement and Support. The automation and engineering teams own the deep builds, the Make scenarios, the HubSpot development, and the LMS code; your patch is first-line support, system administration, access, audits, and enablement, and you escalate the deep technical items to them. Because Contour is remote-first, the weight is on accounts, access, and the SaaS tools the team lives in, not physical hardware. By the end of month three, the ticket queue runs with reliable response times, onboarding and offboarding through Rippling runs like clockwork, Google Workspace and CRM access is clean and audited, and the tech guide is deflecting the questions that used to come in over and over.

Where the work lives

  • Suptask (the Contour Help Hub):every tech and access request becomes a tracked ticket, so nothing slips and response times are measurable.

  • Rippling:identity, onboarding, and accounts. Where you set people up, remove them cleanly, and build the automations that make that reliable.

  • Google Workspace admin:accounts, groups, permissions, and shared drives, kept clean and current.

  • Monday.com and HubSpot:seats and access, plus the CRM workflows the team asks you about.

  • The tech guide and knowledge base:where you turn a repeat question into an answer the team can self-serve.


Requirements

What You Will Do

  • Run the ticket queue.Own the tech and access tickets in Suptask: triage by urgency, resolve first-line issues, and escalate the deep ones with clear context.

  • Do the system administration.Administer Google Workspace, Rippling, and seats and access across Monday and HubSpot, keeping everything accurate.

  • Own onboarding and offboarding.Set new joiners up in the right systems on day one through Rippling, remove access cleanly when someone leaves, in step with People and Culture, and build basic Rippling automations so it runs reliably.

  • Run access and license audits.Check regularly that the right people have the right access, flag over-provisioning and unused licenses, and make sure no leaver keeps a login.

  • Handle the CRM tickets and train the team.Resolve the tool and CRM workflow questions, coach the team so they can self-serve, and keep the tech guide and knowledge base current so repeat questions drop.

  • Fix at the root.When the same issue keeps coming back, fix the cause and document it, rather than closing the same ticket twice.

If a better tool would make support or setup faster, make the case and we will back it.

What You Need

  • 1 to 3 years in IT support, helpdesk, service desk, or a systems administration role, resolving real user issues.

  • Hands-on Google Workspace administration: accounts, groups, and access.

  • Comfort with an HRIS or identity tool like Rippling for onboarding and access, or the aptitude to own it quickly.

  • A genuinely tech-savvy generalist: you pick up new tools fast and are comfortable across a SaaS stack, not just one platform.

  • Clear, patient communication: you explain a fix or a workflow to a non-technical colleague without making them feel small, and you can train a group.

  • Accuracy with access, and ownership by default: you follow a ticket to resolution and close the loop.

  • Cross-timezone comfort: your day runs on India hours with overlap into Australian time.

Nice to Have

  • Rippling experience, or experience administering a comparable HRIS or identity platform.

  • Experience building simple automations or workflows, in Rippling or a no-code tool.

  • Experience with an ITSM or ticketing tool (Suptask, Freshservice, Zoho Desk, Jira Service Management, or similar).

  • Familiarity with ITIL basics: incident, request, and access management.

  • Experience supporting or administering a CRM like Monday.com or HubSpot.

  • Experience in a remote-first company.

The Kind of People Who Thrive Here

The people who do well here see a gap and close it without being asked, holding the bar even when the clock is short. They give a direct read on the work in front of them, including when it's wrong, and when their own idea doesn't hold up, they say so and bring a better one. They build something that keeps running after they step back. Problems here don't show up on schedule or in the same shape twice, and they'd rather make the right call on limited information than let something break while they wait for a sign-off. That's the job. They name the blocker and the ask the moment they have it, on a call or a text, because decisions get made on the information you bring.

Contour's current cluster heads started as team leads. The path from operator to leader is real here.

What good looks like

  • Nobody stays blocked:access, tool, and CRM problems get resolved fast, and people get back to work.

  • Onboarding just works:a new hire has the right access on day one, every time, and leavers are removed promptly.

  • Access stays clean:audits are current, the right people have the right access, and there are no stray logins or unused licenses.

  • Repeat questions shrink:the tech guide and your training mean the same CRM questions stop filling the queue.


Benefits

Fully remote, anywhere in India. Compensation is competitive and benchmarked to the role and your experience,and we discuss it openly early in the process. From application to offer: a short screen, a practical IT support and systems administration task, a culture conversation with our People team, and a final interview with the VP of Global Enablement and Support, in about four weeks.

Apply with a CV and one paragraph on a recurring tech or access problem you made stop coming back: what it was, and what you changed, fixed, or documented so it stopped.

jobs.description:
Join the Tilt team

At Tilt, we see a side of people that traditional lenders miss. Our mobile-first products and machine learning-powered credit models look beyond credit scores, using over 250 real-time financial signals to recognize real potential. With millions of customers worldwide, we're not just changing how people access financial products — we're creating a new credit system that backs the working, whatever they're working toward.

The opportunity: Senior Copywriter, Brand

This role is for a writer with a genuinely distinctive voice — someone who captures the spirit of a brand so naturally it feels like they've always been the one talking. You'll be the creative authority behind how Tilt speaks: writing brand and campaign copy across every surface, building long-form narratives that move people, and setting the standard for what great writing looks like in everything we make. You'll sit within the Creative team (part of Marketing), working closely with designers, marketers, and product partners to define, protect, and expand how Tilt shows up in language. The brand foundation is in place. Now we need the writer who makes it come alive at scale.

How you'll make an impact

  • Own Tilt's voice: Be the primary steward of how we sound — sharpening our voice, setting a high bar for craft, and ensuring everything we write sounds clear, human, and unmistakably Tilt.

  • Write work that defines us: Create brand copy that's clever without being try-hard, warm without being generic, and plain-spoken without being dull. You find the phrase other writers miss, and you make it look easy.

  • Concept to campaign: Generate the big idea and know how to blow it out — from the central creative platform to the headlines, scripts, and executional details that make a campaign feel whole and inevitable.

  • Tell the long story: Lead long-form narrative projects — across touch points, campaign narratives, scripts — that build trust, clarity, and emotional connection with our audience.

  • Drive growth through language: Write direct response copy for ads, email, and performance channels that converts without sounding like it's trying to. Plain speak. Everyday language. Real results.

  • Build the system: Use your craft expertise to design and refine AI-assisted copy workflows — writing prompts, style guides, and frameworks that help to stay on-brand while producing great work at scale.

  • Collaborate across the creative org: Work hand-in-hand with designers on campaign concepting and brand development to ensure writing and design move together, not in parallel.

  • Shape creative practice: As a senior voice on a growing team, you'll have real influence over how we develop creative standards, review work, and push the bar higher.

  • Make financial language feel human: Help people feel seen, respected, and confident through clear, emotionally intelligent writing that builds trust in moments that matter.

Why you're a great fit

  • A voice that's all your own: You've developed a genuine creative point of view over the course of your career. Your writing has a quality that's hard to pin down but impossible to miss — distinctive, alive, never overwrought.

  • Conceptual mind: You have campaign ideas for days. You think strategically, generate strong creative platforms, and know how to take a central concept and blow it out across channels and formats without losing what made it good.

  • Brand experience at depth: You've worked on brand identity or rebrand projects and understand what it means to capture a company's spirit in language and hold it consistently across every touchpoint.

  • Long-form narrative range: You can write a 12-word tagline and a 1,200-word brand story with equal confidence, and you know when each is right.

  • Performance copy fluency: You understand how to write for DR channels — the rhythms, the clarity requirements, the accountability to outcomes — without sacrificing voice.

  • Systems thinker: You see patterns in your craft. You can document what makes writing work and build frameworks that help others write better, including AI-assisted tools.

  • Deep collaborator: You thrive in creative feedback loops, take critique as fuel, and are as invested in the team's work as your own.

  • Clear presenter: You can walk a room through a creative rationale and make people feel the rightness of a choice, not just understand it.

  • Agency and/or in-house experience: You know how creative work actually ships, and you've navigated real-world timelines, stakeholders, and constraints without compromising on quality.

Don’t meet every qualification? We care about potential over your past. If you're bringing ambition and drive to what we're building, we want to hear from you.

What you'll get at Tilt

  • Virtual-first teamwork: The Tilt team is collaborating across 14 countries, 12 time zones, and counting. You’ll get started with a WFH office reimbursement.

  • Competitive pay: We're big on potential, and it's reflected in our competitive compensation packages and generous equity.

  • Complete support: Find flexible health plans at every premium level, and substantial subsidies that stand up to global standards.

  • Visibility is yours: You can count on direct exposure to our leadership team — we’re a team where good ideas travel quickly.

  • Paid global onsites: Magic happens IRL: we gather twice yearly to reconnect over shared meals or kayaking adventures. (We’ve visited Vail, San Diego, and Mexico City, to name a few.)

  • Impact is recognized: Growth opportunities follow your contributions, not rigid promotion timelines.

The Tilt Way

We're looking for people who chase excellence and impact. Those who stand behind their work, celebrating the wins and learning from the missteps equally. We foster an environment where every voice is valued and mutual respect is non-negotiable — brilliant jerks need not apply. We're in this together, working to expand access to fair credit and prove that people are incredible. When you join us, it's not just another day at the [virtual] office, you're helping millions of hardworking people reach better financial futures.

You’re pushing ahead in your career? We can get behind that. Join us in building the credit system that people deserve.

Compensation Range: $132.6K - $156K

Entry-Level Freight Dispatcher — Shipment Scheduling

Full-Time | Remote — United States | U.S. Transportation Operations

Every Delivery Has a Deadline. Every Detail Matters.

We are hiring Entry-Level Freight Dispatchers to support U.S. transportation operations with a focus on shipment scheduling, freight coordination, appointment management, and accurate communication.

This position is entry-level specifically in professional freight dispatching. Previous employment as a freight dispatcher is not required. Applicants must, however, have previous professional experience in trucking, transportation, logistics, or a closely related field and understand basic U.S. trucking operations.

Shipment Scheduling and Appointments

  • Coordinate pickup and delivery appointments with shipping and receiving facilities.
  • Confirm appointment numbers, facility requirements, check-in procedures, and receiving hours.
  • Identify scheduling conflicts before trucks arrive.
  • Communicate appointment changes promptly to drivers and authorized operations personnel.
  • Maintain accurate pickup and delivery schedules.
  • Monitor appointment requirements throughout active shipments.

Trip Planning and Freight Coordination

  • Review freight assignments for travel distance, available driving hours, pickup requirements, and delivery schedules.
  • Use DAT One, Truckstop, or comparable freight load boards to review available freight.
  • Evaluate how pickup and delivery schedules affect subsequent loads.
  • Calculate loaded miles, deadhead miles, total trip miles, and rate per mile.
  • Consider driver Hours of Service when reviewing shipment schedules.
  • Identify excessive deadhead, detention exposure, unrealistic transit expectations, and scheduling conflicts.
  • Assist with coordinating freight around driver availability and operational requirements.

Transportation Records

  • Maintain organized load schedules, appointment confirmations, and shipment updates.
  • Review rate confirmations for pickup and delivery accuracy.
  • Track delays, detention, appointment changes, and revised delivery instructions.
  • Maintain bills of lading, proof-of-delivery records, and related transportation documentation.
  • Update dispatch and operational records accurately.
  • Escalate service, scheduling, documentation, or operational issues requiring additional review.

Required Transportation Background

Previous professional freight-dispatch employment is not required.

Applicants must have previous professional experience or practical knowledge in an applicable transportation area, such as:

  • CDL-A trucking
  • Transportation or logistics operations
  • Fleet operations or administration
  • Truck-driver recruiting with practical trucking knowledge
  • Freight brokerage support
  • Carrier operations
  • Load planning
  • Transportation coordination
  • Comparable U.S. trucking operations

Required Skills

  • Working knowledge of U.S. trucking and transportation operations.
  • Familiarity with U.S. freight load boards.
  • Understanding of CDL-A trucking operations and common equipment types.
  • Ability to coordinate appointments and manage changing schedules.
  • Working knowledge of driver Hours-of-Service considerations.
  • Ability to calculate loaded mileage, deadhead mileage, and rate per mile.
  • Fluent professional spoken and written English.
  • Strong professional telephone and email communication.
  • Strong organization and attention to detail.
  • Computer proficiency and ability to work with spreadsheets and digital documents.
  • Reliable computer and stable high-speed internet connection.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Helpful Additional Experience

  • Warehouse and distribution-center appointment procedures
  • Dry Van or Reefer operations
  • Detention and layover documentation
  • ELD systems
  • Transportation-management systems
  • Dispatch assistance
  • Freight brokerage support
  • Active-load tracking

Work Arrangement and Schedule

This is a full-time remote position supporting U.S. transportation operations.

The position requires availability during assigned U.S. transportation operating hours. Specific working days and schedules will be provided as part of the hiring process.

Applicants must maintain a professional remote-work environment with reliable internet and dependable communication capability.

Compensation

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. Include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

  • Coordinate with and provide independent assurance over other control and monitoring functions (risk management, compliance, security, legal, ethics, environmental, external audit).
  • Assist in designing methods to assess and mitigate business risks and propose methods to improve processes and problem areas identified by audits and/or consultations.
  • Communicate findings with stakeholders in a timely manner, clearly stating the risks and facts, arriving at alignment on the root cause of issues and committing to implementing recommendations.

Build the compliance function of a new securities business from the outset, with direct access to the board and a real say in how the product is designed.

Kruze Consulting is a boutique CPA firm that provides accounting, bookkeeping, finance, payroll, and tax services to over 750 startups backed by top-tier venture capital funds. The Tax Accountant position (what we call an Income Tax Accountant) will work as part of a 30+ person team of tax professionals to serve our corporate clients. We’re looking for someone with a strong background in corporate tax accounting with a consultative approach to problem solving. The ideal candidate will have great time management skills, be very detail-oriented and a quality enthusiast. Kruze Consulting has a proven track record of developing their employees to their highest potential. If you are looking to learn and grow as a corporate income tax professional, this role might be a terrific opportunity to do that in an entrepreneurial, fully remote accounting firm.
KRUZE CONSULTING IS AN EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER.
Kruze Consulting believes in diversity of thought as a competitive advantage to bring people together to build a culturally inclusive team. If you are smart, and good at what you do, come as you are. Diverse candidates (however you choose or choose not to identify) are encouraged to apply.

WHAT WE OFFER/WHY KRUZE CONSULTING:

  • Fully Remote – We’ve completely embraced and invested in remote work and know the benefits. Save time, save money, and decrease stress. Our experience shows that remote work fosters a healthier work/life balance for our people. We do get together once a year for an annual offsite meeting, but it’s optional.
  • Flexibility/Autonomy - Need to run to an appointment, your child's school, or just want to take a walk outside? No problem. If your clients’ needs are met and your work gets done on time, enjoy!
  • Stability – While we serve startups, we aren’t one. We’ve been around for almost a decade enjoying controlled growth over that time. We don’t over-hire, and thankfully, we’ve never had to do a reduction in force. Our service offering is niche, accounting is essential to businesses, and the potential market for our services is diversified/vast.
  • High-Quality Colleagues - We’re a diverse bunch, experts in our respective fields, and eager to help each other and clients. We care about each other as whole human beings.
  • High-Quality Clients - We work exclusively with venture-funded technology startups and early-stage companies who are creating some of the most exciting and transformative products and services in the world! (We also have a “no jerks” policy; our clients treat our people professionally and respectfully.)
  • Purpose/Meaningful Work – Not your average accounting role. Kruze professionals get to work with innovative startups that are disrupting their respective industries and creating the products and services of tomorrow. Like proud parents, we derive vicarious enjoyment as our clients grow, get additional rounds of funding, and ultimately get acquired by Fortune 500 firms.
  • Professional Development – You’ll gain exposure to many types of clients and industries including SaaS, eCommerce, Healthcare, Biotech, Crypto/Blockchain, and Manufacturing. At Kruze, you’ll have the opportunity to learn multiple disciplines and work with a wide variety of high-visibility clients and find your passion.

NEED TO HAVE/POSITION REQUIREMENTS:

  • 3+ years of corporate income tax compliance or accounting experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Tax
  • Strong knowledge of federal/state corporation income tax returns
  • Experience in preparing, reviewing, and providing feedback on federal/state corporation income tax returns
  • Strong experience in tax software systems, ideally CCH Axcess or similar platform
  • Must be willing to work core business hours in their local time zone (approximately 8am to 5pm local time)
  • Meticulous attention to detail – able to follow through and execute on a high volume of nuanced tasks
  • Ability to work with a strong sense of urgency in a fast-paced setting with a wide variety of tasks
  • Strict adherence to deadlines – understanding that governmental agencies don’t make exceptions
  • A love of rapidly changing technology/software solutions that maximize efficiency and deliver firmwide value

NICE TO HAVE/POSITION PREFERENCES:

  • Master’s Degree in Accounting or Tax
  • Licensed CPA or eligible to sit for the CPA exam, or an Enrolled Agent (EA)
  • Some knowledge of international tax reporting (5471 & 5472)
  • Some knowledge of income tax provision and deferred tax concepts
  • Experience in a fully remote people-centric culture
  • Experience in a high growth/startup/entrepreneurial environment
  • Experience with newer systems/platforms such as Slack, Salesforce, 1Password, Airtable, Box, Monday.com, Loom, and
many others (we are always exploring and embracing new systems as part of our DNA!)

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:

Income Tax Preparation and Review (~60% of the time)
  • Preparation and review of 150-200 corporation 1120 tax returns
  • Preparation and review of Forms 5471, 5472, 3115, 3921
  • Preparation and review of state income tax returns, state apportionment, and state modifications
Consulting (~30% of the time)
  • Respond to client tax questions, and help to resolve federal/state notices and audit requests
  • Assist in all M&A transactions by gathering documents and responding to due diligence requests
Administrative (~10% of the time)
  • Review monthly client billing reports to ensure completion and accuracy
  • Provide periodic updates to the senior management regarding tax process status/goals/delays/roadblocks
  • Attend weekly all-hands and tax meetings
WHAT YOU WON’T BE DOING:Kruze’s own corporate taxes. That’s handled by our corporate finance team.
A note of caution about remote work at Kruze Consulting:
While it seems cool, it’s not for everyone. You must have the discipline, work ethic, healthy boundaries, work strategies, and emotional intelligence to work remotely. While we strive for work-life balance at Kruze, this is still a fast-paced role that will require you to juggle many different projects and tasks. You must enjoy and thrive in this type of fast-paced environment.
About Kruze Consulting:
Kruze Consulting provides accounting, bookkeeping, finance, payroll, and tax services to over 750 startups backed by top-tier venture capital funds.
  • Our core values are: Kaizen ∙ Integrity ∙ Collaborative ∙ Caring ∙ Strategic
We are a 100% remote company, working in many different countries and time zones; we encourage our employees to take advantage of our flexible work environment to be happier and more productive. The firm has 750+ Seed, Series A, Series B, and Series C clients. The firm was started 15 years ago, by Vanessa Kruze, CPA and now has 175+ team members. Kruze utilizes best-of-breed software tools such as QuickBooks, Gusto, Justworks, Rippling, Expensify, Bill.com, Zoom, Slack, Ramp, and Brex. Our client base is comprised of venture capital-backed startups funded by the very best venture capital funds in the world.

Physical Requirements:

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

The Role

We are seeking a Device Reliability Testing Engineer to drive reliability qualification, failure analysis, and accelerated life testing for our integrated graphene photonics products. In close collaboration with Design Enablement, Process Integration, and Product Quality, you will establish robust test methodologies to validate device reliability, and long-term stability in accordance with industry standards.

You will play a key role in transitioning our technology from prototype to production- qualified products, ensuring that graphene photonics meet the performance and robustness requirements of high-volume deployment.

To join our team, you should be excited to:

  • Design and execute wafer-level device reliability test plans for graphene- based photonic devices (DC bias, RF endurance, thermal cycling, long-term stability)

  • Identify and investigate the physical mechanisms of graphene-related failure modes.

  • Characterize and monitor key performance metrics, including extinction ratio, insertion loss, bandwidth retention, energy efficiency, dark current stability, responsivity degradation over device lifetime

  • Drive structured root cause investigations using FMEA/8D methodologies and feed findings back to Design and Process teams

  • Work together with product and quality teams to reach compliance with industry standards (JEDEC, OIF, IEC, IEEE) and generate qualification and reliability documentation

  • Ph.D. or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Materials Science, or Photonics Engineering

  • Hands-on experience in semiconductor device physics, optoelectronics, or reliability engineering

  • Experience with semiconductor failure analysis

  • Experience with high-speed RF testing (>40 GHz) and VNA-based S- parameter measurements is good to have

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

At Cogstate, we help improve the quality and reliability of clinical trial data by providing specialized clinical assessment, training, and quality oversight solutions to pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies around the world.

Our team partners with sponsors and research sites to support the consistent administration, scoring, and review of clinical outcome assessments across global clinical trials. Through services including central scoring, central review, image-based review, rater training and certification, calibration, and quality review and remediation, we help reduce variability, strengthen data quality, and ensure greater confidence in clinical trial endpoints.

Our work spans multiple therapeutic areas, including dermatology, where we engage experienced clinicians to bring indication-specific and scale-specific expertise to clinical trial programs. Our experts help ensure assessments are performed and evaluated consistently, from training and certifying site raters to centrally reviewing scores and images and identifying opportunities for remediation.

Our global team brings together clinical, scientific, operational, data, and technology expertise to solve complex challenges in clinical trials. At Cogstate, our goal is simple: to help sponsors generate high-quality, reliable data that supports confident decision-making throughout clinical development.

About the Clinician Network

By joining the Cogstate Clinician Network, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute your clinical expertise to research studies around the world.

Depending on your background, scales experience, and therapeutic area expertise, we may have an opportunity for you immediately - or it may take some time before a study opens that is the right fit.

Cogstate is continuing to grow and expand our clinical research initiatives, so new projects and opportunities are always on the horizon.

About the Role

Cogstate is seeking experienced Dermatologists to support clinical research studies through a range of centralized assessment and quality oversight services. In this fully remote, contract-based role, clinicians may perform Central Scoring, Central Review, Image-Based Review, Site Rater Training & Certification, Calibration Activities, and Quality Review & Remediation across a variety of dermatology clinical trials.

Cogstate provides comprehensive, fully compensated training on study protocols, scoring methodologies, review processes, and operational requirements before clinicians begin study work. Ongoing calibration exercises and quality oversight activities help ensure consistency, reliability, and regulatory compliance across all study assessments.

Depending on study needs and individual expertise, consultants may contribute to one or more service areas, including:

  • Central Scoring: Independent scoring and interpretation of dermatology-specific clinician-reported and observer-reported outcome measures.
  • Central Review: Secondary review of completed assessments to ensure accuracy, consistency, and protocol adherence.
  • Image-Based Review: Evaluation of clinical photographs and imaging data to assess disease severity, treatment response, and endpoint compliance.
  • Site Rater Training & Certification: Training, certifying, and supporting site-based raters on proper scale administration and scoring procedures.
  • Calibration Activities: Participating in ongoing calibration exercises to maintain inter-rater reliability and scoring consistency across global studies.
  • Quality Review & Remediation: Identifying assessment quality issues, providing corrective feedback, and supporting remediation efforts to improve data quality and protocol compliance.

These are fully-remote, contract positions. Work is provided on an as-needed basis and scheduled according to clinician availability.

Qualifications & Expertise

  • MD or DO with specialization in Dermatology.
  • Board-certified or board-eligible Dermatologist preferred.
  • Active and unrestricted medical license in a relevant jurisdiction.
  • Minimum 3-5 years of post-training clinical practice experience in dermatology.
  • Experience evaluating and managing patients with dermatologic conditions in clinical, academic, or research settings.
  • Demonstrated experience with dermatology clinical outcome assessments, disease severity scales, and clinician-reported outcome measures.
  • Experience with one or more dermatology indications such as atopic dermatitis, psoriasis, vitiligo, hidradenitis suppurativa, alopecia areata, prurigo nodularis, eczema, chronic pruritus, or other inflammatory and rare dermatologic disorders.
  • Familiarity with dermatology rating scales and assessments such as EASI, IGA, SCORAD, PASI, DLQI, VASI, PP-NRS, HiSCR, CDLQI, and other study-specific outcome measures.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to consistently apply scoring criteria and identify assessment quality issues.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide training, feedback, and remediation guidance to site personnel.
  • Proficiency with telehealth platforms, Microsoft Office applications, and web-based clinical trial systems.

Our Culture
We bring our whole selves to work every day. We’re courageous and we deliver together. We’re passionate individuals who enjoy working together. We’re brave enough and care enough to have the right conversations to get the best outcome and are famous for our can-do attitude. We see challenges as opportunities and move with pace to achieve our goals.

jobs.title: Package Reliability Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.excerpt: About usWe see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility.
jobs.description:
About us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

The Role

We are seeking a Package Reliability Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will own the reliability of our packaged products, from defining mission profiles and reliability targets to identifying package-level failure mechanisms, developing qualification strategies, and making evidence-based release recommendations.

Reporting to the Quality & Reliability Program Lead, you will work closely with the Package Architecture, Device Reliability, Product Engineering, and OSAT/laboratory partners to translate product use cases into mission profiles and FIT/MTBF targets. You will assess reliability risks, define and execute package-level reliability test plans, lead failure analysis activities, and ensure findings are driven to resolution.

Your core focus will be to transform product requirements into robust reliability strategies, validate package concepts through targeted stress testing, and provide data-driven recommendations that enable confident product release.

To join our team, you should be excited to:

  • Own mission profiles and reliability targets by defining product operating conditions (temperature, voltage, humidity, thermal cycling, and lifetime requirements) and allocating FIT, MTBF, and lifetime targets across package, interconnect, and device-level contributors.

  • Assess package reliability risks by evaluating failure mechanisms across substrates, die attach, interconnects, solder joints, board attach, and optical/fiber interfaces, including delamination, warpage, fatigue, electromigration, and optical or electrical drift.

  • Define and execute package reliability qualification plans covering thermal, mechanical, environmental, and board-level stress testing in accordance with JEDEC, AEC-Q100/Q006, IPC, IEC, and customer-specific requirements.

  • Lead the technical interface with OSATs, substrate suppliers, and labs, defining reliability requirements, reviewing data, and challenging results when the supporting evidence is insufficient or unrepresentative.

  • Drive root-cause investigations and failure analysis, leveraging techniques such as X-ray, C-SAM, cross-sectioning, SEM/EDX, and related methods, and translate findings into CAPA/8D actions, design improvements, and requalification decisions.

  • Develop risk-based qualification strategies for novel packaging technologies, such as UBC and optical interconnects, where industry standards are incomplete or do not yet exist.

  • Provide data-driven release recommendations by assessing whether products are ready for customer sampling, qualification milestones, or production release, while clearly communicating any remaining reliability risks.

Your Qualifications

  • Educational background with a Master's degree (or equivalent experience) in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Materials Science, Reliability Engineering, or a related field.

  • Package reliability expertise with 3–5+ years of experience evaluating semiconductor package construction (substrates, die attach, interconnects, and solder joints) and understanding the failure mechanisms associated with these technologies.

  • Understanding of high-speed I/O and RF reliability, including how reliability degradation impacts high-speed serial, RF, and optical interfaces (e.g., signal integrity, insertion loss, jitter, and eye closure over product lifetime). This expertise goes beyond conventional digital logic reliability and is a core requirement for this role. Experience with photonics reliability is highly desirable.

  • Solid foundation in reliability engineering, including FIT and MTBF calculations, mission profile development, acceleration models, and translating product use cases into measurable reliability requirements and targets.

  • Experience with industry qualification standards, including JEDEC, AEC-Q100/Q006, IPC, and IEC, as well as the judgment to apply knowledge-based qualification approaches when existing standards are not sufficient.

  • Failure analysis expertise, with the ability to interpret results from techniques such as X-ray, C-SAM, cross-sectioning, and SEM/EDX, and translate findings into risk-based recommendations.

  • Experience collaborating with OSATs, substrate suppliers, and external laboratories, including defining technical reliability requirements, reviewing qualification data, and driving technical discussions to ensure robust evidence for product qualification.

  • Excellent cross-functional communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate reliability risks, trade-offs, and evidence gaps to architects, engineers, suppliers, and leadership.

  • Thrives in a startup environment, demonstrating initiative, ownership, adaptability, and the ability to make progress in a fast-paced, resource-conscious setting.

Our work culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry

jobs.description:
About Klar

We're turning one of the world's largest underbanked markets into something fairer, simpler, and more transparent. 7 million users served since 2019. Uber's first global credit card, built right here in Mexico. Klar Empresarial, a brand-new B2B solution bringing agile credit and smart accounts to SMEs who've been ignored by traditional banks for too long.

And a full banking license on the horizon, because our customers asked for it and we listened.

We move fast, we think big, and we go all in, because as our CEO puts it: "Growing doesn't always mean going further. Sometimes it means going deeper."

Behind all of it is a team of 30+ nationalities, working across Mexico City, Berlin, and Argentina, obsessed with building financial products that are simpler, faster, and fairer than anything that came before.

This is Klar, and we're seeking the people who'll write the next chapter.

Our people

If you join us at Klar, you’ll be welcomed to a team that is rich in many talents and we are very proud! With our head office in Mexico City, and remote tech hubs in Berlin and Argentina, we are always learning something new about another culture or language. With so many people from different backgrounds and walks of life (young professionals, parents, LGBTQ+, neurodivergence), you’ll definitely find your people here!

Our values

  • Ownership - We own our successes & our failures as a team.
  • Excellence - We do everything to the best of our ability & always seek to achieve a new level of excellence in our work.
  • Inclusion - We believe we are stronger together and actively work to promote a safe, diverse, inclusive, and respectful culture.
  • Customer Obsession - We understand the value Klar can bring to its customers & it’s always at the forefront of our decisions.
  • Klarity - We communicate clearly & with authenticity. It’s in our name & it’s what we do.

About the role

We are looking for a hands-on Offensive Security Engineer who is passionate about breaking things to make them more secure.

In this role, you'll focus primarily on identifying, exploiting, and helping remediate security vulnerabilities across our applications, APIs, and backend services. You'll work closely with engineering teams to understand how our systems operate, uncover complex security weaknesses, and translate your findings into meaningful improvements.

While penetration testing will be at the heart of your responsibilities, you'll also have the opportunity to contribute to our DevSecOps and Application Security practices, helping us build more secure products from the ground up

What you can expect:

  • Own end-to-end penetration testing engagements across Klar's web applications, APIs, and backend services, from identifying vulnerabilities to validating remediation.
  • Work on complex, real-world security challenges within a fintech environment, helping protect financial products, sensitive customer data, and critical business operations.
  • Go beyond automated scanning by conducting in-depth manual security assessments, exploring attack scenarios, and identifying vulnerabilities that automated tools may miss.
  • Collaborate closely with engineering teams to explain security findings, assess their potential impact, and help design practical, sustainable remediation solutions.
  • Contribute to our security-by-design approach by sharing offensive security insights that help engineering teams identify and prevent vulnerabilities earlier in the development lifecycle.
  • Help strengthen our security testing capabilities through automation, improved testing methodologies, and continuous improvements to our security processes.
  • Have meaningful ownership and autonomy, with the opportunity to influence security practices, challenge existing approaches, and make a tangible impact on the security of our products.

What we are looking for:

  • Proven experience performing manual penetration testing on web applications, REST APIs, and backend services.
  • Strong understanding of OWASP Top 10 and OWASP API Security Top 10.
  • Hands-on experience identifying and exploiting authentication, authorization, IDOR/BOLA, SSRF, injection, and business logic vulnerabilities.
  • Advanced proficiency with Burp Suite and offensive security tools. Ability to review source code and identify security vulnerabilities.
  • Practical knowledge of DevSecOps, CI/CD pipelines, and Secure SDLC practices. Familiarity with SAST, DAST, and SCA security tools.
  • Experience with GitHub, GitHub Actions, or similar CI/CD platforms. Scripting and automation skills using Python or Bash.
  • Experience collaborating with software engineers to remediate vulnerabilities.

Nice to have:

  • AWS and Cloud Security experience. Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform.
  • Experience with Semgrep, Snyk, SonarQube, Checkmarx, or similar tools.
  • Participation in Bug Bounty programs, CTF competitions, or vulnerability research. Certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, eWPTX, or equivalent.
  • Previous experience in fintech, banking, or financial services.

What we value:

  • Strong offensive security mindset and technical curiosity.
  • Ability to independently conduct end-to-end penetration testing engagements.
  • Experience demonstrating the real-world impact of security vulnerabilities.
  • Strong risk assessment and prioritization skills. Effective communication with engineering teams.
  • A proactive approach to security automation and continuous improvement.

Important: Penetration testing is the primary focus of this role. DevSecOps knowledge is a complementary capability, not the main specialization.

Our offer to you:

  • Competitive salary based on performance and experience
  • Chance of earning Klar stock options
  • 26 days of paid vacation per year
  • Computer devices
  • Sponsored coaching and therapy sessions via Mantra Care
  • International work environment with amazing and highly skilled people
  • A world class team that helps you evolve your skills in areas you're interested in

Klar is a safe place for everyone!

We trust our highly skilled and diverse team and we’re committed to creating a welcoming and inclusive environment for new talents to flourish. We value diversity and welcome all applications regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion/belief, physical abilities, age, sexual orientation and identity.

jobs.excerpt: Company Overview Agility PR Solutions is a global leader in media intelligence and PR technology.
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Agility PR Solutions is a global leader in media intelligence and PR technology. Founded in 2003, we help communications teams around the world drive awareness, make smarter decisions, and protect their reputation when it matters most. Our enterprise-grade platform unifies media relations, media monitoring, social listening, AI visibility, and media intelligence into a single seamless system—turning overwhelming streams of coverage and conversation into decision-ready intelligence. Recognized for ease of use, results, and customer support, Agility is one of the most trusted names in media intelligence. Our mission is to empower the voices that shape the world's narratives, and we're looking for people who want to help us do it.

About the Role

Reporting to the VP of Marketing, the Sales Development Manager builds and leads Agility's first marketing-owned sales development team: the people who turn marketing demand into sales conversations.

The team runs two motions, and you own both. The first is the engaged-prospect motion: every hand-raiser and intent signal marketing produces — demo requests, webinar and event attendees, content downloads, website conversations, review-site and intent-data signals — is contacted fast, qualified honestly, and converted into a meeting the sales team is glad to take. The second is cold outbound prospecting: structured, sequenced outreach into target accounts across our customer segments — Enterprise & Government, In-house PR Teams, and PR Agencies — run on dedicated sending infrastructure, in step with the campaigns marketing is already running, and within the consent rules of each market we sell into.

You start with a team of at least two — one Sales Development Representative covering North America and one covering the UK — and you hire, onboard, coach, and scale from there as results earn the headcount. You sit inside the demand generation engine: the Associate Director, Demand Generation designs the campaigns and the sequences; you run the people and the daily motion that executes them. You partner every week with the Director of Sales for North America and the UK sales lead on lead handoff, meeting acceptance, and the feedback loop that tells marketing which conversations are turning into pipeline.

The mandate is direct: become the primary source of qualified sales conversations from marketing demand and double to triple them within a year. One principle governs how this team is measured: a meeting booked is an activity, not a result. The result is a meeting that progresses from the demo and discovery stage to the Proposal stage as a Sales Qualified Opportunity, and ultimately to closed-won. Quotas, variable compensation, and the team scorecard are built on meetings that reach Proposal, not on meetings booked.

What success looks like

  • Both launch SDRs are hired, ramped, and hitting quota within their first quarter; the hiring, onboarding, and coaching playbook that got them there is documented and reusable.
  • The number of SDR-sourced meetings that progress from demo and discovery to the Proposal stage grows quarter over quarter, and the booked-to-Proposal conversion rate holds or improves as volume rises.
  • Closed-won revenue traceable to SDR-sourced meetings is visible in Salesforce and grows with the team; meetings booked is tracked as a leading indicator only.
  • Every engaged prospect is contacted within the agreed speed-to-lead window, with show rates and qualification quality tracked per source.
  • Cold outbound scales only on gates — reply rate, positive-reply rate, bounce rate, and complaint rate stay inside agreed thresholds as volume grows.
  • Marketing-sourced pipeline in the UK rises measurably, closing the gap with North America.
  • Proposal-stage and closed-won conversion for SDR-sourced meetings are reviewed with sales leadership monthly, and the review changes what the team does the following month.

What you’ll do

  • Team Build & Leadership
  • Hire, onboard, and ramp the launch team — one SDR in North America and one in the UK — and build the case for each additional seat with results.
  • Set quotas and variable compensation plans on meetings that progress to the Proposal stage, with activity and meetings-booked targets as leading indicators only; run weekly 1:1s, call and email coaching, and a visible team scorecard.
  • Build the SDR playbook: qualification criteria, talk tracks and objection handling by segment, sequence cadences, and handoff standards.
  • Develop people deliberately: career paths into account executive, customer success, or marketing roles, with a bench that outlasts any single rep.

Engaged-Prospect Motion

  • Own speed-to-lead: every marketing hand-raiser — demo requests, webinar and virtual-event attendees, content downloads, website chatbot handoffs, and intent signals from ZoomInfo and G2 — is worked within the agreed window and routed correctly.
  • Design follow-up plays by source and segment, so an Enterprise & Government webinar attendee and an agency content downloader get different conversations, not the same script.
  • Run post-event follow-through with the field and event marketing team: pre-registration outreach, no-show recovery, and attendee conversion for webinars, Signal Day, research readouts, and tradeshows.
  • Work expansion and cross-sell touches into the existing customer base when campaigns call for them, coordinated with customer success so no account hears from two teams.

Cold Outbound Prospecting

  • Build target-account and contact lists by segment and market using our intent and data platforms; keep list hygiene and suppression discipline so marketing's reputation is never at risk.
  • Execute the outbound sequences designed with the Associate Director, Demand Generation across email, phone, and LinkedIn, and feed reply and conversation data back into sequence and copy improvements.
  • Operate the dedicated outbound sending infrastructure — secondary domains, mailbox rotation, warmup, authentication, deliverability monitoring — kept deliberately separate from the marketing automation platform.
  • Enforce jurisdiction-aware prospecting: opt-out regimes (CAN-SPAM) and opt-in regimes (CASL, GDPR/PECR) are handled differently, market entry is sequenced accordingly, and every message carries honest subject lines, clear identification, and a working opt-out.
  • Pilot AI prospecting and research tooling against cost per sales-accepted meeting, not against the demo.

Handoff, Measurement & Sales Alignment

  • Own the SDR-to-sales handoff: meeting standards, booking-to-acceptance SLAs, agreed definitions for the demo and discovery and Proposal stages, and the Salesforce hygiene that keeps every lead, activity, meeting, and stage change visible — if it is not in Salesforce, it did not happen.
  • Maintain the SDR scorecard with meetings reaching the Proposal stage as the headline number, supported by contacts worked, speed-to-lead, meetings booked, show rate, booked-to-Proposal conversion, and closed-won influenced, by rep, by source, and by market.
  • Run a weekly feedback loop with the Director of Sales for North America and the UK sales lead on lead quality, and bring that feedback to marketing so targeting, content, and sequences improve.
  • Work in HubSpot and Salesforce fluently enough to configure routing, sequences, and reporting with the team rather than waiting on an operations queue.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years in B2B SaaS sales development or inside sales, including 2+ years leading SDRs or BDRs, with at least one example of building a team from zero and taking it to quota.
  • Hands-on cold outbound experience on dedicated sending infrastructure — secondary domains, mailbox rotation, warmup, deliverability management — and the judgment to know why purchased lists never touch the marketing platform's bulk email tools.
  • Jurisdiction-aware prospecting across opt-out (CAN-SPAM) and opt-in (CASL, GDPR/PECR) regimes; you know which markets are consent-only and sequence accordingly.
  • Fluency in the post-2024 deliverability regime — authentication requirements, bulk-sender thresholds, complaint-rate ceilings — and honest subject-line discipline treated as both a legal and a deliverability matter.
  • Salesforce and HubSpot working proficiency, plus experience with sequencing, dialer, and prospecting platforms and the intent and data tools that feed them (ZoomInfo, Apollo, G2, or equivalents).
  • A coaching record: reps you developed can be named, and they got better on the numbers under you.
  • A daily numbers habit: you run the team from the scorecard, you know your booked-to-Proposal and Proposal-to-closed-won rates by source and by rep, and you adjust weekly.
  • Experience managing a remote team across North American and UK time zones, and the discipline to give each market its own playbook rather than one universal script.
  • Clear-eyed judgment on AI SDR and prospecting tools: you pilot against cost per qualified meeting rather than buying the demo.
  • Familiarity with PR, communications, or media intelligence buyers is an asset; the ability to learn a new buyer fast is required.

Why You'll Love It Here

  • Fully remote work environment
  • Collaborative culture – and key tools enabling it
  • Competitive compensation package
  • Private Health Plan
  • Pension Plan
  • Group Income Protection
  • Life Assurance
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Career Development & Progression opportunities
  • Paid Holiday and Sick days
  • Flex Fridays in Summer, Week off between Christmas and New Years'
  • No Internal Meetings Fridays

AI Usage

We use technology to make hiring smarter, faster, and more personal, never less human. Artificial intelligence (AI) tools help us manage applications efficiently and highlight qualifications that align with each role, allowing our recruiters to focus more on meaningful conversations with candidates. AI does not make hiring decisions at Agility. Every decision is made by people, our hiring managers and recruitment professionals, who are trained to apply sound judgment and equitable practices at every stage. We believe technology exists to amplify human insight, not replace it. That belief shapes how we build relationships, tell stories, and grow our teams.

At Agility, we strive every day to build a more inclusive work environment and introduce tools that enable it. We strongly encourage applications from all people regardless of race, religion, gender, age, disability status or sexual orientation.

Even if you find yourself not checking all the boxes of our listed requirements but you are excited about this opportunity, we'd love to hear from you anyway. Our Talent Acquisition team will review your application for this role, and other potential role matches open now or in the future.

If, at any stage of the application process, you require accommodation owing to disability or a medical need, please let us know at for us to make appropriate arrangements.

BJAK is Southeast Asia’s largest digital insurance platform, expanding financial access through automation, data, and digital scale. As we grow across markets, we are committed to building a platform that is safe, compliant, and trusted.

We are hiring a Compliance Director – SMF16 to lead regulatory strategy, risk governance, and compliance operations for our UK market entry and expansion alongside the CEO. This role is expected to hold the SMF16 (Compliance Oversight) Senior Management Function once approved, and will act as our primary point of contact with the FCA.

This is a build role: you'll be creating frameworks, policies, and controls from scratch rather than inheriting an existing function.

Why This Role Matters

The Compliance Director – SMF16 will:

  • Design and enforce compliance frameworks that enable safe scaling of digital financial services.

  • Ensure BJAK operates in accordance with UK regulatory standards, especially FCA requirements.

  • Protect consumers through transparent, fair, and ethical practices.

  • Establish BJAK as a trusted partner with regulators, partners, and industry stakeholders.

  • Build compliance capability and culture across the company.

What You Will Do

Regulatory Leadership & Strategy

  • Develop and maintain compliance frameworks aligned with UK regulatory requirements.

  • Lead regulatory readiness for market entry, licensing, and ongoing supervision.

  • Serve as the primary contact with the FCA and relevant UK bodies.

  • Interpret regulatory changes and guide business strategy accordingly.

Risk Governance & Compliance Operations

  • Build policies and controls covering AML, KYC, data privacy, consumer duty, distribution, and claims-related compliance.

  • Conduct risk assessments and implement remediation plans for identified gaps.

  • Establish monitoring, testing, and reporting processes for ongoing compliance.

  • Ensure internal audits, compliance reviews, and control testing are operationalised.

Consumer Protection & Business Integrity

  • Embed fairness, transparency, and responsible selling throughout the organisation.

  • Oversee product compliance, marketing reviews, pricing governance, and distribution oversight.

  • Implement complaint handling frameworks aligned with regulatory standards.

Cross-Functional Support & Training

  • Partner with product, operations, legal, marketing, and commercial teams to ensure compliant execution.

  • Provide guidance on regulatory implications of new products, partnerships, or distribution models.

  • Deliver training to ensure teams understand and execute compliance responsibilities.

You Will Thrive in This Role If You

  • See compliance as a strategic enabler, not a blocker.

  • Operate with high integrity, sound judgment, and strong attention to detail.

  • Communicate clearly and influence leaders using data and logic.

  • Enjoy building frameworks and scaling systems from early-stage to mature environments.

  • Thrive in fast-paced, evolving settings where regulation meets innovation.

What You Bring

  • Deep understanding of UK regulatory frameworks, including FCA rules and consumer duty requirements.

  • Experience in compliance for digital platforms, distribution, or insurance products (preferred).

Bonus (Nice to Have)

  • Previous SMF experience.

Financial Close Leadership

  • Coordinate intercompany eliminations, foreign currency translation, and consolidation entries, and confirm that intercompany balances reconcile between entities.

Account Reconciliation Review

  • Review and approve balance sheet reconciliations for all general ledger accounts.

GAAP and IFRS Compliance

  • Ensure that accounting policies are applied consistently across entities and that differences between U.S. GAAP and IFRS, or between local GAAP and group policy, are identified, documented, and reconciled.
  • Maintain accounting policy documentation and technical memos for significant or unusual transactions, including the accounting for leases (ASC 842 / IFRS 16), business combinations, stock-based compensation, and income taxes.
  • Support preparation of statutory financial statements and local filings for international subsidiaries in coordination with local teams or external advisors.

Internal Controls and Audit

  • Design, document, and test key controls over the close and reconciliation processes.
  • Serve as support point of contact for external auditors during interim reviews and the annual audit, providing timely PBC responses and resolving audit inquiries.
  • Identify control gaps and segregation-of-duties conflicts and recommend remediation to the Assistant Controller.

Process Improvement and Systems

  • Identify opportunities to automate reconciliations, close tasks, and reporting using the ERP, consolidation software, and reconciliation tools including AI.
  • Lead or support system implementations and upgrades that affect the close, such as M&A integrations.
  • Standardize processes across subsidiaries to reduce close duration and improve data quality.

Leadership

jobs.description:
About the Role

We are looking for an Embedded Python Data & Automation Engineer to take ownership of an existing Python environment, maintain production systems, improve automations and data pipelines, and develop internal tools and integrations.

Key Responsibilities

  • System Transition & Knowledge Absorption: Shadow the departing programmer and take ownership of the existing Python codebase.
  • Production Support & Maintenance: Troubleshoot live issues, maintain existing systems, and ensure system stability.
  • Data Pipelines & Automations: Maintain, debug, and improve data pipelines and scheduled automations.
  • API & Integration Ownership: Maintain and extend APIs, third-party integrations, authentication flows, and webhooks.
  • Technical Debt: Identify fragile systems, undocumented dependencies, and technical risks and improve them over time.
  • Documentation: Create and maintain system documentation, workflow diagrams, dependency maps, and operating procedures.
  • Internal Tooling: Build practical automation tools and internal software based on business needs.
  • Engineering Practices: Use Git, pull requests, automated testing, changelogs, and staged deployments.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 3+ years of professional Python experience in a data-focused environment.
  • Experience building or maintaining production data pipelines and automations.
  • Strong experience with APIs, integrations, authentication, and webhooks.
  • Experience working with an existing or legacy codebase.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
  • Familiarity with Git, pull requests, testing, and deployment workflows.
  • Strong written English and technical documentation skills.
  • Ability to work with meaningful overlap with US business hours.

Typical Day

Your day begins with a check on overnight automations and any open production issues. You spend focused blocks working through the current system — reading existing code, running tests, tracing integrations, and filling in documentation gaps. Early in the engagement, a meaningful portion of your time is in handover sessions with the departing programmer. As the transition matures, that time shifts toward new development: building automations, improving pipeline reliability, or scoping a new internal tool with the client. You communicate primarily over Slack and participate in planning sessions and check-ins that align with US business hours. You raise flags early, document as you go, and push changes through staging rather than directly to production.

  • Video Interview Screening
  • Client Interview
  • Offer Stage

    • Skills & Role Requirements

  • Business & Strategic Capabilities

  • Deep understanding of business strategy, operations, and industry trends, with the ability to engage clients in big-picture conversations.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with a structured, first-principles approach to client challenges.
  • Ability to collaborate with clients to uncover their broader organizational goals, and strategically align product and service offerings to drive measurable business outcomes.

  • Client & Program Management

  • Experience managing large-scale, client-facing programs with multiple stakeholders.
  • Strong communication and influence skills, capable of engaging senior executives and translating complex ideas into actionable plans.
  • Ability to lead strategic conversations centered around ROI, adoption, and long-term outcomes.

  • Commercial Acumen

  • Prior experience in consultative selling, customer success, or account management, ideally in SaaS or tech environments.
  • Demonstrated success in managing renewals and driving account expansion.

  • Technical & Analytical Skills

  • Strong grasp of Mindtickle’s product suite and services, enabling effective solution design and value articulation.
  • Comfort working with technical products and translating client needs into technical solutions.

  • Experience in a top-tier management consulting or professional services firm is preferred.
