Any questions can be directed to: position is offered on a temporary basis through approximately June 2028. The role is full-time (37.5 hours per week), eligible for remote work and benefits, and requires frequent travel approximately 2-3 times per month.The application deadline is Monday, November 30, 2026.

Position Purpose:The Clinical Practice Specialist, CSI leads and independently exercises professional judgment in the development, review, validation, and facilitation of content and programming for AACN’s CSI Academy. This faculty position works collaboratively with internal and external experts and stakeholders to develop and deliver innovative and standard-setting programs and services. This position works both independently and with other CSI faculty with considerable latitude and limited direct supervision.

Main Accountabilities:

  • Leads and exercises independent judgment in the planning and delivery of CSI cohorts as national faculty.

    • Supports and facilitates participants’ projects, providing the overarching perspective to ensure projects remain aligned with AACN project goals and objectives, and provides expert guidance and recommendations regarding project direction and priorities.

    • Develops, evaluates, and recommends project schedules and budgets aligned with internal and external resources; coordinates resources to meet project goals, and uses independent judgment to address issues and adjust project plans through completion.

    • Delivers expert-level workshops designed to ensure effective engagement, learning, and application of content.

    • Facilitates Phase 1 meetings and work, organizes and leads cohort sessions, and independently determines appropriate approaches to support participant progress, including consultation and mentoring meetings as needed.

    • Evaluates and selects appropriate technology solutions to support the development and representation of content, products, services, and interactions with the community.

    • Coordinates course materials, tracks attendance and outcomes, and evaluates program information to identify needs, issues, and opportunities for improvement.

    • Completes program reports and enters data as indicated, using information to inform program evaluation and recommendations.

    • Additional duties as assigned.

  • Ensures effective strategies and systems to facilitate the delivery of expert clinical practice knowledge for projects, programs, and services.

    • Working with internal and external stakeholders, develops and maintains a resource network to support a variety of content expert needs.

    • Leads or contributes substantive clinical expertise to the development and editing of curriculum and associated program products.

    • Actively engages in environmental scanning to identify emerging trends, issues, and opportunities important to nurses and the healthcare environment

    • Synthesizes information from environmental scanning and interprets and communicates implications and recommendations to internal and external stakeholders to inform AACN’s work.

    • Provides clinical expertise and strategic input to envision and develop new CSI Academy products, programs, and services, ensuring current nursing practice and emerging issues are integral to the planning and design.

    • Evaluates project needs and determines or recommends appropriate internal and external resource requirements.

    • Acts as a subject matter expert and liaison with project consultants and community groups.

  • Provides leadership in ensuring content quality and integrity for the AACN CSI Academy.

    • Working collaboratively, develops, evaluates, and maintains systems for content quality assessment of new products and review of existing products.

    • Evaluates clinical content for accuracy, context, relevance, and alignment with professional practice and intended outcomes.

    • Leads the identification, evaluation, and prioritization of content, program, and service updates.

    • Evaluates products and services for consistency with national standards and AACN mission, vision, and values; recommends modifications when appropriate.

    • Develops, mentors, and delivers feedback to CSI participants in order to support their professional development and contributions.

  • Proven project management, with emphasis on independent planning, design, launch, evaluation, and continuous improvement of programs.

  • Experienced in fostering collaboration and exercising judgment to guide diverse teams across functional areas.

  • Skilled in leading initiatives, evaluating opportunities, and building partnerships across departments and specialties.

  • Strong leadership and collaboration capabilities within integrated and cross-functional team settings, with the ability to influence outcomes without direct authority.

  • Expert facilitator, recognized for facilitating alignment and teamwork across varied operational and clinical functions.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including strong facilitation skills.

  • Proven ability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives, exercise sound judgment, and drive results that support strategic organizational outcomes.

  • Demonstrated ability to co-create with others to cultivate engagement and develop and evaluate content and services.

  • Demonstrated experience providing mentorship, professional guidance, and constructive feedback to others.

  • Ability to independently evaluate, use and adapt to technology and willingness to develop new skills.

  • Advanced skills in standard office and productivity applications (examples may include: Google Workspace, Microsoft Office Suite, Zoom, and Smartsheet), with the ability to learn and adapt to additional specialized software platforms as needed.

  • Demonstrates emotional intelligence and the ability to navigate complex stakeholder relationships and organizational dynamics.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively convey complex information, facilitate discussions, and communicate with diverse stakeholders.

Education and/or Experience:

  • Master’s Degree in Nursing required; CNS or MHI - MS in HC innovation preferred.

  • Holds unencumbered RN licensure in the United States.

  • Creation of successful new initiatives that meet or exceed organizational objectives

  • 7 years’ healthcare experience with a minimum of 5 years experience facilitating nursing education and/or leadership content to broad audiences.

  • Demonstrated success developing and implementing new initiatives that meet or exceed organizational objectives.

  • Demonstrated experience leading change management initiatives at the unit or organizational level, using independent judgment to develop and implement innovative programs aligned with strategic goals.

  • Experience in progressive or critical care nursing.

Upon request, the company will engage in an interactive process to identify and implement reasonable accommodations.

Supervision. Ability to travel required. Remote.

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for iOS engineers to build the native iOS experience for BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

What Will You Build

  • Build and ship native iOS features for onboarding, accounts, cards, payments, transfers, rewards and AI-assisted user journeys.

  • Make complex financial flows feel clean, fast and simple on mobile.

  • Work with product, design, backend and AI engineers to take ideas from rough concept to production release.

  • Own app quality across performance, crash rate, loading states, edge cases, responsiveness and release stability.

  • Use production feedback, analytics and customer behaviour to improve features after launch.

  • Integrate APIs, authentication, secure data handling and financial workflows with strong attention to reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong native iOS experience using Swift.

  • Experience shipping iOS apps used by real users.

  • Good understanding of SwiftUI, UIKit, async/await and iOS architecture patterns.

  • Strong product sense and care for UX, not just building screens.

  • Able to debug production issues and improve performance, reliability and app quality.

  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and moving fast without lowering the bar.

The Bar

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

  • People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in China. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in China.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.description:
About the Role

Join a data and infrastructure team building a platform that turns information from multiple sources into reliable, current company intelligence. You will own the platform end to end, from ingestion and architecture to production operations, powering downstream products with trusted data.

What You'll Do

  • Design and build a multi-source data platform for concurrent ingestion, event-driven processing, and orchestrated batch workflows.

  • Ingest data from APIs, webhooks, files, and web scraping with rate limits and robust failure handling.

  • Orchestrate scheduled workflows and historical backfills using Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, or comparable tools.

  • Build event-driven systems with messaging or task queues, including retries, dead-letter queues, and controlled replay.

  • Store original payloads in Google Cloud Storage and transform data with dbt into raw, standardized, and curated layers.

  • Implement idempotent upserts, data contracts, validation, pipeline tests, retention policies, and monitoring for freshness and failures.

  • Design and optimize PostgreSQL schemas and loading patterns, and integrate data enrichment and LLM-based structured extraction.

What We're Looking For

  • At least 5 years building and operating production data platforms across multiple sources, with ownership from architecture through deployment and ongoing operations.

  • Production experience with workflow orchestration, including dependencies, retries, and failure recovery. Airflow is preferred; Dagster, Prefect, Temporal, or comparable tools are relevant.

  • Hands-on production experience with dbt and Google Cloud Platform.

  • Strong Python skills, including asynchronous HTTP and concurrent processing with asyncio, aiohttp, HTTPX, or similar tools.

  • Strong SQL and PostgreSQL skills, including data modeling, query optimization, and incremental loading.

  • Experience with event-driven systems, messaging or task queues, asynchronous processing, and recovery from failures.

  • Experience with raw and curated data storage, data contracts, retention, automated validation, pipeline testing, and monitoring.

  • Web scraping, entity resolution, data enrichment, BigQuery, Dataform, and LLM-based extraction experience are useful. Experience building platforms from scratch or working in small, fast-moving teams is also valued.

Compensation & Benefits

Base salary: $120,000 to $160,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is not available.

Location

Remote within the United States. New York-based candidates are welcome, but New York residency is not required.

Compensation Range: $120K - $160K

jobs.title: Regional Field Operations Manager
jobs.excerpt: About QuartermasterQuartermaster is building the world's most comprehensive maritime intelligence platform.
jobs.description:
About Quartermaster

Quartermaster is building the world's most comprehensive maritime intelligence platform. Our SmartMast™ system transforms commercial and civilian vessels into a persistent, distributed sensing network—combining HD video, AI, radar, RF sensing, and AIS to deliver real-time maritime domain awareness at global scale. With 600+ sensors deployed across 25+ countries and more than 400,000 vessels identified outside of AIS, we are setting a new standard for what ocean surveillance and safety can look like.

We are a startup in build mode: small team, high ownership, fast iteration, and meaningful constraints. We ship quickly, learn in production, and optimize for mission impact over process theater.

The Role

As Regional Field Operations Manager, you will own the deployment and performance of SmartMast™ across your region. Once Launch has opened a market and secured vessel partners, you turn those agreements into units that are installed, activated, and reporting, and you keep them reporting. Success is measured in units installed on schedule, uptime across the regional fleet, and the speed and quality of every install and repair.

You will build and run the regional field operation: technicians, installers, logistics, and spares. You will work hand in hand with the regional Head of Launch and report to Quartermaster's Field Operations leadership in the United States.

What You'll Own

  • Deployment: Plan and execute SmartMast™ installations across the region's vessel partners, from vessel survey and scheduling through install, activation, and first data. Hit the deployment targets set with Launch and leadership.

  • Fleet uptime: Keep every installed unit online and reporting. Own preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, repairs, and unit swaps against clear response-time standards.

  • Field team: Recruit, train, and lead regional field technicians and coordinators. Set the bar for install quality, safety, and professionalism aboard vessels.

  • Logistics and inventory: Run in-country hardware flow, including receiving, warehousing, spares, staging, and reverse logistics for failed units, within the import framework Launch establishes.

  • Vendor and installer management: Direct the local installers, fabricators, and port-side vendors that Launch onboards. Schedule their work, audit quality, and escalate or replace underperformers.

  • Vessel and port coordination: Work with fleet operations teams, crews, and port staff to get aboard during short windows, around vessel schedules, port calls, and access rules.

  • Field data and feedback: Track install, uptime, and repair metrics. Feed hardware and install issues back to engineering, and surface field realities to Launch and leadership.

  • Process: Build repeatable install and maintenance procedures, safety practices, and documentation that scale across countries.

What You Need

  • Experience: 6+ years in field operations, field service, or technical deployment, including at least 3 years leading field teams. Maritime, offshore, telecoms, or marine electronics strongly preferred.

  • Deployment track record: Proven delivery of hardware rollouts across multiple sites or countries, on schedule and to quality standards.

  • Hands-on technical depth: Comfort with vessel-installed electronics, including mounting, power, cabling, networking, and RF/antenna work. You can step aboard and troubleshoot alongside your team.

  • Logistics instinct: Inventory and spares planning, customs-ready shipping, and getting parts to a vessel during a short port call.

  • Safety: Working knowledge of shipboard safety practice and port access procedures in the region.

  • Location: Based in the region and ready to travel up to 50% to ports and vessels, sometimes on short notice.

  • Autonomy: Comfortable running an operation with leadership several time zones away.

  • Language: Fluent professional English, plus the primary working languages of the region's ports and crews.

Nice to Have

  • Marine electronics, electrical, or RF certifications, or equivalent qualifications recognized in the region.

  • An existing network of marine installers, shipyards, and port-side vendors in the region.

  • Additional languages that reflect the region's multinational maritime workforce.

  • Experience with remote monitoring, fleet management, or field service software.

  • Experience scaling field operations in a startup or a newly opened market.

Help shape how Rubrik partners with leading service providers to deliver cyber resilience at scale. The New Product Introduction (NPI) & Service Creation Solution Architect is a new function in the MSP Solution Architecture Team. You will design, package and enable new managed service offerings built on Rubrik's data protection, cyber resilience and recovery portfolio, and turn them into repeatable programs that MSPs, MSSPs and cloud providers can adopt at scale.

You own the technical service blueprint from concept through launch. You also support strategic presales into large global MSPs and work hand in hand with Sales, Product and Engineering, Marketing and Competitive Intelligence teams. The role reports to the Global Director, MSP Solution Architects, is highly partner-facing, and requires significant travel.

Why You'll Love This Role:

  • Build something new: This is a founding role in a new function. You will create the offerings, programs and playbooks from the ground up, then see them launched, adopted and sold by real partners.
  • Make a visible difference: The services you design help service providers protect and recover their customers' data when ransomware and cyber attacks strike.
  • Influence and autonomy: You will work directly with senior leaders across Sales, Product, Engineering and Marketing and with executives at leading service providers, with the freedom to take your own ideas from concept to launch.
  • Build with AI every day: Work in an environment where building with Claude and Claude Code is encouraged and expected, and shape how the team uses AI to move faster.

Key Responsibilities:

Service Creation & Partner Workshops

  • Define and prioritize new service offerings (managed backup, DRaaS, cyber recovery, SaaS backup, ransomware readiness) with Product Management and translate roadmaps into service blueprints and scalable reference architectures covering SLAs, tiers, security, compliance and sovereignty.
  • Own and run a repeatable partner service co-creation workshop program, from joint scoping through launch, owning post-workshop outcomes so each partner moves to a defined, launched and sold service, and tracking partner satisfaction and conversion to launched services.
  • Build and maintain a service adoption tracker with analytics on partner adoption, workshop-to-launch conversion and service results, and use it to continuously improve the program with new templates, feedback surveys and facilitation tooling, in partnership with Sales and Product leadership.
  • Enhance existing partner planning tools with standard sizing guidelines, configuration patterns and partner business-case templates (financial, ROI/TCO, pricing) that turn a design into a priced service.

Presales & Partner Engagement

  • Support strategic opportunities that depend on new services: discovery, requirements capture (RPO/RTO, sovereignty, compliance) and high-level solution design.
  • Lead hands-on workshops and demos to validate architectures against partner and customer environments.
  • Maintain a trusted cadence with strategic MSP partners, track commitments to closure, and keep engagement activity visible to leadership.

Enablement, Content & Product-to-Field Bridge

  • Create delivery playbooks, runbooks, service descriptions, onboarding methodologies, training assets and webinars so partner delivery is high-quality and repeatable.
  • Represent MSP readiness in NPI launches and own roadmap visibility for partners and the SA team, ensuring partners and the field are ready to sell and operate new capabilities at launch, and continuously improve the Claude skill that turns the product roadmap into tailored feature adoption recommendations for MSP partner account teams, refining it every release cycle based on partner feedback and adoption results.
  • Own the MSP content strategy and thought leadership (blogs, webinars, newsletter, partner portal, video) and run recurring programs on a dependable cadence with clear KPIs.

AI-Enabled Building

  • AI is central to this role. You must be a builder with excellent hands-on Claude, Claude Code and Cowork experience, and a track record of turning your work into repeatable assets: skills, automations and tools that others on the team use.
  • Build and maintain a library of Claude skills and rapid prototypes for MSP work, such as partner prep, partner collateral, roadmap summaries, and sizing and pricing calculators, connected to enterprise systems and run on a schedule.
  • Make AI output trustworthy and scalable: use grounding and review gates so content is safe for partners, follow AI governance and data-handling rules, and teach the team through live builds.

Required Qualifications:

  • 10+ years as a Solutions Architect, Services Architect or Senior Consultant in data protection, storage or cloud infrastructure vendors, MSPs or integrators.
  • Deep experience designing complex backup, recovery and cyber resilience solutions, with strong virtualization and hyperscaler (AWS, Azure, GCP) background. Rubrik platform depth is expected, or achievable through certification within 90 days.
  • Proven track record creating standardized managed services (SLAs, catalogs, runbooks), with at least one taken from design through launch and adoption, and a solid grasp of backup security and compliance principles.
  • Excellent communication from C-suite to individual contributors, with strong workshop facilitation, whiteboarding and writing skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Background as a solutions architect at an MSP or MSSP, or at a data protection and cyber resilience vendor that serves them, with deep knowledge of cyber resilience service offerings.
  • Has been on the other side of the table: a technical architecture role at a service provider, with end-to-end experience of how services are defined, built, operated and managed. Candidates with this full experience are strongly preferred.
  • Hands-on infrastructure operations (storage, networking, identity), ITSM and SIEM/SOAR familiarity, and ransomware recovery and cyber-resilient architecture experience.
  • Relevant certifications: data protection vendor, cloud architect, security (CISSP, CISM, CCSK).

Key Competencies:

  • Service and architecture mindset: Designs repeatable, catalog-ready offerings with clear SLAs, and measures success by whether partners launch and sell them.
  • Cross-functional influence and partner trust: Works hand in hand with Sales, Product and Engineering, Marketing and Competitive teams, and earns partners' trust as an extension of their team.
  • Self-starter and builder: Brings fresh perspectives and new ideas and drives them from conception to execution without waiting for direction. Builds tools, skills and automations that make work repeatable, and shares them with the team.
  • Organized, relentless execution: Plans the work, juggles multiple workstreams, and drives each one to completion with disciplined follow-through and a dependable cadence. Closes every loop.
  • Communication at every level: Communicates clearly and credibly from the C-suite to individual contributors, with a bias for action and the hustle to get things done.

Travel Expectations:

  • Travel is expected to be high, including regular partner workshops, customer meetings and company events.

Baue unsere Transfer-Pricing-Strukturen für die nächste Wachstumsphase auf.

Black Semiconductor wächst international und baut seine Finance-Organisation für die nächste Wachstumsphase weiter aus. Dabei schaffen wir heute die Tax- und Transfer-Pricing-Strukturen, die wir für unsere weitere internationale Entwicklung benötigen.

Warum diese Rolle?

Transfer Pricing mit Gestaltungsspielraum: Du übernimmst Verantwortung für unsere Transfer-Pricing-Strukturen und entwickelst diese im Zuge unserer internationalen Expansion weiter.

Aufbau statt Verwaltung: Du gestaltest Strukturen, Prozesse und Standards aktiv mit und schaffst die Grundlage für ein skalierbares internationales Tax-Setup.

Scale-up mit anspruchsvollen Tax-Themen: Du verbindest die Dynamik eines wachsenden Unternehmens mit internationalem Steuerrecht, Transfer Pricing und der Möglichkeit, Strukturen aktiv mitzugestalten.

Über uns

Wir verstehen die Halbleiterindustrie als ein Universum voller Möglichkeiten. Wir erkennen Chancen und sehen das transformative Potenzial, das unsere Graphen-Lösungen für die Neugestaltung der Branche mit sich bringen.

Wir laden Dich ein, diesen Wandel gemeinsam mit uns voranzutreiben, indem wir kluge Köpfe mit einer gemeinsamen Vision zusammenbringen. Diese Vision ist es, zu zeigen, dass grundlegende Veränderungen möglich sind. Mit Deinem Wissen und Deinen Fähigkeiten kannst Du beweisen, dass Dinge anders – und besser – gemacht werden können.

Gemeinsam haben wir die Kraft, das Paradigma zu verändern, wie die Welt vernetzt ist.

Unsere Technology

Die steigenden Anforderungen der Halbleiterindustrie an leistungsfähigere Chips mit höherer Bandbreite und geringerem Energieverbrauch werden durch unsere Technologie adressiert. Wir ermöglichen die Verbindung von Chips mit Hochdurchsatz-Computernetzwerken bei minimaler Latenz.

Der entscheidende Faktor ist die Nutzung der einzigartigen physikalischen Eigenschaften von Graphen, um elektronische Datenverarbeitung mit photonischer Kommunikation zu vereinen. Dadurch können unzählige Chips miteinander interagieren, als wären sie ein einziges System. Unsere Graphen-Photonik-Innovation hebt Rechenleistung und Effizienz auf ein neues Niveau.

Kurz gesagt: Wir vernetzen Chips zu leistungsstarken, energieeffizienten Systemen und überwinden mit unserer Graphen-Technologie die bisherigen Grenzen der Konnektivität in der Halbleiterindustrie.

Deine Aufgaben

Transfer Pricing: Du verantwortest zentrale Transfer-Pricing-Themen und entwickelst unsere Strukturen und Dokumentation im Zuge unserer internationalen Expansion weiter.

Tax Compliance: Du stellst die steuerliche Compliance unserer internationalen Unternehmensgruppe sicher und koordinierst die relevanten Themen mit externen Beratern und Behörden.

Internationaler Strukturaufbau: Du begleitest den Aufbau unserer internationalen Gesellschaften und gestaltest die dafür notwendigen steuerlichen und Intercompany-Strukturen mit.

Zusammenarbeit & Ownership: Du arbeitest eng mit Finance Leadership, CFO, Geschäftsführung und relevanten externen Partnern zusammen und bringst Deine Expertise dort ein, wo fachliche Tiefe und Hands-on-Umsetzung gefragt sind.

Das bringst Du mit

  • Fundierte Erfahrung im Transfer Pricing

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse der internationalen Tax Compliance

  • Erfahrung mit internationalen Gesellschaftsstrukturen und deren steuerlichen Anforderungen

  • Ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Freude daran, Strukturen selbstständig aufzubauen

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Was wir Dir bieten

Entwicklung: Mit dem Wachstum von Black Semiconductor kann auch Dein Verantwortungsbereich wachsen – perspektivisch bis hin zur Verantwortung für Group Reporting & Consolidation und zum Aufbau eines Teams.

Beteiligung: Du erhältst virtuelle Aktienoptionen und partizipierst damit am langfristigen Erfolg unseres Unternehmens.

Flexibilität: Wir arbeiten hybrid mit einer Anwesenheit von ca. einem Tag pro Woche in Aachen.

Gesundheit & Zukunft: Deine Gesundheit und Zukunft sind uns wichtig. Wir bieten Dir ein umfassendes Leistungspaket mit Versicherungs-, Vorsorge- und weiteren Benefits.

Zukunftsbranche: Arbeite an einer Technologie, die die nächste Generation der Halbleiter-Konnektivität mitgestalten soll.

Unsere Kultur

Menschen vor Prozessen. Bei Black Semiconductor ist Flexibilität der Schlüssel - wir sorgen dafür, dass sich die Arbeit dem Leben anpasst und nicht umgekehrt. Wir setzen uns für die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben ein, damit Karrieren sinnvoll und bereichernd sind. Unsere Prozesse sind menschenzentriert, damit Du Dich auf das Wesentliche konzentrieren kannst.

Lass uns gemeinsam wachsen. Dein Potenzial ist unsere Priorität. Wir bieten Dir die nötige Autonomie, um etwas zu bewirken, und fördern Dein Wachstum durch eine Kultur des kontinuierlichen Lernens. Wir investieren in Deine berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung.

Wir leben Offenheit. Zusammenarbeit und Inklusion sind die Eckpfeiler unserer Kultur. Wir praktizieren Offenheit und fördern Vertrauen und Respekt. Individualität ist unsere kollektive Stärke, die uns zu Innovationen antreibt und uns voranbringt.

Wir verbinden Chips – und Menschen. Wir ermutigen qualifizierte Personen mit beliebigem Hintergrund, sich zu bewerben. Wir fördern ein integratives und unterstützendes Arbeitsumfeld, das Zusammenarbeit, Innovation und Wachstum schätzt. Schließ Dich unserem Team an und werde Teil eines Unternehmens, das in der Branche etwas bewirken will.

jobs.description:
Mixlab is the first modern pet pharmacy that focuses on creating high-quality, custom medications and delightful experiences for pets, their parents and veterinarians. By putting service at the heart of everything we do, we're able to provide the best personalized care for our furry friends, as well as those who care for them. Mixlab is proud to be a PCAB-accredited compounding pet pharmacy. Check us out on Instagram or see our 5 star reviews on Google, Yelp and Facebook!

About the role

Mixlab, the fast-growing veterinary compounding pharmacy, is hiring an Overnight Care Pharmacist to keep our service running while most of the country sleeps. We are looking for someone who is obsessed with quality, passionate about personalized care for pets and their people, and driven to #MakeItHappen for our furry (and scaly!) friends no matter what.

This is a remote, overnight role. You will answer after-hours calls from veterinarians and pet parents live, then work through our eScript and Kustomer queues so the Care team starts every morning with a fresh slate. You will help make Mixlab a 100% dependable resource for customers and veterinarians alike, at any hour.

Location and Schedule:

  • This is a fully remote role. You must have a quiet, private workspace and reliable high-speed internet.
  • Shifts run Monday through Friday nights, 8:00 PM to 4:30 AM ET and 5:00PM PT TO 1:30AM PT, including a 30-minute meal break.
  • Your first [2 to 3] weeks of training are on day shift with the Care team before you move to the overnight schedule.
  • Occasional schedule adjustments may be requested to cover peak volume or staff absences.
  • Flexibility to work holidays on a rotating basis is required.

What you'll do

After-hours calls

  • Be the live voice of Mixlab after hours:
  • Answer every call routed to the after-hours line from veterinarians, practice staff, and pet parents
  • Take new prescriptions by phone and enter orders into our proprietary workflow system with extreme attention to detail
  • Triage clinical urgency, including adverse reactions, dosing questions, missed doses, and medication errors, and escalate per protocol
  • Counsel clients on medications, administration, and instructions
  • Document every interaction in Kustomer and flag items that need day-team follow-up
  • Explain Mixlab's policies, procedures, and values, and help prospective customers understand why vets and pet parents choose Mixlab
  • Process payment information and schedule deliveries based on Mixlab's delivery schedule and customer preference

Overnight queue work

  • Work through the eScript and Kustomer queues so the Care team starts each morning fresh:
    • Complete pharmacist review on eScripts received after hours so clean orders release to the lab at open
    • Work open Kustomer conversations oldest first, resolving or advancing prescriber and client requests within service level targets
    • Contact veterinary practices by email or message when additional information, clarification, or authorization is needed
  • Flag orders that need lab, supply chain, or day-team action
  • Leave an end-of-shift handoff note for the morning Care lead covering escalations, pending DVM callbacks, and open items

Across the shift

  • Serve as the overnight point of contact for urgent pharmacy questions, escalating to the on-call lead when needed
  • Work closely with lab, supply chain, logistics, and Care teams so orders are accurately scheduled and delivered on time
  • Work independently with minimal real-time supervision, using SOPs and escalation protocols
  • Provide subject matter expertise to internal teams on processing, compounding, clinical solutions, and workflows
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and uphold Mixlab values
  • Communicate effectively with your supervisor and own corrective action from 1:1 feedback

About you

Required:

  • Active pharmacist license in at least one U.S. state, in good standing with all State Boards of Pharmacy (Preference given to CA or NY license)
  • Willingness to obtain additional state licenses within [6] months of hire, as needed for Care coverage
  • Ability to work Monday through Friday overnight shifts, 8:00 PM to 4:30 AM ET, from a quiet, private remote workspace
  • Impeccable attention to detail and very high standards for accuracy and quality
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to stay calm, empathetic, and supportive in difficult conversations
  • Ability to learn and adapt quickly to changing software and platforms
  • Flexibility to work holidays and occasional schedule changes

Preferred:

  • Additional state licenses, especially NY, FL, TX, WI, and CA
  • 2+ years of veterinary compounding experience
  • Overnight, telepharmacy, or remote pharmacist experience
  • Experience in a customer-facing pharmacy role (call center, telepharmacy, or retail)

Who you are

  • Collaborative and eager to work in a team-oriented, fast-paced, startup environment
  • Self-directed, resourceful, and comfortable owning the shift without real-time oversight
  • All-hands-on-deck attitude; you remain calm and excel under pressure
  • Comfortable switching between live calls and focused queue work
  • You LOVE PETS and their people!

What we offer

  • 100% employer-paid health, dental and vision insurance for our employees, effective on the first of the month following your start date
  • Paid time off for vacation, holidays and sick time, with the ability to accrue more vacation time with increased tenure
  • Competitive starting wages with the opportunity for rapid career growth, promotion, and wage increases
  • Company Stock Options
  • Pre-tax commuter benefits, dependent care, HSA and FSA
  • Employer-paid short and long-term disability leave, parental leave, and life insurance
  • 401k with $300/year match
  • Referral bonus payouts of up to $1,000 for a successful referral
  • Human and pet wellness benefits, including $650/year allowance for routine pet care through Wagmo
  • Discounts on many items through Perkspot

jobs.excerpt: About the companyiSpeedToLead is the #1 lead marketplace in the US for real estate investors.
jobs.description:
About the company

iSpeedToLead is the #1 lead marketplace in the US for real estate investors.

Investors, wholesalers and agents buy phone-verified seller leads like products in an online store.

For us, growth means paying buyers who buy again. It does not mean clicks or sign-ups.

Who we're looking for

An operator who ships, not a consultant who recommends.

Someone who sees a problem on Monday and has a fix live by Wednesday.

Bold. You’d rather launch, measure and kill something than wait for permission.

Self-driven. Nobody will manage your to-do list or approve your copy.

You write from the customer’s pain, not from our feature list.

You pivot fast. When the data says something isn’t working, you change course within days, not weeks.

Who you'll market to

  • Investors burning cash on cold calling, mailers and lists that don’t convert.
  • Wholesalers with empty pipelines and no predictable deal flow.
  • Agents chasing leads that turn out to be junk.

If you can’t make a wholesaler feel that pain in one headline, this isn’t your role.

What you'll be doing

  • Holiday campaigns, starting immediately: Black Friday, Cyber Monday and a year-end / “start Q1 with deals” push.
  • Each campaign gets an offer, ads, landing page, email and SMS. Each one has a cash goal and a written readout afterward.
  • Retargeting across Google and Meta, segmented by intent:

– Site visitors who didn’t sign up

– Sign-ups who haven’t bought

  • First-time buyers who haven’t bought again

– Lapsed buyers

  • Each segment gets its own message, offer and frequency.
  • Google (Search, PMax, YouTube) and Meta budgets. Cut what doesn’t pay back. Scale what does.
  • Pain-point-led creative and copy across ads, landing pages, email and SMS.
  • Weekly scorecard: paying buyers by source, CAC, payback and repeat-buyer rate.
  • Tracking fixes with our data team: UTMs, Conversions API, offline conversions.
  • Direction for the in-house marketing team (paid, social, email, content).

How you'll use AI

We expect you to use AI daily. We care how you use it, not whether.

Use it to move faster: customer research, competitor teardowns, data analysis, creative variants for testing, reporting.

Do not use it to flood channels with generic, interchangeable copy. We’ll spot it, and so will our buyers.

AI gives you the volume. Your judgment, specificity and voice decide what ships.

How you'll work

You have authority to launch campaigns, write copy and move budget within agreed limits.

No copy approval cycle. You own the result.

Guardrails only: a monthly spend cap, CAC limits and TCPA / CAN-SPAM compliance.

Weekly Slack update: what you killed, what you pivoted and why.

First 30 days

Week 1: Black Friday / Cyber Monday campaign live, with retargeting audiences built.

Week 2: Tracking audit with gaps listed, and holiday results readout.

Week 4: Year-end campaign live, segmented retargeting running, and a channel-by-channel readout comparing spend with the cash it returned.

What makes you a strong fit

5+ years in performance or growth marketing, with ownership of paid budgets across Google and Meta.

Hands-on experience building segmented retargeting and lifecycle campaigns.

A track record of pivoting a campaign or channel based on data, with results to show for it.

Proof you’ve written direct-response copy that sold to a US audience.

Strong measurement skills: GA4, Conversions API, UTMs, offline conversions.

Fluent English and the ability to write natural, persuasive copy for US real estate investors.

Availability for at least 4–5 hours of overlap with US Central business hours.

Bonus if you have

Real estate investing, proptech or lead generation experience.

SMS marketing with TCPA compliance (opt-in, quiet hours).

Marketplace or repeat-purchase small-business products.

When this role may be a poor fit

You need approval before you ship.

You measure success by clicks, impressions or sign-ups.

You write polite, feature-led copy.

You’ve only managed agencies or one channel.

Engagement details

Contract: Hourly, roughly 25–40 hours per week, for 60–90 days with possible extension.

This role starts as a fractional engagement with the potential to transition to a full-time role.

Start: As soon as possible.

Remote. Communication runs through Slack.

An NDA is required before account access.

How to apply

Skip the generic proposal and answer these four things:

Tell us about a campaign you pivoted mid-flight: what the data showed, what you changed and what it returned in cash.

Write one Black Friday retargeting ad for a wholesaler who signed up but never bought. Give us the headline and the first line of body copy.

Describe how AI fits into your weekly workflow, and one place you deliberately don’t use it.

Look at our website. Name the first thing you’d change and why.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

The Alliance for Decision Education (the Alliance) is a national nonprofit and field builder with the mission of improving lives by empowering K-12 students with essential skills and dispositions for making better decisions. Founded in 2014 and backed by experts in decision sciences, business, and education—including several Nobel laureates—the Alliance believes that better decisions lead to better lives and a better society.

As a field builder, the Alliance partners with teachers, academic and business leaders, families, and community members to raise awareness and lead the growing call to have Decision Education taught in schools across the country.

The Alliance is committed to an inclusive, supportive, and collaborative culture. Our diverse team comprises educators, researchers, subject matter experts, and other professionals dedicated to our mission. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

What We Offer

The Alliance offers a comprehensive total rewards package, inclusive of competitive compensation.

Annual Salary:

  • $140,000 - 160,000 per year, commensurate with experience and qualifications*

Benefits:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance (100% employer-paid)
  • Basic life insurance and AD&D (100% employer-paid)
  • Short-term disability insurance (100% employer-paid)
  • Long-term disability insurance (100% employer-paid)
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • 401(k) retirement plan with up to a 5% employer match (100% vested)
  • Flexible Spending Accounts (healthcare and dependent care)
  • Up to 20 days of Paid Time Off per calendar year (prorated the first year based on hire date)
  • Unlimited paid sick time
  • Hybrid work schedule
  • Paid lunch stipend while working on-site

*Salary range is a good-faith estimate based on external benchmarking, internal equity, and industry standards and may vary based on qualifications and experience. Benefits are subject to change at the organization’s discretion.

JOB OVERVIEW

The Director of State and District Policy is a senior role responsible for advancing the Alliance’s state and national policy agenda through state and district engagement, policy-aligned outreach, and coalition and stakeholder activities that advance Decision Education. This position focuses on building awareness and scaling Decision Education implementation through network expansion, policy development, relationship-building, and communication with policymakers, external partners, and internal teams.

This role will report to the Director of Public Policy within the Public Policy Department.

LOCATION AND SCHEDULE

This full-time role requires an 8-hour workday and a 40-hour workweek. It is an exempt position under the FLSA and is not eligible for overtime pay.

This position is open to local and remote candidates. Local employees follow the Alliance hybrid schedule, working onsite at our Bala Cynwyd, PA, headquarters every Tuesday and Wednesday and remotely on Monday, Thursday, and Friday. Fully remote employees are expected to maintain a productive home-based workspace and stay engaged with the team during Eastern Time business hours. Leadership-level remote employees are expected to be onsite once every month on both designated in-office days. The role requires 15-30 percent travel for state and district leadership engagements, national and regional conferences, and internal and all-staff meetings at organization headquarters.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

State and District Engagement

  • Lead state and district engagement efforts to advance the adoption and implementation of Decision Education in K–12 schools nationwide.
  • Build and maintain strategic relationships with superintendents, curriculum directors, state education officials, and other education leaders to expand implementation opportunities and build a pipeline of state and district leaders.
  • Collaborate with the Education team to design and pilot multiple pathways for integrating Decision Education into classroom instruction across subject areas, including mathematics, career and technical education (CTE), college and career exploration, social studies, and English language arts.
  • Develop and execute state and district engagement strategies, including a ladder of engagement that supports education systems at varying levels of readiness for implementation and scale.
  • Co-design state and district policies to codify Decision Education in K-12 systems and collaborate with the Deputy Director of Public Policy, Legislative Engagement to ensure policies are adopted through necessary state and district channels.
  • Represent the Alliance at state, regional, and national convenings of education system leaders, building awareness of and interest in the Alliance and classroom implementation of Decision Education.
  • Establish and apply criteria for prioritizing state and district engagement based on implementation readiness, existing relationships, demonstrated interest, and alignment with current education policies.
  • Identify opportunities to align Decision Education with state and district priorities, curriculum frameworks, and existing educational initiatives.
  • Engage current and past Policymaker Fellows in the design and implementation of legislation, regulations, and pilot programs in collaboration with the Senior Manager, Public Policy.

Strategic Planning and Management

  • Build state and district policy and pilot implementation plans with the Director of Public Policy, Education team staff, and national and regional partners.
  • Support the development and monitoring of department-level Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) related to state and district policy development and adoption.
  • Collaborate with the Communications team, the Director of Public Policy, and other teams to design research briefings and public-facing toolkits that shape the national narrative around the importance of Decision Education in K-12 education policy.
  • Support senior‑level relationship management with key strategic policy leaders, including preparing for, aligning, and following up on high‑value engagements.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure public policy activities are aligned, supported, and communicated effectively.
  • Represent the Alliance at events, conferences, and in key coalitions and coordinated advocacy campaigns.

These responsibilities may change or expand over time, consistent with the organization’s needs and initiatives.

JOB QUALIFICATIONS

Minimum Requirements

  • 10+ years of progressive experience leading education policy, public policy formulation, and state and district education initiatives.
  • Deep expertise in state and district education processes and governance, standards-aligned education, and educator professional development.
  • Experience contributing to strategic planning and organizational alignment.
  • Experience managing complex cross-sector initiatives, education policy campaigns, and district- and state-wide initiatives.
  • Strong project management skills, including experience tracking goals and metrics.
  • Ability to represent the Alliance at conferences, executive-level meetings, and national events.
  • Experience using a CRM system.
  • Excellent communication, judgment, and organizational skills.

Preferred Requirements

  • Experience in a national nonprofit or mission‑driven organization.
  • Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships with policymakers, district staff, and education leaders.
  • Experience navigating complex education policy initiatives involving multiple stakeholders.
  • Interest in decision science, behavioral economics, psychology, cognitive science, or related fields.

ATTRIBUTES WE VALUE

  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and relationship‑building skills
  • Strong analytical thinking, problem‑solving ability, and sound judgment
  • Effective leadership skills with the ability to guide, mentor, and collaborate across teams
  • Respectful, collegial, and highly collaborative working style
  • Intellectually humble, open‑minded, innovative, strategic, and adaptable
  • Growth‑minded, intellectually curious, and committed to continuous learning
  • Highly organized, diligent, reliable, professional, and efficient
  • Demonstrated initiative, independence, and the ability to work productively with minimal oversight
  • Strong time‑management skills and the ability to meet deadlines in a fast‑paced environment
  • Passionate about the mission and motivated to contribute to organizational success
  • Detail‑oriented with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively
  • Reflects the Alliance’s core values and standards:
    • Humanism: valuing others as human beings
    • Rationality: thinking and skills to help answer “What is true?” and “What to do?”
    • Education: growth mindset; dedication to developing knowledge and skills
    • Conscientiousness: diligent work ethic; professionalism; high‑quality work
    • Initiative: owners’ and founders’ mentality; leadership skills
    • Mission Alignment: dedication to the organization’s mission and goals

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Employment is contingent upon completing Form I‑9 and verifying authorization to work in the United States, as required by federal law.
  • Successful completion of the pre‑employment screening process.
  • Compliance with all organizational policies and procedures.
  • Ability to understand and demonstrate safe work practices to ensure a safe work environment.
  • Complete special projects and other duties as assigned.

Physical and Environmental Demands

  • Primarily desk‑based work involving sitting at a workstation
  • Occasional walking, standing, or lifting/carrying up to 10 lbs
  • Frequent hand and finger dexterity for typing, writing, and handling objects
  • Ability to perform essential job functions with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • Ability to travel 15–30 percent, including overnight travel, for state and district engagements, conferences, and headquarters meetings, with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • The Alliance is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions, including the use of assistive technologies

This role is based in the United States. Applicants must have authorization to work in the U.S. and must not require current or future visa sponsorship.

jobs.description:
Übernimm Verantwortung für unser General Ledger und gestalte unsere Finance-Strukturen mit.

Black Semiconductor wächst international und baut seine Finance-Organisation für die nächste Wachstumsphase weiter aus. In dieser Rolle übernimmst Du im Team Verantwortung für unser General Ledger und den Closing-Prozess und sorgst gleichzeitig dafür, dass unsere Accounting-Prozesse mit unserem Wachstum Schritt halten.

Dabei geht es nicht nur darum, bestehende Prozesse zuverlässig auszuführen. Du bringst Deine Erfahrung ein, entwickelst Strukturen weiter und gestaltest gemeinsam mit unserem Finance-Team den Aufbau unserer deutschen und niederländischen Gesellschaften mit.

Warum diese Rolle?

Ownership für General Ledger & Closing: Du übernimmst gemeinsam mit dem Team Verantwortung für die Hauptbuchhaltung sowie Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüsse und bist eine wichtige Säule für die Qualität unseres Accountings.

Aufbau statt Verwaltung: Du arbeitest nicht nur mit bestehenden Strukturen, sondern entwickelst Accounting- und Closing-Prozesse aktiv weiter und schaffst Strukturen, die mit unserem Wachstum skalieren.

Hoher Gestaltungsspielraum: Du kannst Deine Erfahrung einbringen, Prozesse hinterfragen und gemeinsam mit dem Finance-Team Standards und Strukturen weiterentwickeln.

Internationale Perspektive: Du arbeitest in einem internationalen Umfeld und gestaltest die Weiterentwicklung unserer Finance-Strukturen im Zuge unseres Wachstums mit.

Hands-on & abwechslungsreich: Du bist nah am operativen Geschäft und kannst Deine fachliche Expertise dort einbringen, wo sie gebraucht wird.

Entwicklungsperspektive: Mit unserem Wachstum können auch Deine Verantwortlichkeiten wachsen – perspektivisch mit weiteren Aufgaben rund um internationale Gesellschaften und gruppenweite Finance-Strukturen.

Scale-up mit Corporate-Anspruch: Du verbindest die Dynamik eines wachsenden Unternehmens mit anspruchsvollen Finance-Themen und der Möglichkeit, Strukturen aktiv mitzugestalten.

Über uns

Wir verstehen die Halbleiterindustrie als ein Universum voller Möglichkeiten. Wir erkennen Chancen und sehen das transformative Potenzial, das unsere Graphen-Lösungen für die Neugestaltung der Branche mit sich bringen.

Wir laden Dich ein, diesen Wandel gemeinsam mit uns voranzutreiben, indem wir kluge Köpfe mit einer gemeinsamen Vision zusammenbringen. Diese Vision ist es, zu zeigen, dass grundlegende Veränderungen möglich sind. Mit Deinem Wissen und Deinen Fähigkeiten kannst Du beweisen, dass Dinge anders – und besser – gemacht werden können.

Gemeinsam haben wir die Kraft, das Paradigma zu verändern, wie die Welt vernetzt ist.

Unsere Technology

Die steigenden Anforderungen der Halbleiterindustrie an leistungsfähigere Chips mit höherer Bandbreite und geringerem Energieverbrauch werden durch unsere Technologie adressiert. Wir ermöglichen die Verbindung von Chips mit Hochdurchsatz-Computernetzwerken bei minimaler Latenz.

Der entscheidende Faktor ist die Nutzung der einzigartigen physikalischen Eigenschaften von Graphen, um elektronische Datenverarbeitung mit photonischer Kommunikation zu vereinen. Dadurch können unzählige Chips miteinander interagieren, als wären sie ein einziges System. Unsere Graphen-Photonik-Innovation hebt Rechenleistung und Effizienz auf ein neues Niveau.

Kurz gesagt: Wir vernetzen Chips zu leistungsstarken, energieeffizienten Systemen und überwinden mit unserer Graphen-Technologie die bisherigen Grenzen der Konnektivität in der Halbleiterindustrie.

Deine Aufgaben

Verantwortung für unser General Ledger: Du übernimmst gemeinsam mit dem Team die Hauptbuchhaltung und stellst eine zuverlässige und qualitativ hochwertige Finanzbuchhaltung sicher.

Closing & Abschlüsse: Du verantwortest die Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüsse und sorgst für einen strukturierten und effizienten Closing-Prozess.

Operative Accounting-Exzellenz: Du übernimmst operative Accounting-Aufgaben, führst Kontenabstimmungen durch und stellst eine hohe Qualität unserer Finanzdaten sicher.

Prozesse weiterentwickeln: Du hinterfragst bestehende Accounting-Prozesse, entwickelst sie weiter und schaffst gemeinsam mit dem Finance-Team effiziente und skalierbare Strukturen.

Das bringst Du mit

  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im General Ledger Accounting, in der Finanzbuchhaltung oder im Closing

  • Fundierte Erfahrung in der Erstellung von Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse der deutschen Rechnungslegung und relevanter HGB-Anforderungen

  • Erfahrung in der operativen Buchhaltung sowie Freude daran, Verantwortung für das Tagesgeschäft zu übernehmen

  • Ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität und Verantwortungsbewusstsein

  • Freude daran, bestehende Prozesse weiterzuentwickeln und Strukturen in einem wachsenden Unternehmen aktiv mitzugestalten

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Was wir Dir bieten

Entwicklung: Mit dem Wachstum von Black Semiconductor kann auch Dein Verantwortungsbereich wachsen – perspektivisch mit zusätzlichen Verantwortlichkeiten für unsere europäischen Tochtergesellschaften und der Möglichkeit, den Aufbau unserer globalen Finance-Organisation aktiv mitzugestalten.

Beteiligung: Du erhältst virtuelle Aktienoptionen und partizipierst damit am langfristigen Erfolg unseres Unternehmens.

Flexibilität: Wir arbeiten hybrid mit einer Anwesenheit von ca. einem Tag pro Woche in Aachen.

Gesundheit & Zukunft: Deine Gesundheit und Zukunft sind uns wichtig. Wir bieten Dir ein umfassendes Leistungspaket mit Versicherungs-, Vorsorge- und weiteren Benefits.

Zukunftsbranche: Arbeite an einer Technologie, die die nächste Generation der Halbleiter-Konnektivität mitgestalten soll.

Unsere Kultur

Menschen vor Prozessen. Bei Black Semiconductor ist Flexibilität der Schlüssel - wir sorgen dafür, dass sich die Arbeit dem Leben anpasst und nicht umgekehrt. Wir setzen uns für die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben ein, damit Karrieren sinnvoll und bereichernd sind. Unsere Prozesse sind menschenzentriert, damit Du Dich auf das Wesentliche konzentrieren kannst.

Lass uns gemeinsam wachsen. Dein Potenzial ist unsere Priorität. Wir bieten Dir die nötige Autonomie, um etwas zu bewirken, und fördern Dein Wachstum durch eine Kultur des kontinuierlichen Lernens. Wir investieren in Deine berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung.

Wir leben Offenheit. Zusammenarbeit und Inklusion sind die Eckpfeiler unserer Kultur. Wir praktizieren Offenheit und fördern Vertrauen und Respekt. Individualität ist unsere kollektive Stärke, die uns zu Innovationen antreibt und uns voranbringt.

Wir verbinden Chips – und Menschen. Wir ermutigen qualifizierte Personen mit beliebigem Hintergrund, sich zu bewerben. Wir fördern ein integratives und unterstützendes Arbeitsumfeld, das Zusammenarbeit, Innovation und Wachstum schätzt. Schließ Dich unserem Team an und werde Teil eines Unternehmens, das in der Branche etwas bewirken will.

This role combines analytical expertise, operational excellence, customer focus, and emerging technologies. In addition to core data responsibilities, you will leverage artificial intelligence (AI), automation tools, and process improvement techniques to enhance efficiency, reduce manual effort, and continuously improve data quality and customer outcomes.

Success in this role requires curiosity, critical thinking, attention to detail, and a commitment to continuous improvement. You will combine human expertise with AI-enabled tools to deliver trusted, high-quality data that helps customers make better decisions.

AI, Automation & Innovation

Why Merit?

At Merit Medical, our mission is to create innovative medical devices that improve lives. Our goal is to hire and develop people who want to build something special through hard work, team effort, and commitment. Together, we are making a difference in the lives of patients around the world.

SUMMARY OF DUTIES

We are looking for a commercially driven and strategically minded leader who can leverage their business acumen, market expertise and leadership skills to drive sustainable revenue growth across Germany and Switzerland through Strategic Accounts, GPOs, procurement organisations, healthcare systems and key customer partnerships.

This role represents a critical leadership position within the EMEA Strategic Account organisation and requires strong business, commercial and financial acumen, exceptional stakeholder management skills and the ability to influence without direct authority across a matrix organisation.

The role requires a strong understanding of the German and Swiss hospital, procurement and reimbursement environments, including purchasing consolidation, hospital reform, digital procurement, outpatient care and supply-chain requirements.

The successful candidate will collaborate closely with Country Leadership, Regional Sales Managers, Pricing, Tenders, Finance, Commercial Analytics, Marketing and EMEA Commercial Strategy functions to ensure that Merit Medical continues to strengthen its position within the evolving German and Swiss healthcare systems.

Strategic Leadership and Market Development

  • Develop and execute a multi-year Strategic Account strategy for Germany and Switzerland, aligning market priorities with EMEA Commercial Strategy and delivering sustainable revenue, margin and market share growth.
  • Influence Country Leadership, including the Country RVP, Regional Business Managers and EMEA stakeholders, to align commercial priorities and organisational resources around the most strategically important customers, products and opportunities.
  • Prioritise strategically important customer segments, including purchasing organisations, private hospital groups, university hospitals, maximum-care providers, hospital networks and other top-tier accounts.
  • Monitor healthcare-system evolution, procurement consolidation, reimbursement trends, policy changes, competitor activity and customer restructuring to anticipate risks and inform commercial strategy.
  • Translate EMEA strategy into relevant local initiatives for Germany and Switzerland, while contributing market insight and best practice back into the EMEA Strategic Account organisation.
  • Contribute to the evolution of the EMEA Strategic Account operating model, supporting future capability, resourcing and market-expansion initiatives.

Customer and Executive Engagement

  • Develop, maintain and expand senior executive relationships with strategic customers, including GPO leadership, procurement executives, CPOs, CFOs, hospital management, private healthcare executives and other healthcare-system decision makers.
  • Act as Merit Medical executive representative for strategic customers, leading complex commercial discussions, strategic reviews, negotiations and long-term partnership development.
  • Influence customer strategy by aligning Merit’s value proposition, portfolio and commercial solutions with customer objectives and wider healthcare-system priorities.
  • Position Merit as a value-creating partner in areas including supply continuity, portfolio optimisation, process efficiency, cost management, clinical value and sustainable customer outcomes.
  • Represent Merit at industry events, customer leadership forums, procurement meetings, strategic supplier reviews and relevant stakeholder engagements.
  • Lead complex strategic negotiations that consider price, volume, margin, contracts, rebates, administration fees, logistics, reimbursement and long-term customer commitments.

Healthcare Policy

  • Maintain a strong understanding of the German and Swiss hospital landscapes, including ownership models, purchasing organisations, hospital networks, relevant procurement structures and care-delivery changes.
  • Assess how German hospital reform, service groups, DRG and hybrid-DRG developments, Swiss reimbursement arrangements, TARDOC and outpatient-care trends may affect customer decisions, account strategies and commercial models.
  • Identify risks and opportunities created by the movement of appropriate procedures from inpatient to outpatient settings and translate these developments into customer, portfolio, pricing and account strategies.
  • Work with relevant Market Access, Finance, Marketing and Commercial Strategy stakeholders to translate reimbursement and policy developments into actionable commercial recommendations.

Team Leadership and Cross-Functional Influence

  • Allocate Strategic Account resources according to revenue potential, margin risk, customer importance, product-growth potential, market dynamics and strategic opportunity.

Revenue Management and Commercial Excellence

  • Partner closely with Pricing, Finance, Tenders and Commercial Analytics to improve pricing discipline, contract governance, margin protection and commercial decision-making.
  • Lead the strategic management of framework agreements, volume agreements, rebate arrangements, GPO administration fees and long-term customer commitments.
  • Monitor contract performance, purchasing behaviour, pricing compliance, portfolio penetration, cross-selling potential and customer delivery against agreed commitments.
  • Use customer insights, CRM data, contract-performance metrics and market intelligence to identify commercial risks, unlock opportunities and improve performance.
  • Champion the use of CRM, analytics platforms, AI-enabled tools and digital collaboration technologies to improve stakeholder mapping, account visibility, opportunity management and strategic decision-making.

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Healthcare, Life Sciences or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
  • Significant experience managing Strategic Accounts, GPOs, National Accounts, Market Access or comparable commercial-strategic responsibilities within the Medical Device, Healthcare or Life Sciences industry.

Team & Culture

You will join a high-performing EMEA Strategic Account organisation focused on driving sustainable growth through healthcare system leadership, customer excellence, commercial discipline and revenue management.

This role offers a unique opportunity to influence market strategy, shape customer partnerships, develop strategic talent and contribute to the future evolution of the EMEA Strategic Account function.

Founded in 1987, Merit Medical Systems, Inc. is a leading manufacturer and marketer of proprietary disposable medical devices used in interventional, diagnostic and therapeutic procedures, particularly in cardiology, radiology, oncology, critical care and endoscopy. Merit serves client hospitals worldwide with an international sales force and clinical support team totalling in excess of 500 individuals. Merit employs approximately 6,300 people worldwide.

Job Title

Data Scientist

Hiring Manager

David Corney

Salary

£41,000 - £50,000 per year depending on experience

Location

Remote first within the UK. We work primarily from home but also have an office available in Central London for quarterly in-person meetings with the AI team and with meetings with the rest of Full Fact. You can expect to travel to the office at least 4 times per year.

Please note that we do not hold a UKVI Sponsorship Licence, so we cannot consider sponsoring a visa applicant or issuing a Certificate of Sponsorship.

Reporting to

Senior Data Scientist

Employment Type

Permanent

We are happy to talk about flexible working, including part time.

Application Closing Date

10 am on Monday 30 November 2026.

Introduction to the role

At a moment when our information environment is under significant strain, this is an exciting opportunity: a role with real autonomy, meaningful mission, and genuine influence at the intersection of AI and web scale engineering.

As a Data Scientist at Full Fact, you will make sure those who make false claims in public can't get away with it. This is a rare opportunity to work for a non-profit tackling internet-scale misinformation problems with a global user base. The fact checks our users publish are seen hundreds of millions of times each year and embedded in many of the most well-known internet services.

Every day, 100s of people around the world find, check, archive and challenge false claims identified by AI-enabled products produced by Full Fact. Your job will be to help us improve and expand this software for our growing user base. You’ll be working at the intersection of software engineering, machine learning, and real-world impact.

Whether you're responding to a new feature request from users in Nigeria covering a general election, helping fact checkers in Australia verify politicians' claims in real time, or enabling health-focused charities to identify and reduce harmful content spreading online, you will be working at pace on projects that make a substantial difference in the world. In this role that means prototyping and developing features with robust APIs, writing clean Python, and working closely with engineers and other data scientists to bring AI-powered features into production.

It is an exciting time to join Full Fact. You will be joining a team of technical, data, and product specialists working on genuinely novel problems in applied AI, from natural language processing and claim detection to trust benchmarks and harm detection.

We will support you to keep learning, and if you are interested in applying but not sure you have all the skills, please do apply. We are open both to supporting learning on the job and to rearranging tasks within the team to suit the skillsets of the best applicant

Job Definition

As an experienced Data Scientist, you will be a key contributor to a number of new and ongoing projects. You will use your technical skills to design and develop software that identifies and counters misinformation. You will develop and use a variety of datasets to train and evaluate machine learning models. You will work with non-technical colleagues and other users of our tools. You will participate in code review, both of your own and of others' code.

Outcomes

Some of the projects you will be contributing to include:

  • Extending our new “Public Interest AI Trust Benchmark” to provide a deeper analysis of how reliably AI chatbots answer everyday questions.

  • Spotting potentially misleading and harmful claims across a broad range of media

  • Identifying and characterising potentially harmful narratives as they spread

  • Helping to integrate the technologies you build into products that will have an immediate use, for both fact checkers and journalists

  • Identifying sightings of previously checked claims at real-time speed

  • Measuring and improving the quality of the system

What we are looking for from you

Political impartiality and sensitivity:

You are committed to the political neutrality of our work and have a good understanding of impartiality (please see the rules on our website).

Understanding of public debate in the UK and sensitivity to the political context we work in.

Skills/competencies

  • Software engineering for data science. You are familiar with the software development lifecycle. You can design, code, test, correct and document moderate to complex programs and scripts from agreed specifications with or without AI coding tools. You can use agreed standards and tools. Collaborate with others to review and refine specifications where appropriate.

  • AI and data science innovation. You are broadly familiar with recent advances in AI including LLMs. You proactively research and explore areas of innovation in our industry. You can identify the value for innovation within the organisation.

  • Applied maths, statistics and scientific practices. You understand and can help teams apply a range of practices. You know how to develop deeper expertise on a narrower range of specialisms. You can start to apply emerging theory to practical situations.

  • Developing data science capability. You promote and monitor continuous professional development within your organisation. You know how to develop knowledge of cutting-edge techniques and share this knowledge. You can develop and support data science capability across the organisation.

  • Domain expertise. You can create automated fact-checking products that are proportionate to the operational benefit and achieve significant impact. You know how to present analysis and visualisations in clear ways to communicate complex messages. You can develop data science communication skills within your team. You support the evolution of data governance and take responsibility for applying ethical data science.

  • Understanding analysis across the product life cycle. You understand and can help teams apply a range of techniques to analyse data and provide insight. You are proactive and can present compelling findings that inform wider decisions. You are starting to apply innovative approaches to resolve problems.

What we offer

A salary between £41,000 - £50,000 per year depending on experience.

Workplace Pension

Generous holidays:

  • 25 days holiday plus bank holidays.

  • In addition, we usually close the office for a period between Christmas and New Year.

Comfortable, centrally located London office with good transport links

Employee Assistance Programme

Emergency Housing Loan and support for moving home

Volunteering day

How to apply

Upload your CV and cover letter using the link below by 10 am on Monday 30 November.

Our recruitment platform will remove identifying details such as email addresses to allow us to sift applications anonymously.

Before applying, please read the requirements we place on staff to protect Full Fact’s independence and non-partisanship

How the application process will work

We want to see you at your best to understand your strengths and the contribution you could make at Full Fact with strong support, including for your learning and development. We also want to make sure that we use your time well during this process and don’t ask for more from you than we need to. We will make any reasonable adjustments we need to make to this process to help ensure you can perform at your best. For more information about this before applying, please .

The interview panel will be Ellie Ashman (Head of AI), David Corney (Senior Data Scientist), and James McMinn (Senior Engineer).

The process starts off with an anonymised covering letter and CV. This will be read by at least two people to produce a shortlist for the panel interview.

The first round interviews will be an audio (not video) interview, lasting no more than half an hour, at a time that’s convenient for you. We will record it so at least two people can review each interview to decide who we invite back for the second round. The recordings will be deleted at the end of the process.

The second round will include a structured interview during which you will be asked to present some of your recent work in any way you choose. The interview will be with the full panel by video and last no more than an hour. We’ll tell you everything you need to know to prepare in advance.

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Be Part Of A High-Performing Team

Join a global climate technology organization developing advanced thermal solutions for high-density data centers and the broader semiconductor ecosystem. This team operates at the intersection of mechanical engineering, liquid cooling, controls, system integration, and product commercialization.

The organization is expanding its data center capabilities to support next-generation computing environments with reliable, scalable, and energy-efficient cooling architectures. Team members collaborate with engineering leaders, product teams, customers, consultants, and industry organizations to transform emerging technologies into practical commercial solutions.

This opportunity is designed for an experienced data center thermal professional who can bring immediate technical credibility, influence system direction, and communicate effectively with customers and senior stakeholders.

What s In Store For You

  • A highly visible role supporting advanced data center cooling initiatives
  • The opportunity to influence next-generation liquid cooling architectures
  • Remote flexibility for highly qualified candidates
  • Collaboration with senior engineering, product, commercial, and customer teams
  • Participation in industry associations, technical committees, conferences, and standards development
  • Exposure to system design, simulation, validation, commissioning, and commercialization
  • Opportunities to mentor technical professionals and shape long-term engineering strategy
  • Comprehensive health, retirement, family-building, educational, wellness, and paid-time-off programs
  • Travel support for qualified candidates attending onsite interviews in Davidson, North Carolina

How You Will Make An Impact

  • Serve as a subject matter expert for advanced data center thermal management and liquid cooling systems.
  • Develop integrated cooling concepts spanning chips, racks, coolant distribution units, facility water systems, controls, and heat rejection.
  • Evaluate system architectures, equipment capabilities, operating modes, control strategies, and performance tradeoffs.
  • Perform or guide thermal analysis, computational fluid dynamics, modeling, simulation, and equipment evaluation.
