  • Support system validation through digital analysis, laboratory testing, commissioning, and field evaluation.
  • Collaborate with product teams, technical specialists, consultants, customers, and commercial leaders.
  • Provide technical guidance during strategic customer pursuits and system commercialization efforts.
  • Deliver technical presentations to customers, leadership teams, sales organizations, and industry audiences.
  • Participate in organizations such as ASHRAE, the Open Compute Project, IEEE, or other relevant standards groups.
  • Translate emerging cooling technologies into reliable, scalable, and market-ready solutions.

Do You Have the Expertise to Lead in Data Center Thermal Systems?

  • Bachelor s degree in mechanical engineering, thermal sciences, controls engineering, or a closely related discipline.
  • At least eight years of relevant engineering, system integration, or technical product experience.
  • Direct professional experience supporting data centers, mission-critical facilities, or data center cooling products.
  • Demonstrated experience with liquid cooling technologies such as direct-to-chip cooling, immersion cooling, coolant distribution units, or facility water systems.
  • Strong understanding of thermal-fluid systems, HVAC equipment, cooling infrastructure, controls, and heat rejection.
  • Ability to evaluate complete thermal management systems rather than individual components.
  • Experience with CFD, ANSYS, thermal modeling, fluid modeling, or system simulation is strongly preferred.
  • Absorption cooling experience is highly valued.
  • Experience developing system modes, control requirements, or sequences of operation is preferred.
  • Commissioning, field validation, troubleshooting, or facility integration experience is strongly valued.
  • Strong customer-facing, presentation, written, and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to explain complex technical topics clearly to both engineering and business audiences.
  • Experience influencing technical direction across multiple teams and stakeholders.
  • Professional Engineer licensure, advanced technical education, or industry committee participation is beneficial but not required.
  • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as needed.

Somos o DOMO

O hub de inovação e tecnologia de um dos maiores e mais consolidados bancos do Brasil: o Banco Mercantil. Criado para atuar como um núcleo de desenvolvimento de soluções conectadas com o novo e com as demandas do futuro.

Seguimos firmes na construção de um ambiente justo, representativo e com oportunidades reais para todas e todos. Vem com a gente!

Se você se identificou, venha fazer parte.

#VEMSERDOMO

Para seu conhecimento:Nesta página todas as vagas estarão identificadas como mistas ou internas. Asvagas mistas contemplam tanto profissionais do mercado quanto colaboradores do Domo, enquanto as vagas internas são destinadas exclusivamente aos colaboradores que já fazem parte do Domo.

Seus principais desafios serão:

  • Testar de forma contínua e adversarial a eficácia de controles de segurança específicos (ex: WAF, EDR, SIEM rules, DLP, etc.) contra as técnicas de ataque mais recentes;
  • Criar e manter um arsenal interno de scripts, ferramentas e metodologias especializadas (ex: payloads personalizados, ferramentas de phishing controlado, implants ou técnicas de evasão) para otimizar as operações do Red Team e refletir o cenário de ameaças exclusivo do banco;
  • Atuar como um elo estratégico de "Purple Team" ao compartilhar descobertas, insights e conhecimento sobre o mindset de ataque com o Blue Team (SOC), Arquitetura e Engenharia de Segurança. Liderar sessões de debriefing e workshops;
  • Estruturar planos de simulação de ataque detalhados, definir Regras de Engajamento (RoE) e coordenar os exercícios alinhando-se aos comitês de risco e lideranças estratégicas;
  • Mimetizar táticas de invasão explorando a cadeia de valor tecnológica do banco, testando a segurança de interfaces com fornecedores de TI, integradores parceiros, esteiras de DevOps (GitHub/GitLab, Kubernetes) e ambientes corporativos em nuvem multi-cloud.

Buscamos uma pessoa com:

  • Superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Segurança da Informação, Redes ou áreas correlatas de Tecnologia;
  • Experiência comprovada de 5 anos em Segurança Ofensiva (Red Team e/ou Pentest avançado);
  • Vivência prática em emulação de adversários, campanhas de simulação de ameaças ou invasões orientadas a objetivos corporativos;
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura e exploração aprofundada de Active Directory e ambientes de nuvem híbrida (Entra ID, Azure, AWS);
  • Técnicas de evasão de defesas (defense evasion), injeção de processos, bypass de AMSI e contorno de EDRs modernos;
  • Domínio em montagem e operação de infraestrutura de C2 (Cobalt Strike, Mythic, Sliver, Havoc ou customizados) com uso de técnicas de ofuscação e redirectors;
  • Conhecimento em protocolos e serviços de rede, Kerberos abuse, delegações restritas/irrestritas e movimentação lateral.

Vai se destacar se apresentar:

  • Pós-graduação na área de segurança ofensiva/cibersegurança;
  • Experiência em empresas do setor financeiro, meios de pagamento ou infraestruturas críticas altamente reguladas.
  • Certificações Desejáveis (com foco Red Team): CRTO (Certified Red Team Operator), CRTE/CRTP (Certified Red Team Expert/Professional), OSEP (OffSec Defense Analyst/Penetration Tester), CPTS (HTB Certified Penetration Testing Specialist), CARTP ou CRTL, OSCP, OSWE, CWEE, GPEN, GXPN.

jobs.title: Senior Compensation Analyst
jobs.excerpt: Senior Compensation AnalystWhat you will be doing:The Senior Compensation Analyst supports the design, administration, analysis, and continuous improvement of Premier’s compensation programs.
jobs.description:
Senior Compensation Analyst

What you will be doing:

The Senior Compensation Analyst supports the design, administration, analysis, and continuous improvement of Premier’s compensation programs. This role conducts job evaluations, market pricing, salary and incentive analysis, and compensation reporting to help ensure pay programs are internally equitable, externally competitive, and aligned with business needs. The Senior Compensation Analyst partners with the Compensation team, HRBPs, HRIS, Employee Relations, and business leaders to provide data-driven recommendations, support audits, improve processes, and communicate compensation guidance clearly and effectively. This role also serves as a Workday compensation functional lead by supporting configuration, release testing, job profile maintenance, compensation-related transactions, and the annual compensation cycle, including merit and incentive planning through Workday Advanced Compensation.

Key Responsibilities


Compensation Administration – 35%

· Conduct job evaluations; determine salary and incentive ranges; and advise HR and business leaders on appropriate job classifications, titles, salary grades, incentive targets, and total pay levels for Premier roles.

· Participate in external market surveys and complete internal and external compensation assessments to support base salary and incentive budgets, guidelines, and programs.

· Annually migrate job matches to updated salary data in MarketPay.

· Prepare analytics and reports for the Compensation team, CHRO, HRBPs, and business leaders.

· Partner with Employee Relations to provide documentation and analysis for compensation audits.

· Partner with Talent Acquisition to provide salary recommendations for new hire offers.

· Monitor and triage the Compensation general email box, ensuring timely responses to routine inquiries, appropriate routing of requests, and escalation of complex or sensitive matters to the appropriate Compensation team members.

· Identify opportunities to improve compensation processes, policies, and service levels.


Workday Administration – 35%

· Serve as the Workday compensation functional lead, including configuration, product knowledge, issue resolution, and team updates.

· Complete testing for compensation products during biannual Workday releases and validate that functionality supports compensation requirements.

· Partner with HRIS to configure and update Workday as needed to reflect changes to compensation programs.

· Complete Workday tasks as the Compensation administrator, including items related to position management, employment agreements, and one-time payments.

· Update job profiles as needed and maintain current job descriptions in the job repository.

Annual Compensation Cycle (ACC) – 30%

· Administer annual merit increases and annual incentive awards in alignment with budgets and guidelines.

· Work with HRIS to configure and implement Workday Advanced Compensation for the cycle.

· Complete ACC project tasks and assist with testing as required.

· Prepare draft communications for review by VP, Compensation.

· Analyze end-of-cycle data for senior leaders

​Required Qualifications

Work Experience:

Years of Applicable Experience - 4 or more years

Education:

High School Diploma or GED (Required)

Preferred Certifications/Licensing

Certified Compensation Professional (CCP)

Preferred Qualifications

Skills:

  • Strong Excel experience, including pivot tables, VLOOKUP, and formulas.
  • Knowledge of compensation principles, including market pricing, job evaluation, salary structures, incentive plans, and pay equity considerations.
  • Ability to analyze complex data sets, identify trends, prepare recommendations, and translate findings into clear, actionable insights for HR and business leaders.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain compensation concepts to stakeholders at varying levels of the organization.
  • Proven ability to manage competing priorities, maintain accuracy and confidentiality, and support process improvements.

Experience:

  • Five or more years of experience in all areas of compensation, including broad-based pay, annual incentives, external surveys, and internal compensation tools.
  • Experience using Workday compensation functionality, including job profiles, compensation plans, eligibility rules, business processes, reporting, and Advanced Compensation.
  • Experience using AI tools, such as Copilot, to create efficiencies and enhance processes.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources

Additional Job Requirements:

  • Remain in a stationary position for prolonged periods of time

  • Be adaptive and change priorities quickly; meet deadlines

  • Attention to detail

  • Operate computer programs and software

  • Ability to communicate effectively with audiences in person and in electronic formats.

  • Day-to-day contact with others (co-workers and/or the public)

  • Making independent decisions

  • Ability to work in a collaborative business environment in close quarters with peers and varying interruptions

Working Conditions: RemoteTravel Requirements: Travel 1-20% within the USPhysical Demands: Sedentary: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally, and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body. Sedentary work involves remaining stationary most of the time. Jobs are sedentary if movement is required only occasionally, and all other sedentary criteria are met.Premier’s compensation philosophy is to ensure that compensation is reasonable, equitable, and competitive in order to attract and retain talented and highly skilled employees. Premier’s internal salary range for this role is $90,000 - $150,000. Final salary is dependent upon several market factors including, but not limited to, departmental budgets, internal equity, education, unique skills/experience, and geographic location. Premier utilizes a wide-range salary structure to allow base salary flexibility within our ranges.

Qualified full-time and part-time employees also receive access to the following benefits:

  • Health, dental, vision, life and disability insurance

  • 401k retirement program

jobs.description:
Job Description:

Job Title: Senior Accountant

Location: Remote | USA, Canada
Reports to: Senior Director, Financial Accounting

Employment Type: Full-time

This is an existing vacancy

About the Role:

We are seeking a high-performing Accountant / Senior Accountant to join our growing finance organization. This role is designed for an experienced accounting professional who brings both strong technical accounting foundations and the ability to take ownership of complex accounting areas. The successful candidate will thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, partner cross-functionally, and play a meaningful role in ensuring accurate, timely, and insightful financial reporting.

This position blends core accounting responsibilities with advanced senior-level duties, including independent judgment, process ownership, and mentoring. It offers strong upside and the opportunity to grow alongside the company as our finance function continues to evolve.


In this role, you will:

  • Prepare monthly journal entries and account reconciliations related to various areas of the balance sheet including but not limited to capitalized assets and/or fixed assets
  • Prepare monthly accruals across multiple cost centers
  • Serve as the primary accounting resource for one or more foreign subsidiaries, with responsibility for month-end close activities in compliance with U.S. GAAP
  • Review financial information on a regular basis for variance analysis purposes and confirmation of accuracy and completeness
  • Support other month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities as needed
  • Support external audit requests and preparation of supporting documentation
  • Partner with accounting and finance leadership on technical accounting matters and other ad hoc projects as needed
  • Perform other accounting, reporting, compliance, and finance-related responsibilities as assigned

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in accounting or related field
  • Minimum 3+ years of relevant accounting experience in a corporate accounting or public accounting environment (will consider candidates with public accounting experience only)
  • Experience in a multi-entity and multi-currency environment
  • NetSuite (or similar ERP) experience
  • Experience with fixed asset accounting or other capitalized assets such as internally developed software
  • Experience with month-end close activities including accruals, recording prepaid expenses, and balance sheet reconciliations
  • Strong understanding of U.S. GAAP and accounting fundamentals
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities with minimal supervision
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Public accounting experience preferred (Big 4 or regional public accounting firm preferred)
  • Active CPA license or CPA candidate preferred
  • Experience preparing technical accounting position papers and accounting policy documentation preferred
  • Experience with system implementations preferred
  • Experience supporting external audits and responding to auditor requests

Experience with financial reporting in a large multi-entity corporate environment [Skills that would strengthen the role but are not required]

Compensation and Benefits

This position has a starting salary range of $81,500 - $108,500 USD or $66,000 - $86,000 CAD per year. The range represents what we reasonably and in good faith expect to pay for the role at the time of posting. An employee’s pay within the range is determined by a number of factors, including relevant skills, education, qualifications, experience, performance, business or organizational needs, and geographic location.

Eligible employees may participate in medical, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, retirement savings programs, paid time off, wellness programs, and other company-sponsored benefits. Benefits vary by country and employment status.

Why Join JD Power

JD Power powers auto-related decisions through proprietary data, advanced analytics, deep industry expertise, and workflows that connect insight to action. Operating across North America, Europe, and Australia, we help customers make better decisions and achieve better outcomes.

As a virtual-first company, we offer flexible work arrangements, opportunities for learning and development, and a culture centered on the Values that guide how we work every day.

· We power our customers’ success. Everything we do is focused on helping customers make better decisions and achieve better outcomes.

· We are innovative, collaborative, and grounded in data. We combine advanced analytics with human expertise to deliver insight that holds up in the real world.

· We make things easy. We turn complexity into clarity so teams can act faster and with confidence.

· We get it done. We focus on execution, accountability, and results.

· We start with trust and prove it every day. Independence, integrity, and credibility are the foundation of our work.


Equal Opportunity & Accommodations

JD Power is committed to employing a diverse workforce. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability.

JD Power is committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for individuals with disabilities or other protected needs under applicable local laws. Please contact for accommodation request.


Data Privacy

JD Power does not disclose your personal data to unauthorized third parties. However, as a global corporation consisting of multiple affiliated companies in various countries, JD Power has international sites and JD Power uses resources located throughout the world. JD Power may from time to time also use third parties to act on JD Power’s behalf. You agree to the fact that to the extent necessary your personal data may be transferred and/or disclosed to any company within JD Power group of companies as well as to third parties acting on JD Power’s behalf, including also transfers to servers and databases outside the country where you provided JD Power with your personal data. Such transfers may include for example transfers and/or disclosures outside the European Economic Area and in the United States of America. If you are a California or United Kingdom resident, additional disclosures about the information we collect and how we use that information can be found by clicking here.

Applications

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where employment is offered. JD Power does not provide employment sponsorship for this position.

This position is posted exclusively on and select trusted job boards such as LinkedIn or Indeed. All official communication comes from email addresses ending in @jdpower.com or @jdpa.com. We will never ask for payment, equipment purchases, or upfront fees. We may take additional steps to verify candidate information to protect the integrity of our recruitment process.

To all recruitment agencies: JD Power does not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

jobs.excerpt: The Manager, Study Start Up and Regulatory Affairs is responsible for developing the strategy based on regulatory requirements and for coordinating and overseeing all SSU deliverables from site selection through site initiation readiness.
jobs.description:
The Manager, Study Start Up and Regulatory Affairs is responsible for developing the strategy based on
regulatory requirements and for coordinating and overseeing all SSU deliverables from site selection
through site initiation readiness. The manager actively assists senior management in securing new
business by participating to BDMs and contributing to proposals/budgets. They also provide strategic
regulatory guidance, training, coaching and mentoring to junior members; may be required to line

manage members of staff.

Leads study start-up and regulatory activities for assigned projects of medium to high complexity,
ensuring delivery aligned with timelines, quality standards, and regulatory requirements.

Accountable for end-to-end delivery of study start-up and regulatory milestones across assigned

projects.

Ensure collection, review for completeness/compliance, and tracking of essential documents for
Study Start-Up to facilitate efficient site initiation and activation. Investigate incomplete, inaccurate
or missing documents to ensure accuracy and completeness of information. Prepare study team
reports or updates regarding status of essential document collection, review and approval.

Ensure negotiation and execution of clinical site agreements, ancillary agreements as well as
amendments, in accordance with project requirements and country regulations and within the

projected delivery timelines.

Defines and implements study start-up and regulatory strategies at project level, ensuring
alignment with sponsor expectations, regulatory requirements, and operational feasibility.

Proactively identifies, assesses, and mitigates risks impacting study start-up and regulatory
timelines, ensuring timely resolution of issues.

Builds and maintains strong relationships with clients, regulatory authorities, and internal
stakeholders to ensure effective collaboration and delivery.

Ensure all team members assigned to the project for departmental deliverables are aware of the
tasks and time allocated, monitor project budgets, hours spent vs budgeted and promptly identify

and escalate any OoS.

Assist in securing new business or repeated business by participating to BDMs, developing and
reviewing regulatory sections of proposals, regulatory costing and budgets.

Provides strategic input into bids and contributes to winning new business opportunities

Provides coaching, guidance, and performance feedback to team members to support

development and delivery excellence.

Performs other work-related duties as assigned.

Graduate degree in Chemistry or Life Sciences, Nursing or equivalent

combination of education and experience.

6-8 years within pharmaceutical or CRO industry or Regulatory
body, of which at least 3 years in a leading/project management

role

Proven ability to successfully manage global projects

When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.

We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.

  • Quality: we hold ourselves to the standard patients deserve.
  • Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard.
  • Drive and passion: we care about the outcome, because someone is waiting on it.
  • Agility and responsiveness: we move quickly, because patients cannot wait.
  • Belonging: everyone is welcome, and every voice counts.
  • Collaborative partnerships: we go further by going together.

We look forward to welcoming your application.

Medicine moves forward here. So will you.

Ergomed is a specialist clinical research organization focused on rare disease and select oncology indications. We focus on the most complex trials, the studies where experience, judgement, and rigorous operational accountability make the biggest difference. We partner with small to midsize biotech companies to move promising therapies through early phase development, so they reach the patients sooner.

We choose complex work on purpose. Rare disease and oncology trials carry real operational risk, and our people are experts at reducing it, protecting timelines, data quality and the experience of sites and patients at the same time. It is demanding, meaningful work, and no one here forgets that patients cannot wait.

That is why culture matters to us as much as capability. We have built a collaborative, international team where people share ideas, grow their careers and are trusted to take ownership early. With colleagues across North America, South America, Europe, Asia and Australia, we value teamwork, flexibility and a real commitment to work-life balance, because good science comes from people who feel supported.

If you want work with purpose, the agility to make an impact and a team that cares about the people behind the work as much as the work itself, we would love to hear from you.

Position Summary

The Digital Content Producer develops, writes, edits and optimizes compelling, audience-focused content that advances Rosalind Franklin University's brand, supports institutional priorities and strengthens engagement across digital communications channels. As a member of the Communications team within the Division of Marketing and Brand Management, the position translates complex academic programs, research, institutional initiatives and university priorities into clear, accessible and engaging content.

Reporting to the Director of Content Strategy, the Digital Content Producer collaborates with communications, marketing and digital team members, as well as academic and administrative partners, to produce content for the university website, landing pages, digital campaigns and other institutional communications. The position brings expertise in digital storytelling, web writing, search engine optimization (SEO), answer engine optimization (AEO), user experience and accessibility to ensure content is accurate, consistent, discoverable and aligned with the university's brand and editorial standards.

Full-time staff are eligible for 3 weeks of vacation/ personal leave, 15 sick days, and 9 paid holidays, paid winter break, plus two floating holidays.

This is a fully remote position.

Who We Are

Rosalind Franklin University of Medicine and Science (RFU) is a graduate health sciences university committed to serving the population through the interprofessional education of health and biomedical professionals and the discovery of knowledge dedicated to improving wellness. The university embodies the spirit of inquiry and excellence modeled by its namesake Dr. Rosalind Franklin, whose Photo 51 was crucial to solving the structure of DNA.

Today, the university’s 6 colleges continue Dr. Franklin’s legacy through rigorous academics, pioneering research, and innovative community service. Our unique interprofessional education model allows students to learn from and with each other in a variety of settings, including our simulation labs, the student-led Interprofessional Community Clinic, and through partnerships with area hospitals and clinics. RFU is a national leader in interprofessional research and practices, and is nationally recognized for its research in areas including neuroscience, brain-related diseases, inherited disorders, proteomics, cancer cell biology and immunology, cardiac resuscitation, and gait and balance.

Content Development, Storytelling and Digital User Experience

The Accessibility Testing Expert will collaborate with developers, designers, quality assurance teams, product owners, vendors, and organizational stakeholders to integrate accessibility throughout the digital product lifecycle and support informed accessibility and compliance decisions.


Key Responsibilities
  • Lead comprehensive accessibility evaluations of websites, applications, and digital content to assess conformance with WCAG 2.0, 2.1, and 2.2 standards and identify barriers that may impact users with disabilities..
  • This is a Remote (work from home) position.
  • Apply automated testing tools, assistive technologies, manual testing techniques, code inspection, and accessibility tree analysis to identify and validate accessibility barriers.
  • Assess the severity, user impact, and accessibility risk of identified issues to support remediation prioritization and informed decision-making.
  • Collaborate with developers, designers, QA, and product teams to provide clear remediation guidance, accessibility acceptance criteria, and recommendations that support accessible implementation.
  • Validate accessibility remediation across iterative development cycles and confirm that identified barriers have been effectively resolved.

  • Support accessibility evaluations during procurement, implementation, and third-party vendor reviews.
  • Conduct accessibility evaluations of electronic documents, including PDF, Word, PowerPoint, and Excel, against applicable WCAG, Section 508, and PDF/UA requirements.
  • Validate document remediation to ensure content is correctly structured and usable with screen readers, keyboard navigation, and other assistive technologies.
  • Contribute to organizational accessibility standards, testing methodologies, procedures, reusable best practices, training, and awareness initiatives.

Required Skills

  • Expertise in comprehensive manual and automated accessibility testing, including keyboard, screen reader, focus management, contrast, zoom/reflow, text spacing, and dynamic-content testing.

  • Ability to map findings accurately to WCAG criteria, severity, and user impact and provide actionable remediation guidance.

  • Ability to manage multiple accessibility assessments and collaborate effectively across development, design, QA, product, and business teams.

Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or related field preferred.
  • At least 8 years of professional experience performing accessibility testing and audits in web and mobile applications.
  • Trusted Tester Certification issued by DHS or a similar certification in accessibility is preferred.

jobs.excerpt: About the jobThe SOC Analyst is responsible for the continuous monitoring, triage, and investigation of security events across the organization's environment, as part of a global follow-the-sun Security Operations Center.
jobs.description:
About the job

The SOC Analyst is responsible for the continuous monitoring, triage, and investigation of security events across the organization's environment, as part of a global follow-the-sun Security Operations Center. This position reports to the SOC Lead. The role goes beyond acknowledging alerts: the focus is on understanding what each alert means, investigating suspicious activity end to end, responding to real threats, and handing over cleanly between regions so that nothing is lost across shifts. The ideal candidate has solid SOC experience, a strong investigative mindset, and thrives in a fast-paced, fully remote setting where accuracy, discipline, and security are essential. Hands-on engineering experience with core security platforms is a big plus.

Responsibilities

  • Monitor, triage, and analyze security alerts and events from the organization's security stack, including SIEM, Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Security Service Edge (SSE), and Web Application Firewall (WAF) platforms.

  • Investigate security incidents end to end, from initial triage through analysis, containment, eradication, and post-incident documentation, coordinating with relevant teams throughout.

  • Determine the scope, severity, and impact of security events, separating true positives from false positives and escalating confirmed incidents according to defined procedures.

  • Execute response actions within the security platforms, such as isolating endpoints, blocking indicators, disabling compromised accounts, and enforcing access restrictions.

  • Ensure structured, high-quality shift handovers across regions in the follow-the-sun model, so that open investigations, ongoing incidents, and pending actions continue seamlessly around the clock.

  • Proactively threat hunt across endpoint, network, and log data to uncover suspicious activity that existing detections may have missed, mapping findings to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.

  • Provide feedback on detection quality and contribute to the tuning of SIEM correlation rules, EDR custom detections, and WAF rules to reduce noise and improve coverage.

  • Enrich investigations with threat intelligence, including indicators of compromise, attacker techniques, and emerging campaigns relevant to the organization.

  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and incident response playbooks.

  • Collaborate with IT, infrastructure, application, and security engineering teams to resolve incidents and support day-to-day operations.

  • Support vulnerability management and drive continuous improvement of the organization's overall security posture.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience as a SOC Analyst, triaging alerts and investigating security incidents in a production environment.

  • Solid working knowledge of core security technologies such as EDR, SSE, SIEM, and WAF, and of how to use them to investigate and respond to threats.

  • Hands-on experience implementing, configuring, and tuning these platforms, or writing and tuning detection content, is a big plus.

  • Experience with incident response and threat hunting, ideally with familiarity with the MITRE ATT&CK framework.

  • Excellent understanding of network security, endpoint security, cloud security, and Zero Trust principles.

  • Relevant certifications such as Security+, CySA+, GCIA, GCIH, BTL1, or vendor-specific credentials are a plus.

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with a high attention to detail.

  • Ability to handle sensitive information responsibly and securely.

  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English, and the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams and across time zones.

About You

You are a hands-on security analyst who wants to understand what is really happening behind an alert, rather than only closing tickets. You dig into the data, follow the evidence, and know when and how to escalate. If you have also stood up or tuned the tools you work with, or written your own detections, even better. You are structured, reliable, and comfortable working independently in a remote, follow-the-sun team, and you take pride in leaving a clear handover for the next shift. You are curious about new threats and technologies, and you enjoy working closely with both technical teams and end users to raise the security bar across the environment.

Job Description:

Product Marketing Manager Principal (PMM)

Vertex is seeking a Product Marketing Manager Principal (PMM) to own the end-to-end market story for one of its product domains: from the market signal that shapes the roadmap, through positioning and launch, to the argument a seller makes in the room. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports, reporting to the VP, Global Product Marketing. The work is judgment-driven determining what Vertex says about a domain, to whom, and why, then moving Product, Sales, and Marketing to act on it. Year-one success is defined by a positioning document that serves as the single source of truth for Product, Sales, and Marketing; a competitive position visible in win/loss outcomes; and at least one product launch delivered on date with verified commercial readiness.

  • Own positioning and messaging for the domain, covering every claim and the proof behind it, authored so demand, creative, and enablement teams can build from it without interpretation.
  • Author the core sales narrative for the domain: the argument a seller makes in the room.
  • Translate win/loss data, customer conversations, competitive movement, and regulatory change into a roadmap-ready point of view Product can act on.
  • Own the go-to-market plan for every launch, from segment and offer decisions through to commercial readiness evidence for Sales, Partners, and Support on day one; run the launch team to the date.
  • Turn competitive intelligence into a winning position against incumbents and AI-native entrants; supply the claims and proof behind battlecards.
  • Carry the domain into partner and ERP routes to market; embed domain proof within joint narratives and conduct a channel conflict check in every launch plan.
  • Contribute to pricing and packaging decisions with commercial evidence; represent the domain with analysts, customers, and partners, and at internal leadership forums.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years in product marketing or an adjacent discipline, with the majority in enterprise B2B software sold through long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.
  • Demonstrated ownership of positioning for a product line, including messaging the field adopted and used in live deals, and the judgment to determine what to say and what to omit.
  • Experience marketing a product embedded in a customer's system of record and reaching part of its market through partners: ERP, procurement, billing, payments, or similar.
  • Proficiency working from pipeline data, deal cycles, and win/loss analysis; demonstrated ability to connect messaging decisions to win-rate outcomes.
  • Proven ability to get fluent quickly in a regulated, technical, detail-heavy domain.
  • Ability to write and present complex ideas with clarity, adapting the message for a tax or finance buyer, a seller in an active deal, or a leadership audience.
  • Active use of AI tools across core work, including research, synthesis, drafting, and competitive monitoring, with the ability to hold a competitive position against AI-native entrants in live deal situations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in indirect tax or another regulated category where rules change on a government's timetable.
  • Equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant professional experience accepted in lieu of a formal degree.

COMMENTS:

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by individuals in this position. Other functions may be assigned, and management retains the right to add or change the duties at any time.



Vertex Values: Together We Win


We're building a team of people who are passionate about making an impact for our customers and committed to how that impact is achieved. Our values define the behaviors, mindset, and culture that make Vertex a great place to grow and do meaningful work.


Play to Win or We Don't Play — If we choose to do something, we're choosing to do it because we plan to win. That mindset raises our bar on product quality, customer outcomes, and how we show up for one another.


Work As a Team, Putting the Customer At the Core — Our customers are our true north. Whatever your role, ask: how will this help a customer succeed today? We earn trust through outcomes, not promises.


Achieve Excellence With Integrity, Speed, and Agility — The market isn't slowing down. We'll move faster, adapt quickly, and never compromise on doing things the right way — for teammates, customers, and partners.


Innovate Boldly With a Growth Mindset — Progress demands smart risk. We'll try new approaches, learn fast, and keep pushing the boundaries — especially where AI can remove friction and unlock value.


Communicate with Care, Candor and Transparency — Honest, constructive conversations make us better. Let's speak plainly about what's working and what isn't and help each other improve.

Senior Director, External Communications (Solventum)

3M Health Care is now Solventum

At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.

The Impact You’ll Make in this Role

As Senior Director, External Communications, you will set Solventum’s external communications strategy and work with leaders, teams and partners around the world to execute against it. We are seeking an experienced, results-driven individual to lead our company’s PR, media relations, social media and thought leadership efforts. As a key member of the Communications & Brand leadership team, reporting to the SVP, Chief Communications and Brand Officer, this role will be instrumental in helping to shape our external brand, protecting our reputation and driving our messaging to a variety of stakeholders, including media, regulators, customers and the public. This position will require a strategic thinker with hands-on expertise in executing external communications initiatives while navigating the complexities of a growing, global organization. The Senior Director will oversee the development and implementation of external communications strategies, working closely with executive leadership to ensure consistent, clear and impactful messaging. This position blends strategic oversight with day-to-day operational management, offering the opportunity to shape the external voice of a dynamic and evolving company.

Here, you will make an impact by:

External Communications Strategy Development:

  • Lead the creation and execution of a comprehensive global external communications strategy in collaboration with marketing and commercial teams that elevates Solventum’s brand, enhances its reputation and supports business objectives across earned media, social media and external influence.
  • Create a clear, differentiated corporate narrative and unified external voice that brings Solventum’s purpose and innovation to life for media, regulators, customers, healthcare professionals, patients and industry partners.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders, including marketing, legal, HR, investor relations and leadership, to align on key external communications initiatives and ensure consistency across all touchpoints.

Media Relations & Public Relations:

  • Build and nurture relationships with journalists, media outlets and relevant creators across healthcare, science, business, technology and consumer media to generate sustained, high-impact earned coverage and protect Solventum’s reputation.
  • Oversee the development and distribution of press releases, media statements and other external facing media materials.
  • Proactively create communications-led moments and campaigns around Solventum’s products, research, partnerships, data and point of view that earn attention, create conversation and build brand awareness. Manage media inquiries with sound judgment to mitigate reputational risk.
  • Partner closely with investor relations on corporate and financial communications strategy, financial media outreach and related activity.

Social Media & Digital Communications:

  • Lead Solventum’s social media strategy across multiple platforms, building a distinctive voice and point of view that engages audiences, while remaining aligned with business objectives.
  • Develop content and campaigns that resonate with target audiences, including thought leadership articles, blog posts, social media updates and videos.
  • Oversee community management and social listening, monitoring the conversations shaping healthcare and Solventum’s reputation, identifying emerging opportunities and responding to inquiries or concerns in a timely and professional manner.

Crisis Communications & Issues Management:

  • Lead the external communications strategy during crises or reputational issues, ensuring timely, transparent and empathetic communication to the public, media, employees, regulators and other key stakeholders. This includes incidents affecting the company’s operations, reputation or public perception.
  • Partner with investor relations and participate in the review process for issues tied to financial health, investor confidence or governance, with target audiences of investors, analysts, shareholders, etc.
  • Partner with internal leadership, investor relations, legal and HR teams to develop crisis communication plans and protocols, ensuring that the company is prepared for potential issues.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, providing counsel on sensitive situations that could impact the company’s external image.

Team Leadership & Development:

  • Lead and mentor a high-performing external communications team that moves quickly, maintains exceptional standards and measures success by impact—not activity. Provide guidance, professional development and a collaborative, results-driven environment.
  • Oversee the development of external communications talent, ensuring team members have the tools and support they need to succeed in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.

Agency Oversight and Management:

  • Lead and manage relationships with external agencies, ensuring alignment with overall brand strategy, objectives and key messaging.
  • Shape Solventum’s external influence strategy through conferences, speaking opportunities, awards and industry relationships that advance the company’s narrative, reputation and business priorities.
  • Ensure that the company’s external communications align with the interests of key stakeholders while advancing the company’s strategic goals.
  • Partner with executives and executive communications team members to develop distinctive external voices and thought leadership through speaking opportunities, media engagements, social content, opinion pieces and major events. Capture each leader’s authentic voice and advise on when and how to engage in public conversations.
  • Partner with investor relations on quarterly earnings, investor days, analyst meetings, financial communications, etc.

Operational Excellence & Reporting:

  • Implement systems and processes to measure external communications beyond impressions and press hits, connecting media coverage, social engagement and other KPIs to brand awareness, consideration, reputation, advocacy and business outcomes. Provide regular reports and use insights to refine strategy.
  • Ensure the company is leveraging the latest tools and technologies to optimize external communications efforts, including media monitoring, social media listening and analytics.

Your Skills and Expertise

To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher in communications, public relations, journalism, business or a related field AND (twelve) 12 years of experience in corporate communications.

OR

  • High School Diploma/GED AND (sixteen) 16 years of experience in corporate communications.

In addition to the above requirements, the following are also required:

  • 5 years of experience in a senior leadership role, ideally in PR, media relations, or corporate communications.
  • Experience in managing external communications strategies for a global organization.
  • Expertise in handling crisis communications and managing complex public relations challenges.
  • Experience in building and leading a high-performing external communications team in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:

  • Exceptional storytelling, writing and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn complex information and business strategies into clear, memorable narratives for diverse audiences.
  • Experience in media relationships and a track record of generating sustained, high-impact earned coverage through ideas, trends, data, people and relevant moments—not just announcements. An understanding of what journalists and audiences care about and how brands earn attention.
  • Expertise in social media and modern communications channels, including creators, influencers, podcasts, events, communities and emerging platforms, with strong audience instincts and the ability to create content people notice, care about, share and remember.
  • Experience working in industries such as medtech, healthcare or highly regulated sectors is a plus.
  • Experience overseeing external agencies, ensuring timely execution and strong results.
  • Leadership skills, including team development, cross-functional collaboration and influencing senior executives, with the judgment to challenge and advise leaders and help them develop distinctive, authentic public voices.
  • Experience measuring communications impact and connecting the work to brand awareness, consideration, reputation, advocacy and business outcomes.
  • A global mindset, with the ability to adapt communications strategies to different cultural contexts and regions.
  • A proactive, solutions-oriented leader who thrives in a dynamic, evolving environment, with high standards, strong editorial judgment, intellectual curiosity, low ego and a bias toward action.

Supporting Your Well-being

Solventum offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, Solventum regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope.

jobs.description:
About Kestra

Kestra is the universal orchestration platform: open source, declarative, & designed to orchestrate data pipelines, IT automation, business workflows, & AI/agentic systems.

Trusted by over 10,000 organizations worldwide, including JPMorgan Chase, Bloomberg, FILA, & Crédit Agricole, Kestra orchestrates mission-critical workloads at scale. The open-source project has close to 30,000 GitHub stars, hundreds of contributors, & a fast-growing global community.

About The Role

Most of Kestra's pipeline starts with someone who already found us: a demo request, a Kestra Cloud trial, a webinar sign-up, or an engineer from the open-source community who wants to talk to Sales. We sell Kestra Enterprise, self-hosted in the customer's own infrastructure, & Kestra Cloud, our fully managed edition.

We're looking for our first inbound Sales Development Representative in Europe to turn that interest into qualified pipeline. You follow up on every inbound lead, qualify it honestly against our Ideal Customer Profile, & pass it to the right Account Executive.

You work closely with our Lead Growth Engineering team, who build & run the systems that capture, score, & route our inbound demand. Together you decide which signals matter, tighten routing, & make sure no good lead goes cold. You report to the Head of Sales & hand off daily to our European Account Executives.

Your buyers are technical: data engineers, platform engineers, & the leaders who run those teams. You don't need to be an engineer, but you need to be curious enough to learn the product & talk credibly about orchestration.

What You'll Own

Follow-up

  • Every inbound lead routed to you: demo & contact requests, Kestra Cloud trials & sign-ups, event & webinar follow-ups, & community hand-raises.

  • Speed to lead: a first personal reply within 1 business hour, & at least 4 follow-up attempts over 7 business days before closing a lead out.

  • Messages that read like a person wrote them: short, relevant, & clearly based on what the prospect actually asked for.

Qualification

  • Qualification calls that uncover the prospect's use case, current tooling (Airflow, cron, homegrown scripts, cloud-native schedulers), team, & timeline.

  • Honest qualification against our Ideal Customer Profile: a real business pain Kestra solves, & someone involved in evaluating or buying.

  • Clean disqualification: leads that don't fit go back to nurture with a clear reason, so the team learns which sources bring good demand.

Hand-off to Account Executives

  • Routing each qualified lead to the right Account Executive by territory & segment, or to the account owner when there is already an open opportunity or an existing customer.

  • First meetings that actually happen, with a written brief so the prospect never has to repeat themselves.

  • Accurate records in HubSpot: every lead, call, & disqualification reason logged, so forecasts & routing can be trusted.

Partnership with Lead Growth Engineering

  • Feedback on lead quality by source, campaign, & persona, so scoring & routing keep improving.

  • Shaping the inbound playbook: qualification questions, templates, objection handling, & the hand-off checklist.

  • Spotting gaps early: leads routed to the wrong place, signals the system misses, or steps that slow a prospect down.

What We're Looking For

  • 1+ year as an SDR, BDR, or in a similar customer-facing role, ideally at a B2B SaaS or software company.

  • Inbound experience: you have worked a lead queue against response-time targets & know how to qualify without losing a good prospect.

  • Curiosity about technical products: you enjoy learning how software works & can hold a credible conversation with an engineer.

  • Clear, concise writing: your emails get answered.

  • CRM discipline: you keep records accurate because you know other people rely on them.

  • Fluent in English; a second European language (especially French or German) is a plus.

  • Comfortable working autonomously in a fully remote team, with working hours that cover European business hours.

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive compensation, performance bonus, & equity

  • Medical, dental, & vision insurance

  • Employer-paid life & disability insurance

  • Fully remote, with home-office & equipment budget

  • Learning & conference budget

  • Paid time off, company holidays, & parental leave

Location

Europe

jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

Natera is a global leader in cell-free DNA testing, serving patients across oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our Data & AI organization builds the enterprise data platform and AI systems that turn clinical, genomic, and operational data into products that improve patient care and accelerate the business.

We are looking for a Senior Forward Deployed Data Engineer to work directly with internal business stakeholders and domain teams to design, build, and deploy high-impact analytics and AI solutions. Reporting directly to the Data & AI Engineering Tech Lead, you will act as the technical point-of-contact and primary builder for stakeholder initiatives, translating business needs into production-ready data and AI products. This is a hands-on, senior individual contributor role where you will write production code, develop semantic layers, and implement agentic workflows and LLM pipelines.

As a forward deployed engineer, you are AI-native by design—using AI coding harnesses and agentic tooling to accelerate development, testing, and documentation. You will partner closely with the Tech Lead to adopt foundational architecture patterns while rapidly delivering tailored solutions in a regulated environment where data quality, lineage, and privacy are essential.

The ideal candidate combines strong engineering fundamentals with a customer-obsessed mindset, pragmatic problem-solving, and the communication skills needed to bridge complex technical solutions and business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Stakeholder Engagement & Technical Ownership

  • Embed closely with business stakeholders to deeply understand their data and AI requirements, serving as their primary technical advisor and engineer.
  • Run launch discovery and impact analysis for new assays or products (models, views, dashboards touched), documented in Confluence and Jira.
  • Translate complex business challenges into clear technical specs and deliverable milestones, partnering with the Tech Lead to align with enterprise architecture standards.
  • Adhere to established engineering standards for pipeline design, data modeling, testing, version control (Git/GitLab branching, MRs, PRs) and CI/CD, ensuring deployed solutions are reliable and maintainable.

Hands-On Solutions Engineering

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and transformations on our cloud data platform, sourcing clinical, laboratory, operational, and commercial data to serve business analytics.
  • Develop governed data models and semantic layers that power self-service analytics, dashboards, and data products (e.g., Patient 360, Provider 360, Test 360) for business teams.
  • Develop AI solutions to enable business productivity and automation through use of agentic workflows, RAG/retrieval, and LLM pipelines (extraction/classification)
  • Write production-grade SQL and Python; contribute to shared frameworks, templates, and tooling that let the team deliver new analytics solutions faster.
  • Ensure the data layer supports performant, trustworthy analytics and LLM querying ; lead root-cause analysis on complex data issues and drive durable fixes.

AI-Native Execution & Continuous Learning

  • Leverage AI coding assistants and agentic tools daily across the full software development lifecycle to accelerate solution development and deployment speed.
  • Apply AI-native engineering best practices—such as prompt engineering, agentic workflows, and automated testing—to maximize individual output while upholding high quality.
  • Collaborate with the Tech Lead and peer engineers through code reviews, technical sharing, and feedback to continually refine forward deployed engineering practices.

Data Quality, Reliability & Compliance

  • Implement data quality checks, contracts, lineage, and monitoring so that downstream consumers can trust the data by default.
  • Own operational excellence for the team’s solutions: SLAs, incident response, and cost efficiency of compute and storage.
  • Ensure pipelines handling PHI and genomic data meet HIPAA, CLIA, and internal security and governance requirements, including access controls, auditability, and retention.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Work directly with business stakeholders across functions to understand their questions, shape analytics solutions to their needs, and communicate technical tradeoffs in plain language.
  • Collaborate with core platform and AI teams under the guidance of the Tech Lead to build solutions on enterprise foundations rather than isolated silos.
  • Represent the team in architecture forums, data governance discussions, and tool evaluations.

Qualifications

Required

  • 7+ years of data or software engineering experience, with a track record of forward-deployed or customer-facing engineering roles delivering analytics and AI solutions directly to stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to partner directly with non-technical business partners, translate technical concepts clearly, and manage project deliverables.
  • Demonstrated, hands-on use of AI coding assistants and agentic tools in daily engineering work, with a point of view on how to use them well.
  • Expert-level SQL and strong Python, with a track record of shipping and operating production data pipelines and data models at scale.
  • Deep experience with a modern cloud data warehouse and cloud infrastructure (Snowflake/AWS preferred).
  • Hands-on experience with transformation frameworks (dbt or equivalent) and workflow orchestration (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, or similar).
  • 1-2 years of practical background building with LLM frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent) alongside managed AI services and model routing gateways like Snowflake Cortex, AWS Bedrock, and foundational APIs.
  • Strong grounding in analytical data modeling (dimensional or domain-driven), semantic layers, data quality engineering, and CI/CD for data systems.

Preferred

  • Experience in healthcare, life sciences, or another regulated domain handling PHI or other sensitive data.
  • Experience with lab data management systems, lab informatics systems, bioinformatics pipelines is a plus
  • Snowflake experience, including performance tuning, cost management, and features such as dynamic tables, Snowpark, or Cortex.
  • Sigma experience, or experience with comparable BI and semantic-layer tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI), and an understanding of how to design data models for self-service consumption.
  • Working knowledge of Power BI, including dataset design, data source connectivity, and troubleshooting dashboards when upstream data changes.
  • Experience building and operating agentic or LLM-based workflows within the data development lifecycle.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and data observability tooling.
  • Experience integrating with Salesforce, laboratory information systems, or EHR data sources.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.
The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations.

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. Senior Project Manager

Full-time (40 hours per week), Remote (overlap with CET business hours required)

About Us

At The Global Talent Co., we provide opportunities to work with leading innovative technology companies worldwide, offering stable employment, competitive compensation, career growth, and access to a community of 25,000+ like-minded marketing professionals.

About the Company

You will be joining a small, AI-first digital publisher that runs evidence-based review and comparison websites, monetised through affiliate partnerships. The team is focused on an independent publishing project in the prop trading space — reading the fine print on evaluation challenges, costs, drawdown limits, payout conditions and trading rules so that traders know exactly what they are signing up for. Editorial standards are strict: ratings can't be bought, every claim is checked against primary sources, and accuracy comes before volume.

The Role

As Senior Project Manager, you will run the project end to end — owning day-to-day delivery and content quality across research, content, SEO, website improvements and commercial initiatives. This is a full-ownership role: goals are agreed with you, and how you get there is your call. You choose the methods, the tools and the order of work, and you decide whether a piece meets the editorial standard or goes back for revision.

You'll work closely with the CEO, who sets business priorities, alongside a specialist SEO advisor, a developer and a Social Media & Community Manager whose output you hold to the same editorial standard. The project is AI-first: research, briefs, drafts, data checks and reporting start in AI tools by default, and you are the human who answers for every published word. This role is ideal for an independent, results-driven operator who measures themselves on outcomes and keeps going until the page ranks and the numbers move.

Key Responsibilities

  • Run delivery: keep a clear backlog and weekly priorities, manage capacity, clear blockers and follow every piece of work through to an agreed standard

  • Hold the quality line — review drafts written by people or models for clarity, structure, accuracy, originality and usefulness, fix the simple things and give precise revision feedback on the rest

  • Turn SEO recommendations into briefs, content improvements, internal links and page updates, and check each finished page meets search intent and the brief

  • Design, document and maintain the AI workflows behind research, drafting, updates and quality checks, with a human check wherever errors could reach a reader

  • Keep content current — manage research, drafting, revisions and WordPress preparation for reviews, comparisons, guides and offers, and make sure verified changes to fees, rules or payout terms reach every affected page and table

  • Translate requirements into clear developer tickets with acceptance criteria, coordinate priorities and test delivered changes on staging

  • Check finished pages for source-data consistency, links and desktop/mobile presentation, then coordinate release

  • Align research and publishing dates with the social content calendar and review social output for accuracy and consistency

  • Report on delivery, content quality, traffic, search and commercial performance using GA4, Search Console and affiliate reports, and act on what you find

Ideal Candidate

  • Proven record of running SEO projects — you owned the plan and the delivery and can show before-and-after numbers from Search Console, GA4 or Ahrefs

  • AI-first way of working: you use Claude, ChatGPT or similar tools daily for research, drafting, analysis and quality checks, know where their output fails, and own the final result

  • Track record of owning delivery on content-led digital projects, with clear examples of personal responsibility and results

  • Strong editorial judgment and excellent written English — you can spot weak, repetitive or unsupported content, explain what needs fixing and improve it

  • Working SEO knowledge across search intent, content structure, internal linking and content updates; confident with WordPress, spreadsheets, source data, GA4 and Search Console

  • Experience managing contributors, deadlines and handoffs in a PM tool such as Notion, ClickUp or Asana, plus enough technical understanding to brief a developer and test changes against requirements

  • Familiarity with prop trading concepts (evaluations, drawdown, payout conditions, trading restrictions), or evidence that you learn technical niches quickly

  • Able to work with consistent overlap with CET business hours

  • Independent thinker who forms their own view, pushes back when the evidence says otherwise, and starts on the next problem without waiting to be asked

  • High achiever who is comfortable in a role that isn't a 9-to-5 and measures success in results

Nice to Have

  • Experience in affiliate publishing

  • GitHub workflows

  • Data reconciliation

  • Workflow automation

Tools & Stack

Claude, ChatGPT, WordPress, GA4, Google Search Console, Ahrefs, affiliate reporting, Notion / ClickUp / Asana, spreadsheets

Join Our Team Be part of a collaborative, innovative environment where your technical skills and product instincts can make a real impact. We offer competitive compensation, professional development opportunities, and a supportive remote work culture. Apply now and take the next step in your career.

jobs.description:
Join a short, paid project that tests whether AI coding agents work as well on instructions written in the target language as they do in English. Your language skills and technical background decide where you fit.

About the project

Welo Data is helping evaluate how well AI coding agents perform when the instructions they receive are written in languages other than English. Agents are given a real software engineering task in a code repository, and automated tests check whether they solved it. The code, repositories and tests stay exactly as they are. Only the human-written instructions change language, so the quality of every instruction directly affects the result.

About the roles

There are two roles on this project. We place you in one of them based on your experience& skillsets.

  • Translator: translate English software engineering task briefs into the target language. You keep every requirement, constraint and success condition, and you leave commands, file paths, API names, code and test conditions exactly as written in English. This role suits people with a stronger technical background, and translation experience is a plus.

  • Reviewer: compare each translation with the English source, check that nothing is missing, added or changed in meaning, correct errors, and log each correction by error type. This role suits people with strong translation, editing or review experience and enough technical familiarity to read code context.

Who we are looking for

  • Native or near-native writing in the target language, and strong reading ability in English.

  • Either professional experience in translation, editing, review or technical writing, or a software background combined with excellent writing in the target language

  • Comfort reading technical text. Coding experience is a strong plus for the translation role and helpful for the review role.

  • Close attention to detail. In this project, a dropped clause can make a task fail.

Project at a glance

  • Project duration: one week since the mid of November

  • Languages: Japanese

  • Project time commitment: 6 hours per person

  • Project compensation: varies depends on different programming language

  • Work location: fully remote

How selection works (major steps)

  1. Screening questions: about 2 minutes. They cover your language background, translation and review experience, which programming languages you know and how well, and your availability.

  1. Language test: short exercises in the target language.

  1. Programming skills assessment: you will be invited to another opportunity, in the programming language you know best (Rust, Go, Python, or TypeScript / JavaScript). It confirms your technical level and places you in a language track.

  1. Financial Onboarding & Role placement:complete the financial onboarding with Welo Data. In the meanwhile, you will be informed about the decision whether you are placed in the initial translation role or the review role.

  1. Production: once you finish all steps above, our project team will contact you for production.

jobs.excerpt: About Auris Practice Solutions, LLC Auris Practice Solutions is a remote audiology services company that partners with hearing care practices and ENT groups across the country.
jobs.description:
About Auris Practice Solutions, LLC

Auris Practice Solutions is a remote audiology services company that partners with hearing care practices and ENT groups across the country. Through the MaestroAuD® and MaestroFusion® product lines, Auris delivers clinical capacity and practice support that allow partner practices to serve more patients. Our team of remote audiologists and hearing care providers works in a growing number of states, and our operations must keep pace with that growth.

Schedule: Part-time, 15 to 20 hours per week

Location: Remote (United States)

Classification: W-2 Part-Time, Hourly (Non-Exempt)

Compensation: $28 - $35 per hour, commensurate with experience

Reports to: Strategic Operations Manager

Position Summary

The Business Operations Administrator manages core business operations for Auris, working closely with the Strategic Operations Manager and the Managing Members. This individual manages monthly customer invoicing in QuickBooks, administers partner agreements once a practice has decided to move forward, supports the partner launch team, coordinates onboarding and offboarding, and maintains Auris registrations in the states where its people work. The position supports the business side of the company and collaborates with the clinical team and other departments. The role suits a highly organized, detail-driven professional who works independently, handles confidential information with discretion, and takes ownership of deadlines.

Key Responsibilities

Operations Coordination Prepare and finalize business correspondence, agreements, and internal documents.

  • Track operational action items and deadlines and follow up to keep open items moving.
  • Coordinate scheduling for partner, vendor, and internal meetings as requested.
  • Maintain organized digital filing for finance, contracts, HR, and compliance records.

Bookkeeping and Customer Invoicing

  • Prepare and send monthly invoices to partner practices in QuickBooks Online.
  • Confirm that all consumables used during the month are added to each partner practice monthly invoice.
  • Manage hearing aid fees due from partner practices to Auris, and confirm each fee is invoiced and collected.
  • Track accounts receivable and follow up on past-due balances.
  • Record transactions, process vendor bills, and reconcile bank and credit card accounts monthly.
  • Collect W-9s from contractors and vendors, prepare year-end 1099 filings, and provide records to the outside CPA.

Partner Contract Administration

  • Prepare partner agreements, schedules, and Business Associate Agreements from approved templates once a practice has decided to move forward.
  • Manage the exchange of drafts and revisions with the practice, track open items, and escalate substantive changes to the Managing Members.
  • Route final agreements for signature, file executed copies, and notify the launch team that the agreement is complete.
  • Maintain a contract tracker with effective dates, renewal dates, and notice deadlines.

Partner Launch Support

  • Complete assigned business-side launch tasks for new partner practices, including agreement completion, billing setup, and partner account records.
  • Collect partner information and documents required for contracting and invoicing, and track business launch checklist items to completion.

Onboarding, Offboarding, and HR Administration

  • Coordinate administrative onboarding and offboarding steps for employees and contractors, including agreements, equipment shipment and recovery, and system access requests.
  • Update the professional liability carrier roster for provider additions and separations.
  • Maintain confidential personnel and contractor files, and prepare employment verification letters.

State Registration and Compliance

  • Register Auris as a foreign entity when a remote employee resides in a new state, and establish state withholding and unemployment insurance accounts.
  • Maintain a compliance calendar of annual reports, registered agent renewals, and business license deadlines, and file on time.

Qualifications Required

  • Three or more years of experience in business operations, bookkeeping, or office management, preferably in a small or remote company.
  • Working knowledge of QuickBooks Online, including reconciliations and invoicing.
  • Experience with contract administration and electronic signature platforms.
  • Familiarity with state business registration and state tax account setup.
  • Strong organization, accuracy, and follow-through, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines independently.
  • Proven discretion with confidential employee, financial, and health-related information.
  • Clear, professional written communication.

Preferred

  • Experience in a healthcare organization and familiarity with HIPAA.
  • Experience with DocuSign, Rippling, and Microsoft 365.
  • QuickBooks ProAdvisor certification.

Work Environment

This is a fully remote position. The individual must maintain a private, secure workspace with reliable high-speed internet and be available during standard business hours on a consistent weekly schedule. Hours may increase during partner launches and year-end close.

How to Apply

Submit your resume with 2-3 references, and a brief cover letter describing relevant operations, bookkeeping, and contract administration experience via the link above.

Auris Practice Solutions is an equal opportunity employer.

Expérience en définition des besoins d’affaires, en essais d’acceptation utilisateurs et en implantation d’améliorations aux systèmes ou aux processus.
