jobs.description:
Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day.

Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu, founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences.

Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta.

About the role:

Cresta’s AI Receptionist answers the phone for small businesses that would otherwise miss the call. It handles millions of conversations a month today, making sure no call goes unanswered and helping owners complete the front-office tasks that keep their business running, and it does so across hundreds of customers. Whether those conversations are actually good is the single most important question in the business, and it deserves a full-time owner. That’s you.
As our first AI Agent Evaluation Engineer, you define what quality means for every agent we run, you build the systems that measure it across every conversation, and you are the person the company trusts when the question is “how good is it, really?”
The work combines hands-on conversation analysis, rigorous evaluation design, and engineering execution: reading and annotating real conversations to learn how the agent actually fails, building the automated evaluation systems (LLM-based judges, golden sets, regression suites) that measure those failures at scale, and keeping those systems honest by calibrating them against human judgment. Fixing what you find is welcome but not the core of the job; an accurate, prioritized picture of agent quality is.

What You'll Do :

Evaluation Design & Quality Definition

  • Define and maintain the evaluation rubric for the agent across three axes: adherence (did it follow its design, call the right tools, respect guardrails), outcome (did the conversation achieve its goal), and conversation experience (latency, turn-taking, tone, repetition).
  • Write the annotation guidelines and failure taxonomy the team uses to talk about failures precisely; run calibration sessions and measure inter-rater agreement.
    • Classify and prioritize failure modes by severity and frequency so engineering and product work on what matters most.

Conversation Analysis & Annotation

  • Review production conversations by hand every week, leverage QA partners; open-code failures, cluster them, and turn the clusters into the evaluations worth automating.
  • Trace each failure to its likely cause (prompt, knowledge gap, tool or flow bug, speech recognition) and route it to the right owner with enough evidence to act on.
  • Evaluate across languages and report quality by segment (language, accent, audio quality, intent), not just in aggregate.

Scalable Evaluation Systems

  • Build and operate the evaluation pipeline that scores every production conversation, combining automated checks, LLM-based judges, and human review.
  • Calibrate every automated judge against human labels before trusting it; treat judge error as the primary measurement risk.
  • Design sampling strategies (stratified by intent, language, caller type, audio conditions) so that reported changes in quality are real.
  • Build and maintain the golden set and regression suite that every prompt, model, knowledge, and flow change is validated against before release.

Coverage & Edge Cases

  • Maintain the failure-mode coverage map: which behaviors are tested, partially tested, or unmeasured; close the gaps.
  • Design evaluations for behaviors no standard harness covers: high-stakes conversation types such as handoffs to a human, misuse and unwanted-caller handling, and resilience under upstream failures.
  • Define the quality and latency thresholds the agent is held to.

Reporting & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Report quality trends to internal stakeholders and customers clearly, with uncertainty stated and without burying bad news.
  • Partner with forward-deployed engineers, backend engineers, product managers, and the voice/language engineering team to turn findings into prioritized recommendations.
  • Document methodology so results are reproducible and the evaluation practice outlives any one person.

What We're Looking For:

  • 3+ years of professional experience in software engineering, applied ML, or data-intensive research roles, including at least 1–2 years working hands-on with LLM-based systems in production.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computational Linguistics, Cognitive Science, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Built and operated an end-to-end evaluation system for a production LLM product (agent or otherwise): rubric, human labels, automated judge, regression suite.
  • Deep understanding of evaluation methodology: what golden sets, judges, regression suites, and calibration are for, and when each fails. Tool-agnostic; you will work in our in-house tooling.
  • Fluent in how LLM agents work: prompts, tool calls, context handling, multi-turn state. You can read a trace and tell what the agent was doing and why.
  • Strong programming skills in Python and experience with LLM APIs; able to build and ship evaluation tooling independently. Fine-tuning and ML frameworks are not required.
  • Able to write a rubric that independent reviewers would score the same way, and to measure whether they do.
  • Able to design a test from an open-ended quality question: you decide what to measure and how, rather than executing a predefined plan.
  • Willing to do non-scalable work weekly, both yourself and by directing our QA partners: listening to calls, labeling conversations, building a failure taxonomy from scratch.
  • Professional fluency in at least one language other than English, sufficient to evaluate multilingual agent behavior directly.
  • Strong written communication; you author the guidelines others follow.

Note on Our Hiring Process

We highly value your time and engineering craftsmanship. To ensure a streamlined and objective process, the first step for qualified applicants following an initial resume review is a self-paced CoderPad technical assessment. This allows you to showcase your practical coding and problem-solving skills in a real-world environment before moving into conversational interview rounds.

Perks & Benefits:

We offer a comprehensive and people-first benefits package to support you at work and in life:

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with plans to fit you and your family
  • Flexible PTO to take the time you need, when you need it
  • Paid parental leave for all new parents welcoming a new child
  • Retirement savings plan to help you plan for the future
  • Remote work setup budget to help you create a productive home office
  • Monthly wellness and communication stipend to keep you connected and balanced
  • In-office meal program and commuter benefits provided for onsite employees

Compensation at Cresta:

Cresta’s approach to compensation is simple: recognize impact, reward excellence, and invest in our people. We offer competitive, location-based pay that reflects the market and what each individual brings to the table.

The posted base salary range represents what we expect to pay for this role in a given location. Final offers are shaped by factors like experience, skills, education, and geography. In addition to base pay, total compensation includes equity and a comprehensive benefits package for you and your family.

Our use of AI in recruiting: We may use AI tools in our recruiting process, which require human review and oversight. If you have questions about our use of AI or wish to opt out, please contact (if you are opting out, please use the subject ‘Opt-Out’ in your email).
Recording & AI transcription: We do not authorize candidates to record or use AI transcription of any interview by phone, notetaker app, AI glasses, or other device. Candidates may request an exception or accommodation for review during the interview process as needed.
Recruiting impersonation scams: We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Cresta recruiting email communications will always come from the @cresta.ai domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Cresta via other sources should be ignored.

jobs.title: IBCLC, Telehealth Lactation Consultant
jobs.excerpt: About SimpliFedSimpliFed is a virtual maternal health company.
jobs.description:
About SimpliFed

SimpliFed is a virtual maternal health company. We start with feeding support (lactation care, pumping and supply help, and prescribing for breast pumps and related needs) and build from there into care across pregnancy and postpartum, including postpartum mood screening and connection to the right next level of care. Our clinicians see families by video across the U.S., working alongside health plans, health systems, and breast pump suppliers.

We believe the key to every happy, healthy baby is a happy, healthy parent.

How we think about feeding

We help families feed their babies in whatever way works for them: nursing, exclusive pumping, formula, combination feeding, donor milk, supplementing, or weaning. Our job is to give parents accurate information and real support for their goals, not to judge their choices. A confident, supported parent and a fed, growing baby are the outcomes we care about.

We hire clinicians who share this view and show it in how they talk with families.

The role

You'll see new and expecting parents by video for lactation and feeding visits: assessment, care planning, and ongoing support through their feeding journey. This is a lactation role and does not include prescribing. You'll work closely with our nurse practitioners, who handle breast pump orders and medications.

What you'll do

  • Run prenatal and postpartum video visits covering feeding assessment, latch and positioning, milk supply, pumping and flange fit, supplementing, bottle feeding, formula transitions, and weaning.
  • Build practical care plans around each family's own feeding goals.
  • Screen for red flags (infant weight and hydration, parental pain or infection, postpartum mood) and escalate or refer per SimpliFed protocols.
  • Hand off to our NP/APP team when a visit shows a need for a breast pump order or medication.
  • Document every visit clearly and on time in our EHR.
  • Follow families across multiple visits, not just one.

Required

  • Current IBCLC certification (IBLCE), in good standing.
  • Available at least 15 hours a week. 20+ hours preferred.
  • A private, quiet space for video visits, reliable high-speed internet, and a computer with a camera that meets our telehealth platform requirements.

Preferred

  • The same days and times each week (fixed weekly blocks).
  • 20+ hours a week, including evening or weekend blocks. We see families 8am to 10pm ET.
  • Telehealth lactation experience, including prenatal and pump consults.
  • An individual NPI and an active CAQH profile; current enrollment with major health plans.
  • Bilingual in Spanish and English (or another language our families speak).
  • Experience working alongside prescribers (NP or MD) in shared care.
  • A Connecticut or Rhode Island lactation consultant license. Both states license lactation consultants; tell us if you hold either.
  • An RN license? See our Registered Nurse, IBCLC role.

Where we're hiring

IBCLC is a national certification, so we hire from every state. Demand is highest for families in:

States

Demand

Florida, New York, California, Texas

Highest

New Jersey, North Carolina, Virginia, Georgia

Strong and steady

Illinois, Maryland, Arizona, Pennsylvania

Solid and growing

Because we cover families across time zones until 10pm ET, clinicians in Central, Mountain, and Pacific time who can take evening Eastern blocks are especially helpful.

Schedule and commitment

We're building a team of fewer, more committed clinicians rather than a large panel of low-hour contractors. It gets families seen faster and gives you a steadier caseload. We look for at least 15 hours a week of availability. Clinicians who can offer the same days and times each week, and more hours, get priority scheduling and more volume.

Getting started

After you accept an offer, you'll start an onboarding period: credentialing, systems setup, and training. Our aim is to have you seeing families as soon as possible, though please note that credentialing can take between 30 and 90 days.

Credentialing with licensing boards and health plans can take 30 to 90 days from your hire date to delivering care, depending on your licenses and which health plans you'll see patients under. We'll tell you up front what to expect for your situation and start the paperwork the day you accept.

Pay

Hourly rates for 1099 contract roles, by regional market tier (based on where you live):

  • Tier 1 (CA, NY, MA, NJ, HI, MD): $48–$53/hr
  • Tier 2 (IL, CO, OR, VA, PA, AZ, MN): $42–$46/hr
  • Tier 3 (NC, GA, FL, TX, TN, OH, MI, IN, SC, WI, MO, and states not listed): $38–$42/hr
  • Tier 4 (MS, AR, WV, KY, OK, AL, LA): $34–$38/hr

Part-time and full-time W2 roles are also available for clinicians who commit to more hours.

Senior Account Executive - Life Sciences (US, Remote)

➡️ Frustrated selling a product that's difficult to differentiate or competing purely on price?

➡️ Want to represent an AI platform trusted by Pfizer, Moderna, Roche, GSK and thousands of other innovation-led organisations?

➡️ Looking for enterprise sales cycles that challenge you intellectually, create genuine customer impact, and reward high performance?

If this sounds like your next move, we’d love to hear from you.

Role Summary:

The Life Sciences industry is changing rapidly, and AI is becoming central to how the world's leading pharmaceutical and biotech companies innovate. At Patsnap, we're at the heart of that transformation.

We're looking for a Senior Account Executive to help accelerate one of our fastest-growing business units. With 20%+ year-on-year growth, significant investment in AI, and ambitious expansion plans, there's never been a more exciting time to join our Life Sciences team.

This isn't about selling another point solution.

You'll represent one of the most comprehensive AI-powered Innovation Intelligence platforms on the market, bringing together patents, scientific literature, clinical trials, regulatory intelligence, market data and proprietary AI to help customers make smarter R&D and IP decisions.

Trusted by organisations including Pfizer, Moderna, Roche, Novartis, GSK, Bayer, Sanofi and Johnson & Johnson, you'll partner with global pharmaceutical, biotech and medical device companies to solve some of their most important innovation challenges—from accelerating drug discovery to reducing R&D risk and shaping long-term innovation strategy.

You'll own strategic enterprise opportunities from prospecting through to close, engaging senior stakeholders across R&D, Innovation, Intellectual Property and the C-suite. These are commercially significant, multi-stakeholder sales cycles where you'll build trusted relationships, influence complex buying decisions and deliver measurable business value.

If you're looking for a role where you can sell a genuinely differentiated product, own a strategic territory, and play a key role in one of Patsnap's highest-growth markets, we'd love to hear from you.

Want to see the platform you'd be representing?

Check out this short overview:

This is a remote US-based position, ideally suited for candidates able to work flexibly across EST hours.

Who are we?

Patsnap is a global, pre-IPO company that transforms the way organizations harness their Intellectual Property and Research & Development productivity. Our platform revolutionizes how IP and R&D teams collaborate across the entire innovation lifecycle, using domain-specific AI to accelerate the creation of market-ready products. With over 12,000 customers worldwide, including some of the biggest names in innovation, Patsnap is at the forefront of technological advancement. Our $300M Series E funding round brings our valuation to a $1 billion unicorn status, and we still have a remarkable amount of growth ahead.

As the leading global Life Sciences intelligence platform, Patsnap helps pharmaceutical, biotech, medical device, and life sciences organisations make better innovation decisions. By connecting patents, scientific literature, clinical trials, regulatory data, and market intelligence, we enable our customers to identify white spaces, reduce R&D risk, and accelerate breakthrough innovation.

We have a vibrant and diverse team with offices in Singapore, Toronto, London, Shanghai and remote teams based in US. Our hyper-growth trajectory is powered by our people, and we are extremely proud of our company-wide vision, work ethic, and entrepreneurial spirit. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where talent thrives and ideas bloom.

Why Join Patsnap?

  • Sell a platform customers genuinely want to buy. Trusted by leading Life Sciences organisations including Pfizer, Moderna, Roche, Novartis, GSK, Bayer, Sanofi and Johnson & Johnson, Patsnap helps customers solve mission-critical R&D and innovation challenges.

  • Join one of our fastest-growing business units. With 20%+ year-on-year growth, significant investment in AI, and ambitious expansion plans, there's never been a more exciting time to join our Life Sciences team.

  • Own a high-value territory with real opportunity. Take ownership of strategic enterprise accounts, combining new business with significant expansion potential across pharmaceutical, biotech and medical device organisations.

  • Sell a genuinely differentiated solution. Patsnap brings together AI, patents, scientific literature, clinical trials, regulatory intelligence and market data in one platform, helping customers make smarter innovation and R&D decisions.

  • Have conversations that matter. Partner with senior stakeholders across R&D, Innovation, Intellectual Property and Commercial leadership, influencing decisions that shape future products, portfolios and scientific breakthroughs.

  • Join a high-performance commercial team. Work alongside experienced sales leaders in a collaborative culture that values curiosity, ownership, continuous learning and shared success.

  • Accelerate your career. As Patsnap continues to invest in Life Sciences globally, you'll have the opportunity to grow into strategic account leadership, larger enterprise opportunities, or broader commercial leadership roles.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Own the full enterprise sales cycle from prospecting through to negotiation and close.

  • Build and execute a territory strategy to drive new logo acquisition across pharmaceutical, biotechnology and medical device organisations.

  • Develop executive relationships across R&D, Innovation, Intellectual Property and Commercial leadership teams.

  • Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales processes, creating consensus across technical and commercial buyers.

  • Build, manage and accurately forecast a healthy pipeline of enterprise opportunities.

  • Partner closely with SDRs, Customer Success, Product and Marketing to maximise territory growth.

  • Become a trusted advisor by understanding customer innovation challenges and demonstrating measurable business value.

  • Consistently achieve and exceed revenue targets while contributing to the continued growth of the Life Sciences business.

Requirements

What We'd Love From You:

  • 3+ years of a proven track record of consistently hitting or exceeding quota in B2B SaaS or technology sales

  • Experience selling into Life Sciences organisations, including pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device or adjacent markets.

  • Confident in high-volume outbound outreach; from cold calling to pipeline building and engaging prospects.

  • Confidence managing complex, consultative enterprise sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders.

  • Experience engaging senior decision-makers and executive buyers.

  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to translate technical capabilities into business value.

  • A proactive, self-motivated approach with experience building pipeline alongside inbound opportunities.

  • Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills.

  • A growth mindset, intellectual curiosity and a genuine interest in AI, innovation and Life Sciences.

Benefits & Perks:

A genuinely strong sales culture we’re really proud of. High-performing but low ego, social, and dynamic. It’s a team that supports each other, shares best practice, raises standards, and celebrates wins properly together. Alongside a great product, it’s one of the best parts of working here.

Additional benefits

  • Unlimited vacation

  • 2 volunteer days for community volunteering

  • Health and dental benefits for you and your dependents from day one

  • 401K matching

  • Remote work environment + WFH stipend for your home office set-up

  • 24/7 employee assistance program which provides access to virtual healthcare, therapy, financial and legal assistance, wellness counselling and resources for family support.

Patsnap is proud to be an equal opportunity employer (EOE) that champions diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, citizenship, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, age, or marital, veteran/military, or disability status, or any other protected status in accordance with federal, provincial/state or local laws.

Even if you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, we encourage you to apply and tell us why you’d be a great fit for this role! If you require any accommodations during the interview process, please email us at so we can best support you.

  • Collaborates with team members and internal departments on inquiries, escalations, client communications, reporting needs, and event-related communication support. • Serves as a direct fund contact and liaison for assigned Alternative fund clients operational matters. • Maintains periodic contact with shareholders, fund families, and internal partners regarding account-related and event-related matters. • Partners with transfer agent teams to support communication coverage, procedure updates, inquiry resolution, and completion of priority items during peak periods. May perform other duties as required and assigned.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

Experience within the financial services industry. Experience supporting Alternative Investment products preferred. Series 6 or 7 license is an asset.

Operational standards, SEC, AML, IRS, fund governing document, prospectus, subscription document, tender offer, and capital call requirements. Client communication standards, relationship management practices, inquiry management, issue resolution, and escalation support expectations. Alternative investment products, including REITs, BDCs, CEFs, interval funds, tender offer funds, and other registered or private Alternative products. Transfer agent operations related to Alternative fund closes, repurchases, tenders, capital calls, warehoused activity, reconciliations, shareholder servicing, and client communications. General Transfer agent operations knowledge encompassing all aspects of Transfer Agent Operations. Microsoft Office Suite. Adobe Acrobat.

Leadership skills to foster a positive work environment that encourages teamwork, motivation, efficiency, and maximum utilization of associate skills. Understanding of clients’ businesses, Alternative fund structures, communication needs, and operational requirements to proactively anticipate complications. Aligns associates with company values, department goals, quality expectations, communication standards, and service standards. Plans and delegates work within assigned responsibilities. Motivates and inspires others through effective communication, coaching, training, and practical support. Assesses the performance of self and associates to support improvements or corrective action. Plans and develops systems, templates, standards, and procedures to improve operating quality and efficiency of the department in accordance with company policies and procedures. Troubleshoots complex communication and servicing issues utilizing creative and critical thinking skills. Strong multitasking, analytical, organizational, follow-up, and relationship-building skills. Initiative-taking, strategic, and meticulous approach with a strong commitment to quality, efficiency, and effectiveness. Demonstrates personal integrity, responsibility, and accountability. Effectively uses resources such as time and information in conjunction with associates. Participates in solving problems and making decisions. Presents and expresses ideas and information, written and oral, clearly and concisely. Actively listens to others to achieve understanding and supports an open exchange of ideas and information. Identifies needs, arranges for, and obtains resources to accomplish individual and department goals. Establishes and develops effective working relationships with associates, clients, and business partners during both favorable and unfavorable situations. Modifies team and individual priorities and deadlines in response to added information, changing conditions, or unexpected obstacles and ensures completion.

At times, as business needs arise, associates are required and agree to work beyond their normal workday or work week to fulfill the accountabilities required for their job. You will own technical direction and delivery for scheduling, dispatch, field and mobile workflows, and the software that connects equipment and home technology to the operation.

A likely first assignment is an “Air Traffic Control” system for field operations. A supervisor needs to understand what is happening and act when the plan breaks: a flat tire, a delayed visit, a missing piece of equipment, or a member whose availability changes. You will work with the people doing the job to decide what they need to see, what the system can help resolve, and when a human should intervene.

This is a hands-on role that spans product and engineering. You will understand the business problem, shape the solution, build useful increments, and see whether they work. You may start without direct reports and can expect to coach and eventually manage one or two engineers. You should enjoy building personally and helping others become more capable.

We value a tinkering instinct: try the unfamiliar tool, inspect the data, trace the failure, put a small improvement in front of a user, and learn from what happens. Hardware or connected-device experience can be a strong signal of that mindset, but it is not required. The central work is building dependable software for an operation that changes throughout the day.

As an Engineering Lead, Clinical Operations, you will:

  • Work directly with supervisors, clinical field staff, and operations leaders to understand schedules, travel, capacity, handoffs, and the exceptions that disrupt a day’s work.
  • Build field visibility and intervention tools that give supervisors useful context, distinguish current facts from missing information, and help them respond to changing conditions.
  • Develop scheduling and dispatch capabilities that match people and visits to practical constraints, with clear ways for operating staff to review and adjust the plan.
  • Build and debug APIs, mobile workflows, integrations, and data flows supporting field teams, connected equipment, and home technology.
  • Prototype quickly and ship focused increments. Make deliberate choices about what to build, integrate, or buy, and avoid committing to a large system before the operation has tested the approach.
  • Use AI actively for development, investigation, prototypes, analysis, and useful workflow capabilities. Check the behavior and make failures understandable and recoverable.
  • Coach engineers and take on a small number of direct reports as the team develops. Maintain clear ownership, sound engineering practices, and credible delivery commitments.

Success in this role looks like:

  • First 90 days: You understand how the field operation works, have shipped an improvement used by supervisors or field staff, and can show what it changed. You have a focused technical plan grounded in real constraints and exceptions.
  • First six months: Several useful increments are in place. Supervisors can understand and respond to disruptions more effectively, scheduling and field workflows are improving, and technical ownership is clear.

  • You are a strong production software engineer who has owned meaningful work end-to-end and still builds regularly.

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

GitLab’s Forward Deployed Engineering team is a field-situated product engineering function focused on strategic customer outcomes, artificial intelligence (AI) adoption, and direct contributions to GitLab’s product. This isn't a traditional field engineering, solutions architecture, or professional services role. As a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll work closely with customers while maintaining the technical standards and contribution discipline of a Staff-level product engineer.

You'll work where strategic customer urgency, complex technical ambiguity, and GitLab product execution intersect. You'll partner directly with strategic customers and teams across Product, Engineering, Support, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Solutions Architecture (SA), Customer Success Architecture (CSA), Customer Success Management (CSM), and Professional Services. You'll diagnose and resolve high-impact adoption blockers, contribute production-quality fixes and features, and turn what you learn into repeatable patterns for GitLab and its customers.

Why this role exists

Strategic customers sometimes encounter challenges that are too broad, deep, urgent, or cross-functional for any single team to own from start to finish. These challenges may involve product gaps, performance degradation, scale bottlenecks, AI governance, adoption blockers, architectural constraints, Git usage patterns, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) complexity, application programming interface (API) automation, security requirements, or operational instability.

Forward Deployed Engineering provides technical stewardship in these moments. The team doesn't simply observe, report, or escalate. You'll engage directly, diagnose the underlying technical problem, collaborate with the right teams, contribute code or technical solutions where appropriate, and transition the outcome into normal ownership once the customer is stable and the learning can be reused.

What you’ll do

Product contribution

  • Contribute production-quality code to GitLab’s product and adjacent systems.
  • Develop bug fixes, features, integrations, tooling, and performance improvements when strategic customer outcomes require direct engineering work.
  • Work within GitLab’s product and engineering processes, including issue discovery, merge request creation, testing, review, documentation, and maintainability.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering so customer-driven solutions support long-term product direction rather than becoming one-off customizations.
  • Turn blockers discovered in the field into durable product improvements, reference architectures, documentation, and repeatable implementation patterns.

Strategic technical stewardship

  • Engage with strategically important customers when adoption, retention, executive confidence, or public trust is materially at risk.
  • Diagnose complex problems across GitLab product behavior, customer architecture, Git internals, CI/CD workflows, API usage, observability, infrastructure, networking, and cloud environments.
  • Coordinate across Product, Engineering, SRE, Support, SA, CSA, CSM, Professional Services, and customer technical teams to drive resolution from discovery through handoff.
  • Provide recommendations grounded in data, traces, and systems analysis to improve GitLab usage, workflows, automation, and architecture.
  • Create durable outcomes without establishing permanent dependency on Forward Deployed Engineering.

AI adoption and agentic software development lifecycle

  • Drive governed, measurable, and production-oriented adoption of GitLab Duo Agent Platform with strategic customers.
  • Identify and resolve AI adoption blockers involving governance, usage controls, auditability, security, compliance, operating models, workflow design, and integrations.
  • Develop customer-safe adoption patterns for the agentic software development lifecycle (SDLC), AI-assisted development, intent-based review, AI governance, and human-in-the-loop software delivery.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Field, and Customer Success teams to turn AI adoption learning into reusable guidance and product improvements.

Thought leadership

  • Create technical narratives grounded in customer experience and product reality that can help shape the industry’s approach.
  • Contribute to Well-Architected Frameworks, whitepapers, webinars, reference architectures, technical strategy memos, and adoption frameworks.
  • Guide ideas through discovery, formulation, validation, amplification, and adoption across GitLab.
  • Partner with SA, CSA, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Product Marketing Management, CSM, Support, and executive stakeholders to make technical thought leadership a shared company capability.

What you’ll bring

  • Staff-level experience building, operating, or improving complex production software systems.
  • Experience contributing to large, mature product codebases with high standards for testing, maintainability, performance, and security.
  • Strong Ruby on Rails or Go experience and the ability to contribute directly to GitLab’s product and adjacent systems.
  • Experience with AI-assisted software development, agentic workflows, AI governance, model evaluation, context management, prompt and workflow design, or AI adoption in enterprise environments.
  • Experience diagnosing complex system behavior across application code, data stores, infrastructure, observability, networking, APIs, and customer usage patterns.
  • Deep knowledge of modern DevSecOps workflows, including Git, merge requests, CI/CD, security controls, compliance needs, and enterprise software delivery.
  • Experience working with strategic customers or senior technical stakeholders in ambiguous, high-impact situations.
  • The ability to coordinate across product, engineering, field, and customer teams without formal authority.
  • Strong written communication and sound judgment, including the ability to create technical narratives and distinguish reusable product work from customer-specific customization.

Strongly preferred qualifications

  • Direct experience with GitLab as a platform, including GitLab.com, GitLab Dedicated, or GitLab Self-Managed.
  • Production experience with Ruby on Rails, Go, PostgreSQL, Redis, Sidekiq, Vue, TypeScript, Kubernetes, Docker, Linux, or observability tools.
  • Deep familiarity with Git internals, repository performance, large-scale Git usage patterns, or GitLab Runner behavior.
  • Experience creating technical thought-leadership materials, such as whitepapers, technical talks, architecture frameworks, requests for comments, public technical writing, or internal strategy documents.
  • A background in performance engineering, site reliability engineering, platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, or distributed systems.
  • Experience working in open source or highly asynchronous engineering environments.

Technologies and domains

Directly relevant technologies and domains include:

  • Ruby on Rails
  • Go
  • AI-assisted development and the agentic SDLC
  • PostgreSQL
  • Redis and Sidekiq
  • Git internals
  • GitLab CI/CD and Runner architecture
  • Kubernetes and containers
  • Terraform
  • Linux, networking, observability, and performance analysis
  • Vue and TypeScript
  • APIs and automation
  • DevSecOps governance, security, and compliance

What this role is not

This role isn't:

  • A generic field engineering role.
  • A proof-of-concept factory.
  • A replacement for Solutions Architecture, Customer Success Architecture, Customer Success Management, Professional Services, Support, SRE, Product, or Engineering.
  • A customer-specific customization function.
  • Unbilled Professional Services.
  • A requirements-gathering role that only escalates to Product.
  • An AI evangelism role disconnected from product execution.

Success measures

Success in this role may include:

  • Stabilizing strategic customer adoption or retention risks.
  • Fixing product bugs or contributing features.
  • Removing AI adoption blockers for strategic accounts.
  • Creating reusable implementation patterns and transitioning them to long-term owners.
  • Producing or enabling Well-Architected Frameworks, whitepapers, webinars, or technical narratives.
  • Resolving cross-functional customer challenges without creating permanent dependency on Forward Deployed Engineering.
  • Equipping Product, Engineering, Support, CSA, CSM, Professional Services, and SA teams with better guidance based on learning from the field.
  • Increasing adoption and effective use of GitLab capabilities, especially GitLab Duo and GitLab Duo Agent Platform, in targeted accounts.

About the team

The Forward Deployed Engineering team connects strategic customer needs with GitLab product execution. The team works directly with customers and across GitLab to resolve complex adoption challenges, contribute durable product improvements, and create reusable technical guidance. Its goal is to stabilize urgent situations, improve the product, and transition ongoing ownership to the appropriate team rather than create a permanent dependency.

You're a Staff-level product or platform engineer who can operate in the field without becoming field-only. You're comfortable reading traces, writing production code, debugging architecture, discussing AI governance, leading a customer technical session, opening a merge request, outlining a whitepaper, and coordinating across teams to achieve a strategic customer outcome.

You're not simply a strong communicator with technical awareness. You're a credible engineer with the judgment, presence, and narrative ability to turn customer reality into product contributions, adoption guidance, and company-level thought leadership.

jobs.description:
Die Rolle auf einen Blick

Als Business Development Representative – bei uns auch Business Developer oder Sales Development Representative – gewinnst du Neukunden für die Compliance-Plattform von Bits und baust B2B-Beziehungen zu regulierten Finanzunternehmen in Europa auf: Banken, Neobanken, Payment-Anbieter, Kreditgeber sowie Investment- und Fondsgesellschaften. Dein wichtigstes Werkzeug ist das Telefon: Du bist ein echtes Call-Talent, das Entscheider in wenigen Minuten für ein Gespräch gewinnt.

Standort: Remote (Deutschland) · Start: ab sofort · Umfang: Vollzeit

Über Bits Technology

Bits Technology baut Compliance-Infrastruktur für regulierte Finanzunternehmen in der EU: KYB- und KYC-Onboarding, AML-Risikoscoring, laufende Sorgfaltspflichten (Ongoing Due Diligence), Transaktionsmonitoring und Case Management – alles in einer Plattform, ergänzt um Bits AI. Mit 60+ integrierten Datenquellen und Abdeckung in 100+ Märkten ist die Plattform für die EU-Geldwäscheverordnung AMLR gebaut, die ab Juli 2027 gilt.

Gegründet 2022 in Stockholm von Fintech-Buildern mit Hintergrund bei Klarna und Tink, haben wir bislang 17 Mio. € eingesammelt – zuletzt 12 Mio. € in einer Series A (Februar 2026) unter Führung von Alstin Capital. Zu unseren Kunden zählen u. a. Qliro, Alisa Bank, Brite Payments, Walley und Coinmotion. Wir sind ein Team von rund 20 Leuten, das stark wächst – und du baust den Vertrieb mit auf.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Neukundengewinnung am Telefon (Outbound & Inbound): Du greifst täglich zum Hörer und sprichst aktiv Entscheider bei regulierten Finanzunternehmen in Europa an – CEOs, COOs, Heads of Compliance, MLROs und CFOs von Fintechs, Banken, Neobanken, Payment- und Kreditanbietern. Cold Calls sind dein Heimspiel; E-Mail, LinkedIn und Events ergänzen deinen Mix.

  • Pitching & Demo-Vorbereitung:Du stellst die Bits-Plattform (Onboarding, Risikoscoring, ODD, Transaktionsmonitoring, Case Management, Bits AI) überzeugend vor und bereitest Demos gemeinsam mit den Account Executives vor.

  • Pipeline-Aufbau:Du qualifizierst Leads, generierst Termine für das Senior-Sales-Team und sorgst für einen sauber gepflegten Funnel im CRM – von der ersten Recherche bis zur Übergabe an den Abschluss.

  • Markt- und Account-Research:Du identifizierst Zielkunden nach Segment (Banks & Neobanks, Payments, Lenders, Investment & Fund Managers) und Markt, baust Zielkundenlisten auf und erkennst Trigger wie Marktexpansion, Lizenzierung oder AMLR-Vorbereitung.

  • Feedback-Schleife:Du gibst Markt- und Kundenfeedback direkt an Product, Marketing und die Gründer weiter – bei einem Team von rund 20 Leuten hat deine Stimme Gewicht.

Dein Profil

  • Call-Talent:Du telefonierst gern und gut – du gehst auf fremde Menschen zu, kommst schnell auf den Punkt, hörst aktiv zu und bleibst auch nach dem zehnten „Nein“ freundlich und hartnäckig. Erfahrung in Telesales, Cold Calling oder im SDR/BDR-Bereich ist ein klares Plus.

  • Qualifikation:(Fach-)Hochschulstudium, kaufmännische Ausbildung oder ein Quereinstieg mit klarer Vertriebsaffinität – erste Erfahrung im B2B-Sales oder in Fintech/RegTech ist willkommen, kein Muss.

  • Interesse an Fintech & Compliance:Du willst verstehen, wie KYC, KYB, AML und Transaktionsmonitoring funktionieren und warum die AMLR 2027 für Finanzunternehmen gerade jetzt ein Thema ist – Vorkenntnisse bringen wir dir bei.

  • Struktur & Eigenverantwortung: Du arbeitest sauber im CRM, planst deine Woche selbst und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Zahlen (Bits-Wert: Personal Accountability).

  • Bias for Action:Du probierst lieber aus und lernst daraus, als auf die perfekte Information zu warten.

  • Sprachen:Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und sicheres Englisch (Arbeitssprache im Team); weitere europäische Sprachen sind ein Vorteil.

  • Remote-fit: Du arbeitest selbstorganisiert aus Deutschland, hältst engen Kontakt zum Team in Stockholm und hast Lust auf regelmäßige Besuche vor Ort.

Vergütung & Perspektiven

  • Gehalt: Fixes Grundgehalt plus variable, ungedeckelte Provision auf qualifizierte Termine und Abschlüsse.

  • Karrierepfad im Vertrieb:Klarer Weg vom BDR zum Account Executive (New Business) und weiter zu Senior-Sales- oder Führungsrollen, während das Commercial-Team mit der Series A wächst.

  • Weiterentwicklung:Strukturiertes Onboarding in Produkt, Compliance-Grundlagen (KYC, KYB, AML, AMLR 2027) und Sales-Methodik; enge Zusammenarbeit mit Account Executives, dem Head of Product & Compliance und den Gründern; regelmäßige Demos und Team-Sessions, in denen du dein Wissen ausbaust.

  • Gestaltungsspielraum:Du kommst früh in ein kleines, schnell wachsendes Team und prägst Prozesse, Playbooks und Zielmärkte des Vertriebs mit.

Was dich bei Bits erwartet

Bei Bits erwartet dich ein dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld, in dem du Verantwortung übernehmen, eigene Ideen einbringen und gemeinsam mit einem engagierten Team etwas bewegen kannst. Wir wachsen, entwickeln uns weiter und legen großen Wert auf eine Kultur, die von Vertrauen, Zusammenarbeit und Eigenverantwortung geprägt ist.

Darüber hinaus bieten wir dir:

  • 30 Tage Urlaub

  • Ein Stock-Optionen-Programm: Wir möchten diejenigen am Unternehmenserfolg beteiligen, die ihn aktiv mitgestalten.

  • Moderne technische Ausstattung, abgestimmt auf deine individuellen Bedürfnisse.

  • Kurze Entscheidungswege und viel Gestaltungsspielraum in einem Unternehmen, in dem deine Ideen zählen.

Position summary

The In-house CRA (IHCRA) provides centralized, non-site-facing support to CRAs and clinical project teams across the study lifecycle. The role supports consistent site oversight by maintaining study documentation and systems, reviewing and reconciling site-level data, preparing operational metrics, and completing agreed administrative follow-up activities. The IHCRA works in close collaboration with assigned CRAs and under the oversight of the CTM, escalating issues that require site-facing follow-up or clinical judgment.

This is a regional support role. Direct communication with investigator sites and travel to site visits are not part of the core scope. The role may support studies across European countries and therefore does not require a local language for each supported country.

Essential functions

  • Provide non-site-facing operational and administrative support to assigned CRAs and clinical project teams throughout the study lifecycle.
  • Prepare and maintain Investigator Site Files, including document distribution and coordination with shipping vendors where required. Route site communication and follow-up to the assigned CRA.
  • Where an electronic Investigator Site File is implemented, review it remotely for completeness and identify documents requiring CRA follow-up or filing in the Trial Master File.
  • Review documents received from CRAs and CTMs for legibility, completeness, correct orientation and filing readiness, and file documents in the eTMF in accordance with applicable processes.
  • Review the eTMF for missing or expiring site documents and provide clear follow-up lists to the assigned CRA.
  • Perform scheduled reconciliations between the Delegation of Authority Log, CTMS, eTMF and system-access records; create placeholders or update records as required by the agreed process.
  • Set up and maintain assigned site-level data, milestones and activities in CTMS and other study-specific systems based on information provided by the CRA and/or CTM.
  • Run available reports and provide assigned CRAs with agreed site metrics, including data-cleaning, enrollment and approval-status information where applicable.
  • Support sample tracking and other vendor or study reconciliations, identify discrepancies, and provide findings to the CRA for site-facing follow-up.
  • Complete agreed non-site-facing administrative actions arising from CRA site contacts or monitoring visits, such as coordinating supply orders, tracking completion and escalating delays.
  • Provide documentation and tracking support for audit and inspection readiness under CRA or CTM direction.
  • Support study tracking and reporting, maintain accurate activity status, and escalate risks, delays or data inconsistencies to the appropriate study team member.
  • Perform all activities in accordance with ICH-GCP, applicable regulations, company and sponsor SOPs, project plans and study-specific procedures.

Qualifications

Minimum required

  • Bachelor’s degree or international equivalent, preferably in a scientific, healthcare or related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Initial experience in clinical research, clinical trial administration or study coordination within a CRO, pharmaceutical or biotechnology environment.
  • Practical experience using CTMS, eTMF and other clinical trial systems or tools.
  • Familiarity with ICH-GCP principles and clinical trial documentation.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

Skills and competencies

  • Strong organization, prioritization and follow-through across multiple studies, sites and deadlines.
  • High attention to detail and the ability to perform accurate document and data review for extended periods.
  • Ability to identify discrepancies, communicate findings clearly and escalate issues appropriately.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating effectively with CRAs, CTMs and cross-functional partners.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Self-motivation, flexibility, teamwork and commitment to delivering on agreed responsibilities.

Preferred

  • Experience supporting multiple studies or countries in a centralized or regional clinical operations model.
  • Experience with Veeva Clinical applications.

What you’ll do

What you’ll bring

  • Experience directly managing quota-carrying reps, setting goals, running one-on-ones, and addressing underperformance.

  • Fluent English for live customer calls and availability during US business hours.

Experience hiring and onboarding reps, selling to US real estate investors or agents, or working in lead generation, marketplaces, or subscription businesses is a plus.

Engagement details

This remote hourly contract starts at approximately 30–40 hours per week for 60–90 days, with the potential to transition to full-time. We’re looking for someone who can start as soon as possible. An NDA is required before access to the CRM and call recordings.

How to apply

  1. Tell us about a sales team you directly managed. How many reps reported to you, and how did you run weekly coaching and performance reviews?

  3. If the team’s demo-to-close rate dropped by a third, what would you check in your first week?

You will be responsible for keeping the books accurate, reconciling 10+ accounts, managing vendor and customer payments, tracking trip profitability, and maintaining accurate financial and booking records. The role requires strong Xero, Excel and Google Sheets experience, along with the ability to work independently and handle confidential financial information.

Key Responsibilities

Accounting & Reconciliation

  • Perform monthly and quarterly reconciliations across 10+ bank, credit card, HubSpot and accounting accounts.
  • Review and categorize expenses in Xero.
  • Identify duplicate payments, missing transactions, unusual charges, and discrepancies.
  • Maintain accurate financial records and supporting documentation.

Payments & Vendor Management

  • Track vendor and customer payments, outstanding balances, and payment status.
  • Coordinate domestic and international payments, including foreign currency transactions.
  • Manage payments through platforms such as Convera (GlobalPay).
  • Work with vendors, operators, and internal teams to resolve payment issues.

Trip Profitability & Reporting

  • Track gross and net margins by trip or flight.
  • Monitor trip-related costs including aircraft, catering, transportation, and other operational expenses.
  • Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual expense and financial reports.
  • Maintain vendor variance and fixed-cost reports.
  • Provide management with clear reporting on expenses, margins, and payments.

CRM & Systems Management

  • Keep HubSpot deal stages and booking information up to date.
  • Maintain accurate trip details, pricing, invoicing, and payment status.
  • Reconcile HubSpot data with Xero and other financial records.
  • Organize financial documents and shared accounting folders.

Process Improvement

  • Build and maintain Excel and Google Sheets templates, dashboards, and reporting tools.
  • Use formulas, pivot tables, and data validation to improve reporting.
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive accounting and reporting tasks.
  • Improve processes to reduce manual work and prevent errors.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 3+ years of experience in bookkeeping, accounting operations, or financial analysis.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Xero, including reconciliation, expense coding, and reporting.
  • Experience reconciling 10+ accounts on a monthly and quarterly basis.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets skills, including XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, SUMIFS, pivot tables, and data validation.
  • Experience handling international payments and foreign currency transactions.
  • Strong understanding of financial reporting and account reconciliation.
  • Fluent English with strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to handle confidential financial information.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Availability during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Convera GlobalPay and international payment workflows.
  • Experience with HubSpot or a similar CRM.
  • Experience in private aviation, charter, luxury travel, or hospitality.
  • Experience working with U.S.-based companies and USD accounting.
  • Experience building automated reports or workflows.
  • Xero Advisor Certification.
  • Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

Remote & Availability Requirements

  • Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated, secure workspace.
  • Must be available during 9:00 AM–5:00 PM ET, Monday–Friday.
  • Occasional after-hours, weekend, or holiday availability is required for urgent matters such as operator payments, declined cards, or vendor issues affecting active flights.
  • Must be reachable by phone and able to respond promptly during urgent situations.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 90 days, you will be expected to learn the company's systems and vendor network, reconcile all 10+ accounts, align HubSpot records with the books, complete a monthly close, and deliver trip-level margin reporting.

Over time, you will help make the accounting and reporting process faster, more accurate, and more automated while providing leadership with reliable financial information for business decisions.

Stord is building out its Content and Communications function, and we're looking for a Senior Manager of Content & Thought Leadership to shape how Stord leads the conversation in commerce.

As agentic commerce changes how products are discovered, bought, and fulfilled, we want to build real authority on physical intelligence: the layer that connects digital intent to physical outcomes. You'll be the editorial mind behind that effort and a senior partner to the Head of Content & Comms across PR, content, and social.

This isn't a conversion-content role, though you'll care about conversion. We're looking for someone who can build a more dynamic, point-of-view-driven home for Stord's ideas and make sure that work performs. You'll report directly to the Director of Content & Comms and work closely with our social lead, the Brand team, marketing, sales, and internal subject matter experts.

What you'll do


Thought leadership & editorial strategy

  • Develop and defend Stord's point of view on agentic commerce, physical intelligence, fulfillment, supply chain, and omnichannel strategy.
  • Spot emerging conversations where Stord has a credible, differentiated perspective, and decide when to lead, join, or stay out.
  • Own the editorial calendar from planning to publication: bylines, executive content, contributed articles, long-form, and owned-channel programming.
  • Interview executives and subject matter experts and turn deep operational knowledge into writing that's clear without being oversimplified.
  • Reimagine the home for Stord's content (format, structure, cadence, and experience) so it reads as a destination rather than a blog archive.

Editorial leadership across Comms

  • Act as the editorial #2 to the Director of Content & Comms, setting the narrative and quality bar across content, PR, and social.
  • Shape how Stord's stories show up in earned media: pitch angles, contributed content, and executive visibility.
  • Partner with the social lead on content production and distribution for key assets, and with the Brand team to keep voice and storytelling consistent.

Content production & enablement

  • Write and edit across formats: essays, case studies, web copy, email, sales collateral, and executive materials.
  • Partner with demand gen, product marketing, and sales to keep content tied to campaigns and pipeline goals.
  • Help shape decks and presentations for marketing, sales, and executive audiences.

Distribution, discoverability & performance

  • Build content for both people and machines: AEO/SEO, answer-engine visibility, and clear conversion paths.
  • Track content performance and use it to sharpen editorial priorities over time, knowing which metrics matter and which don't.
  • Coordinate publication across owned channels and manage relationships with third-party outlets and publication partners.

Team & stakeholder leadership

  • Build relationships across sales, product, operations, and the executive team to surface new thought leaders and story opportunities.
  • Manage and provide editorial direction to freelancers, contract writers, and agency partners, with the potential to build out a team over time.
  • Act as an editorial resource for the broader Brand and Comms teams, reviewing, sharpening, and elevating written work across the function.

What you'll bring

  • 8+ years of experience in content, editorial, communications, or brand storytelling, ideally across B2B tech, media, or commerce.
  • A distinct editorial voice and the judgment to know when a piece is ready and when it isn't.

  • Experience with AEO/SEO, lead generation, and content performance metrics, and a clear view of what they do (and don't) tell you.

jobs.excerpt: As the Product Manager for Percona Monitoring and Management (PMM), you will own the product strategy and execution for Percona's open source observability platform for databases.
jobs.description:
As the Product Manager for Percona Monitoring and Management (PMM), you will own the product strategy and execution for Percona's open source observability platform for databases. You will work closely with engineering, design, product leadership, customers, and the open source community to define the future of PMM.

This is a highly technical product role. Our users are database administrators, SREs, platform engineers, DevOps engineers, cloud engineers, and developers who rely on PMM to monitor and optimize mission-critical database environments.

We're looking for someone with an entrepreneurial mindset who enjoys moving quickly, talking to customers, validating ideas early, and iterating rapidly. This is not a role where you'll spend months writing specifications before shipping. We value experimentation, pragmatism, and delivering customer value.

What Will You Do

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for PMM, ensuring it aligns with Percona's overall product vision.

  • Work directly with customers and the community to understand their challenges, validate ideas, and identify new product opportunities.

  • Conduct market research and competitive analysis to help shape product direction.

  • Translate customer problems into clear product requirements and priorities.

  • Work closely with Engineering, Design, Documentation, Marketing, and Customer Success to deliver outstanding product experiences.

  • Prioritize features and make informed trade-offs based on customer value, engineering effort, and strategic goals.

  • Define success metrics and use customer feedback, product telemetry, and usage data to guide product decisions.

  • Collaborate closely with engineering throughout the entire product lifecycle, from discovery to release.

  • Represent PMM internally and externally through blog posts, webinars, conferences, customer meetings, and community engagement.

  • Help drive the adoption of PMM across the open source community and enterprise organizations.

What You Have Done

  • Proven success managing technical products, particularly developer tools, infrastructure, platform, or observability products.

  • Demonstrated experience shipping successful software products from idea to release.

  • Strong technical understanding of modern infrastructure, databases, cloud-native, and observability technologies, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into product strategy and customer value.

  • Experience working cross-functionally across engineering, design, marketing, sales, and customer success.

  • Strong customer empathy with the ability to translate customer problems into products that deliver real value.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, making decisions with incomplete information, and iterating quickly based on customer feedback.

  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.

  • Fluent in English.

  • Willingness to travel occasionally for customer visits, conferences, and company events.

What Will Make You Stand Out

  • Experience with observability technologies such as Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, VictoriaMetrics, or similar platforms.

  • Experience with databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or other data platforms.

  • Experience with Kubernetes, Linux, cloud-native technologies, and distributed systems.

  • Experience working with open source communities as an active contributor or community member.

  • Experience building products for developers, SREs, platform engineers, DevOps engineers, database administrators, or other highly technical users.

  • Experience defining AI-powered workflows, developer productivity tools, or AI-assisted observability experiences.

  • Experience working in startups or high-growth companies where rapid iteration, experimentation, and customer feedback drive product decisions.

  • Comfortable taking ownership and wearing multiple hats in a small, collaborative team.

  • Passion for open source and building products in close partnership with engineering and the community.

Why Percona?

At Percona, we believe an open world is a better world. Our mission is to enable everyone to innovate freely, by providing the best open source database software, support, and services. We make databases and applications run better through a unique combination of expertise and open source software built with the community for you. Our technical teams are experts in MySQL, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and MariaDB.

Percona is proud to be a remote-only and globally dispersed workforce – we have colleagues in more than 50 countries! We offer a collaborative, highly-engaged culture where your ideas are welcome and your voice is heard.

Our staff receives generous benefits including flexible work hours and various paid time off programs, all your equipment for your remote office, funds for career development (external training, certifications, conferences), ongoing connectivity allowances, and the opportunity to participate in our equity incentive plan. We also have benefits that support a healthy work/life balance such as The Percona Adventure Team, Work-from-Anywhere, FlowDays, FryDays, and overall flexibility. We also support being socially responsible through our PAVE volunteering program and Women Transforming Technology.

If you love the idea of working with a high-growth tech company that is one of the best in the business and known globally as a leader in the open-source database space, let’s talk!

Connect with us and stay up to date on our latest news and developments by following us on LinkedIn and Twitter. We look forward to connecting with you!

At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.


Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.


ABOUT THE ROLE

The Senior Software Engineer - Developer Experience is a hands-on individual contributor focused on improving how engineers build, test, and deliver software across Genesys. You will design and deliver scalable tooling, automation, and development workflows that reduce friction, increase delivery velocity, and improve software quality. You will also help advance Genesys's AI-enabled software development lifecycle (AI-SDLC), applying sound technical judgment as AI capabilities and engineering practices evolve. This role has no direct reports; you will lead through technical ownership, mentorship, and collaboration.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

Developer Experience & Platforms

· Design and deliver internal developer platforms, CI/CD pipelines, and reusable tooling that streamline code development, testing, and deployment workflows.

· Build and improve standardized development environments and paved workflows using GitHub, CI/CD automation, and testing frameworks to reduce setup time and inconsistencies across partner teams.

· Improve developer onboarding and day-to-day productivity by creating self-service capabilities, documentation, and paved paths for common engineering tasks.


AI-SDLC, Automation & Quality

· Implement and continuously improve AI-enabled software development practices, evaluating emerging capabilities and incorporating effective approaches into development, testing, and delivery workflows while maintaining quality, security, and reliability.

· Automate build, test, and release processes across the software development lifecycle to reduce manual effort, improve consistency, and shorten delivery cycles.

· Use software delivery and quality metrics, including build success rates, test effectiveness, lead time, deployment frequency, and change failure rate, to identify bottlenecks, prioritize improvements, and measure impact.


Engineering Delivery & Adoption

· Contribute to technical design and reusable frameworks for developer tooling and platforms, balancing developer usability, scalability, security, and operational reliability.

· Partner with platform, security, and application teams to deliver developer experience improvements aligned with enterprise standards and engineering needs, and support adoption by gathering feedback and iterating based on usage and impact.

· Mentor engineers through code and design reviews, pairing, and knowledge sharing to strengthen engineering practices within the team and partner teams.


WHAT YOU BRING

Required Qualifications

· Demonstrated understanding of how AI is changing software development, with the ability to evaluate emerging tools and practices, learn rapidly as capabilities evolve, and apply effective approaches to engineering workflows.

· Strong hands-on software engineering experience using Python, Java, or another modern programming language, with demonstrated experience designing and delivering production-quality software or developer tooling.

· Experience in developer productivity, DevOps, or platform engineering, with a track record of delivering complex technical initiatives and contributing to cross-team efforts.

· Strong experience with CI/CD systems, version control, automated testing frameworks, and cloud-native development environments (preferably AWS) or infrastructure projects.

· Experience using software delivery metrics such as deployment frequency, lead time, build reliability, or change failure rate to identify and improve engineering workflows.

· Ability to influence adoption of tools and practices through collaboration, technical judgment, clear communication, and effective partnership across engineering teams.

· Experience with developer infrastructure, observability, and testing technologies such as GitHub, Terraform, Honeycomb, Gremlin, Playwright, or comparable tools.


Preferred Qualifications

· Experience integrating AI-powered developer tools, code assistants, agents, or automation capabilities into engineering workflows.

· Experience working in large-scale SaaS or distributed engineering organizations.

If you bring many of these capabilities but do not meet every qualification listed, we encourage you to apply. We value demonstrated ability, sound engineering judgment, and the capacity to learn as technologies and practices evolve.


KEY SKILLS

· Developer Experience (DevEx)

· CI/CD & Automation

· AI-Enabled Software Development (AI-SDLC)

· Software Quality & Testing

· Technical Design & Collaboration


BUSINESS IMPACT

· Reduces developer friction and cycle time across development, testing, and release workflows through automation, self-service capabilities, and paved paths.

· Improves software delivery and quality indicators such as build reliability, lead time, deployment frequency, and change failure rate within supported engineering workflows.

· Expands effective adoption of standardized and AI-enabled development practices, helping engineering teams use emerging capabilities responsibly while maintaining quality, security, and reliability.


Working at Genesys

  • AI at enterprise scale – Build, support and operate AI-powered technology used by more than 8,000 organizations worldwide. 150+ new AI features were released in the last fiscal year.
  • A flexible-first culture – Join a global team of nearly 7,000 employees with flexible ways of working designed to help people do their best work.
  • Growth in the AI era – Build future-ready skills through mentorship, learning programs, leadership development and education support.
  • Time to recharge and give back – Benefits include paid volunteer time, August Free Fridays, well-being resources and regionally tailored programs for employees and their families.
  • Recognized globally – Genesys is Great Place to Work®certified in 17 countries and 94% of employees are proud to tell others they work at Genesys.

Learn more about our culture, AI innovation and sustainability commitments through our Careers site and Sustainability Report.


What Happens After You Apply

After you apply, here's what you can typically expect:

  • Our Talent Acquisition team reviews your application with the hiring team.
  • A Talent Acquisition Partner will review your application and, if your background is aligned, schedule a Zoom interview. 
  • Next, you'll meet the hiring manager and other members of the interview team.
  • We aim to keep the process focused and respectful of your time, with no more than five interviews in most cases.
  • After interviews are complete, our team will follow up with the final steps.

Every application is reviewed by a person. Response times may vary by role and location, but our team will keep you informed throughout the process.


Stay Connected

Stay connected to learn more about how we're applying AI to customer and employee experience challenges and get notified when relevant opportunities become available.

Get notified about relevant opportunities.


Be the one building what's next - where AI, experience and impact come together.


Employee Referral

If a Genesys employee referred you, please apply using the link they shared so we can connect your application to their referral.


About Genesys:

Genesys® empowers more than 8,000 organizations worldwide to create the best customer and employee experiences. Genesys Cloud™ is the Agentic Orchestration Platform that securely connects people, systems, data and AI across the enterprise with built-in governance and control. As a result, organizations can drive customer loyalty, growth and retention while increasing operational efficiency and teamwork across human and AI workforces. To learn more, visit www.genesys.ai.

Dream Big. Go Beyond. Be Unstoppable.

About Us

Kyriba is a global fintech leader empowering CFOs and finance teams with cloud-based treasury, payments, risk management and working capital solutions. We serve 3,000+ customers worldwide, managing $15 trillion in payments annually and helping businesses optimize liquidity performance across the enterprise.

We're on a mission to become the most sought-after cloud technology company globally. We think big, innovate relentlessly, and challenge the status quo every day. About The Role

The Business Development Representative (BDR) is responsible for identifying, qualifying and nurturing prospects; building trust, uncovering compelling events and presenting Kyriba’s unique business value with the goal of developing a sales-ready opportunity. Prospects are identified through marketing campaigns as well as direct prospecting efforts from the BDR. Interaction with the prospect involves comprehensive discussions surrounding their current Treasury operations to identify their current situation, problems and pain all while positioning Kyriba’s unique business value.


About The Team

Our Business Development team services our global sales team via several BDR-Hubs in San Diego, London, Paris, Tokyo, and Singapore. The goal of our BDR leadership is to simultaneously generate the sales pipeline needed to satisfy booking targets and train, coach, and mentor Kyriba’s next generation of sellers, customer-facing support, and marketers. Our culture is goal-oriented and embodies the better parts of collaboration amongst each other as well as cross-functionally with our partners in marketing and sales.


What You’ll do:

  • Educate contacts through comprehensive discussions around their current Treasury operations and Kyriba’s product offerings.
  • Become fluent with all scripting, and speak with general proficiency regarding basic Treasury terminology and concepts.
  • Understand and qualify the prospect accordingly.
  • Nurture non-qualified prospects by offering resources and educational materials.
  • Follow-up on inquiries from marketing campaigns, online ads, events and webinars.
  • Perform high volume outbound calling activities combined with e-mail marketing.
  • Gather key information to update SalesForce.com in order to effectively prospect specified territory.
  • Enhance product knowledge through regularly scheduled training sessions and self-education.
  • Become part of a very collaborative team in terms of training and sharing education, and best practices.
  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with the sales executive in assigned territory.
  • Provide qualified sales-ready opportunities to the field sales organization to engage in our sales cycle.

What You bring:

  • 1 year+ professional work experience or sales internship preferred.
  • Fluent in English and German.
  • Must hold a Bachelor's degree or equivalent
  • Successful track record in inside sales or cold calling environment preferred.
  • Ability to handle high outbound call volume with corresponding high talk time.
  • Ability to learn complex Treasury concepts and incorporate them into daily interactions and conversations.
  • Ability to build rapport with prospects and transition inquiries over time to the sales force.
  • Strong phone, prospecting, sales, customer service, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to effectively communicate with internal stakeholders.

Our Values Guide Everything We Do

  • Think Big & Constantly Innovate: We have the confidence to think big, embrace change, challenge the status quo, and continuously evolve - incorporating new technologies and driving industry progress.

  • Put our Customers’ Outcomes First: We are passionate about delivering the highest value for our customers and supporting them with end-to-end care throughout their journey with us.

  • Act with Integrity: Integrity is at the heart of everything we do. We take personal responsibility for our actions, own our decisions, and honour each other’s contributions. We empower each other through honesty, respect, trust and transparency.

  • Work as One Team: We are driven by our common goals and share in each other’s successes and failures, learning and working together as a team where everyone can bring their best selves.

  • Strive for Excellence while Having Fun: We enjoy tackling new challenges together, and revel in continuous improvement as we deliver, with ultimate professionalism, the very best for our customers, while exceeding our own expectations.

At Kyriba we value pay transparency and fairness.
