GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Senior Salesforce Engineerin our Resellers Team in Brazil! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

As a Senior Salesforce Software Engineer, you will be responsible for analyzing and developing high-quality, scalable solutions tailored to our reseller partners. You will own the software lifecycle end-to-end, creating technical documentation, developing features, supporting UAT/homologation, and maintaining stable live operations. Additionally, you will assist partners with technical inquiries and issue resolution, driving incident analysis and root-cause fixes to ensure a robust and reliable product.

In this role, you will work in close alignment with Product Managers to translate business rules into scalable technical solutions, support the Tech Lead in key architectural decisions, and collaborate cross-functionally with other squads. By balancing trade-offs between speed and quality, you will actively contribute to fostering a healthy, collaborative, and high-performing engineering environment.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Own the architecture and development of solutions within our Salesforce platform for the Resellers squad, making design decisions that balance scalability, maintainability, and high performance.
  • Lead RFCs and PRDs, creating detailed technical documentation, setting standards, and acting as a technical reference in code and design reviews.
  • Drive end-to-end incident resolution and root-cause analysis (post-mortems) for reseller operations, converting lessons learned into long-term system stability and quality.
  • Support homologation, deployment, and live operations, actively assisting reseller partners with technical queries, troubleshooting, and issue resolution.
  • Partner closely with Product Managers and Tech Leads to align business requirements, evaluate technical trade-offs, and guide architectural choices across squads.
  • Proactively manage technical debt across the team's codebase, ensuring a clean, scalable architecture and removing roadblocks autonomously.
  • Build solutions through both declarative programming (Flows, Approval Processes) and code (Apex, LWC, Aura), adhering to SOLID principles and leveraging GitHub CI/CD pipelines.
  • Support hiring by interviewing candidates and helping spot structural inefficiencies or roadblocks within the team.
  • Roll up your sleeves and help when needed. Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce development (Apex, JavaScript), with a proven track record of designing, building, and maintaining scalable solutions end-to-end.
  • Strong expertise in Lightning Web Components (LWC), Aura, and Salesforce declarative automation tools (Flows, Approval Processes), alongside solid knowledge of SOLID design patterns and Git-based CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experienced in creating complete technical documentation, analyzing architectural trade-offs, and acting as a technical guide to support Tech Leads and Product Managers.
  • A collaborative team player with strong problem-solving skills, comfortable driving incident resolution, root-cause analysis, and supporting partners with complex queries to maintain product stability.
  • Proven ability to work autonomously in agile, cross-functional environments, fostering a healthy, inclusive, and collaborative team culture.
  • Strong verbal and written communicator with fluent/advanced English skills, capable of influencing technical decisions and presenting complex ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience with Salesforce development (Apex, JavaScript) are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge.Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here.

Want to see what it’s really like to work here? Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on YouTube!

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

jobs.excerpt: When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.
jobs.description:
When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

Are you a commercially minded finance professional who enjoys turning complex financial data into decisions that make a real difference?


We are looking for a Commercial Finance Manager to join Parexel and act as a trusted financial partner to our Commercial and Operational leadership teams.

This is much more than a traditional finance role. You will work closely with senior stakeholders across the business, using financial insight, commercial judgement and scenario modelling to shape decisions, strengthen client partnerships and improve the profitability of key client portfolios.

You will become a recognised commercial finance expert for your assigned clients, bringing together financial performance, pricing, forecasting and business intelligence to help teams make informed decisions and deliver sustainable growth.


You can work remotely or in a hybrid pattern in this role, which is connected to our Dublin office - you must live in Ireland. If you work remotely, we may occasionally ask you to come into the office for Team or Client meetings, but this is not frequent.



What you’ll do:


In this role, you will:


  • Partner with Commercial, Portfolio, Business Operations and Finance leaders to improve the financial performance of key client accounts.
  • Translate complex financial and commercial data into clear, actionable insights for senior stakeholders.
  • Provide forward-looking financial analysis, scenario modelling and recommendations to support strategic decision-making.
  • Develop a deep understanding of client economics, profitability drivers, revenue, costs and margin performance.
  • Identify financial risks and opportunities across client portfolios and recommend actions to enhance profitability.
  • Challenge and influence Commercial leadership where appropriate to ensure decisions balance client needs with Parexel’s financial objectives.
  • Analyse actual and forecast performance, investigate variances and help drive corrective actions.
  • Partner with Proposals & Contracts and Commercial teams on financial analysis and pricing for proposals, including complex, multi-million-dollar opportunities.
  • Support the resolution of complex commercial finance issues, acting as a trusted escalation point where required.
  • Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders and, where appropriate, directly with clients on financial and commercial matters.
  • Support continuous improvement across Commercial Finance, helping simplify processes, strengthen financial discipline and embed best practices.

What we’re looking for:


We’re looking for someone who can combine strong financial expertise with genuine commercial judgement and stakeholder influence.


You’ll ideally bring:


  • Approximately 6–10 years of progressive Finance experience, with a strong track record in commercial finance, financial analysis or business partnering.
  • A degree in Finance, Accounting or a related discipline, with professional Accounting or Finance Qualification e.g. CIMA, ACA, ACCA or equivalent.
  • Strong financial modelling and analytical skills, with the ability to identify the story behind the numbers.
  • Experience supporting commercial decisions around areas such as pricing, profitability, forecasting, revenue and margin.
  • The confidence to challenge assumptions, influence decision-making and have constructive conversations with senior stakeholders.
  • Strong business partnering skills and the ability to build credibility with both Finance and non-Finance leaders.
  • Experience working within a complex, matrixed and ideally global organisation.
  • An ability to operate effectively when priorities are changing or information is incomplete.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex financial concepts clearly.
  • Experience within the CRO, pharmaceutical, life sciences or another project-based professional services environment would be particularly valuable.

What will make you successful:


You’ll thrive in this role if you naturally look beyond reporting the numbers and ask “What does this mean for the business, and what should we do next?”

You will be comfortable moving between detailed financial analysis and strategic conversations with senior leaders. You’ll understand when to challenge, when to influence and when to propose a different commercial approach.

Most importantly, you’ll be able to balance customer needs with strong financial stewardship, helping Parexel build sustainable, profitable client partnerships.


If you’re looking for a role where you can combine finance, strategy, commercial partnership and influence, we’d love to hear from you!

Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.

More than half of all working Americans are not saving enough for their future. Too often, it’s because they are employed by a company that doesn’t offer a retirement plan. Human Interest is changing that by making it affordable and accessible for small and medium-sized businesses to offer employees a path to financial independence through retirement savings.

We’re a high-growth fintech company changing the retirement industry. We are backed by a number of investors. This includes funding from Marshall Wace and Baillie Gifford, as well as top investors such as BlackRock, TPG (The Rise Fund), SoftBank, Glynn Capital, NewView Capital, USVP, Wing, Uncork, and more.

About the role

As a Dedicated Sales Activation Specialist, you will support the setup and launch of our new clients 401(k) plans while representing our White Label partners. This joint effort means you'll be on the front lines with our new clients/partners, working with a wide variety of companies (anything from the local plumber to the nationwide robotics firm), helping them set up and launch their new 401(k) plans. You'll own keeping the sales activation process on-track while ensuring that customers and partners are engaged and happy. Process-driven and people-focused - you are organized, friendly and flexible.

You will be accountable for hitting key performance metrics, identifying and escalating operational blockers to consistently launch a high volume of plans while delivering an exceptional customer experience. jobs.description:
This role is the first point of contact for all internal IT support, managing the entire help desk queue from logging to resolution.

Job Responsibilities

Day-to-day tasks include:

User Support: Providing remote support for software (M365/Google Workspace, OS), connectivity (VPN, Wi-Fi), and hardware issues.

Lifecycle Management: Executing the full onboarding process (account creation, access, hardware coordination, induction) and offboarding process (disabling accounts, asset retrieval).

Security Operations: Monitoring security logs and alerts (antivirus, O365, endpoint), managing security awareness training, and assisting with patch management.

Systems & Auditing: Conducting monthly audits (backup checks, access reviews), maintaining the IT asset inventory, and reporting on system health.

Documentation: Creating and maintaining user-facing "how-to" guides and internal IT process documentation.

Qualifications (Skills)

Must-Have Skills:

Strong experience with IT help desk ticketing systems.

Expertise in supporting Windows and macOS environments.

Admin-level knowledge of Microsoft 365 and/or Google Workspace.

Identity Management: Experience with Active Directory (user creation, permissions).

Security Tools: Familiarity with endpoint protection, email filtering, and MFA.

Networking: Strong remote troubleshooting skills for VPN, Wi-Fi, and connectivity.

MDM: Experience with mobile device management/provisioning (e.g., Intune/Autopilot).

Excellent remote communication and user-support skills.

Nice-to-Have Skills:

Experience with the specific security platforms in use.

Experience documenting systems (e.g., in Confluence or similar)

Competencies/Traits

Highly Organized: Essential for managing the entire support queue, prioritizing tasks, and logging all work.

Customer-Service Mindset: Professional, patient, and timely in all user interactions.

Detail-Oriented & Meticulous: Critical for security log analysis, monthly audits, and user lifecycle processes.

Proactive & Accountable: Takes ownership of tickets from start to finish, including escalations.

Strong Communicator: Able to write clear, user-friendly documentation and conduct IT inductions.

Prior Experience

2-3+ years of experience in an IT Support, Help Desk, or Service Desk role.

Demonstrable experience supporting users in a fully remote or hybrid environment.

Proven experience managing the new-hire-to-leaver IT lifecycle (onboarding/offboarding).

Hands-on experience with security monitoring and alert management.

Performance Measurement

Ticket Resolution Time: Average time to close support tickets. First Contact Resolution (FCR): Percentage of issues solved on the first interaction.

Ticket Backlog: Number of open/aging tickets in the queue.

Audit Completion: On-time completion of all scheduled monthly audits.

User Satisfaction (CSAT): Feedback from internal staff.

Documentation: Number of new/updated Knowledge Base articles.

Who we are:

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit to learn more.

About the Role:

Motive's GTM Intelligence & Operations team owns the systems, data, and governance behind how 2,000 sellers, managers, and marketers engage our customers worldwide. As an Analyst, you will help keep our GTM platforms reliable, usable, and well-governed. You will administer and troubleshoot Outreach and connected workflows, help maintain accurate data and permissions, analyze recurring issues and adoption patterns, and turn user needs into clear requirements and practical improvements.

This role is suited to an experienced individual contributor who can independently manage operational work, resolve issues within their area of ownership, and coordinate with partners across GTM and technical teams. The analyst is expected to exercise sound judgment, communicate risks and findings clearly, and improve processes - not only close individual support requests. The role does not include people management responsibility.

What You’ll Do:

  • Administer and support Outreach and related GTM workflows, including user access, settings, configuration, troubleshooting, and routine operational requests.
  • Help maintain reliable Salesforce-Outreach data synchronization by investigating record, ownership, field-mapping, and workflow issues; document findings and coordinate fixes with the appropriate system owners.
  • Triage support requests, identify root causes, communicate status clearly, and escalate high-impact or cross-system incidents with useful evidence and recommended next steps.
  • Monitor data quality, usage, and operational health; build or maintain reports and analyses that surface trends, exceptions, adoption gaps, and opportunities to reduce manual work.
  • Support governance for user access, roles, permissions, data handling, and compliant outbound workflows in partnership with system owners and relevant teams.
  • Translate stakeholder needs into documented requirements, process maps, test cases, and acceptance criteria for system changes.
  • Participate in testing and release activities, validate changes, maintain accurate documentation, and help users understand updates through concise guidance and training.
  • Partner with Sales Operations, Sales leaders, Enterprise Systems, IT, Enablement, Legal, and other stakeholders to resolve issues and improve GTM processes.
  • Own assigned operational processes or system workstreams, track dependencies, and follow work through implementation and measurement of results.
  • Look for repeatable ways to improve support, data hygiene, platform adoption, and the quality of operational reporting.

What We’re Looking For:

  • Typically 3–5+ years of relevant experience, or equivalent practical experience demonstrating ownership of complex systems or operational workstreams.
  • Hands-on experience administering or supporting a sales engagement platform; Outreach experience is strongly preferred. Experience with Salesloft or a comparable platform may also be relevant.
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce concepts such as records, objects, fields, ownership, reporting, and integrations; direct Salesforce administration experience is a plus.
  • Basic understanding of GTM tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, and LeanData.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently investigate system, workflow, or data issues, identify likely root causes, validate findings, and explain conclusions clearly.
  • Experience managing operational requests and project work, prioritizing across competing needs, and communicating status, risks, and dependencies.
  • Comfortable working with spreadsheets and operational reports; experience with SQL, BI tools, or data visualization is a plus.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, sound judgment with sensitive data, and the ability to collaborate across technical and nontechnical teams.
  • A detail-oriented, service-minded approach, with the ability to balance timely user support and durable process improvements.
  • Experience documenting business processes, requirements, test plans, or system changes.

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer (Payments)
jobs.excerpt: At Bloomerang, we believe change happens on purpose.
jobs.description:
At Bloomerang, we believe change happens on purpose. We champion the power and potential of nonprofits, igniting next-level impact with the team and technology built for purpose. Our powerful giving platform and stellar support enable tens of thousands of nonprofits to raise more, recruit more, and retain more, fueling maximum impact and raising the bar on what’s possible for the nonprofit sector. That's why, even as the nonprofit sector sees declines in giving, Bloomerang customers raise more year over year.

We're also in the business of creating thriving employees. Join a mission-driven culture built on our core values of Simplify, Care and Act. We know our people are the key to our success, and we're proud to be home to some of the most innovative and skilled individuals in the workforce today. Come feel invigorated and unstoppable with us!

The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer at Bloomerang, you'll be a hands-on engineer and a key driver of technical success on your team. You'll design, build, and ship production software that helps nonprofits raise the money that powers their missions. Agentic AI tools are part of how we build every day, across the whole delivery lifecycle, and how we work keeps changing as those tools do.

You'll join Paid in Dreams, the team that owns payments at Bloomerang. In payments, reliability and security can't be compromised. A bug here can mean a donation that didn't go through or money that didn't land where it should. Stripe is our primary processor, and the work covers processor integrations, webhooks, and the donor-facing experiences built on top of them.

We're looking for a pragmatic engineer who sees the bigger picture. You understand how a change ripples across systems, products, and the people who use them. You find the real problem before reaching for a solution, and you know when something needs rigor and when good enough is fine. You bring ideas without assuming you have all the answers, and you're curious about the customer problem behind the ticket.

How You'll Show Up

  • Own your work and drive it to done. Treat commitments as promises, push through the murky middle, and share bad news early.
  • Communicate directly. Ask the question, raise the concern, and keep the team in the loop.
  • Use good judgment and welcome feedback. Make sound decisions with incomplete information, and treat feedback as useful information to act on.
  • Keep learning. Pick up new tools quickly and let go of approaches that no longer fit.
  • Think like a product engineer. Connect technical work to business goals and to the experience of nonprofits and their donors.

What You Will Do

  • Design, build, test, and ship features and integrations across the payments stack, from processor APIs and webhooks to the UI. Partner with product, design, and support to understand the problem nonprofits and their donors face before you build.
  • Use agentic AI tools every day to deliver value faster, and help shape the harnesses, guardrails, and conventions that keep AI-generated code aligned with our architecture.
  • Keep payment flows secure, reliable, and observable. Debug production issues to the root cause, and improve the live codebase, including legacy code, step by step with the team's agreement instead of through unilateral rewrites.
  • Make the team better. Review code, pair with teammates, and share what you know so it doesn't stay siloed. Represent payments in cross-team work and bring that context back.

What You Need to Succeed

AI Fluency

  • Hands-on experience taking AI-assisted or AI-driven work to production, beyond writing prompts, in large, established codebases, not just greenfield projects.
  • Enough architectural understanding to codify it into the harnesses, instructions, and reviews that keep AI tools producing code that fits the system.

Technical Depth

  • Strong recent experience as a hands-on senior engineer shipping and supporting a live production app.
  • A deep understanding of software architecture, which matters more to us than any specific language. Our stack includes .NET/C#, TypeScript/Node, React, and SQL, and strong engineers from similar ecosystems will ramp up quickly. This includes:
    • object-oriented design, distributed systems, and event-driven architecture
    • asynchronous programming
    • relational databases and ORMs
    • automated testing
    • modern front-end and component architecture, including micro-frontends
  • Experience with modern payment processing at scale. That means immediate API responses confirmed later by asynchronous webhooks, and the failure modes that come with them. It also means third-party rate limits, queuing and retries, and traffic spikes. Experience with Stripe, PayPal, or similar processors.
  • A working knowledge of modern security practices for web and payment systems, and the instinct to spot a brittle or insecure design before it ships.

Collaboration

  • You thrive on a tight-knit, highly communicative team that talks every day and jumps on quick calls to work through problems together.

Benefits

Health + Wellness
You’ll have access to generous health, vision, and dental insurance options as well as HealthiestYou, a healthcare service that offers convenient, confidential access to quality doctors 24/7, anytime, anywhere.

Time Off
You'll get a competitive PTO package that includes 20 PTO days, 3 flex days, 4 optional volunteer days, 12 paid holidays, as well as paid parental leave. More is more!

401kYou'll receive a 401k match to help invest in your future.

Equipment
Everything you need to be successful, shipped right to your door. You got this. We got you.

Compensation
The salary range for this position is $114,800 - $191,400. You may also be eligible for a discretionary bonus. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent on your skills, experience, qualifications, and location, as well as applicable employment laws

Location
This is a permanent, full-time, fully remote position (within the U.S. and select Canadian Provinces only). Employees living in Indianapolis, IN are welcome to work from our company headquarters. We do not offer Visa sponsorship or relocation assistance at this time.

AccommodationsApplicants who require accommodations may contact to request an accommodation in completing an application.

Bloomerang is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Individuals seeking employment at Bloomerang are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, or sexual orientation.

People review every application and every AI recommendation, make all rejection decisions, and make all final hiring decisions.

jobs.description:
At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.

With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy.

We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.

We're assembling a small team to take over a set of backend services that power a direct-to-consumer commerce platform of a global beverage/consumer goods company. The platform is being separated from the B2B ecosystem it was born in. As part of that separation, a group of critical services (orders, pricing, payments, and promotions/combos) is being forked as-is into the new environment, and they need a team that owns them.
The mission for this phase is clear: keep the lights on. Absorb these services fast, keep them stable through the highest-demand period of the year, and leave them better documented and tested than we found them. The client's architecture team is designing the target architecture in parallel. That work is not in this team's scope today, but it is the natural next step.
This is not greenfield. You'll inherit real services with real history, learn them from the people who built them.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own a portfolio of forked backend services (mostly Java/Spring Boot): bug fixes, small changes, and day-to-day stability.
  • Drive knowledge transfer with the original team through shadowing sessions. Ask the right questions, map dependencies, and turn tacit knowledge into something written.
  • Build service context documentation in three layers (business rules, application behavior, operations) following the client's template. This feeds both the human team and the AI-assisted development model the client already runs in production.
  • Support incidents in a production environment that runs 24/7 across global markets, including critical flows like orders and payments.
  • Work within an Azure-based infrastructure (Azure DevOps, pipelines, and subscriptions), contributing to the duplication and adaptation of CI/CD pipelines for the new environment
  • Participate in the team's shift toward better engineering practices: adopting GitFlow, strengthening test coverage, and gradually incorporating quality gates — without breaking what already works
  • Help classify services by technical criticality and flag systemic risks early, such as hidden dependencies, shared databases/queues, and fragile integrations.

Requirements (Must Have):

  • Hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools (coding agents, assistants) in real work, with judgment about when to trust and when to verify.
  • Java (backend, production experience) — this is non-negotiable
  • Spring Boot — the core framework across the service landscape
  • REST API design and integration
  • Azure DevOps — familiarity with pipelines, repos, and environments
  • Non relational (CosmosDB for MongoDB) and relational databases (PostgreSQL)
  • Testing — JUnit for unit tests; familiarity with E2E or integration testing
  • Incident response mindset — ability to diagnose, triage, and resolve issues in complex distributed systems under pressure
  • English — for reading documentation, participating in cross-team calls, and written communication
  • Hands-on experience operating and debugging distributed microservices in production: logs, tracing, triage under pressure.
  • Clear, proactive communication. You'll extract knowledge from a team that is moving on, so you must be able to drive conversations, write things down, and escalate early.
  • Comfort working on inherited/legacy code with a "understand first, change carefully" mindset.

Nice to Have Skills:

  • Experience with microservices at scale — especially the operational realities of running and debugging many services in production
  • Azure cloud services beyond DevOps (Service Bus, Blob Storage, Functions, etc.)
  • Familiarity with DDD (Domain-Driven Design) concepts and service boundary thinking
  • Go — a secondary language used in some newer services
  • Understanding of internationalization and global commerce (multi-currency, multi-region systems)
  • Performance optimization experience in high-throughput environments

What Makes This Role Different:

You'll be joining at a moment that requires adaptability over idealism — the goal isn't to redesign what's working, it's to understand it deeply, keep it running, and incrementally move it toward a cleaner state. The team values engineers who can hold two things at once: operational discipline today and architectural vision for tomorrow.
If you've ever had to inherit complex legacy systems, win trust through reliability, and earn the space to improve things over time — this will feel familiar in the best way.

Seniority Levels:

We're open to Mid-Level and Senior profiles. Both levels are hands-on: everyone on this team writes code, fixes bugs, and takes on-call shifts. The difference is scope and autonomy.
  • Mid-Level: Delivers fixes and changes independently on well-understood services, with guidance on the more complex ones. Strong Java/Spring Boot fundamentals and solid microservices concepts. Takes part in incident response alongside senior engineers. Learns a complex domain fast through shadowing and documentation, and writes down what they learn.
  • Senior: Delivers the hardest changes and fixes, especially on critical flows such as orders, pricing and payments. Leads incident resolution end to end, from diagnosis to fix in production. Drives knowledge transfer sessions with the outgoing team and turns what comes out of them into documentation and service context. Spots systemic risks such as hidden dependencies, shared resources and fragile integrations. Sets the quality bar for the team through code reviews, tests and standards, mostly by example.

Section 1: Position Summary


The Director, Data Solutions leads the data foundation for Ascensus Data & Analytics: the architecture, engineering, integration and quality work that enterprise reporting, client-experience analytics and predictive modeling all depend on. The role is accountable for connecting disparate source systems into a connected intelligence layer, so insight can be drawn across the enterprise rather than one system at a time, and so analytics teams build on trusted data instead of assembling it themselves.

The Director reports to the Senior Vice President, Data & Analytics and leads a team spanning data engineering, data product management and business analysis. The role works closely with Technology on data priorities, pipeline delivery and platform standards, starting with the Retirement business line, and with analytics leaders and business stakeholders on sequencing what gets built first.

Section 2: Job Functions, Essential Duties and Responsibilities


  • Data Architecture & Technical Direction: Define the target architecture for our shared data environment, including the layered (medallion) structure, semantic models and reporting layers, working with Technology and enterprise architecture. Set standards for pipeline design, source control, testing, deployment and documentation, and hold the team to them.
  • Connected Data Sets & Integration: Build the integrated data sets that join sources across the enterprise. Near-term priorities include client interactions, book of business, customer experience and behavioral trends, and product and partner definitions with a reliable source of truth. Deliver the shared client-interaction source covering digital, workflows, interactions and sentiment, and the advisor data pipeline connecting core platform data with CRM sales activity.
  • Process Efficiency & Automation: Automate the manual, repetitive reporting and data preparation work that consumes capacity today. Track cycle time and manual touchpoints on recurring deliverables and reduce both.
  • Data Products & Roadmap: Work with the data product owner to maintain a prioritized data roadmap tied to analytics and business priorities. Build data sets once, document them, assign owners, and make them reusable across teams instead of rebuilt per project.
  • Data Quality & Governance: Establish a single source of truth for enterprise reporting and client insight. Maintain enterprise data definitions so key terms mean the same thing across lines of business. Run data quality audits, and identify gaps in foundational systems that block enterprise-wide reporting and cross-sell insight.
  • AI & Advanced Analytics Enablement: Structure and govern data to support predictive and propensity modeling and emerging agentic workflows, working with data science and analytics early enough that the foundation is ready when the models are.
  • Technology Partnership: Act as the main point of coordination with Technology on data priorities, platform upgrades and the ongoing support model. Represent Data & Analytics requirements in architectural review and influence decisions so solutions stay consistent and scalable across teams.
  • Team Leadership & Development: Lead, coach and develop a team spanning data engineering, data product management and business analysis. Set clear expectations for engineering discipline and delivery, mentor through code and design review, and build the bench as the function grows.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Explain technical constraints and trade-offs in plain business terms to analytics leaders, business stakeholders and executives, and communicate status, dependencies and risk early.

General

  • Proactively adopt, protect and boldly embrace emerging technologies (AI, automation, etc.), platforms, and evolving practices that accelerate transformational growth and advance Ascensus’ mission and client commitments.
  • Responsible for protecting, securing, and proper handling of all confidential data held by Ascensus to ensure against unauthorized access, improper transmission, and/or unapproved disclosure of information that could result in harm to Ascensus or our clients.
  • At Ascensus we are guided by our Core Values of People Matter, Quality First and Integrity Always®. They inspire us every day to prioritize an environment of respect for those we serve and one another and should be visible in your actions on a day-to-day.

Supervision

  • Direct reports span Data Engineer, Data Product Owner and Business Analyst roles. Team composition and size will flex with business priorities.

Section 3: Experience, Skills, Knowledge Requirements

  • Leadership & Experience: 10+ years in financial services in data engineering, data management, business intelligence or systems analysis, including at least three years managing a data or reporting team.
  • Process Ownership: Experience owning a recurring, deadline-driven data production cycle, such as regulatory reporting, capital planning or stress testing submissions, financial close or executive reporting, with responsibility for streamlining it over successive cycles.
  • Technical Expertise: Strong SQL, including optimization of complex queries and tuning of stored procedures. Proficiency in ETL/ELT and pipeline design, dimensional and semantic modeling, and modern cloud data platforms. Experience with layered data architectures, data lineage and data quality tooling. Working familiarity with the Microsoft data stack in use at Ascensus (SQL Server, SSIS, SSAS, Power BI semantic models) is strongly preferred.
  • Systems Analysis & Solution Engineering: Experience designing, developing, testing and administering internal applications and reporting tools, including replacing vendor products where an internal solution serves the business better.
  • Delivery Discipline: Experience with software development lifecycle methodologies (Agile Scrum, Kanban) using tools such as Azure DevOps or Jira for requirements and delivery management.
  • AI/ML Readiness: Practical understanding of what predictive, propensity and generative AI use cases require of upstream data, including structure, granularity, freshness, lineage and governance.
  • Business & Industry Acumen: Retirement, wealth management, asset management, banking or fintech experience preferred. Able to connect data investments to commercial outcomes and explain the value and trade-offs of foundational work to non-technical leaders.
  • Collaboration & Influence: Proven ability to build working relationships across Technology, Operations, Product and business teams, and to exercise good judgment independently.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Finance or a related field required, or equivalent work experience. Advanced degree or relevant data platform certifications preferred.

For all virtual remote positions, in order to ensure associates can effectively perform their job duties with no distractions, we require an uninterrupted virtual workspace and there is also an expectation of family care being in place during business hours. Additionally, there is an internet work speed requirement of 25 Mbps or better for individual use. If more than one person is utilizing the same internet connection in the same household or building, then a stronger connection is required. If you are unsure of your internet speed, please check with your service provider. Please ensure that you are able to meet these expectations before applying.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer | Experimentation - Product Analytics | UK | Remote
jobs.excerpt: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale.
jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote opportunity and we would be interested in applications from the UK, Ireland, Sweden, Spain and Germany.

The opportunity:

Grafana Labs is building a native experimentation platform: a Grafana app that lets teams define A/B tests, connect them to feature flags and product telemetry, and get trustworthy, statistically sound answers about what their changes actually did.

It started as a hackathon project and is now used by Grafana engineering and product teams in our internal environment to run real experiments. The next step is to make it a first-class product: one we rely on every day internally and, over time, one we offer to Grafana Cloud customers alongside Frontend Observability, Session Replay and our other user-experience capabilities.

You'll join the Product Analytics team, a group of highly technical product analysts who help teams across Grafana understand how our products are used and run experiments on them. As the team's dedicated software engineer, you'll own the engineering of the experimentation app and have a lot of influence over where it goes. You'll partner closely with data scientists on the statistics, data engineers on event pipelines and the data warehouse, software engineers across Grafana on feature flags, Frontend Observability and the App Platform, and product stakeholders who rely on experiment results to make decisions. This is a hands-on engineering role that ships production code. It is not an analyst role.

About the product:

The experimentation app is built on the Grafana App Platform:

  • Frontend: a TypeScript and React app plugin using @grafana/ui, plus a custom datasource plugin that powers experiment statistics panels.
  • Backend: Go, built with the Grafana App SDK. Experiments are Kubernetes-style custom resources defined in CUE, with an operator, admission webhooks, and support for declarative, GitOps-style management.
  • Feature flags: integration with OpenFeature and the OpenFeature Remote Evaluation Protocol (OFREP), Grafana's multi-tenant feature toggle service, and an embedded GO Feature Flag evaluator.
  • Statistics engine: a Bayesian analysis engine (TypeScript, with a Go port) that produces a direction-aware verdict per metric, probability to be best, credible intervals, expected loss and sample-size recommendations.
  • Data: experiment exposure and outcome events flow from product instrumentation through RudderStack into BigQuery, or from Grafana Faro into Loki, and are queried live through Grafana datasources.
  • AI: experiment authoring assisted by Grafana Assistant, which discovers relevant data and drafts the experiment configuration for a human to review.

What You’ll be doing:

  • Evolve the experimentation app from internal tool to product. Full ownership of features end to end across the React frontend and Go backend, from problem framing and design through rollout, measurement and iteration.
  • Build the experimentation experience. Develop intuitive workflows for defining hypotheses, configuring experiments and metrics, managing their lifecycle, and exploring results. Make these experiences useful for product managers and analysts as well as engineers.
  • Make instrumentation easier to adopt and trust. Evolve the experimentation SDK and its OpenFeature and Faro integrations. Help teams connect variant assignment, actual exposure, and outcome events with consistent identity and event contracts.
  • Connect experiments to the rest of Grafana’s user-experience stack. Integrate with Grafana Faro and Frontend Observability so flag exposures and outcomes are captured automatically, and link experiment results to Session Replay and critical user journeys so teams can see why a variant won, not only that it won.
  • Harden the statistics and analysis path. Work with our data analysts to extend the statistics engine, and make analysis scalable, cost-aware and correct. Examples include moving computation server-side, scheduled analysis, alerting on experiment health, and guardrails against misleading results.
  • Use AI where it genuinely helps. Extend the Grafana Assistant integration for authoring, explaining and reporting on experiments.
  • Raise the engineering bar. Mentor teammates, including analysts who contribute code, through code review, pairing and design docs. Write the architecture decision records (ADRs), docs and demos that help other teams adopt experimentation.
  • Own what you ship. Take part in on-call for the services you build, and support the internal teams that run experiments on them.

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups, always with strong code review and quality standards. You’ll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

What makes you a great fit:

We highly value people who are intellectually curious, default to transparency, have a strong bias towards action, and are kind and enjoy working as a team.

  • Strong full-stack engineering experience. You’ve built and operated production web applications with TypeScript and React, and backend services in Go (or a similar language, with willingness to work in Go). You value maintainability, automated testing and secure development practices.
  • Experience building an in-house platform or integrating existing experimentation and A/B testing platform (for example Statsig, Eppo, GrowthBook, Optimizely, LaunchDarkly experiments, or an in-house platform).
  • Product and data intuition. You care whether what you shipped actually moved the needle, and you’re comfortable working with event data, SQL and data warehouses such as BigQuery.
  • Technical ownership. You’ve delivered complex projects with minimal supervision, broken them into short feedback loops (analyze, design, ship an MVP, learn, iterate), and helped teammates work more effectively.
  • Operational responsibility. You’ve been on call, supported software in production, and know how to make systems observable and debuggable.
  • Pragmatic AI usage. You use AI coding tools thoughtfully, validate their output, and share practices that improve the team’s speed and quality.
  • Clear communication. You can explain technical and statistical tradeoffs to engineers, analysts and product managers in a fully remote, asynchronous environment.

Bonus Points For:

  • Hands-on experience with feature flags and OpenFeature.
  • A working understanding of experiment statistics: Bayesian or frequentist testing, sample sizing, variance reduction, and common pitfalls such as peeking and sample ratio mismatch.
  • Experience with Kubernetes concepts: custom resources, operators, admission webhooks, GitOps.
  • Experience building Grafana plugins or apps, or with the Grafana App SDK or Scenes.
  • Familiarity with frontend observability and product analytics tooling, such as Grafana Faro, RUM, session replay, RudderStack or Segment.
  • Open source contribution or maintainership.
  • Experience as a user of Grafana, Prometheus, Loki or Tempo, whether at work or on a homelab.

Compensation & Rewards:

In the UK, the base compensation range for this role is £94,000 - £118,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.

At In Tandem, we build technology that helps families manage everyday routines and navigate life’s biggest transitions. Through our four brands—OurFamilyWizard, Cozi, FamilyWall, and Custody Navigator—we help families stay organized, communicate well, and foster healthy childhoods.

We believe technology should strengthen relationships and make daily coordination less complicated. Everything we create is designed to lighten the mental load, reduce conflict, and support families through big and small moments.
If you want your work to make a real difference in the daily lives of parents and kids, In Tandem is the place where your impact will truly matter.

As a Finance Automation Engineer, you'll help fundamentally reinvent how our finance and accounting function operates. You'll work directly with our accounting team to replace repetitive manual processes with automated, reliable, and auditable workflows. This is a builder role dedicated to finance. This isn't a traditional accounting role, and it isn't a conventional ERP engineering position. You'll be an engineer embedded in Finance, using modern development tools, AI, and automation to build systems that scale with the business. We're equally interested in an accountant who learned to build software and an engineer who developed a passion for finance. What matters most is your ability to turn complex, manual processes into working technology.

What you will accomplish:

  • Reinvent the monthly close. Build automated workflows for reconciliations, journal-entry preparation, accruals, intercompany accounting, and financial reporting, allowing accountants to focus on judgment and exceptions rather than repetitive execution.
  • Build with AI at the center of your workflow. Use modern AI development tools such as Claude Code and similar technologies to accelerate software development. Identify opportunities to incorporate AI into accounting operations where it can improve accuracy, efficiency, or decision-making.
  • Connect our finance systems. Design and maintain integrations between NetSuite, Avalara, AP platforms, banking systems, and other data sources using APIs, scripts, and automation tools. Eliminate unnecessary spreadsheet exports and manual data transfers.
  • Build reliable financial data pipelines. Develop automated data extraction, transformation, validation, and reporting workflows. Establish accurate, consistent financial data that can support both accounting operations and management reporting.

  • Continuously improve how Finance operates. Evaluate new technologies, challenge outdated processes, and help build a finance organization capable of supporting substantially greater scale without proportionate increases in manual effort.

Who you are:

  • Comfortable with both technology and business processes. You understand that great automation requires knowing not just how a process works, but why it exists.
  • Independent and resourceful. You don't need a detailed specification to get started. You're comfortable discovering problems, building prototypes, and iterating toward production-ready solutions.
  • Practical rather than dogmatic. You know when to build custom software, when to use an existing platform, and when AI introduces unnecessary complexity.
  • Rigorous about accuracy. You understand that financial automations need strong controls, repeatable results, and clear accountability.

What you bring:

  • Experience building automation, integrations, data pipelines, or data models in a business-systems, finance-systems, or analytics-engineering capacity

  • Understanding of core finance/accounting concepts (month-end close, GAAP, reconciliations), whether from a finance background, a technical role embedded in a finance team, or genuine self-teaching

We are entering an aggressive growth phase — expanding our product surface, deepening our platform capabilities, and accelerating our delivery velocity. We need senior-caliber Node.js developers who can own significant parts of our architecture and ship production code that enterprise customers depend on daily.

This is not a staff augmentation seat. You will work directly with engineering leadership, product managers, and the CEO. Your decisions will have real consequences, your opinions will be heard, and your craftsmanship will be visible to the customers who rely on our platform.

What You’ll Build

  • Modern front-end experiences using Vue.js and TypeScript that serve demanding enterprise users

Requirements

Non-Negotiable Technical Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional Node.js development in production environments — not tutorials, not side projects, not bootcamp exercises. Real production systems serving real users at scale.
  • Expert-level understanding of asynchronous programming, event loops, streams, and the Node.js runtime. You should be able to explain backpressure, the differences between setImmediate and process.nextTick, and why unhandled promise rejections are dangerous — without Googling it.
  • Deep experience with TypeScript in production codebases. We write typed code, and we expect you to understand why.
  • Strong command of RESTful API design, authentication patterns (OAuth 2.0, JWT), and API security best practices for enterprise environments.
  • Proven experience with SQL and NoSQL databases, query optimization, data modeling, and understanding the performance implications of schema decisions at scale.

  • Familiarity with DevOps/DevSecOps toolchains and practices in the Salesforce ecosystem.

The Kind of Person We’re Looking For

Skills get you in the door. Mindset determines whether you thrive here:

Missionary, Not Mercenary

You care about what you’re building and why. You take ownership not because someone assigned it to you, but because that’s who you are. When something is broken at 2 AM, you don’t check whether it’s “your responsibility” — you fix it.

Builder, Not a Bystander

You don’t wait for perfect specifications. You dig in, ask hard questions, propose solutions, and ship. You would rather have a working prototype by Friday than a polished slide deck by next quarter.

Craftsperson Under Pressure

Enterprise customers depend on our uptime and data integrity. You write code that doesn’t just work — it survives. You understand that in regulated industries, your code is your reputation.

Direct Communicator

jobs.excerpt: We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production.
jobs.description:
We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production. That means orchestrating multi-step workflows with retries, skips, and parallel execution; keeping long-running work persistent and observable; and serving per-tenant retrieval at scale. This isn't about wrapping an LLM in an API call, it's the hard backend engineering that makes agents dependable.

Our stack is Python (FastAPI) on AWS, with Terraform. We hire on engineering depth and judgment, not on a keyword count, and we work in whichever language you're strongest in during the interview (more below). As a Senior Engineer, you will own backend services and the orchestration layer on top of them, from design through deployment, operation, and the on-call that follows.

Our team is based in Tehran and pays salaries monthly in USD.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and own backend services and the agent-orchestration layer end to end.

  • Build resilient systems that stay correct under load and degrade gracefully when a model, tool, or dependency fails.

  • Ensure operational excellence by making long-running, multi-step work observable and debuggable in production.

  • Shape technical direction through rigorous code reviews, mentorship, and pushing back on specifications when they misalign with engineering reality.

  • Drive the full software development lifecycle, translating ambiguous requirements into durable architectures and actionable technical plans.

What We Are Looking For:

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems, with deep ownership of at least one non-trivial service you can talk through end to end.

  • Deep fluency in your primary backend language, and the ability to pick up a new one fast. We work in Python; if it is not your daily language today, we expect you to ramp quickly.

  • Strong systems fundamentals — concurrency, data modeling, and failure modes — and the judgment to choose the right abstraction rather than the cleverest one.

  • Sound reasoning under ambiguity: you ask the clarifying question first, make the trade-offs explicit, and adapt when the constraints change.

  • Solid grasp of infrastructure and operations, including message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), SQL and NoSQL stores, and running services in containers with an orchestrator (Kubernetes, ECS, Nomad, or similar).

  • Professional written English, enabling you to write crisp design documents and align stakeholders on complex technical trade-offs.

Even Better:

  • AWS (especially ECS) and Terraform, or comparable cloud and Infrastructure-as-Code experience.

  • Hands-on work with LLM, agentic, or RAG systems (LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs, Hugging Face) and a real grasp of how non-deterministic agent steps differ from ordinary functions.

  • A recognized-bar engineering background, owned open-source work, or another verifiable standout signal.

How We Hire:

We use a deliberate, transparent two-stage process designed to see how you think and build:

  • 1. A 120-minute conversation focusing on your background and a collaborative system-design exercise and cultural fit..

  • 2. A 120-minute live technical session involving code review, live coding, and a self-review.

You may complete the technical session in your strongest language (Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, PHP, or TypeScript/Node.js). Web search is encouraged; AI assistants are not used. We want to see your fundamental engineering judgment.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive USD-based salary and a comprehensive benefits package.

  • Hybrid work flexibility with hours that support deep work.

  • The opportunity to work at the frontier of agentic AI, tackling hard problems with high ownership.

  • A highly educated, agile senior team that values pragmatism, learning, and continuous improvement.

If you would rather be judged on how you think than on a buzzword list, we would like to talk!

Responsibilities include:

  • Define, implement and maintain data quality checks (completeness, accuracy, validity, timeliness, uniqueness) across ingestion pipelines, dynamic tables and reporting layers in Snowflake.
  • Monitor data observability alerts (freshness, volume, schema change, distribution drift), triage incidents, and route root causes to the owning team with clear evidence.

  • Experience with a BI or reporting tool (e.g., Omni, Tableau, Power BI, Looker).

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable batch and streaming data pipelines using Databricks, Apache Spark, PySpark, and Spark SQL.
  • Build and manage Delta Lake tables using the medallion (bronze/silver/gold) architecture to deliver reliable, analytics-ready data.
  • Develop real-time and near-real-time data ingestion solutions using Spark Structured Streaming and messaging platforms such as Kafka.
  • Configure and manage Databricks clusters, jobs, and workflows in production environments.
  • Implement data governance, access controls, and security best practices using Unity Catalog.
  • Integrate data from a variety of source systems and destinations, supporting ETL/ELT and pipeline orchestration activities.
  • Optimize existing data workflows and Spark jobs for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency.
  • Integrate Databricks development with CI/CD pipelines and enterprise SDLC tooling, including Git-based version control.
  • Collaborate with data scientists and analysts to define data models and support machine learning and AI use cases, including model lifecycle management with MLflow.
  • Support advanced analytics use cases such as anomaly detection, risk scoring, and fraud analytics.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot data processing jobs, implementing data quality checks and observability to ensure high availability.
  • Document data processes, frameworks, pipelines, and data mappings for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Work closely with scrum teams, product owners, and client stakeholders to deliver end-to-end data solutions.
  • Stay current on Databricks platform capabilities and industry trends to recommend best-fit tools and technologies.

Requirements

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 4+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or big data development.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience with the Databricks platform.
  • Proficiency in Apache Spark, PySpark, and Spark SQL.
  • Experience with Databricks clusters, jobs/workflows, Delta Lake, and Unity Catalog in production environments.
  • Experience with medallion architecture and Spark Structured Streaming.
  • Strong Python and SQL skills for data engineering and data analysis.
  • Experience with ETL/ELT processes and data pipeline orchestration.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud and their native data services.
  • Experience integrating data solutions with CI/CD pipelines and Git-based version control workflows.
  • Understanding of data governance, security, and access control best practices.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust determination.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience with Synapse Pipelines, Azure Data Factory, Starburst, Azure Data Lake Service, Collibra for data cataloging, Azure ML/AI services, and Pyramid Analytics/Power BI for visualization.

Preferred Qualifications

  • ﻿Databricks certification (e.g., Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate/Professional) or cloud platform certification.
  • Experience implementing ML or AI solutions in Databricks, including MLflow-based model lifecycle management.
  • Knowledge of machine learning, AI, or Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques, including text mining.
  • Experience supporting fraud analytics, risk scoring, or anomaly detection.
  • Experience with distributed data and streaming tools such as Kafka, Hadoop, Hive, or Amazon EMR.
  • Experience with data quality frameworks and observability/monitoring tooling.
  • Experience with NoSQL databases.
  • Experience with visualization packages such as Plotly, Seaborn, or ggplot2.
  • Experience supporting federal government or regulated-industry programs, especially the Department of Veterans Affairs.
